original: atha tatrabhavānbhavabhūtiḥ kīrtyādisatkāvyanirmāṇaprayojanaprāptaye prekṣyaprabandhabhedanāṭyapradhānaṃ prakaraṇaṃ sāṅgaṃ mālatīmādhavaṃ nāma rūpakamātatāna/ tatra prakaraṇalakṣaṇaṃ bharate - ``tatra kavirājabudhdyā vastuśarīraṃ ca nāyakaṃ caiva/ svayamutpādya viracayettajjñeyaṃ prakaraṇaṃ nāma//'' iti/
analyzed: atha tatrabhavān bhavabhūtiḥ kīrti ādi sat kāvya nirmāṇa prayojana prāptaye prekṣya prabandha bheda nāṭya pradhānam prakaraṇam sāṅgam mālatīmādhavam nāma rūpakam ātatāna tatra prakaraṇa lakṣaṇam bharate tatra kavi rāja budhdyā vastu śarīram ca nāyakam ca eva svayam utpādya viracayet tat jñeyam prakaraṇam nāma iti

original: daśarūpako'pi - ``atha prakaraṇe vṛttamutpādyaṃ lokasaṃśrayam/ amātyavipravaṇijāmekaṃ kuryāttu nāyakam// dhīrapraśāntaṃ sopāyaṃ dharmakāmārthatatparam/ śeṣaṃ nāṭakavatsaṃdhipraveśakarasādikam//'' iti/ tatra nāṭyopakrame vighnopaśāntaye kuśīlavaiḥ pūrvaraṅgaḥ kriyate/ taduktam - ``prathamaṃ pūrvaraṅgaśca tataḥ prastāvaneti ca/
analyzed: daśarūpakā upi atha prakaraṇe vṛttam utpādyam loka saṃśrayam amātya vipra vaṇijām ekam kuryāt tu nāyakam dhīra praśāntam sa upāyam dharma kāma artha tatparam śeṣam nāṭaka vat saṃdhi praveśaka rasa ādikam iti tatra nāṭya upakrame vighna upaśāntaye kuśīlavaiḥ pūrvaraṅgaḥ kriyate tat uktam prathamam pūrvaraṅgaḥ ca tatas prastāvanā iti ca

original: ārambhe sarvanāṭyānāmetatsāmānyamiṣyate// yannāṭyavastunaḥ pūrvaṃ raṅgavighnopaśāntaye/ kuśīlavāḥ prakurvanti pūrvaraṅgaḥ sa kīrtitaḥ//'' iti/ tatra cānuṣṭhitabharatopadiṣṭapūrvaraṅgāṅgakalāpena sūtradhāreṇa pāṭhyāṅgabhūtā nāndī prayoktavyā/ taduktam - ``yadyapyaṅgāni bhūyāṃsi pūrvaraṅgasya nāṭake/
analyzed: ārambhe sarva nāṭyānām etat sāmānyam iṣyate yat nāṭya vastunaḥ pūrvam raṅga vighna upaśāntaye kuśīlavāḥ prakurvanti pūrvaraṅgaḥ sa kīrtitaḥ iti tatra ca anuṣṭhita bharata upadiṣṭa pūrvaraṅga aṅga kalāpena sūtradhāreṇa pāṭhya aṅga bhūtā nāndī prayoktavyā tat uktam yadi api aṅgāni bhūyāṃsi pūrvaraṅgasya nāṭake

original: teṣāmavaśyaṃ kartavyā nāndī nandīśvarapriyā//'' iti/ nāndīlakṣaṇaṃ tu - ``āśīrnamaskriyārūpaḥ ślokaḥ kāvyamukhoditaḥ/ nāndīti kathyate tasyāṃ padādiniyamo'pi vā// māṅgalyā śaṅkhacakrābjakokakairavaśaṃsinī/ nāndī padairdvādaśabhiraṣṭābhirvāpyalaṃkṛtā//'' iti/ ``api vā'' iti padāniyamapakṣopakṣepaḥ/
analyzed: teṣām avaśyam kartavyā nāndī nandīśvara priyā iti nāndī lakṣaṇam tu āśīḥ namaskriyā rūpaḥ ślokaḥ kāvya mukha uditaḥ nāndī iti kathyate tasyām pada ādi niyamaḥ api vā māṅgalyā śaṅkha cakra abja koka kairava śaṃsinī nāndī padaiḥ dvādaśabhiḥ aṣṭābhiḥ vā api alaṃkṛtā iti api vā iti pada aniyama pakṣa upakṣepaḥ

original: tathāha vidyānāthaḥ - ``kaiścinnāndyāṃ padaniyamo nābhyupagataḥ'' iti/ tatra kaviścikīrṣitasya prakaraṇasyāvighnaparisamāptaye viśiṣṭeṣṭadevatānamaskāralakṣaṇaṃ maṅgalamācaranpūrvaraṅgāṅgabhūtāmaṣṭapadātmikāmāśīralaṃkṛtāṃ nāndīṃ sūtradhāraprayojyāṃ tāvadāha - cūḍeti/ eṣā ca ``saṃdigdhamugdhendavaḥ'' iti candranāmāṅkitā nāndī/
analyzed: tathā āha vidyānāthaḥ kaiścid nāndyām pada niyamaḥ na abhyupagataḥ iti tatra kaviḥ cikīrṣitasya prakaraṇasya avighna parisamāptaye viśiṣṭa iṣṭadevatā namaskāra lakṣaṇam maṅgalam ācaran pūrvaraṅga aṅga bhūtām aṣṭa pada ātmikām āśīḥ alaṃkṛtām nāndīm sūtradhāra prayojyām tāvat āha cūḍā iti eṣā ca saṃdigdha mugdha indavaḥ iti candra nāma aṅkitā nāndī

original: taduktam - ``candranāmāṅkitā kāryā rasānāṃ sa yato nidhiḥ/ prīte candramasi sphītā rasaśrīriti vālukiḥ//'' iti/ ayamarthaḥ - bhūteśasya jaṭāḥ pāntviti saṃbandhaḥ/ tā viśinaṣṭi - cūḍeti/ cūḍā śikhā/ ``śikhā cūḍā keśapāśaḥ'' ityamaraḥ/ tayā ca svāśrayabhūtaṃ śiro lakṣyate/ kapālamālikāyāḥ śirobhūṣaṇatvāt/ tasyāpīḍastatra tiryaṅnaddhā srak/
analyzed: tat uktam candra nāma aṅkitā kāryā rasānām sa yatas nidhiḥ prīte candramasi sphītā rasa śrīḥ iti vālukiḥ iti ayam arthaḥ bhūteśasya jaṭāḥ pāntu iti saṃbandhaḥ tāḥ viśinaṣṭi cūḍā iti cūḍā śikhā śikhā cūḍā keśapāśaḥ iti amaraḥ tayā ca svāśraya bhūtam śiraḥ lakṣyate kapāla mālikāyāḥ śiraḥ bhūṣaṇa tvāt tasya āpīḍaḥ tatra tiryak naddhā srak

original: ``āpīḍaśekharottasāvataṃsāḥ śirasi srajaḥ'' iti halāyudhaḥ/ āpīḍaśabdenaiva śiraḥsraguktāvapi cūḍāśabdastatsaṃnidhānapratītyarthaḥ/ karṇāvataṃsavat/ yathāhuḥ - ``karṇāvataṃsādipadaiḥ karṇādidhvaninirmitaḥ/ saṃnidhānapratītyartham'' iti/ tatra kapālāḥ/ tadgrathitatvādāpīḍasya/
analyzed: āpīḍa śekhara uttasa avataṃsāḥ śirasi srajaḥ iti halāyudhaḥ āpīḍa śabdena eva śiraḥ sraj uktau api cūḍā śabdaḥ tad saṃnidhāna pratīti arthaḥ karṇa avataṃsa vat yathā āhuḥ karṇa avataṃsa ādi padaiḥ karṇa ādi dhvani nirmitaḥ saṃnidhāna pratīti artham iti tatra kapālāḥ tad grathita tvāt āpīḍasya

original: teṣu saṃkulaṃ vyāptaṃ galatatpūraṇādadhaḥsravacca mandākinyāḥśaṃbhuśirogaṅgāyā vāridhārā yāsu tāḥ/ taḍittulyenālikanetratejasā sājātyādviśeṣeṇa miśrībhūtā dīptiryāsāṃ tāḥ/ komalayā ketakagarbhadroṇyā saha saṃdigdhaḥ samānākṛtivarṇatvātkiṃ ketakaśikheyamuta śaśirekheti saṃdehagocaro mugdho manohara induryāsu tāḥ/
analyzed: teṣu saṃkulam vyāptam gala tad pūraṇāt adhas sravat ca mandākinyāḥ śaṃbhuśiraḥ gaṅgāyāḥ vāri dhārāḥ yāsu tāḥ taḍit tulyena alika netra tejasā sājātyāt viśeṣeṇa miśrībhūtā dīptiḥ yāsām tāḥ komalayā ketaka garbha droṇyā saha saṃdigdhaḥ samāna ākṛti varṇa tvāt kim ketaka śikhā iyam uta śaśi rekhā iti saṃdeha gocaraḥ mugdhaḥ manoharaḥ induḥ yāsu tāḥ

original: jaṭīkṛtya baddhāsu jūṭīkṛtāsu viprakīrṇāsu/ ekasyāścandrakalāyāstirodhānaprasaṅgena ketakaśikhāsaṃśayajanakatvāyogāt/ bhujaṅgā eva vallayo latāstābhireva valayairvalayīkṛtaiḥ/ latāsadṛśairiti yāvat/ nirmitayā srajā naddhā jūṭā yāsāṃ tā iti/ atra rūpakasaṃdehānuviddhā svabhāvoktiralaṃkāraḥ/ tallakṣaṇāni tu vistarabhayānna likhyante/
analyzed: jaṭīkṛtya baddhāsu jūṭīkṛtāsu viprakīrṇāsu ekasyāḥ candra kalāyāḥ tirodhāna prasaṅgena ketaka śikhā saṃśaya janaka tva ayogāt bhujaṅgāḥ eva vallayaḥ latāḥ tābhiḥ eva valayaiḥ valayīkṛtaiḥ latā sadṛśaiḥ iti yāvat nirmitayā srajā naddhāḥ jūṭāḥ yāsām tāḥ iti atra rūpaka saṃdeha anuviddhā svabhāvoktiḥ alaṃkāraḥ tad lakṣaṇāni tu vistara bhayāt na likhyante

original: atreśvarasya jaṭājūṭālaṃkṛtasya praśāntākārapratīterdhīraśāntaḥ kathānāyakaḥ sūcitaḥ/ jaṭā iti kartṛbahutvena nāyakanāyikābahutvam, bhūteśasyaityaupasarjanyena jaṭā iti svātantryeṇa nāyakasya svaprayojananirvāhe'nyapāratantryam, kāmandakyāditapasvinījanasyaiva tatkāryanirvahaṇanirantarodyogitvaṃ sūcitamiti manākkāvyārthasamunmeṣa ūhyaḥ//1//
analyzed: atra īśvarasya jaṭā jūṭa alaṃkṛtasya praśānta ākāra pratīteḥ dhīra śāntaḥ kathā nāyakaḥ sūcitaḥ jaṭāḥ iti kartṛ bahutvena nāyaka nāyikā bahutvam bhūteśasya eti aupasarjanyena jaṭāḥ iti svātantryeṇa nāyakasya sva prayojana nirvāheni apāratantryam kāmandakī ādi tapasvinī janasya eva tad kārya nirvahaṇa nirantara udyogi tvam sūcitam iti manāk kāvya artha samunmeṣaḥ ūhyaḥ

original: pracitādeva maṅgalāttādṛgantarāyanirāsaṃ matvāha - sānandamiti/ vināyakasya saṃbandhīni mukhavidhūnanāni pāntu/ vināyakasya vighnarājatvāttanmukhavidhūnanāni pratyūhanivartakānītyāśayaḥ/
analyzed: pracitāt eva maṅgalāt tādṛś antarāya nirāsam matvā āha sa ānandam iti vināyakasya saṃbandhīni mukha vidhūnanāni pāntu vināyakasya vighna rāja tvāt tad mukha vidhūnanāni pratyūha nivartakāni iti āśayaḥ

original: teṣu nimittamāha - śūlapāṇestāṇḍave nandikaravādyamānamurajadhvaninā ghanagarjitasadṛśenāhūtātskandavāhanamayūrāttrāso bhayaṃ tasmādbhogasaṃkocabhāji sūkṣmarandhrapraveśasidhdyarthaṃ saṃkucitaśarīre phaṇipatāvupavītīkṛte/ nāsāgrarandhraṃ puṣkaravivaraṃ sānandaṃ yathā bhavati tathā/ tadaiva saṃnihitavivaralābhāt/ viśati sati/ kīdṛśyaḥ/
analyzed: teṣu nimittam āha śūlapāṇeḥ tāṇḍave nandikara vādyamāna muraja dhvaninā ghana garjita sadṛśena āhūtāt skanda vāhana mayūrāt trāsaḥ bhayam tasmāt bhoga saṃkoca bhāji sūkṣma randhra praveśa sidhdi artham saṃkucita śarīre phaṇipatau upavītīkṛte nāsā agra randhram puṣkara vivaram sa ānandam yathā bhavati tathā tadā eva saṃnihita vivara lābhāt viśati sati kīdṛśyaḥ

original: kapolatalotthitamadhukaramālāmukharitadiśaḥ/ cītkāro'nukaraṇaśabdastatsahitāḥ/ kāvyaliṅgamalaṃkāraḥ// etābhyāṃ ślokābhyāṃ jaladharasamayaprārambhaḥ sūcyate/ tasya nirvahaṇasaṃdhau vakṣyamāṇatvāt/ mukhasaṃdhisūcitasyaiva nirvoḍhavyatvāt/
analyzed: kapola tala utthita madhukara mālā mukharita diśaḥ cītkāraḥ anukaraṇa śabdaḥ tad sahitāḥ kāvya liṅgam alaṃkāraḥ etābhyām ślokābhyām jaladhara samaya prārambhaḥ sūcyate tasya nirvahaṇa saṃdhau vakṣyamāṇa tvāt mukha saṃdhi sūcitasya eva nirvoḍhavya tvāt

original: tatra kapāletyanena balākāvaliḥ, jalakṣaraṇena vṛṣṭiḥ, vidyudityanena ca vidyut, ketakaśikhetyanena ketakodgamaḥ, bhujagavalayabaddhajaṭāpaṭalatvena jaladodayaḥ, murajadhvānena garjitaśabdaḥ, kaumārabarhīti mayūraharṣaśca sūcyata iti kecidvyācakṣate/ tadetacchabdaśaktyā pratīyate'rthaśaktyā veti ta eva jānanti/
analyzed: tatra kapāla iti anena balākā āvaliḥ jala kṣaraṇena vṛṣṭiḥ vidyut iti anena ca vidyut ketaka śikhā iti anena ketaka udgamaḥ bhujaga valaya baddha jaṭā paṭala tvena jalada udayaḥ muraja dhvānena garjita śabdaḥ kaumārabarhi iti mayūra harṣaḥ ca sūcyate iti kecid vyācakṣate tat etat śabda śaktyā pratīyate irtha śaktyā vā iti te eva jānanti

original: natvete śabdāḥ prakṛtārthaniyantritā api śaktyantarabalādanvitamarthāntaraṃ pratyāyayantīti kasyacidvyutpannasya pratītiḥ/ artho'pi prakṛto naitādṛśasyārthāntarasya pratītau samartho'nubhūyate sahṛdayaiḥ/ kathāṃśānāmeva nirvahaṇe nirūpyamāṇānāṃ mukhasaṃdhau sūcananirbandhaḥ/ na tu tatra vakṣyamāṇasya sarvartuvarṇanāderapi/
analyzed: na tu ete śabdāḥ prakṛta artha niyantritāḥ api śakti antara balāt anvitam artha antaram pratyāyayanti iti kasyacid vyutpannasya pratītiḥ arthaḥ api prakṛtaḥ na etādṛśasya artha antarasya pratītau samarthaḥ nubhūyate sahṛdayaiḥ kathā aṃśānām eva nirvahaṇe nirūpyamāṇānām mukha saṃdhau sūcana nirbandhaḥ na tu tatra vakṣyamāṇasya sarva ṛtu varṇana ādeḥ api

original: tato naiṣo'rthaḥ kavervivakṣagocaro'pi/ tasmānnāyaṃ dhvanimārgavidāṃ panthāḥ//2//
analyzed: tatas na eṣaḥ ṛthaḥ kaveḥ vivakṣa gocaraḥ api tasmāt na ayam dhvani mārga vidām panthāḥ

original: ``dantaśreṇiṣu'' ityādi ślokadvayaṃ prakṣiptamiti pūrvairavyākṛtamapi kvacitpustakeṣu dṛṣṭatvādasmābhirvyākhyāyate - danteti/ cūḍāsravantyūrmayaḥ śironadītaraṅgā vaḥ pāntu/ brahmakapālakaṃdaraparispandolbaṇā vidhiśiraḥkaroṭipariskhalanaprabhūtāḥ/ dantapaṅktiṣu saṃgalantyaḥ kṣarantyaḥ kalakalasahitena vyāvartanena paribhramaṇena vyākulāḥ/
analyzed: danta śreṇiṣu ityādi śloka dvayam prakṣiptam iti pūrvaiḥ avyākṛtam api kvacid pustakeṣu dṛṣṭa tvāt asmābhiḥ vyākhyāyate danta iti cūḍā sravanti ūrmayaḥ śiraḥ nadī taraṅgāḥ vaḥ pāntu brahma kapāla kaṃdara parispanda ulbaṇāḥ vidhi śiraḥ karoṭi pariskhalana prabhūtāḥ danta paṅktiṣu saṃgalantyaḥ kṣarantyaḥ kalakala sahitena vyāvartanena paribhramaṇena vyākulāḥ

original: nāsādisuṣirapradeśeṣu budbudaśabdavatyaḥ/ gaṇḍasthalābhighātādviśīrṇā atyunnatapradeśādadho viṣamasthale patantyaḥ nirbharavāridhārā yāsāṃ tāḥ/ svabhāvoktiralaṃkāraḥ//3//
analyzed: nāsā ādi suṣira pradeśeṣu budbuda śabdavatyaḥ gaṇḍa sthala abhighātāt viśīrṇāḥ ati unnata pradeśāt adhas viṣama sthale patantyaḥ nirbhara vāri dhārāḥ yāsām tāḥ svabhāvoktiḥ alaṃkāraḥ

original: pakṣmeti/ tṛtīyameva tārtīyīkam/ ``tṛtīyādīkak svārthe vaktavyaḥ'' itīkak/ madanaploṣaṇaṃ smaradāhi locanaṃ vo'vatu/ kīdṛk/ yatpakṣmapaṅktipiṅgalatāyāḥ sarvo'pi taḍitsaṃgho leśaḥ/ kālo mṛtyureva yajvā/ īṣadvighaṭitamukule kiṃcidunmīlite/ yasminnāhavanīyasthāne jagaddhutavān/
analyzed: pakṣma iti tṛtīyam eva tārtīyīkam tṛtīyāt īkak svārthe vaktavyaḥ iti īkak madana ploṣaṇam smara dāhi locanam vaḥ vatu kīdṛś yat pakṣma paṅkti piṅgala tāyāḥ sarvaḥ api taḍit saṃghaḥ leśaḥ kālaḥ mṛtyuḥ eva yajvā īṣat vighaṭita mukule kiṃcid unmīlite yasmin āhavanīya sthāne jagat hutavān

original: jvālāsaṃtāpitaśiraścandrakalāsudhādhārānipātena prataptāyasi jalabindusecaneneva śātkāriprāntam/ udāttālaṃkāraḥ//4//
analyzed: jvālā saṃtāpita śiraḥ candra kalā sudhā dhārā nipātena pratapta ayasi jala bindu secanena iva śātkāri prāntam udātta alaṃkāraḥ

original: atha prastāvanāṃ vivakṣustadaṅgayoḥ prarocanāmukhayoḥ prathamaṃ prarocanāṃ prastauti - nāndyanta iti/ kṛtapūrvaraṅge prathamapraviṣṭe sūtradhāre nāndīṃ paṭhitvāvaśiṣṭaṃ ca pratyāhāramārjanālepanādipūrvaraṅgāṅgakalāpaṃ niṣpādya vinirgate tatsadṛśo'nyaḥ sūtradhāraḥ praviśya prastāvayatītyarthaḥ/
analyzed: atha prastāvanām vivakṣuḥ tad aṅgayoḥ prarocanā mukhayoḥ prathamam prarocanām prastauti nāndī ante iti kṛta pūrvaraṅge prathama praviṣṭe sūtradhāre nāndīm paṭhitvā avaśiṣṭam ca pratyāhāra mārjana ālepana ādi pūrvaraṅga aṅga kalāpam niṣpādya vinirgate tad sadṛśaḥ nyaḥ sūtradhāraḥ praviśya prastāvayati iti arthaḥ

original: taduktaṃ daśarūpake - ``pūrvaraṅgaṃ vidhāyādau sūtradhāre vinirgate/ praviśya tadvadaparaḥ kāvyamākhyāpayennaṭaḥ//'' iti/ prarocanāmukhalakṣaṇaṃ tu - ``nivedanaṃ prayojyasya nirdeśo deśakālayoḥ/ kāvyārthasūcakaiḥ śabdaiḥ sabhāyāścittarañjanam// kavikāvyanaṭādīnāṃ praśaṃsā ca prarocanā//'' ādiśabdena sabhāvastunāyakānāṃ grahaṇam/
analyzed: tat uktam daśarūpake pūrvaraṅgam vidhāya ādau sūtradhāre vinirgate praviśya tadvat aparaḥ kāvyam ākhyāpayet naṭaḥ iti prarocanā mukha lakṣaṇam tu nivedanam prayojyasya nirdeśaḥ deśa kālayoḥ kāvya artha sūcakaiḥ śabdaiḥ sabhāyāḥ citta rañjanam kavi kāvya naṭa ādīnām praśaṃsā ca prarocanā ādi śabdena sabhā vastu nāyakānām grahaṇam

original: ``sūtradhāro naṭīṃ brūte māriṣaṃ vā vidūṣakam/ svakāryaprastutākṣepi citroktyā yattadāmukham//'' iti alamiti/ aŸŸŸ dīśloka ŸŸkaṃ pūrvasūtriṇaṃ prati vilāsamasahamānasyoktiḥ/ prabhātakālaṃ nirdiśati - uditeti/ bhūyasā maṇḍalena bhāgenoditaḥ/ uditakalpa iti bhāvaḥ/ upatiṣṭhe stotreṇārādhayāmi/ ``pathyārādhanayośca'' ityātmanepadam/
analyzed: sūtradhāraḥ naṭīm brūte māriṣam vā vidūṣakam sva kārya prastuta ākṣepi citra uktyā iti alam iti pūrva sūtriṇam prati vilāsam asahamānasya uktiḥ prabhāta kālam nirdiśati udita iti bhūyasā maṇḍalena bhāgena uditaḥ udita kalpaḥ iti bhāvaḥ upatiṣṭhe stotreṇa ārādhayāmi pathya ārādhanayoḥ ca iti ātmanepadam

original: tathā karoti - kalyāṇānāmiti/ viśvamūrte sarvātmaka/ ``sūrya ātmā jagatastasthuṣaśca'' iti śruteḥ/ tvaṃ kalyāṇānāṃ maṅgalarūpāṇāṃ tejasāṃ sthānamasi/ mayi dhuryāṃ sakalasaukhyasaṃpādanasamarthāṃ lakṣmīṃ dhehi prasannobhava/ yadyaditi vīpsayā prakārakārtsnyamabhipraiti/
analyzed: tathā karoti kalyāṇānām iti viśvamūrte sarva ātmaka sūryaḥ ātmā jagataḥ tasthuṣaḥ ca iti śruteḥ tvam kalyāṇānām maṅgala rūpāṇām tejasām sthānam asi mayi dhuryām sakala saukhya saṃpādana samarthām lakṣmīm dhehi prasannaḥ bhava yat yat iti vīpsayā prakāra kārtsnyam abhipraiti

original: yena kenacidrūpeṇa sthitaṃ sarvaprakāraṃ yatpāpamasti namrasya me tathābhūtaṃ sarvaprakāraṃ pāpaṃ pratijahi nivartaya/ atra yadyaditi vīpsayā yādṛśo'rtha uktastasyaiva prakṛtaparāmarśinā tacchabdenopādānānna dvitīyastacchabdo'pekṣita ityāhuḥ/ tena pūrvavākye yacchabdadvayadarśanāttaduttaravākye tacchabdadvayaṃ draṣṭavyamityapavyākhyānam/
analyzed: yena kenacid rūpeṇa sthitam sarva prakāram yat pāpam asti namrasya me tathābhūtam sarva prakāram pāpam pratijahi nivartaya atra yat yat iti vīpsayā yādṛśaḥ arthaḥ uktaḥ tasya eva prakṛta parāmarśinā tad śabdena upādānāt na dvitīyaḥ tad śabda upekṣitaḥ iti āhuḥ tena pūrva vākye yad śabda dvaya darśanāt tat uttara vākye tad śabda dvayam draṣṭavyam iti apavyākhyānam

original: bhagavan, bahuprakāraṃ maṅgalaṃ bhūyase maṅgalāya vitara/ maṅgalānubandhīni maṅgalāni prayacchetyarthaḥ/ iyaṃ kāvyārthasūcakena ślokena saṃskṛtaprāyavāgvyavahārarūpā bhāratī vṛttiḥ/ prarocanāṅgaṃ kāvyārthasūcanaṃ ca/ kathānāyakatanmitrādīnāmaniṣṭaparihāreṣṭaprāptipratīteḥ/ tathāpi yadyadityaghoraghaṇṭaśārdūlanandanādikṛtopadravanirdeśaḥ/
analyzed: bhagavan bahu prakāram maṅgalam bhūyase maṅgalāya vitara maṅgala anubandhīni maṅgalāni prayaccha iti arthaḥ iyam kāvya artha sūcakena ślokena saṃskṛta prāya vāc vyavahāra rūpā bhāratī vṛttiḥ prarocanā aṅgam kāvya artha sūcanam ca kathā nāyaka tad mitra ādīnām aniṣṭa parihāra iṣṭa prāpti pratīteḥ tathā api yat yat iti aghora ghaṇṭa śārdūla nandana ādi kṛta upadrava nirdeśaḥ

original: bhadraṃ bhadramiti mālatīmadayantikāprāptirūpaṃ maṅgaladvayaṃ sūcitam/ bhūyase maṅgalāyeti kapālakuṇḍalāgṛhītamālatīvipannistāraḥ/ ārakṣagṛhītamādhavamakarandaprāṇarakṣādayaḥ sūcyante//5//
analyzed: bhadram bhadram iti mālatī madayantikā prāpti rūpam maṅgala dvayam sūcitam bhūyase maṅgalāya iti ārakṣa gṛhīta mādhava makaranda prāṇa rakṣā ādayaḥ sūcyante

original: nepathya iti/ nepathyo nāma raṅgasthalasya paścādyavanikāntarito varṇagrahaṇādiyogyakuśīlavakuṭumbāvasthānadeśaḥ/ ``kuśīlavakuṭumbasya sthalī nepathya iṣyate'' iti vacanāt/ māriṣo naṭaḥ// naṭaḥ sūtradhāreṇa māriṣa iti vācyaḥ/ ``sūtrī naṭena bhāveti tenāsau māriṣeti ca'' ityuktatvāt/ suvihitāni sādhu saṃpāditāni/
analyzed: nepathyaḥ iti nepathyaḥ nāma raṅga sthalasya paścādi avanikā antaritaḥ varṇa grahaṇa ādi yogya kuśīlava kuṭumba avasthāna deśaḥ kuśīlava kuṭumbasya sthalī nepathyaḥ iṣyate iti vacanāt māriṣaḥ naṭaḥ naṭaḥ sūtradhāreṇa māriṣaḥ iti vācyaḥ sūtrī naṭena bhāva iti tena asau māriṣa iti ca iti ukta tvāt su vihitāni sādhu saṃpāditāni

original: kālapriyanāthasya mahākālāspadasya śaṃbhoḥ/ nānādeśanivāsītyanena sarvakalāveditvaṃ pariṣado darśayati/ vidagdhapariṣatsaṃnidhau hi prayogakauśalaprakaṭanasyotsāhaḥ/ bharatāstacchāstrādhyetāro naṭāḥ/ kiṃ tarhi taiḥ prayojyamityāha - ādiṣṭo'smīti/ nirdiṣṭaguṇaprabandhamiti/ rañjanīyavidvatpari ŸŸŸ guṇāstacchālinaṃ prabandhamityarthaḥ//
analyzed: kālapriya nāthasya mahākāla āspadasya śaṃbhoḥ nānā deśa nivāsi iti anena sarva kalā vedi tvam pariṣadaḥ darśayati vidagdha pariṣad saṃnidhau hi prayoga kauśala prakaṭanasya utsāhaḥ bharatāḥ tad śāstra adhyetāraḥ naṭāḥ kim tarhi taiḥ prayojyam iti āha ādiṣṭaḥ asmi iti nirdiṣṭa guṇa prabandham iti rañjanīya vidvas pari guṇāḥ tad śālinam prabandham iti arthaḥ

original: āryā iti sarvavidyāsthānavedinaḥ/ miśrā iti pūjyanirdeśaḥ/ bhūmidevā iti tatpradhānatvāt, sabhāyā guṇadoṣavivecanasya ca tadadhīnatvāt, devatātmakatvena teṣāmārādhanīyatvācca/ anena sabhāpraśaṃsā kṛtā// ete yānudāharanti ta ete guṇāḥ ka iti naṭasya praśnaḥ/ tāneva guṇānāha - bhūmneti/
analyzed: āryāḥ iti sarva vidyā sthāna vedinaḥ miśrāḥ iti pūjya nirdeśaḥ bhūmidevāḥ iti tad pradhāna tvāt sabhāyāḥ guṇa doṣa vivecanasya ca tad adhīna tvāt devatā ātmaka tvena teṣām ārādhanīya tvāt ca anena sabhā praśaṃsā kṛtā ete yān udāharanti te ete guṇāḥ kaḥ iti naṭasya praśnaḥ tān eva guṇān āha bhūmnā iti

original: bhūmnā prācuryeṇa rasānāmaṅgāṅgibhāvena niviṣṭānāṃ śṛṅgārādīnāṃ prayogā abhinayā gahanāḥ sthūladarśibhirbhāvayitumaśakyāḥ/ rasānāṃ hi vyañjanena viṣayāṇāmagūḍhatve guṇībhāvaprasaṅgāt/ gūḍhatayaiva kāminīkucakalaśavaditi/ bhāvanāccarvaṇādau sūkṣmamataya eva sahṛdayāḥ samarthāḥ/ na tu padapadārthajñānakṛtārthāḥ paṇḍitaṃmanyāḥ/
analyzed: bhūmnā prācuryeṇa rasānām aṅga aṅgi bhāvena niviṣṭānām śṛṅgāra ādīnām prayogāḥ abhinayāḥ gahanāḥ sthūla darśibhiḥ bhāvayitum aśakyāḥ rasānām hi vyañjanena viṣayāṇām agūḍha tve guṇībhāva prasaṅgāt gūḍha tayā eva kāminī kuca kalaśa vat iti bhāvanāt carvaṇa ādau sūkṣma matayaḥ eva sahṛdayāḥ samarthāḥ na tu pada padārtha jñāna kṛtārthāḥ paṇḍitaṃmanyāḥ

original: yathāha dhvanikṛt - ``śabdārthaśāsanajñānamātreṇaiva na vedyate/ vedyate sa hi kāvyārthatattvajñaireva kevalam//'' iti/ anena rasaikapravaṇatvaṃ prabandhasya jīvitabhūto guṇo darśitaḥ/ tathā sauhārdhena nirupādhikasnehena hṛdyāni manoharāṇi viceṣṭitāni nāyakatanmitrādīnāṃ vyāpārāḥ/ anena dhīrapraśāntanāyakopetatvaṃ nāma guṇo darśitaḥ/
analyzed: yathā āha dhvanikṛt śabda artha śāsana jñāna mātreṇa eva na vedyate vedyate sa hi kāvya artha tattva jñaiḥ eva kevalam iti anena rasa eka pravaṇa tvam prabandhasya jīvita bhūtaḥ guṇaḥ darśitaḥ tathā sauhārdhena nirupādhika snehena hṛdyāni manoharāṇi viceṣṭitāni nāyaka tad mitra ādīnām vyāpārāḥ anena dhīra praśānta nāyaka upeta tvam nāma guṇaḥ darśitaḥ

original: tathā auddhatyaṃ śṛṅgārarasapradhānasyāpi nāyakasya tadvirodhibībhatsādbhutaraudrarasālambanatvam/ tathā āyojitamānukūlyena saṃghaṭitaṃ kāmasūtraṃ nāyikānāyakayoranyonyānurāgabījaṃ yena tādṛśam/ kāmo'nurāgaḥ/ sa eva vartiṣyamāṇasarvakāryabījabhūtatvātsūtramiva sūtram/
analyzed: tathā auddhatyam śṛṅgāra rasa pradhānasya api nāyakasya tad virodhi bībhatsa adbhuta raudra rasa ālambana tvam tathā āyojitam ānukūlyena saṃghaṭitam kāmasūtram nāyikā nāyakayoḥ anyonya anurāga bījam yena tādṛśam kāmaḥ anurāgaḥ saḥ eva vartiṣyamāṇa sarva kārya bīja bhūta tvāt sūtram iva sūtram

original: ayaṃ bhāvaḥ - mahāmāṃsavikrayāghoraghaṇṭādau yadbībhatsaraudraśṛṅgāravirodhirasopādānaṃ tadapi pradhānamālatīlābhalakṣaṇaprayojanānuguṇyena śṛṅgārāṅgabhāvāpattyā virodhaparihāreṇaucityameva saṃpādayatīti/ taduktam - ``vivakṣite rase labdhapratiṣṭhe tu virodhinām/ bhāvānāmaṅgabhāvaṃ vā prāptānāmuktiracchalā//'' iti/
analyzed: ayam bhāvaḥ mahāmāṃsa vikraya aghora ghaṇṭā ādau yat bībhatsa raudra śṛṅgāra virodhi rasa upādānam tat api pradhāna mālatī lābha lakṣaṇa prayojana ānuguṇyena śṛṅgāra aṅgabhāva āpattyā virodha parihāreṇa aucityam eva saṃpādayati iti tat uktam vivakṣite rase labdha pratiṣṭhe tu virodhinām bhāvānām aṅga bhāvam vā prāptānām uktiḥ acchalā iti

original: atra khalvavadhānavatā kavinā bhavitavyam/ yadvirodhirasopādāne'pyanaucityaleśo'pi nāspadaṃ labhate/ yadāha - ``anaucityādṛte nānyadrasabhaṅgasya kāraṇam/ prasiddhaucityabandhastu rasasyopaniṣatparā//'' iti/ anenaucityaśālitvaṃ nāma guṇo darśitaḥ/ kathāścitrāḥ/ vastu punarāścaryajanakamiti vṛttavaicitryaṃ guṇaḥ/ vāci vidagdhatā uktau cāturyam/
analyzed: atra khalu avadhānavatā kavinā bhavitavyam yat virodhi rasa upādāne ipi anaucitya leśaḥ api na āspadam labhate yat āha anaucityāt ṛte na anyat rasa bhaṅgasya kāraṇam prasiddha aucitya bandhaḥ tu rasasya upaniṣad parā iti anena aucityaśāli tvam nāma guṇaḥ darśitaḥ kathāḥ citrāḥ vastu punar āścarya janakam iti vṛtta vaicitryam guṇaḥ vāci vidagdha tā uktau cāturyam

original: nirdoṣaguṇālaṃkārayogo'nena darśitaḥ/ īdṛśaguṇagariṣṭhaprabandhaprayogārthamādiṣṭo'smīti bhāvaḥ//6//
analyzed: nirdoṣa guṇa alaṃkāra yogā ūnena darśitaḥ īdṛśa guṇa gariṣṭha prabandha prayoga artham ādiṣṭaḥ asmi iti bhāvaḥ

original: kasminniti/ ŸŸdṛśaḥ prabandhaḥ prāyeṇa lakṣyata ityāśayaḥ// smṛtamiti/ asti kaścidīdṛśaḥ prabandho mayedānīṃ diṣṭyā smṛta iti bhāvaḥ/ taittirīyāḥ tittiriproktaṃ chandastaittirīyam/ tadadhīyata iti taittirīyāḥ/ pañcāgnayo gārhapatyādipañcāgniparicaryāparāḥ/ āhitāgnaya iti yāvat/ somapīthinaḥ somapānameṣāmastīti te/
analyzed: kasmin iti śūdṛśaḥ prabandhaḥ prāyeṇa lakṣyate iti āśayaḥ smṛtam iti asti kaścid īdṛśaḥ prabandhaḥ mayā idānīm diṣṭyā smṛtaḥ iti bhāvaḥ taittirīyāḥ tittiri proktam chandaḥ taittirīyam tat adhīyate iti taittirīyāḥ pañca agnayaḥ gārhapatya ādi pañca agni paricaryā parāḥ āhitāgnayaḥ iti yāvat soma pīthinaḥ soma pānam eṣām asti iti te

original: tathā jyotiṣṭomādikratvanuṣṭhātāra ityarthaḥ/ dhṛtavratāstaponiyamaniṣṭhāḥ/ udumbarākhyaṃ kulanāma yeṣāṃ te/ tathā brahmavādino'dhyātmaniṣṭhāḥ/ ta iti/ śrotriyāḥ sāṅgavedādhyayanatadarthajñānatadanuṣṭhānaniṣṭhā viśiṣṭakulaprasūtāḥ brāhmaṇāḥ/ ``śrotriyaṃśchando'dhīte'' iti nipātanātsādhuḥ/
analyzed: tathā jyotiṣṭoma ādi kratu anuṣṭhātāraḥ iti arthaḥ dhṛtavratāḥ tapaḥ niyama niṣṭhāḥ udumbara ākhyam kula nāma yeṣām te tathā brahma vādinā adhyātma niṣṭhāḥ te iti śrotriyāḥ sa aṅga veda adhyayana tad artha jñāna tad anuṣṭhāna niṣṭhāḥ viśiṣṭa kula prasūtāḥ brāhmaṇāḥ śrotriyan chandaḥ adhīte iti nipātanāt sādhuḥ

original: tattvasya pāramārthikasya brahmasvarūpasya paramapuruṣārthasya viśeṣataḥ asaṃbhāvanāviparītabhāvanānirāsapūrvakaṃ niścayo nirvicikitsaṃ jñānaṃ tasmai prayojanāya/ bhūriśrutaṃ śāśvatam/
analyzed: tattvasya pāramārthikasya brahma svarūpasya parama puruṣa arthasya viśeṣataḥ asaṃbhāvanā viparīta bhāvanā nirāsa pūrvakam niścayaḥ nirvicikitsam jñānam tasmai prayojanāya bhūri śrutam śāśvatam

original: ``brāhmaṇena niṣṭādharmaḥ ṣaḍaṅgo vedo'dhyeyo jñeyaḥ'' iti nityavacchrutibodhitatvena nityaṃ śrutaṃ śāstraśravaṇamādriyante, na tu prativādigarvanirvāpaṇena khyātilābhārtham/ yāgādyanuṣṭhānārthaṃ taṭākādinirmāṇārthaṃ cārthānādriyante, na tu bhogecchayā/ saṃtatisaṃpādanāya dārān, na tu manmathaṃ kṛtārthayitum/
analyzed: brāhmaṇena niṣṭā dharmaḥ ṣaṣ aṅgaḥ veda udhyeyaḥ jñeyaḥ iti nitya vat śruti bodhita tvena nityam śrutam śāstra śravaṇam ādriyante na tu prativādi garva nirvāpaṇena khyāti lābha artham yāga ādi anuṣṭhāna artham taṭākā ādi nirmāṇa artham ca arthān ādriyante na tu bhoga icchayā saṃtati saṃpādanāya dārān na tu manmatham kṛtārthayitum

original: tapaḥsaṃvardhanārthamāyurapekṣante, na tu jīvanalobhena maraṇabhayena veti/ parisaṃkhyālaṃkāraḥ//7//
analyzed: tapaḥ saṃvardhana artham āyuḥ apekṣante na tu jīvana lobhena maraṇa bhayena vā iti parisaṃkhyā alaṃkāraḥ

original: āmuṣyāyaṇasya amuṣyakulaprasūtasya putrasya/ naḍāditvātphak/ ``āmuṣyāyaṇāmuṣyaputrikāmuṣyakuliketi cālugvaktavyaḥ'' iti ṣaṣṭhyā aluk/ śrīkaṇṭhapadaṃ lāñchanaṃ yasya saḥ/ bhavabhūtiriti vyavahāre tasyaiva nāmāntaram/
analyzed: āmuṣyāyaṇasya amuṣya kula prasūtasya putrasya naḍa ādi tvāt phak āmuṣyāyaṇa amuṣyaputrikā āmuṣyakulikā iti ca aluk vaktavyaḥ iti ṣaṣṭhyāḥ aluk śrīkaṇṭha padam lāñchanam yasya saḥ bhavabhūtiḥ iti vyavahāre tasya eva nāma antaram

original: bharateṣu nisargasauhṛdena nāṭyavedapāragatvenābhinayārthaṃ nāyakādinirmāṇanipuṇatvena ca naṭāstasmingurau yathā bhaktiṃ kurvantīti teṣu tadvātsalyādvartamānaḥ svakṛtimevaṃguṇabhūyasīṃ bhūmnetyatra nirdiṣṭaguṇaśālinīṃ sabhāsu prayogeṇa prakhyāpayantvityasmākamarpitavān/ yatra kṛtau khalu prasi Ÿ vāco ŸŸrvacobhaṅgiḥ/ ye nāmetyādi/
analyzed: bharateṣu nisarga sauhṛdena nāṭya vedapāraga tvena abhinaya artham nāyaka ādi nirmāṇa nipuṇa tvena ca naṭāḥ tasmin gurau yathā bhaktim kurvanti iti teṣu tad vātsalyāt vartamānaḥ sva kṛtim evaṃguṇa bhūyasīm bhūmnā iti atra nirdiṣṭa guṇa śālinīm sabhāsu prayogeṇa prakhyāpayantu iti asmākam arpitavān yatra kṛtau khalu ye nāma ityādi

original: atra pramukhe vinayapradarśanaṃ kavitvagavagddhatyaprakaṭanaṃ ca/ nāmeti prasiddhau/ madapekṣayāpi prasiddhā ye kecinmahātmāno no'smākamavajñāṃ prathayanti kiyadetadityavajānanti/
analyzed: atra pramukhe vinaya pradarśanam kavi tvac avagddhatya prakaṭanam ca nāma iti prasiddhau mad apekṣayā api prasiddhāḥ ye kecid mahātmānaḥ na usmākam avajñām prathayanti kiyat etat iti avajānanti

original: te hi vivekasalilasaṃkṣālitasaṃsāravāsanāpaṅkakalaṅke manasi pratyagātmavastveva paribhāvayantastṛṇamiva jagadaśeṣamavalokayantaḥ kimapi rahasyamupaniṣadekagamyaṃ vastu jānanta iti yuktaiva teṣāmasmāsvavidyāparatantreṣvavajñā/ ata eva tānuddiśya nāyaṃ yatnaḥ/
analyzed: te hi viveka salila saṃkṣālita saṃsāra vāsanā paṅka kalaṅke manasi pratyagātma vastu eva paribhāvayantaḥ tṛṇam iva jagat aśeṣam avalokayantaḥ kim api rahasyam upaniṣad eka gamyam vastu jānantaḥ iti yuktā eva teṣām asmāsu avidyā paratantreṣu avajñā atas eva tān uddiśya na ayam yatnaḥ

original: kiṃ tarhyatītānāmanena prayojanābhāvādvartamānānāmapyuttamādhamānāmatrāpravṛtteḥ sadṛśasya caivaṃvidhagranthanirmāṇadakṣasyaitadanupādānāt/ yo matsadṛśa utpatsyate taṃ pratīti yattadoranupādānepi sāmarthyāttadubhayalābhaḥ/ tādṛśasyotpattiḥ saṃbhāvyata ityata āha - kāla iti/ niravadhiranantaḥ/ vipulā vistīrṇā/
analyzed: kim tarhi atītānām anena prayojana abhāvāt vartamānānām api uttama adhamānām atra apravṛtteḥ sadṛśasya ca evaṃvidha grantha nirmāṇa dakṣasya etad anupādānāt yaḥ mad sadṛśaḥ utpatsyate tam prati iti yat tadoḥ anupādāne api sāmarthyāt tad ubhaya lābhaḥ tādṛśasya utpattiḥ saṃbhāvyate iti atas āha kālaḥ iti niravadhiḥ anantaḥ vipulā vistīrṇā

original: ataḥ kasmiṃściddeśe kasmiṃścitkāle matsadṛśo'pi kvacidetadupādāyī janiṣyata iti saṃbhāvyata ityarthaḥ/ athavā nāmeti kilārthe/ ye kecidyādṛśāstādṛśāno'vajñāṃ kila prathayanti svamahimnā jagatsarvamabhibhavatāmasmākamapi/ uḍubhiriva bhānoḥ kṣudraiḥ kācidavajñāvārteti citramiti bhāvaḥ/ te kiṃ jānanti/ na kimapītyarthaḥ/
analyzed: atas kasmiṃścid deśe kasmiṃścid kāle mad sadṛśaḥ api kvacid etad upādāyī janiṣyate iti saṃbhāvyate iti arthaḥ athavā nāma iti kila arthe ye kecid yādṛśāḥ tādṛśāḥ no vajñām kila prathayanti sva mahimnā jagat sarvam abhibhavatām asmākam api uḍubhiḥ iva bhānoḥ kṣudraiḥ kācid avajñā vārttā iti citram iti bhāvaḥ te kim jānanti na kim api iti arthaḥ

original: ajñatvānna tadavajñayāsmākaṃ kācitkṣatiriti bhāvaḥ/ apiśabdo bhinnakramaḥ/ eṣa yatno'pi tānprati na/ teṣāmalakṣyatvāt/ kaṃ prati tarhi/ atītaiḥ prayojanābhāvādvartamānasya ca matsadṛśasyābhāvādyaḥ kaścinmādṛśa utpatsyate taṃ prati/ kathamidānīmetāvati prapañce'pyavidyamānastvādṛśa itaḥ paramutpatsyata iti/
analyzed: ajña tvāt na tad avajñayā asmākam kācid kṣatiḥ iti bhāvaḥ api śabdaḥ bhinnakramaḥ eṣa yatnaḥ upi tān prati na teṣām alakṣya tvāt kam prati tarhi atītaiḥ prayojana abhāvāt vartamānasya ca mad sadṛśasya abhāvāt yaḥ kaścid mādṛśaḥ utpatsyate tam prati katham idānīm etāvati prapañce pi avidyamānaḥ tvādṛśaḥ itas param utpatsyate iti

original: saṃbhāvanetyata āha - anavadhau kāle'pyaparicchinne deśe yathāhameka etāvataḥ kālasyotpannastadvadeva ko jānīte kadā vā kutra vā tādṛśaḥ kaścidutpadyetāpītyarthaḥ/ hetvalaṃkāraḥ//8//
analyzed: saṃbhāvanā iti atas āha anavadhau kāle ipi aparicchinne deśe yathā aham ekaḥ etāvataḥ kālasya utpannaḥ tadvat eva kaḥ jānīte kadā vā kutra vā tādṛśaḥ kaścid utpadyeta api iti arthaḥ hetvalaṃkāraḥ

original: guṇairityādi/ satāmasmadgurūṇāṃ guṇaiḥ prakhyāpyamānaiḥ/ tacchiṣyasya mama ko guṇo na prakaṭīkṛtaḥ tādṛśairgurubhiḥ śikṣitatvādeva svasminsarve saṃbhāvyanta ityarthaḥ/ tameva guruṃ nidarśayati - yathārtheti//9//
analyzed: guṇaiḥ ityādi satām asmat gurūṇām guṇaiḥ prakhyāpyamānaiḥ tad śiṣyasya mama kaḥ guṇaḥ na prakaṭīkṛtaḥ tādṛśaiḥ gurubhiḥ śikṣita tvāt eva svasmin sarve saṃbhāvyante iti arthaḥ tam eva gurum nidarśayati yathārtha iti

original: yadvedeti/ upaniṣadāṃ vedaśirasāṃ sāṃkhyasya kāpilasya yogasya pātañjalasya ca mokṣaśāstrasya/ nahīti tatparijñānaṃ na kāvyanirmāṇanaipuṇyopayogamityarthaḥ/ kiṃ tarhi nāṭaŸŸnopayuktamatha āha-vacasāṃ yatprauḍhitvaṃ vivakṣitārthasamarpaṇaprāvīṇyam/ ``vivakṣitārthanirvāhaḥ kāvye prauḍhiriti smṛtā'' iti vacanāt/
analyzed: yat veda iti upaniṣadām vedaśirasām sāṃkhyasya kāpilasya yogasya pātañjalasya ca mokṣa śāstrasya nahi iti tat parijñānam na kāvya nirmāṇa naipuṇya upayogam iti arthaḥ kim tarhi nāṭa śūna upayuktam atha āha vacasām yat prauḍhi tvam vivakṣita artha samarpaṇa prāvīṇyam vivakṣita artha nirvāhaḥ kāvye prauḍhiḥ iti smṛtā iti vacanāt

original: ``pade vākyārtharacanā vākyārthe ca padābhidhā/ prauḍhirvyāsasamāsau ca sābhiprāyatvamasya ca//'' ityevaṃrūpaṃ vaicitryaṃ vā/ udāratā prabandhasaundaryaṃ ślāghyārthatvaṃ vā/ arthato gauravamanekārthapratipādanasāmarthyaṃ gāmbhīryarūpaṃ tadetaccedasti/ tadeva pāṇḍityasya vyutpattervaidagdhyasya kavitāśakteśca gamakaṃ jñāpakam/
analyzed: pade vākya artha racanā vākya arthe ca pada abhidhā prauḍhiḥ vyāsa samāsau ca sa abhiprāya tvam asya ca iti evaṃrūpam vaicitryam vā udāra tā prabandha saundaryam ślāghya artha tvam vā arthataḥ gauravam aneka artha pratipādana sāmarthyam gāmbhīrya rūpam tat etat ced asti tat eva pāṇḍityasya vyutpatteḥ vaidagdhyasya kavi tā śakteḥ ca gamakam jñāpakam

original: prabandhaguṇāndṛṣṭvā svayameva vidvāṃso mama vaidagdhyaṃ jñāsyanti/ natvetanmayā svakaṇṭhena vaktavyamityarthaḥ//10//
analyzed: prabandha guṇān dṛṣṭvā svayam eva vidvāṃsaḥ mama vaidagdhyam jñāsyanti na tu etat mayā sva kaṇṭhena vaktavyam iti arthaḥ

original: etāvatā kavikāvyapraśaṃsā kṛteti prarocanāṃ nirvṛtyāmukhaṃ prastauti - tāvadityādi/ vīthyaṅgānāmāmukhe vikalpitatvānnātra teṣāmupādānamiti mantavyam/ tāvatsākalyena bhūmikāstattadabhinayakāryaṃ prati janocitavarṇaveṣabhāṣābhinayādiparigrahānsvavargāntargatāḥ pāṭhitāḥ śikṣitāḥ/
analyzed: etāvatā kavi kāvya praśaṃsā kṛtā iti prarocanām nirvṛtyāmukham prastauti tāvat ityādi vīthi aṅgānām āmukhe vikalpita tvāt na atra teṣām upādānam iti mantavyam tāvat sākalyena bhūmikāḥ tat tat abhinaya kāryam prati jana ucita varṇa veṣa bhāṣā abhinaya ādi parigrahān sva varga antargatāḥ pāṭhitāḥ śikṣitāḥ

original: saugatajaratpravrājikāyā bauddhavṛddhasaṃnyāsinyāḥ prathamāmāditaḥ praveśanīyām// tataḥ kim/ brūhīti śeṣaḥ/ tata iti/ āvābhyāṃ tāvatkāmandakyā avalokitāyāśca bhūmikādvayaṃ prathamameva gṛhītam/ pradhānanāyakabhūmikāparigrahastu kathaṃ kena vā kartavya ityarthaḥ/ uttaramāha - kalahaṃseti/
analyzed: saugata jarat pravrājikāyāḥ bauddha vṛddha saṃnyāsinyāḥ prathamām āditas praveśanīyām tatas kim brūhi iti śeṣaḥ tatas iti āvābhyām tāvat kāmandakyāḥ avalokitāyāḥ ca bhūmikā dvayam prathamam eva gṛhītam pradhānanāyaka bhūmikā parigrahaḥ tu katham kena vā kartavyaḥ iti arthaḥ uttaram āha kalahaṃsa iti

original: kalahaṃso mādhavasya ceṭaḥ, makarando mittram, tatpraveśāvasara evaitanmādhavabhūmikāparigrahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyatīti nedānīṃ taccintanīyam/ tena sarvaṃ suṣṭhu vihitam, na kiṃcidapi kartavyamavaśiṣṭamityarthaḥ/ tadanena prathamaṃ kāmandakyavalokitāpraveśaḥ sūcitaḥ/
analyzed: kalahaṃsaḥ mādhavasya ceṭaḥ makarandaḥ mittram tad praveśa avasare eva etat mādhava bhūmikā parigrahaṇam bhaviṣyati iti na idānīm tat cintanīyam tena sarvam suṣṭhu vihitam na kiṃcid api kartavyam avaśiṣṭam iti arthaḥ tat anena prathamam kāmandakyavalokitā praveśaḥ sūcitaḥ

original: kecittu yāvantyatra prakaraṇe pātrāṇi teṣāṃ sarveṣāmapi prathamataḥ praveśaḥ sūcita iti vyācakṣate/ tadasaṃgatam/ tatpraveśāvasara eva praveśasya sūcanīyatvāt/ na tu kṛtsnaprakaraṇapātrapraveśaḥ prathamataḥ sūcanīya iti prakaraṇalakṣaṇatve na kvacidapi granthe dṛśyate/ tattatpātrapraveśasamaye tattatsūcanaṃ sphuṭamevāgre dṛśyata ityalam// teneti/
analyzed: kecid tu yāvanti atra prakaraṇe pātrāṇi teṣām sarveṣām api prathamatas praveśaḥ sūcitaḥ iti vyācakṣate tat asaṃgatam tad praveśa avasare eva praveśasya sūcanīya tvāt na tu kṛtsna prakaraṇa pātra praveśaḥ prathamatas sūcanīyaḥ iti prakaraṇa lakṣaṇa tve na kvacid api granthe dṛśyate tat tat pātra praveśa samaye tat tat sūcanam sphuṭam eva agre dṛśyate iti alam tena iti

original: sāmājikanirdiṣṭaguṇayogitvena vargairadhītatvena cetyarthaḥ samāje ŸŸŸ[samave]tānsāmājikān/ ``paśūnāṃ samajo'nyeṣāṃ samājo'tha sadharmiṇām'' ityamaraḥ// bāḍhamiti/ tathā kurma ityarthaḥ/ eṣa iti/ sūtradhārarūpaparityāgena kāmandakībhūto'smi// ahamapyavalokitā saṃvṛttetyetadāmukhāṅgaṃ prayogātiśayaḥ/
analyzed: sāmājika nirdiṣṭa guṇa yogitvena vargaiḥ adhīta tvena ca iti arthaḥ samāje Ÿśū samavetān sāmājikān paśūnām samajaḥ anyeṣām samājaḥ utha sadharmiṇām iti amaraḥ bāḍham iti tathā kurmaḥ iti arthaḥ eṣaḥ iti sūtradhāra rūpa parityāgena kāmandakībhūtaḥ asmi aham api avalokitā saṃvṛttā iti etat āmukha aṅgam prayoga atiśayaḥ

original: taduktam - ``eṣoya'mityupakṣepātsūtradhāraprayogataḥ/ pātrapraveśo yatrāyaṃ prayogātiśayo mataḥ//'' iti/ anyasya pātrasya praveśa eṣo'yamityupakṣepaḥ/ sūtradhārasyaiva samanantarapātratva eṣo'hamityupakṣepa iti nātīva bhedaḥ// iti prastāvanā// parivṛtya nirgamanaṃ nāṭayitvā/
analyzed: tat uktam eṣaḥ yam iti upakṣepāt sūtradhāra prayogataḥ pātra praveśaḥ yatra ayam prayoga atiśayaḥ mataḥ iti anyasya pātrasya praveśaḥ eṣaḥ yam iti upakṣepaḥ sūtradhārasya eva samanantara pātra tve eṣaḥ ham iti upakṣepaḥ iti na atīva bhedaḥ iti prastāvanā parivṛtya nirgamanam nāṭayitvā

original: kāṣāyaśāṭīviracitaveṣāvupaviṣṭau kāmandakyavalokitāveṣadhāriṇau praviśataḥ/ ityevaṃ prastāvanāṃ parisamāpya sūcanīyakathāṃśasūcanārthaṃ miśraviṣkambhamārabhate - kāmandakītyādi/ vadatīti śeṣaḥ/ viṣkambhalakṣaṇaṃ tu - ``vṛttavartiṣyamāṇānāṃ kathāṃśānāṃ nidarśakaḥ/ saṃkṣepārthastu viṣkambho madhyapātraprayojitaḥ//'' iti/
analyzed: kāṣāya śāṭī viracita veṣau upaviṣṭau kāmandakī avalokitau veṣa dhāriṇau praviśataḥ iti evam prastāvanām parisamāpya sūcanīya kathā aṃśa sūcana artham miśra viṣkambham ārabhate kāmandakī ityādi vadati iti śeṣaḥ viṣkambha lakṣaṇam tu vṛtta vartiṣyamāṇānām kathāṃśānām nidarśakaḥ saṃkṣepa arthaḥ tu viṣkambhaḥ madhya pātra prayojitaḥ iti

original: śuddhaḥ saṃkīrṇo vā dvividho viṣkambhako'pi vaktavyaḥ/ madhyamapātraiḥ ``śuddhaḥ saṃkīrṇo nīcamadhyamakṛt//'' iti/ śeṣaṃ nāṭakavadityatideśātprakaraṇe'pi viṣkambhakaniveśaḥ/ tathā cāhuḥ - ``prakaraṇanāṭakaviṣaye praveśako nāma vijñeyaḥ/ viṣkambhakastu kāryo nāṭakayoge prakaraṇe ca//'' iti// avalokiteti/ ājñāpayatu bhagavatī// apināmeti/
analyzed: śuddhaḥ saṃkīrṇaḥ vā dvividhaḥ viṣkambhakaḥ api vaktavyaḥ madhyama pātraiḥ śuddhaḥ saṃkīrṇaḥ nīca madhyama kṛt iti śeṣam nāṭaka vat iti atideśāt prakaraṇe api viṣkambhaka niveśaḥ tathā ca āhuḥ prakaraṇa nāṭaka viṣaye praveśakaḥ nāma vijñeyaḥ viṣkambhakaḥ tu kāryaḥ nāṭaka yoge prakaraṇe ca iti avalokitā iti ājñāpayatu bhagavatī apināmā iti

original: kalyāṇinoḥ kalyāṇaṃ maṅgalamanyonyānurūpaṃ vayorūpabhāgyasaubhāgyādikamanayorastīti tau tathoktau/ anena cānyonyānuguṇayogānmālatyeva mādhavasya yogyā vadhūḥ, sa eva tasyāḥ samucito varaḥ, iti sūcitam/ bhūrīti ślāghyavaṃśaprasūtatvena kulatatsaṃbandhārhatvaṃ dhvanitam/ mālatīmādhavayoritaretarayogadvandvanirdeśena sāhityapratīteḥ/
analyzed: kalyāṇinoḥ kalyāṇam maṅgalam anyonya anurūpam vayaḥ rūpa bhāgya saubhāgya ādikam anayoḥ asti iti tau tathā uktau anena ca anyonya anuguṇa yogān mālatī eva mādhavasya yogyā vadhūḥ saḥ eva tasyāḥ samucitaḥ varaḥ iti sūcitam bhūri iti ślāghya vaṃśa prasūta tvena kula tad saṃbandha arha tvam dhvanitam mālatī mādhavayoḥ itaretara yoga dvandva nirdeśena sāhitya pratīteḥ

original: taddheturanyonyānurāgo'stīti dyotyate/ abhimataṃ tayorbandhūnāmanyeṣāṃ ca sahṛdayānāmabhilaṣitamityarthaḥ/ tadanena mālatīmādhavayoranyonyānurāgo'tra prakaraṇe bījabhūtaḥ sūcito bhavati/ yathā - ``stokoddiṣṭaḥ kāryaheturbījaṃ vistāryanekadhā'' iti/
analyzed: tad hetuḥ anyonya anurāgaḥ asti iti dyotyate abhimatam tayoḥ bandhūnām anyeṣām ca sahṛdayānām abhilaṣitam iti arthaḥ tat anena mālatī mādhavayoḥ anyonya anurāgaḥ utra prakaraṇe bīja bhūtaḥ sūcitaḥ bhavati yathā stokoddiṣṭaḥ kārya hetuḥ bījam vistāri anekadhā iti

original: prathamaṃ svalpamevoddiṣṭaḥ paścādanekadhā vistārī yaḥ kāryasya prayojanasya hetuḥ so'rtho bījamityucyate/ atra ca prakara ŸŸŸtīprāŸrmādhavasya pradhānaṃ kāryam/ taddhetuśca tayoranurāgo bījam/ bījaṃ nāma prāthamikī arthaprakṛtiḥ/ kāryaṃ pañcamī/ prā[pā]ṇigrahaṇamaṅgalamapi nāma syāt/ kiṃ nu khalu bhavet/
analyzed: prathamam svalpam eva uddiṣṭaḥ paścāt anekadhā vistārī yaḥ kāryasya prayojanasya hetuḥ saḥ ṛthaḥ bījam iti ucyate atra ca prakaraḥ pradhānam kāryam tad hetuḥ ca tayoḥ anurāgaḥ bījam bījam nāma prāthamikī artha prakṛtiḥ kāryam pañcamī prāpāṇigrahaṇamaṅgalam api nāma syāt kim nu khalu bhavet

original: anena mālatīmādhavasamāgamarūpaphalārthamautsukyapratīterārambho nāma prathamāvasthā darśitā/ yathā - ``autsukyamātramārambhaḥ phalalābhāya bhūyase'' iti/ bījārambhasamavyayāccāyaṃ mukhasaṃdhiḥ/ taduktam - ``bījabindupatākākhyaprakarīkāryalakṣaṇāḥ/ ārambhayatnaprāptyāśā niyatāptiphalāgamāḥ// arthaprakṛtayaḥ pañca pañcāvasthāsamanvitāḥ/
analyzed: anena mālatī mādhava samāgama rūpa phala artham autsukya pratīteḥ ārambhaḥ nāma prathama avasthā darśitā yathā autsukya mātram ārambhaḥ phala lābhāya bhūyase iti bīja ārambha sama vyayāt ca ayam mukha saṃdhiḥ tat uktam bīja bindu patākā ākhya prakarī kārya lakṣaṇāḥ ārambha yatna prāpti āśāḥ niyata āpti phala āgamāḥ artha prakṛtayaḥ pañca pañca avasthā samanvitāḥ

original: yathāsaṃkhyena jāyante mukhādyāḥ pañca saṃdhayaḥ//'' iti/ tatrārthahetumadbhedo yatra bījasya tanmukham/ tasya ca mukhasaṃdherupakṣepādīnyaṅgāni dvādaśa bījārambhānuguṇyena prayoktavyāni/ tāni ca yathāvasaramagrata eva nirūpayiṣyanta ityalam// saharṣamiti/ vicintyamānamanorathasiddhisūcakanimittalābhāt/ tadeva darśayati - vivṛṇvateti/
analyzed: yathāsaṃkhyena jāyante mukha ādyāḥ pañca saṃdhayaḥ iti tatra artha hetumat bhedaḥ yatra bījasya tat mukham tasya ca mukha saṃdheḥ upakṣepa ādīni aṅgāni dvādaśa bīja ārambha ānuguṇyena prayoktavyāni tāni ca yathāvasaram agratas eva nirūpayiṣyante iti alam sa harṣam iti vicintyamāna manoratha siddhi sūcaka nimitta lābhāt tat eva darśayati vivṛṇvatā iti

original: āntarajñenevāsminnarthe sva[kha]lviyaṃ saṃdigdhe kimetatprayojanaṃ bhaviṣyati na veti, tadasyāḥ saṃśayamapanayāmītyevamasmadabhiprāyavedineva kalyāṇaṃ vivṛṇvatā bhāvimaṅgalaṃ sūcayatā sphuratā vāmakena savyena/ atha ca pratikūlenāpi satā cakṣuṣā dākṣiṇyaṃ cintyamānakāryasiddhiśaṃsitvenāprātikūlyam/ atha ca savyetaratvamaṅgīkriyate/
analyzed: āntara jñena iva asmin arthe saṃdigdhe kim etat prayojanam bhaviṣyati na vā iti tat asyāḥ saṃśayam apanayāmi iti evam asmad abhiprāya vedinā iva kalyāṇam vivṛṇvatā bhāvi maṅgalam sūcayatā sphuratā vāmakena savyena atha ca pratikūlena api satā cakṣuṣā dākṣiṇyam cintyamāna kārya siddhi śaṃsi tvena aprātikūlyam atha ca savyetaratvam aṅgīkriyate

original: avalokitā - mahānkhalveṣa cintārūpo bhagavatyāścittāvakṣepo manaḥkhedaḥ/ āścaryamāścaryam/ yadidānīṃ cīrai rathyāpatitapaṭaccarakhaṇḍaiḥ kṛto yaścīvaraḥ kanthā tanmātraprāvaraṇāṃ piṇḍasya bhaikṣakavalasya prāṇadhāraṇocitasya pāta udarakuhare nikṣepastanmātraprāṇavṛttiḥ/
analyzed: avalokitā mahān khalu eṣa cintā rūpaḥ bhagavatyāḥ citta avakṣepaḥ manaḥ khedaḥ āścaryam āścaryam yat idānīm cīraiḥ rathyā patita paṭaccara khaṇḍaiḥ kṛtaḥ yaḥ cīvaraḥ kanthā tanmātra prāvaraṇām piṇḍasya bhaikṣa kavalasya prāṇa dhāraṇa ucitasya pātaḥ udara kuhare nikṣepaḥ tanmātra prāṇa vṛttiḥ

original: pātre pāṇau mukhe vā yairyadannaṃ vinipātyate tadevauṣadhavannigīryate, na tu rasāsvādapūrvakaṃ bhujyata ityarthaḥ/ bhagavatīṃ māhātmyavatīmātmavatīmīdṛśeṣvāyāseṣu duḥkhajanakeṣu rāgijanocitadūtyādikṛtyeṣvamātyabhūrivasurniyojayatīti tasya tāvatkāryagrastatvādanyena cāsya duṣkaratvādanucite'pi vyāpāre bhagavatīṃ niyojayatu nāma/
analyzed: pātre pāṇau mukhe vā yaiḥ yat annam vinipātyate tat eva auṣadha vat nigīryate na tu rasa āsvāda pūrvakam bhujyate iti arthaḥ bhagavatīm māhātmyavatīm ātmavatīm īdṛśeṣu āyāseṣu duḥkha janakeṣu rāgi jana ucita dūtī ādi kṛtyeṣu amātya bhūrivasuḥ niyojayati iti tasya tāvat kārya grasta tvāt anyena ca asya duṣkara tvāt anucite api vyāpāre bhagavatīm niyojayatu nāma

original: tasmiṃścāyāsa utkhaṇḍita ucchinnaḥ saṃsāra evāvagraho niḥśreyasāmṛtavarṣapratibandhaḥ/ mokṣāntarāya iti yāvat/ sa yasya ātmā yuṣmābhirapi nikṣipyata iti yadetatsarvamāścaryamiti yojanā// kāmandakī/ vatse iti/ naivaṃ vaktavyamityarthaḥ// yanmāmiti/ sa pūjyo bhavānbhūrivasurmāṃ vidheyaviṣaye kṛtyaviṣaye niyuṅkta iti yattatsnehasya premṇaḥ phalam/
analyzed: tasmin ca āyāse utkhaṇḍitaḥ ucchinnaḥ saṃsāraḥ eva avagrahaḥ niḥśreyasa amṛta varṣa pratibandhaḥ mokṣa antarāyaḥ iti yāvat sa yasya ātmā yuṣmābhiḥ api nikṣipyate iti yat etat sarvam āścaryam iti yojanā kāmandakī vatse iti na evam vaktavyam iti arthaḥ yat mām iti sa pūjyaḥ bhavān bhūrivasuḥ mām vidheya viṣaye kṛtya viṣaye niyuṅkte iti yat tat snehasya premṇaḥ phalam

original: asau visrambhayogyaṃ premaiva praṇaya ityucyate/ nirvyājaṃ saujanyameva praṇaya iti kecit/ tasya sāraḥ sthirāṃśaḥ/ snehātirekādanucite'pi karmaṇi niyogo'smākaṃ ca tadaṅgīkaraṇaṃ yuktameveti bhāvaḥ/ prāṇairathavā tebhyo'pi ślāghyaistapobhirvā suhṛdabhilaṣitakṛtyaṃ ghaṭeta yadi sidhyet/
analyzed: asau visrambha yogyam prema eva praṇayaḥ iti ucyate nirvyājam saujanyam eva praṇayaḥ iti kecid tasya sāraḥ sthira aṃśaḥ sneha atirekāt anucite api karmaṇi ca tad aṅgīkaraṇam yuktam eva iti bhāvaḥ prāṇaiḥ athavā tebhyaḥ api ślāghyaiḥ tapobhiḥ vā suhṛd abhilaṣita kṛtyam ghaṭeta yadi sidhyet

original: tattarhi niḥśreyasādapyadhikaṃ kṛtyamasmatprāṇaistapobhiśca kṛtaṃ niṣpāditaṃ syādityāvṛttyā yojanīyam/ mitrakāryaniṣpādanaṃ mokṣādapi garīya iti bhāvaḥ/
analyzed: tat tarhi niḥśreyasāt api adhikam kṛtyam asmad prāṇaiḥ tapobhiḥ ca kṛtam niṣpāditam syāt iti āvṛttyā yojanīyam mitra kārya niṣpādanam mokṣāt api garīyaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: amātyabhūrivasuḥ svasutāṃ mālatīṃ svabālamitrasya devarātasyātmajāya mādhavāya praditsurnarapaternandananāmne narmasacivāya mālatīṃ yācamānādbhayena prakāśaṃ dātumaśaknuvangūḍhavivāhanirvartanavyāpāre kāmandakīṃ niyuktavāniti kathā upari sphuṭībhaviṣyati//12//
analyzed: amātya bhūrivasuḥ sva sutām mālatīm sva bāla mitrasya devarātasya ātmajāya mādhavāya praditsuḥ narapateḥ nandana nāmne narmasacivāya mālatīm yācamānāt bhayena prakāśam dātum aśaknuvan gūḍha vivāha nirvartana vyāpāre kāmandakīm niyuktavān iti kathā upari sphuṭībhaviṣyati

original: kimiti bhūrivasormādhavāyaiva mālatī dātavyeti nirbandhaḥ/ bhagavatyā vā prāṇavyayenāpyetatkāryaṃ saṃpādyamiti kimityabhiniveśa ityata āha - kiṃ na vetsīti/ ābālyānmadantevāsinī tvamapyetatsarvaṃ jānāsyeveti bhāvaḥ/ na iti/ bhūrivasudevarātayormama cetyarthaḥ/ nānādigantavāsena bahudeśavāsena sāhacaryaṃ sahacarabhāvaḥ/
analyzed: kim iti bhūrivasoḥ mādhavāya eva mālatī dātavyā iti nirbandhaḥ bhagavatyā vā prāṇa vyayena api etat kāryam saṃpādyam iti kim iti abhiniveśaḥ iti atas āha kim na vetsi iti ābālyāt mad antevāsinī tvam api etat sarvam jānāsi eva iti bhāvaḥ naḥ iti bhūri vasudeva rātayoḥ mama ca iti arthaḥ nānā diganta vāsena bahu deśa vāsena sāhacaryam sahacara bhāvaḥ

original: ekatrādhyayananibandhanā maitrī yadaivābhūttadaivāsmaditi pañcamībahuvacanam/ asmatta eva matkāritaiva yayoriyaṃ pratijñā pravṛttā/ ketyata āha - āvābhyāmiti/ ataśca pūrvapratijñātvādbhūrivasormatpuraḥsaratvānmama cātra nirbandho yukta iti bhāvaḥ/ matprathamaśiṣyā saudāminyapyatrārthe sākṣiṇītyata āha - saudāminīsamakṣamiti/
analyzed: ekatra adhyayana nibandhanā maitrī yadā eva abhūt tadā eva asmat iti pañcamī bahuvacanam asmattaḥ eva mad kāritā eva yayoḥ iyam pratijñā pravṛttā kā iti atas āha āvābhyām iti atas ca pūrva pratijñā tvāt bhūrivasoḥ mad puraḥsara tvāt mama ca atra nirbandhaḥ yuktaḥ iti bhāvaḥ mad prathama śiṣyā saudāminī api atra arthe sākṣiṇī iti atas āha saudāminī samakṣam iti

original: tena tasyā apyetatprayojananirvāhakāntaḥpātitvapratīteḥ ante tayā kariṣyamāṇo mālatyupadravaparihāraḥ kathāṃśaḥ sūcito bhavati/ nāpi māṃ bhūrivasurdūtye niyuṅkte/ kiṃ tvahameva matkāṅkṣitapratijñānirvāhārthaṃ pravarte/ na me dūtyalāghavamāśaṅkanīyamityapi sūcyate/ mama ca saudāminyāścāsmatsaudāminīsamakṣamiti vyaŸŸānamanupapannam/
analyzed: tena tasyāḥ api etad prayojana nirvāhaka antaḥpāti tva pratīteḥ ante tayā kariṣyamāṇaḥ mālatī upadrava parihāraḥ kathā aṃśaḥ sūcitaḥ bhavati nā api mām bhūrivasuḥ dūtye niyuṅkte kim tu aham eva mad kāṅkṣita pratijñā nirvāha artham pravarte na me dūtya lāghavam āśaṅkanīyam iti api sūcyate mama ca saudāminyāḥ ca asmad saudāminī samakṣam iti vyaśśānam anupapannam

original: sa ca devadattaśca tāvitivat ``tyadādīni sarvairnityam'' ityekaśeṣaprasaṅgāt/ dviparyantādīnāmeva tyadāditvamiti tu tyadādyatvamātranirāsārtham/ tadidānīmiti/ tatpratijñātam/ mantriṇetipadaṃ bahuprayojanoddeśena putramatra preṣitavāniti tasya buddhikauśalaṃ prakaṭayitum/ ānvīkṣikī nyāyaśāstram/ nītiśāstrasyāpi nyāyamūlakatvāttadantargatiḥ/
analyzed: sa ca devadattaḥ ca tau iti vat tyad ādīni sarvaiḥ nityam iti ekaśeṣa prasaṅgāt dviparyanta ādīnām eva tyad ādi tvam iti tu tyad ādya tva mātra nirāsa artham tat idānīm iti tat pratijñātam mantriṇā iti padam bahu prayojana uddeśena putram atra preṣitavān iti tasya buddhi kauśalam prakaṭayitum ānvīkṣikī nyāya śāstram nīti śāstrasya api nyāya mūlaka tvāt tad antargatiḥ

original: suvihitaṃ sādhu saṃpāditam// suvidhāne yuktimāha - apatyeti/ pūrvameva saṃbandhasya pratijñātatvātsvayameva bhūrivasuḥ sutāṃ mādhavāya dāsyatīti yadi tamatra devarāto na preṣayettadā smārakābhāvātkālaviprakarṣācca bhūrivasuḥ pratijñāṃ vismaredapi/ tadanena putrapreṣaṇena suhṛdaḥ pratijñā smṛtiviṣayaṃ prāpitā/
analyzed: su vihitam sādhu saṃpāditam su vidhāne yuktim āha apatya iti pūrvam eva saṃbandhasya pratijñāta tvāt svayam eva bhūrivasuḥ sutām mādhavāya dāsyati iti yadi tam atra devarātaḥ na preṣayet tadā smāraka abhāvāt kāla viprakarṣāt ca bhūrivasuḥ pratijñām vismaret api tat anena putra preṣaṇena suhṛdaḥ pratijñā smṛti viṣayam prāpitā

original: yadi vā kadācidadṛṣṭavaśātsmarannapi varaguṇaparijñānādatilokalāvaṇyaśālinīṃ sutāṃ dātuṃ saṃśayīta, tadapi nirākṛtam/ yataḥ prarocanārthaṃ saṃbandhecchotpādanārthaṃ yūnoranyonyānurāgajananārthaṃ cānitarasādhāraṇaguṇastanūjaḥ prakaṭīkṛtaśceti yuktidvayātpratijñātaṃ sutapreṣaṇena suvihitamityarthaḥ//13//
analyzed: yadi vā kadācid adṛṣṭa vaśāt smaran api vara guṇa parijñānāt ati loka lāvaṇya śālinīm sutām dātum saṃśayīta tat api nirākṛtam yatas prarocana artham saṃbandha icchā utpādana artham yūnoḥ anyonya anurāga janana artham ca anitara sādhāraṇa guṇaḥ tanūjaḥ prakaṭīkṛtaḥ ca iti yukti dvayāt pratijñātam suta preṣaṇena su vihitam iti arthaḥ

original: avalokitā - kimiti mālatīmamātyo mādhavasyātmanā na pratipādayati/ yena cauryavivāhe bhagavatīṃ tvarayati/ mādhavasyeti caturthyarthe ṣaṣṭhī// svayamapradāne nimittamāha - kāmandakī/ tāmiti/ narapaternarmasuhṛtkrīḍāsacivonandanastāṃ mālatīṃ nṛpamukhena yācate/ nandanāya prayaccheti rājñā yācayatītyarthaḥ/ rājaguṇena yācate/
analyzed: avalokitā kim iti mālatīm amātyaḥ mādhavasya ātmanā na pratipādayati yena caurya vivāhe bhagavatīm tvarayati mādhavasya iti caturthī arthe ṣaṣṭhī svayam apradāne nimittam āha kāmandakī tām iti narapateḥ narma suhṛd krīḍā sacivaḥ nandanaḥ tām mālatīm nṛpa mukhena yācate nandanāya prayaccha iti rājñā yācayati iti arthaḥ rāja guṇena yācate

original: na tu ślāghyavaraguṇeneti bhāvaḥ/ tasyā narapatiprārthanāyāḥ sākṣānmukhato na prayacchāmītyeva niṣedho rājñaḥ kopāya syāt/ ayaṃ tu cauryavivāharūpa upāyaḥ śivaḥ śobhanaḥ/ abhimatasya saṃbandhanṛpadveṣalakṣaṇeṣṭāniṣṭaprāptiparihārahetutvāt//14//
analyzed: na tu ślāghya vara guṇena iti bhāvaḥ tasyāḥ narapati prārthanāyāḥ sākṣāt mukhataḥ na prayacchāmi iti eva niṣedhaḥ rājñaḥ kopāya syāt ayam tu caurya vivāha rūpaḥ upāyaḥ śivaḥ śobhanaḥ abhimatasya saṃbandha nṛpa dveṣa lakṣaṇa iṣṭa aniṣṭa prāpti parihāra hetu tvāt

original: avalokitā - āścaryamāścaryam/ na khalvamātyo mādhavasya nāmāpi jānātīti mādhave nirapekṣatā lakṣyate/ kathaṃ tasmai sutāṃ praditsustaṃ mādhavamapyajānāna iva tasminnaispṛhyamācaratītyarthaḥ// kāmandakī - saṃvaraṇaṃ tat, rājabhayenākāragopanaṃ tat/ ajñānanaṭanamityarthaḥ/ ito'pyajñānaṃ naṭanīyamityāha - viśeṣatastviti/
analyzed: avalokitā āścaryam āścaryam na khalu amātyaḥ mādhavasya nāma api jānāti iti mādhave nirapekṣa tā lakṣyate katham tasmai sutām praditsuḥ tam mādhavam api a jānānaḥ iva tasmin naispṛhyam ācarati iti arthaḥ kāmandakī saṃvaraṇam tat rāja bhayena ākāra gopanam tat ajñāna naṭanam iti arthaḥ itas upi ajñānam naṭanīyam iti āha viśeṣataḥ tu iti

original: bālyānantarabhāvitvādbhūyasā taddharmānuvṛtteśca/ bālyamiha prathamayauvanamucyate/ tena yuktāyuktavicāravidhure, ākāragopanānabhijñe, madanājñaikavaśaṃvade, gurujanamullaṅghyāpi manorathaṃ saṃpādayitumudyuñjāne, prathamayauvane vartamānatvādvivṛtabhāvayoḥ prakaṭībhūtānyonyānurāgakuṇṭhībhāvaparihārārthaṃ viśeṣataḥ svamatestadanyonyānurāgaviṣayāyā
analyzed: bālya anantara bhāvi tvāt bhūyasā tad dharma anuvṛtteḥ ca bālyam iha prathama yauvanam ucyate tena yukta ayukta vicāra vidhure ākāra gopana anabhijñe madana ājñā eka vaśaṃvade guru janam ullaṅghya api manoratham saṃpādayitum udyuñjāne prathama yauvane vartamāna tvāt vivṛta bhāvayoḥ prakaṭībhūta anyonya anurāga kuṇṭhībhāva parihāra artham viśeṣataḥ sva mateḥ tad anyonya anurāga viṣayāyāḥ

original: kulakumārījanānucite hyasmadupadiṣṭe svayamātmapradānasāhase yathāsau nāśaṅkate tathā naivātiparicayena vaśīkartavyeti bhāvaḥ// kāmandakī/ vicintyeti/ kīdṛśaṃ dūtyamācaraṇīyamiti vimṛśya/ niścinotīti śeṣaḥ/ atyudārātigambhīrā prakṛtiryasyāḥ sā/ tathā gāmbhīryaṃ ca - ``yasya prabhāvādākārā harṣakrodhabhayādiṣu/
analyzed: kula kumārī jana anucite hi asmad upadiṣṭe svayam ātma pradāna sāhase yathā asau na āśaṅkate tathā na eva ati paricayena vaśīkartavyā iti bhāvaḥ kāmandakī vicintya iti kīdṛśam dūtyam ācaraṇīyam iti vimṛśya niścinoti iti śeṣaḥ atyudārā ati gambhīrā prakṛtiḥ yasyāḥ sā tathā gāmbhīryam ca yasya prabhāvāt ākārāḥ harṣa krodha bhaya ādiṣu

original: bhāveṣu nopalakṣyante tadgāmbhīryaṃ prakīrtitam//'' ityuktarūpam/ tena mālatyatigambhīraprakṛtitvāccaramāvasthāyāmapi svābhiprāyaṃ svayaṃ na nivedayatīti hetornipuṇaṃ yathā syāttathā nisṛṣṭārthā yā dūtī tasyāḥ kalpo yā vyāpārapaddhatistantrayitavyaḥ pradhānīkartavyaḥ/ prādhānyenāśrayaṇīya ityarthaḥ/
analyzed: bhāveṣu na upalakṣyante tat gāmbhīryam prakīrtitam iti ukta rūpam tena mālatī ati gambhīra prakṛti tvāt carama avasthāyām api sva abhiprāyam svayam na nivedayati iti hetoḥ nipuṇam yathā syāt tathā nisṛṣṭārthā yā dūtī tasyāḥ kalpaḥ yā vyāpāra paddhatiḥ tantrayitavyaḥ pradhānīkartavyaḥ prādhānyena āśrayaṇīyaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nisṛṣṭo nikṣiptaḥ ``tvameva vetsi sarvaṃ kṛtyam'' iti samarpito'rthaḥ kāryabhāro yasyāmiti vyutpattyā svatantrakāryanirvāhikā dūtī kathyate/ taduktam - rūḍhānurāgayoryūnorabhilāṣaṃ manogatam/ jñātvā tābhyāmanādiṣṭā tadapekṣitasiddhaye// yā pravarteta sā proktā nisṛṣṭārtheti kovidaiḥ/ nisṛṣṭaḥ kāryabhāro'syāmiti vyutpattisaṃbhavāt//'' iti/
analyzed: nisṛṣṭaḥ nikṣiptaḥ tvam eva vetsi sarvam kṛtyam iti samarpita ūrthaḥ kārya bhāraḥ yasyām iti vyutpattyā svatantra kārya nirvāhikā dūtī kathyate tat uktam rūḍha anurāgayoḥ yūnoḥ abhilāṣam manogatam jñātvā tābhyām an ādiṣṭā tad apekṣita siddhaye yā pravarteta sā proktā nisṛṣṭa arthā iti kovidaiḥ nisṛṣṭaḥ kārya bhāraḥ asyām iti vyutpatti saṃbhavāt iti

original: avācyakauṭilyo yatkṛtāḥ saṃdhyādayaḥ pramāṇaṃ sa nisṛṣṭārtho dūtaḥ/ yathā bhagavānpāṇḍavānāmiti// idānīṃ svavyāpārasāphalyamāśāste - sarvatheti/ śarajjyotsneti/ kalyāṇī manoharākārānuguṇaśīlasaṃpannā sujātaṃ sujanmānaṃ kāntaṃ svaprāṇanāyakaṃ śāradacandrikākumudamiva samānurāgasaṃghaṭane dṛṣṭāntaḥ/ nandayatu niratiśayānandasamṛddhaṃ karotu/
analyzed: avācya kauṭilyaḥ yad kṛtāḥ saṃdhyā ādayaḥ pramāṇam sa nisṛṣṭārthaḥ dūtaḥ yathā bhagavān pāṇḍavānām iti idānīm sva vyāpāra sāphalyam āśāste sarvathā iti śarad jyotsnā iti kalyāṇī manohara ākāra anuguṇa śīla saṃpannā sujātam sujanmānam kāntam sva prāṇanāyakam śārada candrikā kumudam iva sama anurāga saṃghaṭane dṛṣṭāntaḥ nandayatu niratiśaya ānanda samṛddham karotu

original: tena sa ca yuvā kṛtapuṇyaścaritārtho bhavatu/ ubhayoḥ samānurāgatvena sa ca tāṃ nandayatu/ sā ca kṛtakṛtyā bhavatvityayamartho'rthāllabhyate/ taṃ cakāro dyotayati/ evaṃ ca sati garīyāngurutaro'nyonyasya parasparasya praguṇā anuguṇā ye guṇāsteṣāṃ nirmāṇe nipuṇo vidhāturvyāpāraḥ phalatu tatsaṃghaṭanalakṣaṇenaiva phalena phalavānbhavatu/
analyzed: tena sa ca yuvā kṛta puṇyaḥ caritārthaḥ bhavatu ubhayoḥ sama anurāga tvena sa ca tām nandayatu sā ca kṛtakṛtyā bhavatu iti ayam artha ūrthāt labhyate tam cakāraḥ dyotayati evam ca sati garīyān gurutaraḥ nyonyasya parasparasya praguṇāḥ anuguṇāḥ ye guṇāḥ teṣām nirmāṇe nipuṇaḥ vidhātuḥ vyāpāraḥ phalatu tad saṃghaṭana lakṣaṇena eva phalena phalavān bhavatu

original: manojñaḥ sarvajanaślāghyo bhavatu/ tādṛganyonyānurūpanirmāṇasya tayoḥ saṃghaṭanameva phalam/ anyathā vyarthameva syāt/ yadāha kālidāsaḥ - ``paraspareṇa spṛhaṇīyaśobham'' ityādiślokena/ atropamopastutyamanyonyamalaṃkāraḥ/ atra parasparānurāgasya bījasyānurūpeṇa stutervilobhanaṃ nāmāṅgam/ yathā - ``tadguṇākhyā vilobhanam''iti//19//
analyzed: manojñaḥ sarva jana ślāghyaḥ bhavatu tādṛś anyonya anurūpa nirmāṇasya tayoḥ saṃghaṭanam eva phalam anyathā vyartham eva syāt yat āha kālidāsaḥ paraspareṇa spṛhaṇīya śobham ityādi ślokena atra upamā upastutyam anyonyam alaṃkāraḥ atra paraspara anurāgasya bījasya anurūpeṇa stuteḥ vilobhanam nāma aṅgam yathā tad guṇa ākhyā vilobhanam iti

original: miśraviṣkambho'yam/ nīcamadhyamapātraprayojitatvāditi// ``mādhavānucaraḥ kalahaṃso nāma'' iti vākye sūcitamupadarśayaŸŸmārabhate - tata ityādi/ aṅkalakṣaṇaṃ yathā - ``dvedhā vastuvibhāgaḥ syātprakāśyaḥ sūcya ityapi/ prakāśyo madhurodāttarasabhāvanirantaraḥ// aṅkaiḥ prakāśayedenamaṅkalakṣma pravakṣyate/ tatpratyakṣanetṛcarito bījabindupuraskṛtaḥ//
analyzed: miśra viṣkambhā ūyam nīca madhyama pātra prayojita tvāt iti mādhava anucaraḥ kalahaṃsaḥ nāma iti vākye sūcitam upadarśayaśaḥ ārabhate tatas ityādi aṅka lakṣaṇam yathā dvedhā vastu vibhāgaḥ syāt prakāśyaḥ sūcyaḥ iti api prakāśyaḥ madhura udātta rasa bhāva nirantaraḥ aṅkaiḥ prakāśayet enam aṅka lakṣma pravakṣyate tad pratyakṣa netṛ caritaḥ bīja bindu puraskṛtaḥ

original: prasaktārthopasaṃhārī patākāsthānakānvitaḥ/ aṅko nānāprakārārthasaṃvidhānarasāśrayaḥ// ekāhe vaikarātre vā caritaṃ tatra varṇayet/ prayuktaḥ pañcaṣaiḥ pātraisteṣāmante ca nirgamaḥ//'' iti/ gṛhītaṃ citraphalakamevopakaraṇamupāyanatvena mādhavasaṃdarśanasādhanaṃ yena saḥ/
analyzed: prasakta artha upasaṃhārī patākā sthānaka anvitaḥ aṅkaḥ nānā prakāra artha saṃvidhāna rasa āśrayaḥ eka ahe vā eka rātre vā caritam tatra varṇayet prayuktaḥ pañcaṣaiḥ pātraiḥ teṣām ante ca nirgamaḥ iti gṛhītam citra phalakam eva upakaraṇam upāyana tvena mādhava saṃdarśana sādhanam yena saḥ

original: kvedānīṃ tulitamakaradhvajāvaleparūpavibhramākṣiptamālatīhṛdayamāhātmyaṃ śithilīkṛtamanmathagarvo yo rūpavibhramaḥ saundaryasaṃpadvilāsastenākṣiptaṃ nirastaṃ mālatīhṛdayasya māhātmyaṃ gāmbhīryaṃ yena tam/ mālatīlikhitamādhavapraticchandakadarśanena mālatī manmathena mādhavaṃ lakṣyīkṛtya sudūramākṛṣṭā calitadhairyā jātetyanena jñāteti mantavyam/
analyzed: kva idānīm tulita makaradhvaja avalepa rūpa vibhrama ākṣipta mālatī hṛdaya māhātmyam śithilīkṛta manmatha garvaḥ yaḥ rūpa vibhramaḥ saundarya saṃpad vilāsaḥ tena ākṣiptam nirastam mālatī hṛdayasya māhātmyam gāmbhīryam yena tam mālatī likhita mādhava praticchandaka darśanena mālatī manmathena mādhavam lakṣyīkṛtya su dūram ākṛṣṭā calita dhairyā jātā iti anena jñātā iti mantavyam

original: nāthaṃ mādhavaṃ paśyāmi/ svāmino mādhavasyātmani mālatyanurāgaṃ saṃbhāvayatastatpratyayahetutvenātyantopādeyacitraphalakānayanānmahatsvāmikāryamanuṣṭhitamiti kvedānīmityautsukyagarbhā sasaṃbhramoktiḥ/ parikramyetyādi/ pariśrānto'smi/ yāvadihodyāne vane muhūrtaṃ viśramya makarandasahacaraṃ nāthaṃ mādhavaṃ prekṣiṣye/
analyzed: nātham mādhavam paśyāmi svāminaḥ mādhavasya ātmani mālatī anurāgam saṃbhāvayataḥ tad pratyaya hetu tvena atyanta upādeya citra phalaka ānayanāt mahat svāmi kāryam anuṣṭhitam iti kva idānīm iti autsukya garbhā sa saṃbhrama uktiḥ parikramya ityādi pariśrāntaḥ asmi yāvat iha udyāne vane muhūrtam viśramya makaranda sahacaram nātham mādhavam prekṣiṣye

original: ``makarandanandanam'' iti pāṭhe prāṇamitratayā tasyānandajanakamityarthaḥ/ kliṣṭatvātsutamiti vyākhyānamupekṣitam/ anenaiva makarandapraveśaḥ sūcitaḥ// tadāha - tata ityādi// madanodyānaṃ kāmadevāyatanopalakṣitamudyānamityanena śṛṅgāroddīpanavibhāvatvamuktam/ diṣṭyeti tṛtīyāntapratirūpakamavyayaṃ bhāgyavāci/ abhivartate/
analyzed: makaranda nandanam iti pāṭhe prāṇamitra tayā tasya ānanda janakam iti arthaḥ kliṣṭa tvāt sutam iti vyākhyānam upekṣitam anena eva makaranda praveśaḥ sūcitaḥ tat āha tatas ityādi madana udyānam kāmadeva āyatana upalakṣitam udyānam iti anena śṛṅgāra uddīpana vibhāva tvam uktam diṣṭyā iti tṛtīyā anta pratirūpakam avyayam bhāgya vāci abhivartate

original: abhimukhamāgacchatītyarthaḥ/ anyamanaskatayā na māṃ paśyatīti bhāvaḥ/ nirūpya nirvarṇya/ vadatīti śeṣaḥ/ asya tviti ślokopaskāro gamanamityādinānvīyate/ gamanamiti/ gamanamalasaṃ lakṣyābhāvādanicchāpūrvakameva kathaṃcidavalambitam/ anena vipralambhasyālasyākhyo vyabhicārī sūcitaḥ/ yathā - ``kriyā vidveṣa[kriyāvidveṣa] ālasyam'' iti/
analyzed: abhimukham āgacchati iti arthaḥ anyamanaskatayā na mām paśyati iti bhāvaḥ nirūpya nirvarṇya vadati iti śeṣaḥ asya tu iti śloka upaskāraḥ gamanam ityādinā anvīyate gamanam iti gamanam alasam lakṣya abhāvāt anicchā pūrvakam eva kathaṃcid avalambitam anena vipralambhasya ālasya ākhyaḥ vyabhicārī sūcitaḥ yathā kriyā vidveṣa kriyā vidveṣaḥ ālasyam iti

original: tathā dṛṣṭiḥ śūnyā cintāpahṛtena manasyadhiṣṭhitā/ tata eva svaviṣayaparicchedarūpaphalaśūnyatvena śūnyā ca/ śūnyā yathā - ``tārāsamapuṭā snigdhā niṣkampā śūnyadarśanā/ bāhyārthagrāhiṇī śyāmā śūnyadṛṣṭistu cintanāt//'' iti/ anena cintākhyo vyabhicārī vyajyate/ ``prayatnapūrvikārtheṣu smṛtiścinteti kathyate'' iti/
analyzed: tathā dṛṣṭiḥ śūnyā cintā apahṛtena manasi adhiṣṭhitā tatas eva sva viṣaya pariccheda rūpa phala śūnya tvena śūnyā ca śūnyā yathā tārā sama puṭā snigdhā niṣkampā śūnya darśanā bāhya artha grāhiṇī śyāmā śūnya dṛṣṭiḥ tu cintanāt iti anena cintā ākhyaḥ vyabhicārī vyajyate prayatna pūrvikā artheṣu smṛtiḥ cintā iti kathyate iti

original: tathā śarīramasauṣṭhavaṃ balahīnaṃ svavyāpārāsamarthakaracaraṇādikamityarthaḥ/ anena glānyākhyo vyabhicārī vyajyate/ yathā - ``vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmāṇi glānirgamayatīti yat'' iti/ śvasitamadhikaṃ pūrvāpekṣayā prabalam/ anena śramaviṣādamohādayo vyajyante niḥśvāsasyānubhāvasyānekabhāvasādhāraṇatvāt/ evaṃ cānusmṛtirūpā tṛtīyāvasthā darśitā/
analyzed: tathā śarīram asauṣṭhavam bala hīnam sva vyāpāra asamartha kara caraṇa ādikam iti arthaḥ anena glāni ākhyaḥ vyabhicārī vyajyate yathā vāc manaḥ kāya karmāṇi glāniḥ gamayati iti yat iti śvasitam adhikam pūrva apekṣayā prabalam anena śrama viṣāda moha ādayaḥ vyajyante niḥśvāsasya anubhāvasya aneka bhāva sādhāraṇa tvāt evam ca anusmṛti rūpā tṛtīya avasthā darśitā

original: yathā - ``muhurmuhurniḥśvasiti manorathavicintanaiḥ/ pradveṣādanyakāryāṇāmanusmṛtirudāhṛtā//'' iti/ kiṃ nvetatsyāt/ eṣāṃ cintālasyādīnāṃ nimittaṃ kiṃ nu bhavediti makarandasya vitarkaḥ/ vimṛśya tannimittaṃ nirdhārayati - kimanyaditi/ athavā kimatra vitarkeṇa madanavikāravyatiriktaṃ kimeteṣāṃ nimittaṃ saṃbhāvyate/ na kiṃcidapītyarthaḥ/
analyzed: yathā muhur muhur niḥśvasiti manoratha vicintanaiḥ pradveṣāt anya kāryāṇām anusmṛtiḥ udāhṛtā iti kim nu etat syāt eṣām cintā ālasya ādīnām nimittam kim nu bhavet iti makarandasya vitarkaḥ vimṛśya tad nimittam nirdhārayati kim anyat iti athavā kim atra vitarkeṇa madana vikāra vyatiriktam kim eteṣām nimittam saṃbhāvyate na kiṃcid api iti arthaḥ

original: tadeva nimittamāha - bhramatīti/ bhuvane kaṃdarpājñābhramati/ apratihatā vijṛmbhate/ yauvanaṃ ca prathamaṃ dvitīyaṃ vā/ itarayoratrāyogyatvāt/ vikāri vikārajananaśīlam/ yauvanaṃ yathā - ``rativyāyāmasahano mattebhasyeva mattatā/ vidyate yuvabhāvo yastadyauvanamudāhṛtam//'' iti/
analyzed: tat eva nimittam āha bhramati iti bhuvane kaṃdarpa ājñā bhramati apratihatā vijṛmbhate yauvanam ca prathamam dvitīyam vā itarayoḥ atra ayogya tvāt vikāri vikāra janana śīlam yauvanam yathā rati vyāyāma sahanaḥ matta ibhasya iva matta tā vidyate yuva bhāvaḥ yaḥ tat yauvanam udāhṛtam iti

original: ``yauvanaṃ tu caturdhāsyāt'' ityādinā bhāvaprakāśe yauvanaviśeṣalakṣaṇaṃ prapañcitam/ tata eva jñātavyam/ lalitāḥ sundarā nayanasukhakarā madhurā manoharāśca te te bhāvā indūdyānādaya uddīpanavibhāvāḥ svabhāvadhīrasyāpi dhīratāṃ dhairyaṃ kṣipantyapasārayanti/ dhairyaṃ yathā - ``cāpalenānupahatā sarvārtheṣvavikatthanā/
analyzed: yauvanam tu caturdhā āsyāt ityādinā bhāva prakāśe yauvana viśeṣa lakṣaṇam prapañcitam tatas eva jñātavyam lalitāḥ sundarāḥ nayana sukha karāḥ madhurāḥ manoharāḥ ca te te bhāvāḥ indu udyāna ādayaḥ uddīpana vibhāvāḥ svabhāva dhīrasya api dhīra tām dhairyam kṣipanti apasārayanti dhairyam yathā cāpalena anupahatā sarva artheṣu avikatthanā

original: svābhāvikī cittavṛttirdhairyamityabhidhīyate//'' iti/ nūnamadya madanodyāne madanotsavadarśanāyāgato'sau kasyāṃcidāsaktacitto madanāvasthayaivābhibhūto vartata ityarthaḥ/ sasaṃdeho niścayāntaḥ samuccayālaṃkāraḥ//20//
analyzed: svābhāvikī citta vṛttiḥ dhairyam iti abhidhīyate iti nūnam adya madana udyāne madana utsava darśanāya āgataḥ asau kasyāṃcid āsakta cittaḥ madana avasthayā eva abhibhūtaḥ vartate iti arthaḥ sa saṃdehaḥ niścaya antaḥ samuccaya alaṃkāraḥ

original: diṣṭetyādinā mādhavapraveśaḥ sūcitaḥ/ tadāha - tata ityādinā/ yathānirdiṣṭaḥ gamanamityādinā nirūpitāvasthaḥ// tāmityādi/ me cetaḥ kartṛ/ induvanmanojñamukhīṃ tāṃ pūrvakṣaṇe nayanātithīkṛtāṃ suciraṃ bahukāla[laṃ] vibhāvya ajakāgryeṇa viṣayāntaraparityāgena bhāvanāviṣayaṃ kṛtvā/ dhyātvetyarthaḥ/
analyzed: diṣṭa ityādinā mādhava praveśaḥ sūcitaḥ tat āha tatas ityādinā yathā nirdiṣṭaḥ gamanam ityādinā nirūpita avasthaḥ tām ityādi me cetaḥ kartṛ indu vat manojña mukhīm tām pūrva kṣaṇe nayana atithīkṛtām suciram vibhāvya aja kāgryeṇa viṣaya antara parityāgena bhāvanā viṣayam kṛtvā dhyātvā iti arthaḥ

original: kathaṃkathamapi kenakenāpi prakāreṇa kadācidapyananubhūtacareṇa/ īdṛgasāviti nirūpayitumaśakyenāvasthābhedenetyarthaḥ/ vyapavartate vaikṛtādanyathaiva vartate/ vikāramupayātītyarthaḥ/ kiṃ kṛtvetyapekṣāyāṃ tāmevāpathavṛttimāha - akāṇḍe'navasare/ prathamadarśanasamaya eva/ lajjām/
analyzed: katham katham api kena kena api prakāreṇa kadācid api ananubhūta careṇa īdṛś asau iti nirūpayitum aśakyena avasthā bhedena iti arthaḥ vyapavartate vaikṛtāt anyathā eva vartate vikāram upayāti iti arthaḥ kim kṛtvā iti apekṣāyām tām eva apatha vṛttim āha akāṇḍena avasare prathama darśana samaye eva lajjām

original: kathamāryavigarhite paropahāsanīye karmaṇi pravṛtto'hamiti manaḥsaṃkocanaṃ lajjā/ yathā - ``manaḥsaṃkocanaṃ lajjā hyanaucityapravartanāt'' iti/ tāṃ vijitya nirasya vinayaṃ vinītatāṃ vinivārya/ dhairyaṃ dhīratāmunmathya mathitvā mantharo mandībhūto vivekaḥ kṛtyākṛtyajñānaṃ yathā syāttatheti//
analyzed: katham ārya vigarhite para upahāsanīye karmaṇi pravṛttaḥ aham iti manaḥ saṃkocanam lajjā yathā manaḥ saṃkocanam lajjā hi anaucitya pravartanāt iti tām vijitya nirasya vinayam vinīta tām vinivārya dhairyam dhīra tām unmathya mathitvā mantharaḥ mandībhūtaḥ vivekaḥ kṛtya akṛtya jñānam yathā syāt tathā iti

original: atra lajjātyāgo vivekamāndyena unmādaśceti saptamāṣṭamāvasthādvayamādāveva rāgotkarṣapradarśanārthamuktamiti draṣṭavyam/ mantharavivekamiti cetoviśeṣaṇaṃ vā//21//
analyzed: atra lajjā tyāgaḥ viveka māndyena unmādaḥ ca iti saptama aṣṭama avasthā dvayam ādau eva rāga utkarṣa pradarśana artham uktam iti draṣṭavyam manthara vivekam iti cetaḥ viśeṣaṇam vā

original: āścaryam/ yadvismayeti/ yanmadīyaṃ manastasyāḥ saṃnidhau vismayenāmānuṣalokocitāpūrvalāvaṇyadarśanajanitena cittavikāsenādbhutarasasthāyinā rasatāmāpannena stimitaṃ niṣpandamastamitānyabhāvaṃ vigalitavedyāntaramamṛtaplavanādiva sudhārṇavanimajjanenevānandena niratiśayasukhāvirbhāvena mandaṃ tadāsvādaikaparatayā niruddhavṛttyantaramabhūt/
analyzed: āścaryam yat vismaya iti yat madīyam manaḥ tasyāḥ saṃnidhau vismayena amānuṣa loka ucita apūrva lāvaṇya darśana janitena citta vikāsena adbhuta rasa sthāyinā rasa tām āpannena stimitam niṣpandam astamita anya bhāvam vigalita vedya antaram amṛta plavanāt iva sudhā arṇava nimajjanena iva ānandena niratiśaya sukha āvirbhāvena mandam tad āsvāda eka para tayā niruddha vṛtti antaram abhūt

original: tadevedānīṃ tadasaṃnidhāvaṅgāracumbitaṃ pradīptendhanaśakalasaṃspṛṣṭamiva/ dagdhamiti vaktavye manogatapreyasīdāhabhiyā cumbitamiti komaloktiḥ/ vyathamānaṃ saṃtapyamānamāste/ tatsaṃnidhānāsaṃnidhānayoḥ kṣaṇamātrabhedenātīvamanovasthāvailakṣaṇyamidamāścaryamityarthaḥ//22//
analyzed: tat eva idānīm tad asaṃnidhau aṅgāra cumbitam pradīpta indhana śakala saṃspṛṣṭam iva dagdham iti vaktavye manaḥ gata preyasī dāha bhiyā cumbitam iti komala uktiḥ vyathamānam saṃtapyamānam āste tad saṃnidhāna asaṃnidhānayoḥ kṣaṇa mātra bhedena atīva manaḥ vasthā vailakṣaṇyam idam āścaryam iti arthaḥ

original: makarando'nyamanaskatayātmānamapaśyantamapi svayameva prajñāpayannākārayati - makarandaḥ/ sakhe mādhaveti/ ita itaḥ/ āgamyatāmiti śeṣaḥ/ lalāṭetyādi/ lalāṭaṃtapo nabhomadhyavartītyarthaḥ/ ``asūryalalāṭayordṛśitapoḥ'' iti khac/ ``khityanavyayasya'' iti mumāgamaḥ// kalahaṃsaḥ - kathaṃ makarandasahacara idameva bālodyānamalaṃkaroti mādhavaḥ/
analyzed: makarandaḥ anya manaska tayā ātmānam a paśyantam api svayam eva prajñāpayan ākārayati makarandaḥ sakhe mādhava iti itas itas āgamyatām iti śeṣaḥ lalāṭa ityādi lalāṭaṃtapaḥ nabhaḥ madhya varti iti arthaḥ a sūrya lalāṭayoḥ dṛśi tapoḥ iti khac kh iti anavyayasya iti mum āgamaḥ kalahaṃsaḥ katham makaranda sahacaraḥ idam eva bāla udyānam alaṃkaroti mādhavaḥ

original: taddarśayāmyasya madanavedanāsvidyamānamālatīlocanasukhāvaham/ citrasya darśanamātraphalakatvāt/ ātmanaḥ praticchandakam/ athavā viśrāmasaukhyaṃ tāvadanubhavatu/ paścāddarśayiṣyāmīti śeṣaḥ// makarandaḥ - taditi/ vikasitakusumakiñjalkānāṃ kaṣāyaśītalo ya āmodo dūravisṛmaro gandhaḥ/
analyzed: tat darśayāmi asya madana vedanā svidyamāna mālatī locana sukha āvaham citrasya darśana mātra phalaka tvāt ātmanaḥ praticchandakam athavā viśrāma saukhyam tāvat anubhavatu paścāt darśayiṣyāmi iti śeṣaḥ makarandaḥ tat iti vikasita kusuma kiñjalkānām kaṣāya śītalaḥ yaḥ āmodaḥ dūra visṛmaraḥ gandhaḥ

original: kaṣāyatvaśiśiratvayo rasadharmatve'pi tādṛśarasenaikārthasamavāyādāmodadharmatvopacāraḥ/ tena surabhīkṛtodyānasya kāñcanapādapasya cāmpeyatarośchāyāyāmupaviśāvaḥ// sakaletyādi/ anyādṛśaṃ vilakṣaṇāvastham/ apiḥ praśne// vihasyeti/
analyzed: kaṣāya tva śiśira tvayoḥ rasa dharma tve pi tādṛśa rasena ekārtha samavāyāt āmoda dharma tva upacāraḥ tena surabhīkṛta udyānasya kāñcana pādapasya cāmpeya taroḥ chāyāyām upaviśāvaḥ sakala ityādi anyādṛśam vilakṣaṇa avastham apiḥ praśne vihasya iti

original: svamanogatajñānādavanatānane mādhave satyaṃ madanavikāra eva madunnīto heturetadvailakṣaṇasyeti svamatisaṃvādādvihasya svānukūlyapradarśanena lajjāṃ śithilayitumāheti śeṣaḥ/ kimiti/ mugdhaṃ sundaram/ tvadantaḥkaraṇanirviśeṣe mayi kimāśaṅkayā lajjayā vā/ tāvadvisrabdhaṃ kathayetyarthaḥ/
analyzed: sva manogata jñānāt avanata ānane mādhave satyam madana vikāraḥ eva mad unnītaḥ hetuḥ etad vailakṣaṇasya iti sva mati saṃvādāt vihasya sva ānukūlya pradarśanena lajjām śithilayitum āha iti śeṣaḥ kim iti mugdham sundaram tvad antaḥkaraṇa nirviśeṣe mayi kim āśaṅkayā lajjayā vā tāvat visrabdham kathaya iti arthaḥ

original: kiṃ ca na khalu tvadupajña evāyaṃ smarābhiṣaṅgaḥ surāsuranarasādhāraṇatvāt/ tenānanyakṛtapūrvātyantānucitavannaitadapahnavo nyāyya ityāha - anyeṣviti/ yo viśvasya dhātari jagatsraṣṭari surajyeṣṭhe svaduhitṛkāmuke/ parameśvare smaraśāsane'pi vāmadehārdhaniveśitapreyasīke tamasāvṛteṣvajñānopahatavivekeṣvanyeṣu jantuṣu/ prāṇimātra ityarthaḥ/
analyzed: kim ca na khalu tvad upajñaḥ eva ayam smara abhiṣaṅgaḥ sura asura nara sādhāraṇa tvāt tena ananya kṛta pūrva atyanta anucita vat na etad apahnavaḥ nyāyyaḥ iti āha anyeṣu iti yaḥ viśvasya dhātari jagatsraṣṭari sura jyeṣṭhe sva duhitṛ kāmuke parameśvare smara śāsane api vāma deha ardha niveśita preyasīke tamasā āvṛteṣu ajñāna upahata vivekeṣu anyeṣu jantuṣu prāṇi mātraḥ iti arthaḥ

original: samo'vaiṣamyeṇākuṇṭhitavyāpāraḥ/ sa tādṛśo'yaṃ tvanmanogataścittajanmā prasiddhavibhavaḥ prathitaprabhāvaḥ khalu brahmādīnapi svavaśīkaroti/ kā kathānyeṣviti bhāvaḥ/ tato lajjayā tava manogatasya vikārahetorapahnutirapahnavaḥ/ citte niyamanamiti yāvat/ mā bhūt/ lajjāṃ visṛjya kathayetyarthaḥ//23//
analyzed: samaḥ vaiṣamyeṇa akuṇṭhita vyāpāraḥ sa tādṛśaḥ yam tvad manaḥ gataḥ cittajanmā prasiddha vibhavaḥ prathita prabhāvaḥ khalu brahma ādīn api sva vaśīkaroti kā kathā anyeṣu iti bhāvaḥ tatas lajjayā tava manaḥ gatasya vikāra hetoḥ apahnutiḥ apahnavaḥ citte niyamanam iti yāvat mā bhūt lajjām visṛjya kathaya iti arthaḥ

original: mādhavaḥ - vayasya, kiṃ na kathayāmi/ sarvavisrambhāspadasya tavāpyapahnavaḥ kimityāśayaḥ/ yadāhuḥ - ``samānurāgavyasano rahasyākhyaikabhājanam/ vipatpratikriyādakṣo vayasyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ//'' iti/
analyzed: mādhavaḥ vayasya kim na kathayāmi sarva visrambha āspadasya tava api apahnavaḥ kim iti āśayaḥ yat āhuḥ sama anurāga vyasanaḥ rahasya ākhyā eka bhājanam vipad pratikriyā dakṣaḥ vayasyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ iti

original: avalokitayā janitaṃ kautukaṃ ``adya khalu mahānutsavo madanodyāne nāgarikāṇām, tattvayāpi taddarśanārthaṃ gantavyam'' ityevamutpādito gamanotsāho yasya so'haṃ kāmadevāyatanamutsavasthānaṃ gato'bhūvam/
analyzed: avalokitayā janitam kautukam adya khalu mahān utsavaḥ madana udyāne nāgarikāṇām tat tvayā api tad darśana artham gantavyam iti evam utpāditaḥ gamana utsāhaḥ yasya saḥ ham kāmadevāyatanam utsava sthānam gataḥ bhūvam

original: tatra cetastataḥ parikramya ramyavastuvilokanalobhātpariśramātparikramaṇasaṃjātādullasito visarpanyo madhuro manoharo madirāmodasamāno yaḥ parimalaḥ/ kesarakusumasyeva jātiprayuktaḥ/ tenākṛṣṭaṃ yatsakalānāṃ milatāmalīnāṃ paṭalaṃ tena saṃkulā vyāptākulitā ca yā mukulaśreṇiḥ saiva manoharamābharaṇaṃ yasya saḥ/
analyzed: tatra ca itas tatas parikramya ramya vastu vilokana lobhāt pariśramāt parikramaṇa saṃjātāt ullasitaḥ visarpan yaḥ madhuraḥ manoharaḥ madirā āmoda samānaḥ yaḥ parimalaḥ kesara kusumasya iva jāti prayuktaḥ tena ākṛṣṭam yat sakalānām milatām alīnām paṭalam tena saṃkulā vyāpta ākulitā ca yā mukula śreṇiḥ sā eva manoharam ābharaṇam yasya saḥ

original: tathā ca ramaṇīye'ṅgaṇe kāmadevāyatanapurobhāge bhavati tathā/ tena samyagutsavāvalokanayogyadeśatvamuktam/ bālabakulasya/ bālatvādupaviśya karāpacayakusumasyetyarthaḥ/ ālavālaparisare pratidinajalasekaśītale sthitaḥ/ nirantaranipatitāni sāndranipatitāni/
analyzed: tathā ca ramaṇīya iṅgaṇe kāmadeva āyatana purobhāge bhavati tathā tena samyak utsava avalokana yogya deśa tvam uktam bāla bakulasya bāla tvāt upaviśya kara apacaya kusumasya iti arthaḥ ālavāla parisare pratidina jala seka śītale sthitaḥ nirantara nipatitāni sāndra nipatitāni

original: upaveśanasthala eva yāvadapekṣaṃ labhyāni vikasitāni tasya kusumāni yadṛcchayā svecchayādāya vidagdhā manojñā yā racanā grathanā tayā manoharāṃ srajamabhinirmātumārabdhavān/ anantaramiti/ saṃcāriṇī saṃcaraṇaśīlā jagadvijayavaijayantikā tribhuvanavijayalāñchanabhūtā puraḥsarī patākā/ tāmevānu manmatho jagajjigīṣayā nirgataḥ/
analyzed: upaveśana sthale eva yāvadapekṣam labhyāni vikasitāni tasya kusumāni yadṛcchayā sva icchayā ādāya vidagdhā manojñā yā racanā grathanā tayā manoharām srajam abhinirmātum ārabdhavān anantaram iti saṃcāriṇī saṃcaraṇa śīlā jagat vijaya vaijayantikā tribhuvana vijaya lāñchana bhūtā puraḥsarī patākā tām eva anu manmathaḥ jagat jigīṣayā nirgataḥ

original: tasya cāhamādiśaravyatāmupagato'smītyāśayaḥ/ ujjvalaṃ prakāśamānaṃ vidagdhamagrāmyaṃ mugdhaṃ sundaraṃ bālocitanepathyaṃ prasādhanaṃ tasya yā viracanā tayā vibhāvitaḥ kumārībhāvaḥ kanyātvaṃ yasyāḥ/ prathamayauvane vartamānatvāt/ vayasā punarna jñāyate kumārīyamityāśayaḥ/ mahānubhāvaprakṛtiratigambhīrasvabhāvā/ atyudāro'tidakṣiṇaḥ/
analyzed: tasya ca aham ādiśaravya tām upagataḥ asmi iti āśayaḥ ujjvalam prakāśamānam vidagdham agrāmyam mugdham sundaram bāla ucita nepathyam prasādhanam tasya yā viracanā tayā vibhāvitaḥ kumārī bhāvaḥ kanyā tvam yasyāḥ prathama yauvane vartamāna tvāt vayasā punar na jñāyate kumārī iyam iti āśayaḥ mahā anubhāva prakṛtiḥ ati gambhīra svabhāvā ati udārā uti dakṣiṇaḥ

original: ``udāro dātṛmahatordakṣiṇe cābhidhīyate'' iti darśanāt/ parijano yasyāḥ sā/ tata eva yatrāhaṃ sthitastatraiveti saptamyarthe tasiḥ/ sārvavibhaktikatvāt/ atha tatprathamato locanapathagocaraṃ tasyāḥ svarūpamidānīmapi pratyakṣamiva vibhāvyamānaṃ nirvarṇayati - seti/ ramaṇīyasya bhāvo rāmaṇīyakam/ ``yopadhādgurūpottamāt'' iti vuñ/
analyzed: udāraḥ dātṛ mahatoḥ dakṣiṇe ca abhidhīyate iti darśanāt parijanaḥ yasyāḥ sā tatas eva yatra aham sthitaḥ tatra eva iti saptamī arthe tasiḥ sārvavibhaktika tvāt atha tad prathamatas locana patha gocaram tasyāḥ svarūpam idānīm api pratyakṣam iva vibhāvyamānam nirvarṇayati sā iti ramaṇīyasya bhāvaḥ rāmaṇīyakam ya upadhāt guru upottamāt iti vuñ

original: ābhirūpyamiti yāvat/ tasya nidhirnikṣepaḥ śaṅkhapadmādivat/ tasyādhiṣṭātṛdevatā vā/ saundaryasya sarvāvayavasauṣṭhavasya niketanaṃ mandiraṃ vā/ sakhe, tasyā nirmāṇe kāraṇamupādānamindvādi/ na tu bhautikam/ madanaśca vedhāḥ/ na tu sādhāraṇo vedābhyāsajaḍaḥ/ yadāha - ``asyāḥ sargavidhau prajāpatirabhūccandro nu kāntiprabhaḥ'' ityādi/
analyzed: ābhirūpyam iti yāvat tasya nidhiḥ nikṣepaḥ śaṅkha padma ādi vat tasya adhiṣṭātṛ devatā vā saundaryasya sarva avayava sauṣṭhavasya niketanam mandiram vā sakhe tasyāḥ nirmāṇe kāraṇam upādānam indu ādi na tu bhautikam madanaḥ ca vedhāḥ na tu sādhāraṇaḥ veda abhyāsa jaḍaḥ yat āha asyāḥ sarga vidhau prajāpatiḥ abhūt candraḥ nu kānti prabhaḥ ityādi

original: anena nāyikāguṇavarṇanena tadviṣayo mahānurāgo'pi śreyāniti bījaguṇapraśaṃsanādvilobhanaṃ nāma mukhasaṃdheraṅgamuktam/ yathā - ``tadguṇākhyā vilobhanam'' iti/ guṇasvarūpanirūpaṇādguṇastutirūpā caturthyavasthā mādhavasya pradarśitā/ yathā - ``rūpaudāryaguṇairlīlāceṣṭāhasitavīkṣitaiḥ/ darśanālāpamādhuryairnāstyatastatsamā vadhūḥ//'' iti/
analyzed: anena nāyikā guṇa varṇanena tad viṣayaḥ mahā anurāgaḥ upi śreyān iti bīja guṇa praśaṃsanāt vilobhanam nāma mukha saṃdheḥ aṅgam uktam yathā tad guṇa ākhyā vilobhanam iti guṇa svarūpa nirūpaṇāt guṇa stuti rūpā caturthī avasthā mādhavasya pradarśitā yathā rūpa audārya guṇaiḥ līlā ceṣṭā hasita vīkṣitaiḥ darśana ālāpa mādhuryaiḥ na asti atas tad samā vadhūḥ iti

original: ``yatredṛśī śivā vāṇī bhavetsaiva guṇastutiḥ'' iti/ vitarkaśca vyabhicārī vyajyate/ yathā - ``ūho vitarka ityuktaḥ parārtheṣu yathāmati'' iti/ saṃśayāpahnavayoḥ saṃsṛṣṭiḥ//24//
analyzed: yatrā īdṛśī śivā vāṇī bhavet sā eva guṇa stutiḥ iti vitarkaḥ ca vyabhicārī vyajyate yathā ūhaḥ vitarkaḥ iti uktaḥ para artheṣu yathāmati iti saṃśaya apahnavayoḥ saṃsṛṣṭiḥ

original: atheti/ praṇayinībhiḥ premaviṣayābhiranucarībhiḥ parisaravartinībhiḥ/ kusumasaṃcayasyāvacaya eva līlā tasyāmabhilāṣavatībhirabhyarthamānā svayameva gantukāmāpi śālīnatayā kuṇṭhitecchā satī tadapanodanāya manovinodinībhiḥ prārthyamānā/ tameva yatrāhaṃ sthitastasyāśca kasmiṃścidapi lokottare/
analyzed: athā iti praṇayinībhiḥ prema viṣayābhiḥ anucarībhiḥ parisara vartinībhiḥ kusuma saṃcayasya avacayaḥ eva līlā tasyām abhilāṣavatībhiḥ abhyarthamānā svayam eva gantu kāmā api śālīna tayā kuṇṭhita icchā satī tad apanodanāya manaḥ vinodinībhiḥ prārthyamānā tam eva yatra aham sthitaḥ tasyāḥ ca kasmiṃścid api loka uttare

original: mahābhāgadheyādaśvamedhādyapi tatkarmakalāpaṃ yadutpādane varākaprāyaṃ tādṛśasucaritaviśeṣājjanma yasya tasmin/ anyādṛśasya tadabhilāṣapātratālakṣaṇatribhuvanasāmrājyasiṃhāsanādhirohaṇasaubhāgyānarhatvāt/ bahudivasopacīyamānamaticirakālātpravardhamānaṃ manmathājjātā yā vyathā tajjanyaṃ vikāramupalakṣitavānasmi/ unnayane liṅgānyāha - yataḥ/
analyzed: mahā bhāgadheyāt aśvamedha ādi api tad karma kalāpam yat utpādane varāka prāyam tādṛśa su carita viśeṣāt janma yasya tasmin anyādṛśasya tad abhilāṣa pātra tā lakṣaṇa tribhuvana sāmrājya siṃhāsana adhirohaṇa saubhāgya anarha tvāt bahu divasa upacīyamānam ati cira kālāt pravardhamānam manmathāt jātā yā vyathā tad janyam vikāram upalakṣitavān asmi unnayane liṅgāni āha yatas

original: parimṛditeti/ parimṛditāpacayena mlāyamānā mṛṇālī visatanturiva/ ``jāterastrīviṣayādayopadhāt'' iti ṅīp[ṣ]/ mlānaṃ glānimupagatam/ kārśyaṃ nāma madanadaśā sūcitā/ kriyāsu snānapānādikāsu parivāraprārthanābhiḥ parijanasya cāṭuvākyapādapraṇāmādibhiranunayaiḥ kathamapi kṛcchreṇa pravṛttiḥ/ na tu svārasyena/
analyzed: parimṛdita iti parimṛdita apacayena mlāyamānā mṛṇālī visa tantuḥ iva jāteḥ astrī viṣaya ādayaḥ upadhāt iti mlānam glānim upagatam kārśyam nāma madana daśā sūcitā kriyāsu snāna pāna ādikāsu parivāra prārthanābhiḥ parijanasya cāṭu vākya pādapraṇāma ādibhiḥ anunayaiḥ katham api kṛcchreṇa pravṛttiḥ na tu svārasyena

original: makarandaḥ - tatastata iti// mādhavaḥ - atrāntara iti/ asminnavasara āyatākṣyāstasyā mānmathamācāryakam/ manmatha eva hi kumārījanasyātyantāparicitatādātmiko dīyamānavividhavilāsaśikṣāyāmācāryaḥ/ tasyācāryakamācāryabhāvaḥ/ ``yopadhādgurūpottamādvuñ''/ vividhaśṛṅgāraceṣṭāśikṣāprāvīṇyamāvirāsītprādurabhūt/ kīdṛśam/
analyzed: makarandaḥ tatas tatas iti mādhavaḥ atrā antare iti asmin avasare āyata akṣyāḥ tasyāḥ mānmatham ācāryakam manmathaḥ eva hi kumārī janasya atyanta aparicita tādātmikaḥ dīyamāna vividha vilāsa śikṣāyām ācāryaḥ tasya ācāryakam ācārya bhāvaḥ vividha śṛṅgāra ceṣṭā śikṣā prāvīṇyam āvirāsīt prādurabhūt kīdṛśam

original: vāgvibhavātivṛttavaicitryamuktiprakārasarvasvollaṅghivicitrabhāvam/ ata eva kimapi viśeṣato nirdeṣṭumaśakyam/ ullasito vibhramo yatra/ vibhramaḥ śṛṅgāraceṣṭāviśeṣaḥ/ yathā - ``vāgaṅgasattvābhinayabhūṣāsthānaviparyayaḥ/ tvarayā kalpito'bhīṣṭadarśane yaḥ sa vibhramaḥ//'' iti/
analyzed: vāc vibhava ativṛtta vaicitrya mukti prakāra sarva sva ullaṅghi vicitra bhāvam atas eva kim api viśeṣataḥ nirdeṣṭum aśakyam ullasitaḥ vibhramaḥ yatra vibhramaḥ śṛṅgāra ceṣṭā viśeṣaḥ yathā vāc aṅga sattva abhinaya bhūṣā sthāna viparyayaḥ tvarayā kalpitaḥ abhīṣṭa darśane yaḥ sa vibhramaḥ iti

original: tanmanasaiva kevalamanusaṃdhīyamānaṃ bhūrisāttvikavikāraṃ pracuratarastambhādisāttvikabhāvam/ sāttvikabhāvādiryaduktam - ``tadbhāvabhāvanaṃ yena bhavettadanukūlataḥ/ tatsattvaṃ tena nirvṛttāḥ sāttvikā ityudīritāḥ//'' yathā - ``stambhaḥ svedo'tha romāñcaḥ svarabhedaśca vepathuḥ/ vaivarṇyamaśrupralaya ityaṣṭau sāttvikā matāḥ//'' iti/
analyzed: tat manasā eva kevalam anusaṃdhīyamānam bhūri sāttvika vikāram pracuratara stambha ādi sāttvika bhāvam sāttvika bhāva ādiḥ yat uktam tad bhāva bhāvanam yena bhavet tad anukūlataḥ tat sattvam tena nirvṛttāḥ sāttvikāḥ iti udīritāḥ yathā stambhaḥ svedaḥ utha romāñcaḥ svarabhedaḥ ca vepathuḥ vaivarṇyam aśru pralayaḥ iti aṣṭau sāttvikāḥ matāḥ iti
