original: apāstadhairyamanyonyadarśanādubhayorapyapākṛtacittasthairyam/ vijayi jayaśīlam/ kutrāpyakuṇṭhitaprasaramiti/ atra paripūrṇaśṛṅgārānubhavanibandhanāttaducitamohāvegādivyabhicāripratīterālambanoddīpanavibhāvasaṃnidhānapūrṇaḥ śṛṅgārarasadhvaniḥ/ parikaraścālaṃkāraḥ//29//
analyzed: apāsta dhairyam anyonya darśanāt ubhayoḥ api apākṛta citta sthairyam vijayi jaya śīlam kutra api akuṇṭhita prasaram iti atra paripūrṇa śṛṅgāra anubhava nibandhanāt tad ucita moha āvega ādi vyabhicāri pratīteḥ ālambana uddīpana vibhāva saṃnidhāna pūrṇaḥ śṛṅgāra rasa dhvaniḥ parikaraḥ ca alaṃkāraḥ

original: ataśca cirakālapravṛttasya garīyasaḥ pūrvānurāgasya śabdavikalpasmaraṇasaṃtānopacitasya jīvitasarvasvāyamānasya tasyaiva svālambanavibhāvasya sāṃmukhyādanyonyakaṭākṣamiśrībhāvādutpūrasya sudhākarakarasparśādivakṣīrasāgarasyāpūritāntaratayā paripūrṇakumbhoccalananyāyena muhurbahiruccalato niratiśayaparipoṣātmikāṃ rasatāmāpannasya taraṅgacchaṭā iva
analyzed: atas ca cira kāla pravṛttasya garīyasaḥ pūrva anurāgasya śabda vikalpa smaraṇa saṃtāna upacitasya jīvita sarva svāyamānasya tasya eva sva ālambana vibhāvasya sāṃmukhyāt anyonya kaṭākṣa miśrībhāvāt utpūrasya sudhākara kara sparśāt iva kṣīrasāgarasya āpūrita antara tayā paripūrṇa kumbha uccalana nyāyena muhur bahis uccalataḥ niratiśaya paripoṣa ātmikām rasa tām āpannasya taraṅga chaṭāḥ iva

original: prathamānubhāvabhūtāḥ śṛṅgāradṛṣṭayo madālambanāḥ prādurāsannityāha - tataśca/ stimiteti/ ahamālokitānāṃ śṛṅgāradṛṣṭiviśeṣāṇāṃ vividhaṃ pātramabhūvam/ ``prasādalalitā kāntā śālinī manmathāśayā/ vicaladbhūkaṭākṣā ca śṛṅgāre dṛṣṭiriṣyate//'' iti/
analyzed: prathama anubhāva bhūtāḥ śṛṅgāra dṛṣṭayaḥ mad ālambanāḥ prādurāsan iti āha tatas ca stimita iti aham ālokitānām śṛṅgāra dṛṣṭi viśeṣāṇām vividham pātram abhūvam prasāda lalitā kāntā śālinī manmatha āśayā vicalat bhū kaṭākṣā ca śṛṅgāre dṛṣṭiḥ iṣyate iti

original: tadviśeṣaṃ darśayituṃ viśinaṣṭi - stimitānāmunmīlanānantarameva purovartini mayi nipatya darśanalobhena tatraiva viṣaye niścalānām/ stimitaṃ nāma śṛṅgāradṛṣṭivikāraḥ/ yathā - ``svagocarānna cālyeta yattatstimitamucyate'' iti/ tato vikasitānāṃ viṣayagatāśeṣaviṣayagrāhiṇām/ vikasitadṛṣṭivikāro yathā - ``vikāsitaṃ yadviṣaye viśeṣamavagāhate'' iti/
analyzed: tad viśeṣam darśayitum viśinaṣṭi stimitānām unmīlana anantaram eva purovartini mayi nipatya darśana lobhena tatra eva viṣaye niścalānām stimitam nāma śṛṅgāra dṛṣṭi vikāraḥ yathā sva gocarāt na cālyeta yat tat stimitam ucyate iti tatas vikasitānām viṣaya gata aśeṣa viṣaya grāhiṇām vikasita dṛṣṭi vikāraḥ yathā vikāsitam yat viṣaye viśeṣam avagāhate iti

original: ato viṣayāsvādajanmānandabhāvanayollasantī kiṃciducchvasantī caturākhyabhrūkarmasahitā bhrūlatā yeṣām/ caturaṃ nāma bhrūkarma/ yathā - ``caturaṃ kiṃciducchvāsānmadhurā racanā bhruvoḥ'' iti/ prasannākhyaścānena dṛgvikāra uktaḥ/ yathā - ``prasannaṃ tadbhavetsabhrūvilāsaṃ sasmitaṃ ca yat'' iti/ ato masṛṇānāmanurāgapeśalānām/
analyzed: atas viṣaya āsvāda janma ānanda bhāvanayā ullasantī kiṃcid ucchvasantī catur ākhya bhrūkarma sahitā bhrū latā yeṣām caturam nāma bhrū karma yathā caturam kiṃcid ucchvāsāt madhurā racanā bhruvoḥ iti prasanna ākhyaḥ ca anena dṛś vikāraḥ uktaḥ yathā prasannam tat bhavet sa bhrū vilāsam sa smitam ca yat iti atas masṛṇānām anurāga peśalānām

original: masṛṇadṛgvikāro yathā - ``masṛṇaṃ tattu vijñeyamanurāgakaṣāyitam'' iti/ tataḥ sukhapāravaśyānmukulitānāmanunmīlitānām/ mukulitā dṛṣṭiranenoktā/ mukulitākhyaśca dṛgvikāro yathā - ``sphuritāśliṣṭapakṣmāgrā mukulordhvapuṭocchritā/ sukhonmīlitatārā ca mukulā dṛṣṭiriṣyate//
analyzed: masṛṇa dṛś vikāraḥ yathā masṛṇam tat tu vijñeyam anurāga kaṣāyitam iti tatas sukha pāravaśyāt mukulitānām anunmīlitānām mukulitā dṛṣṭiḥ anena uktā mukulita ākhyaḥ ca dṛś vikāraḥ yathā sphurita āśliṣṭa pakṣma agrā mukula ūrdhva puṭa ucchritā sukha unmīlita tārā ca mukulā dṛṣṭiḥ iṣyate

original: dṛṣṭirmukulitā svapnasukhanidrāsu vartate//'' iti anena vikūṇitākhyadṛgvikāra uktaḥ/ vikūṇitaṃ yathā - ``bhāgatrayasya saṃkocovikāsastvaparasya ca/ yasyā dṛṣṭervilakṣeṇa tadvikūṇitamucyate//'' iti/ tataḥ punardarśanaspṛhayā prānte'pāṅgadeśe vistārabhājāṃ visṛtvarāṇām/ samyagāśliṣṭaviṣayāṇāmiti yāvat/
analyzed: dṛṣṭiḥ mukulitā svapna sukha nidrāsu vartate iti anena vikūṇita ākhya dṛś vikāraḥ uktaḥ vikūṇitam yathā bhāga trayasya saṃkocaḥ vikāsaḥ tu aparasya ca yasyāḥ dṛṣṭeḥ vilakṣeṇa tat vikūṇitam ucyate iti tatas punar darśana spṛhayā vistāra bhājām visṛtvarāṇām samyak āśliṣṭa viṣayāṇām iti yāvat

original: apāṅgadṛṣṭirhi tatraiva nipatantī samyagviṣayaṃ paricchinatti/ anena vistārī saspṛhaśceti dṛgvikāradvayamuktam/ yathā - ``yenāśliṣṭo hi viṣayastadvistārīti kathyate/ bhūyobhūyaḥ spṛhā yatra dṛṣṭestatsaspṛhaṃ bhavet//'' iti/
analyzed: apāṅga dṛṣṭiḥ hi tatra eva nipatantī samyak viṣayam paricchinatti anena vistārī sa spṛhaḥ ca iti dṛś vikāra dvayam uktam yathā yena āśliṣṭaḥ hi viṣayaḥ tat vistāri iti kathyate bhūyas bhūyas spṛhā yatra dṛṣṭeḥ tat sa spṛham bhavet iti

original: tataḥ pratinayanasya tadavalokanāya prahitasya mannetrasya nipāta ābhimukhyena yugapadupasthāne lajjayā kiṃcidākuñcitānāmīṣatsaṃkucitānām/ saṃkucitaṃ nāma dṛgvikāro yathā - ``apāṅgabhāgasaṃkoco yatra tatkuñcitaṃ bhavet'' iti/ bahuvacanena dhārāvāhinyāyena pravṛttipratīterlolākhyo dṛṣṭivikāra uktaḥ/
analyzed: tatas pratinayanasya tad avalokanāya prahitasya mad netrasya nipāte ābhimukhyena yugapad upasthāne lajjayā kiṃcid ākuñcitānām īṣat saṃkucitānām saṃkucitam nāma dṛś vikāraḥ yathā apāṅga bhāga saṃkocaḥ yatra tat kuñcitam bhavet iti bahuvacanena dhārāvāhi nyāyena pravṛtti pratīteḥ lola ākhyaḥ dṛṣṭi vikāraḥ uktaḥ

original: yathā - ``dhārāvāhikasaṃcāro yasya tallolamucyate'' iti/ vividhapadenānyānapi madhurasābhilāṣasotkaṇṭhitasotsukasamanmathapraṇayipremagarbhavikocalalitakomalamukhāñśṛṅgāradṛṣṭivikāraviśeṣānsaṃgṛhṇāti/ tallakṣaṇāni vistarabhayānna likhitāni/ parikara evālaṃkāraḥ//30//
analyzed: yathā dhārāvāhika saṃcāraḥ yasya tat lolam ucyate iti vividha padena anyān api madhu rasa abhilāṣa sa utkaṇṭhita sa utsuka sa manmatha praṇayi prema garbha vikoca lalita komala mukhān śṛṅgāra dṛṣṭi vikāra viśeṣān saṃgṛhṇāti tad lakṣaṇāni vistara bhayāt na likhitāni parikaraḥ eva alaṃkāraḥ

original: idānīṃ tādṛgavalokanapātramabhūvam/ tasmātpunastādātmikīmavasthāmāha - tataśca/ alaseti/ pakṣmale atisāndrapakṣmamāle akṣiṇī yasyāstasyāḥ kaṭākṣaiḥ ``apāṅge tāravikṣepaḥ kaṭākṣa iti kathyate'' ityuktalakṣaṇairdṛṣṭiviśeṣaiḥ pūrvoktairmehṛdayamaśaraṇaṃ sattadā mama pāravaśyenākiṃcitkaratvādanyena ca rakṣaṇasyāśakyatvāttadabhāvācca
analyzed: idānīm tādṛś avalokana pātram abhūvam tasmāt punar tādātmikīm avasthām āha tatas ca alasā iti pakṣmale ati sāndra pakṣma māle akṣiṇī yasyāḥ tasyāḥ kaṭākṣaiḥ apāṅge tāra vikṣepaḥ kaṭākṣaḥ iti kathyate iti ukta lakṣaṇaiḥ dṛṣṭi viśeṣaiḥ pūrva uktaiḥ me hṛdayam aśaraṇam sat tadā mama pāravaśyena akiṃcitkara tvāt anyena ca rakṣaṇasya aśakya tvāt tad abhāvāt ca

original: rakṣitāramalabhamānaṃ sat/ apahṛtaṃ balādācchidya gṛhītam/ kaṭākṣāṇāṃ manoharatvāttadā manaḥśūnya ivābhavam/ pramuṣitamatitvāttatastairapahṛtya tadapaviddhamatitīkṣṇatvātteṣāṃ nārācairiva vikṣatam/ niśitaśalākāgrakṛtarandhramiva vyathāmanvabhūdityarthaḥ/
analyzed: rakṣitāram alabhamānam sat apahṛtam balāt ācchidya gṛhītam kaṭākṣāṇām manohara tvāt tadā manaḥ śūnyaḥ iva abhavam pramuṣita mati tvāt tatas taiḥ apahṛtya tat apaviddham ati tīkṣṇa tvāt teṣām nārācaiḥ iva vikṣatam niśita śalākā agra kṛta randhram iva vyathām anvabhūt iti arthaḥ

original: tataśca saṃtaptamadananārācakalpatvātteṣāṃ tadapavedhena dravībhūya tatraiva dhārājalanyāyena vilīnatvāttaiḥ pītamiva/ yathā pītaṃ salilādikaṃ pāturantarvilīyate, evaṃ kaṭākṣeṣu manmano vilīnamityarthaḥ/ tataśca tairmadīyahṛdayālavāle līnasyāpi manasaḥ punaraṅkurodayaśaṅkayā tadunmūlitamutkhātamūlaṃ kṛtam/ apunarudbhavayogyaṃ kṛtamityarthaḥ/
analyzed: tatas ca saṃtapta madana nārāca kalpa tvāt teṣām tad apavedhena dravībhūya tatra eva dhārā jala nyāyena vilīna tvāt taiḥ pītam iva yathā pītam salila ādikam pātuḥ antar vilīyate evam kaṭākṣeṣu mad manaḥ vilīnam iti arthaḥ tatas ca taiḥ madīya hṛdaya ālavāle līnasya api manasaḥ punar aṅkura udaya śaṅkayā tat unmūlitam utkhāta mūlam kṛtam apunar udbhava yogyam kṛtam iti arthaḥ

original: manaḥpāravaśyātiśayoktiḥ/ kavinā prauḍhyutkarṣādevaṃ nirūpitam/ kecittu - vidagdho yathā kaścinnālikeratarostatphalamapahṛtyāyaḥśūlenāpavidhya sarandhraṃ kṛtvā tadantaḥsalitaṃ[laṃ] nipīya tadantaḥsāramunmūlya bhakṣayati, evaṃ kaṭākṣā api mādhavādeva tarormanaḥphalamapahṛtya gāmbhīryadhairyādinā dṛḍhatvātprathamamapavidhya sakṣataṃ kṛtvā
analyzed: manaḥ pāravaśya atiśayoktiḥ kavinā prauḍhī utkarṣāt evam nirūpitam kecid tu vidagdhaḥ yathā kaścid nālikera taroḥ tad phalam apahṛtya ayaḥ śūlena apavidhya sa randhram kṛtvā nipīya tad antar sāram unmūlya bhakṣayati evam kaṭākṣāḥ api mādhavāt eva taroḥ manaḥ phalam apahṛtya gāmbhīrya dhairya ādinā dṛḍha tvāt prathamam apavidhya sa kṣatam kṛtvā

original: tadantargataṃ lajjāvinayavivekādikaṃ kṣatavivaranirgataṃ nipīya tāvatāpyatṛptatvāccaitanyalakṣaṇaṃ mūlamunmūlyāgrasannityevaṃ nālikeraphalasamādhirukteti vyācakṣate/ kīdṛśaiḥ kaṭākṣairityata āha - alaseti/ alasāḥ prathamapātitāḥ/ purataḥ prasāritāḥ purovartini mayyeva nipātitāḥ/ paścādvibhāvya vrīḍayeva pratinivṛttāḥ/
analyzed: tad antargatam lajjā vinaya viveka ādikam kṣata vivara nirgatam nipīya tāvatā api atṛpta tvāt caitanya lakṣaṇam mūlam unmūlya agrasan iti evam nālikera phala samādhiḥ uktā iti vyācakṣate kīdṛśaiḥ kaṭākṣaiḥ iti atas āha alasa iti alasāḥ prathama pātitāḥ puratas prasāritāḥ purovartini mayi eva nipātitāḥ paścāt vibhāvya vrīḍayā iva pratinivṛttāḥ

original: alasādayaḥ śṛṅgāradṛṣṭivikārāḥ/ tatrālasaṃ yathā - ``alasaṃ tadabhīṣṭārthādvrīḍādyairyannivartate'' iti/ tato valitāḥ punardarśanotkaṇṭhayā tiryagudañcitāḥ/ valitaṃ yathā - ``valitaṃ tannivṛttasya bhūyastryaśrāvalokanam''/ ``tryaśraṃ tiryagudañcitam'' iti tryaśralakṣaṇam/ tato mugdhāḥ savyājabhāvagarbhasvabhāvāḥ/
analyzed: alasa ādayaḥ śṛṅgāra dṛṣṭi vikārāḥ tatra alasam yathā alasam tat abhīṣṭa arthāt vrīḍā ādyaiḥ yat nivartate iti tatas valitāḥ punar darśana utkaṇṭhayā tiryak udañcitāḥ valitam yathā valitam tat nivṛttasya bhūyas tri aśra avalokanam tri aśram tiryak udañcitam iti tri aśra lakṣaṇam tatas mugdhāḥ sa vyāja bhāva garbha svabhāvāḥ

original: mugdhaṃ yathā - ``svabhāvālokita[taṃ] mugdhaṃ bhāvagarbhamapi cchalāt'' iti/ tataḥ snigdhāḥ snehaparyāyaratibhāvānuviddhāḥ snigdhā dṛṣṭiryathā - ``snigdhaṃ yadratibhāvena snehaprāyeṇa saṃyutam'' iti/ tato niṣpandā viṣayādanyatra kvāpi na calantaḥ/ niṣpandaṃ yathā - ``niṣpandaṃ tadyadanyatra dṛṣṭānna spandate kvacit'' iti/

original: tato mandā viṣayāntaragamanānudyuktāḥ/ mantharadṛṣṭiranenoktā/ yathā - ``mantharā mandasaṃcārā'' iti/ adhikaṃ vikasannāścaryakārivastudarśanalakṣaṇāduddīpanādvistāraṃ rasabhāvonmukhatvamupanayan/ antaḥkaraṇagato vismayo'dbhutarasasthāyī/ tena smerāḥ sphuratpakṣmapaṅktibhirutphullatārā yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ/

original: kalahaṃsaḥ - dṛḍhaṃ khalveṣa kayāpyadyāpahṛtaḥ/ api nāma mālatyeva sā bhavet/ dṛḍhaṃ yathā vanitāntaravārtāmapi na sahate tathā/ kayāpyadya yātrāsamaye nayanapathapatitayā/ yātrā hi yūnoḥ prathamāvalokane prāthamikopāyaḥ/ yathā - ``yātrā puraskandanamutsaho vā svapno'tha citraṃ ratisaṃkathā vā/
analyzed: kalahaṃsaḥ dṛḍham khalu eṣa kayā api adya apahṛtaḥ api nāma mālatī eva sā bhavet dṛḍham yathā vanitā antara vārtām api na sahate tathā kayā api adya yātrā samaye nayana patha patitayā yātrā hi yūnoḥ prathama avalokane prāthamika upāyaḥ yathā yātrā pura skandanam utsahaḥ vā svapnaḥ utha citram rati saṃkathā vā

original: bhavantyupāyāḥ prathamāvalokane yūnoryato vṛddhimupaiti rāgaḥ//'' iti/ apahṛtaḥ svāyattacittaḥ kṛtaḥ/ sā etaccittākarṣiṇī/ apināmeti saṃbhāvanāyām/ mālatyeva saṃbhāvitā/ tasyā evaitadabhilāṣagocaratāyogyalāvaṇyaśālitvāditi bhāvaḥ// makarandaḥ - svagatamiti/ aśrāvyārthaprayoge svagatamiti prayujyate/
analyzed: bhavanti upāyāḥ prathama avalokane yūnoḥ yatas vṛddhim upaiti rāgaḥ iti apahṛtaḥ sva āyatta cittaḥ kṛtaḥ sā etad citta ākarṣiṇī api nāma iti saṃbhāvanāyām mālatyā eva saṃbhāvitā tasyāḥ eva etad abhilāṣa gocara tā yogya lāvaṇya śāli tvāt iti bhāvaḥ makarandaḥ svagatam iti a śrāvya artha prayoge svagatam iti prayujyate

original: taduktam - ``aśrāvyaśrāvyabhedena dvidhā vastu prakīrtitam/ sarvatra niyatasyeti śrāvyaṃ ca dvividhaṃ smṛtam// aśrāvyaṃ svagataṃ tatra prayojyaṃ svagataṃ tviti/ sarvaśrāvyaṃ prakāśaṃ syātprakāśamiti tadvadet// śrāvyaṃ tu niyatasyaiva nāṭyadharmamapekṣya ca/ dvidhā vibhajyate tatra janāntamapavāritam/ tripatākākareṇānyānapavāryāntarā kathām/
analyzed: tat uktam aśrāvya śrāvya bhedena dvidhā vastu prakīrtitam sarvatra niyatasya iti śrāvyam ca dvividham smṛtam aśrāvyam svagatam tatra prayojyam svagatam tu iti sarva śrāvyam prakāśam syāt prakāśam iti tat vadet śrāvyam tu niyatasya eva nāṭya dharmam apekṣya ca dvidhā vibhajyate tatra jana antam apavāritam tripatākā kareṇa anyān apavārya antarā kathām

original: anyonyāmantraṇaṃ yatsyāttajjanāntikamucyate// rahasyaṃ kathyate'nyatra parāvṛtyāpavāritam/ vastunirvāhakatvena nāṭyadharmaprasaṅgataḥ//'' iti/ abhiṣaṅgo'bhiniviśaḥ/ apūrvo'yamekapade cittāsaṅgaprakarṣa ityadbhutāveśātparibhāvanaṃ nāma saṃdhyaṅgamuktaṃ bhavati/ ``paribhāvo'dbhutāveśaḥ'' iti/ tatkimiti/ itthamidānīmasyonmādadaśā vartate/
analyzed: anyonya āmantraṇam yat syāt tat jana antikam ucyate rahasyam vastu nirvāhaka tvena nāṭya dharma prasaṅgataḥ iti abhiṣaṅgaḥ apūrvaḥ yam eka pade citta asaṅga prakarṣaḥ iti adbhuta āveśāt paribhāvanam nāma saṃdhi aṅgam uktam bhavati paribhāva udbhuta āveśaḥ iti tat kim iti ittham idānīm asya unmāda daśā vartate

original: tena samanantaradaśopanipātātpūrvameva kimenamasmādabhiṣaṅgānnivārayāmīti svātmanyeva vitarkaḥ/ evaṃ vitarkya nivāraṇamaśakyamiti nirdhārayati - athavā/ mā mūmuhaditi/ ananyajanmāsvacittaikayoniḥ kāmo bhavantaṃ mā mūmuhanna mohaṃ prāpayatu/ āśiṣi luṅ/
analyzed: tena samanantara daśa upanipātāt pūrvam eva kim enam asmāt abhiṣaṅgāt nivārayāmi iti sva ātmani eva vitarkaḥ evam vitarkya nivāraṇam aśakyam iti nirdhārayati athavā mā mūmuhat iti ananya janmā sva citta eka yoniḥ kāmaḥ bhavantam mā mūmuhat na moham prāpayatu āśiṣi luṅ

original: tava matirmalīmaso malinastrivargapratyanīkatvānnindito yo vikāro manmathābhiṣaṅgastena ghanā sāndratarā channā mā bhūdityādyupadeśajātamihaivamavasthe'sminnirarthakamakāryakāritvānniṣphalam/ nanvityātmana evāvadhāraṇe/
analyzed: tava matiḥ malīmasaḥ malinaḥ trivarga pratyanīka tvāt ninditaḥ yaḥ vikāraḥ manmatha abhiṣaṅgaḥ tena ghanā sāndratarā channā mā bhūt ityādi upadeśa jātam iha evam avasthā ismin nirarthakam akārya kāri tvāt niṣphalam nanu iti ātmanaḥ eva avadhāraṇe

original: nairarthakye hetumāha - yasminmādhave kāmaśca jṛmbhitāḥ saṃjātajṛmbhāḥ pratyagravyaktanidrā vijṛmbhamāṇaguṇā virahijanaprāṇahāriṇo vyāpārā yasya tathābhūto vartate/ yauvanaṃ ca pravṛddhavivekapramoṣaṇādidharmakaṃ vartate/ tasmānnedānīmasya kiṃcidapyupadeṣṭavyamasti/
analyzed: nairarthakye hetum āha yasmin mādhave kāmaḥ ca jṛmbhitāḥ saṃjāta jṛmbhāḥ pratyagra vyakta nidrāḥ vijṛmbhamāṇa guṇāḥ virahi jana prāṇa hāriṇaḥ vyāpārāḥ yasya tathābhūtaḥ vartate yauvanam ca pravṛddha viveka pramoṣaṇa ādi dharmakam vartate tasmāt na idānīm asya kiṃcid api upadeṣṭavyam asti

original: pāṭaccaraluṇṭhitasarvasvaṃ pathikaṃ prati ``corabhūyiṣṭho'yaṃ mārgaḥ, tannānena pathā gantavyam'' ityupadeśavadvṛthaiva balavanmanmathākṛṣṭamānasaṃ prati madanavaśago mā bhūrityupadeśo'tītakālatvādvyartha eva/ yadāha - ``yo hi brūyādbhuktavantaṃ mā bhukthā iti kiṃ tena kṛtaṃ syāt'' iti//35//
analyzed: pāṭaccara luṇṭhita sarva svam pathikam prati cora bhūyiṣṭhaḥ yam mārgaḥ tat na anena pathā gantavyam iti upadeśa vat vṛthā eva balavat manmatha ākṛṣṭa mānasam prati madana vaśagaḥ mā bhūḥ iti upadeśa utīta kāla tvāt vyarthaḥ eva yat āha yaḥ hi brūyāt bhuktavantam mā bhukthāḥ iti kim tena kṛtam syāt iti

original: evamātmanyeva niṣedhāśakyatāṃ nirdhārya tadabhilaṣitasaṃpādanenaiva tadupadravaṃ parijihīrṣaurānukūlyamavalambya pṛcchati - prakāśamiti/ vayasya, sā tāvattvaduparyanurakteti tvaduktena tacceṣṭāviśeṣeṇa jñātam/ kasminkule jātā saṃbandhayogyā vā kiṃnāmadheyā vetyetaditaḥ paraṃ jñātavyam/ tatsādhanāya tvayā yatkiṃcidviditamiti praśnaḥ//
analyzed: evam ātmani eva niṣedha aśakya tām nirdhārya tad abhilaṣita saṃpādanena eva tad upadravam parijihīrṣā aura ānukūlyam avalambya pṛcchati prakāśam iti vayasya sā tāvat tvad upari anuraktā iti tvad uktena tad ceṣṭā viśeṣeṇa jñātam kasmin kule jātā saṃbandha yogyā vā kiṃnāmadheyā vā iti etat itas param jñātavyam tad sādhanāya tvayā yat kiṃcid viditam iti praśnaḥ

original: mādhavaḥ - śrūyatāmityādi/ vilambya kusumāpacayavyājena vilambaṃ kṛtvā/ kusumāpacayakrameṇa tānyupacinomi/ tāni tānītyevaṃrūpeṇa nedīyasībhūyaḥ[ya] saṃnihitā bhūtvā kusumāpīḍavyājena praṇamya śirasi sragbandhanavyājena lalāṭataṭaghaṭitakarakamalasaṃpuṭā namaskṛtya/ namaskāreṇa svabhartṛdārikāyāstvameva bharteti tathā sūcitam/
analyzed: mādhavaḥ śrūyatām ityādi vilambya kusuma apacaya vyājena vilambam kṛtvā kusuma apacaya krameṇa tāni upacinomi tāni tāni iti evaṃrūpeṇa saṃnihitā bhūtvā kusumāpīḍa vyājena praṇamya śirasi sraj bandhana vyājena lalāṭa taṭa ghaṭita kara kamala saṃpuṭā namaskṛtya namaskāreṇa sva bhartṛ dārikāyāḥ tvam eva bhartā iti tathā sūcitam

original: māmevaṃ vakṣyamāṇamuktavatī/ sā tāvatpūrvamevāvalokitādimukhānmādhavasya sarvakalākauśalaṃ jñātavatī satī nipuṇaṃ vaktumupakramate - mahābhāgetyādi/ mahānbhāgo bhāgadheyaṃ yasya/ ``nāmarūpabhāgebhyo dheyaḥ'' iti svārthe dheyapratyayavidhānādbhāga eṣa bhāgadheyam/ ākṛtiviśeṣeṇaivopalakṣyamāṇamahābhāgyātiśayetyarthaḥ/
analyzed: mām evam vakṣyamāṇam uktavatī sā tāvat pūrvam eva avalokita ādi mukhāt mādhavasya sarva kalā kauśalam jñātavatī satī nipuṇam vaktum upakramate mahābhāga ityādi mahān bhāgaḥ bhāgadheyam yasya nāma rūpa bhāgebhyaḥ dheyaḥ iti svārthe dheya pratyaya vidhānāt bhāgaḥ eṣa bhāgadheyam ākṛti viśeṣeṇa eva upalakṣyamāṇa mahābhāgya atiśaya iti arthaḥ

original: eṣa saṃniveśaḥ kusumasaṃniveśanaprakāraḥ sragviracanāvaidagdhyaṃ suśliṣṭaguṇatayā susaṃghaṭitagranthimatsūtratvena ramaṇīyo manoharaḥ/ kutūhalinī cāsminvidagdhātiśaye kusumadāmaviracanāviśeṣe cāsmākaṃ bhartṛdārikā/ bhūrivasoramātyasya rājatulyatvāttatsutāpi bhartṛdāriketyucyate bahumānasūcanāya/
analyzed: eṣa saṃniveśaḥ kusuma saṃniveśana prakāraḥ sraj viracanā vaidagdhyam su śliṣṭa guṇa tayā su saṃghaṭita granthimat sūtra tvena ramaṇīyaḥ manoharaḥ kutūhalinī ca asmin vidagdha atiśaye kusuma dāma viracanā viśeṣe ca asmākam bhartṛ dārikā bhūrivasoḥ amātyasya rāja tulya tvāt tad sutā api bhartṛ dārikā iti ucyate bahu māna sūcanāya

original: tasyāmadhikaraṇabhūtāyāmabhinavo'nyatrādṛṣṭapūrvo vicitraścamatkārakārī kusumeṣu viṣaye vyāpāro mālyagrathanārūpo'sti/ svayamasyāṃ kusumaracanāyāmatiśayenāsādhāraṇīṃ prasiddhimupagatā svavaidagdhyasadṛśaṃ bhavato mālyagrathanakauśalamupalabhyedānīṃ kautukākrāntamānasā vartata ityarthaḥ/
analyzed: tasyām adhikaraṇa bhūtāyām abhinavaḥ anyatra adṛṣṭa pūrvaḥ vicitraḥ camatkāra kārī kusumeṣu viṣaye vyāpāraḥ mālya grathanā rūpaḥ asti svayam asyām kusuma racanāyām atiśayena asādhāraṇīm prasiddhim upagatā sva vaidagdhya sadṛśam bhavataḥ mālya grathana kauśalam upalabhya idānīm kautuka ākrānta mānasā vartate iti arthaḥ

original: tattasmāttvadīyasya vaidagdhyasya kusumadāmaracanāprāvīṇyasya kṛtārthatāvidagdhayā tayopalālanāccaritārthatā bhavatu/ yathāha - ``ā paritoṣādviduṣāṃ na sādhu manye prayogavijñānam'' iti/ asyā api srajo nirmāṇasya ramaṇīyatābhijñajanamanorañjanenaiva phalena phalatu apacitakusumānāṃ svasvaphalājanakatve'pyetadeva phalamastvityarthaḥ/
analyzed: tat tasmāt tvadīyasya vaidagdhyasya kusuma dāma racanā prāvīṇyasya kṛtārtha tā vidagdhayā tayā upalālanāt caritārtha tā bhavatu yathā āha paritoṣāt viduṣām na sādhu manye prayoga vijñānam iti asyāḥ api srajaḥ nirmāṇasya ramaṇīya tā abhijña jana manaḥ rañjanena eva phalena phalatu apacita kusumānām sva sva phala ajanaka tve pi etat eva phalam astu iti arthaḥ

original: tadeṣa te saraso'mlānaḥ, tathā sārasyena cāturyeṇānvitaḥ, tathā tvayānurāgeṇa samarpitaḥ, kusumavyāpāro bhartṛdārikāyāḥ kaṇṭhāvalambanena grīvālaṃkāratayā dhāraṇena mahārghatāṃ mahāmūlyatāmāsādayatu prāpnotu/
analyzed: tat eṣa te sarasaḥ mlānaḥ tathā sārasyena cāturyeṇa anvitaḥ tathā tvayā anurāgeṇa samarpitaḥ kusuma vyāpāraḥ bhartṛ dārikāyāḥ kaṇṭha avalambanena grīvā alaṃkāra tayā dhāraṇena mahārgha tām mahā mūlya tām āsādayatu prāpnotu

original: yathā kiṃciduttamaṃ ratnamuttamakanakabhūṣaṇasthāpitaṃ mahāmūlyaṃ bhavati, tathedamapi bakuladāmaratnabhūtaṃ bhartṛdārikākaṇṭhābharaṇatvena mahāmūlyaṃ bhavatviti prakṛto'rthaḥ/ anyastu - eṣo'smādṛśasya sakhījanasya taṭasthasahṛdayalokasya cāśāsyatvena buddhau viparivartamānaḥ saṃniveśo bhavatoḥ saṃbandho'bhilāṣamātram/
analyzed: yathā kiṃcid uttamam ratnam uttama kanaka bhūṣaṇa sthāpitam mahā mūlyam bhavati tathā idam api bakula dāma ratna bhūtam bhartṛ dārikā kaṇṭha ābharaṇa tvena mahā mūlyam bhavatu iti prakṛtaḥ ūrthaḥ anyaḥ tu eṣa usmādṛśasya sakhī janasya taṭastha sahṛdaya lokasya ca āśāsya tvena buddhau viparivartamānaḥ saṃniveśaḥ bhavatoḥ saṃbandhaḥ abhilāṣa mātram

original: tasyāṃ viṣaye'bhinavaḥ kenāpi virahiṇānanubhūtapūrvaḥ, ata eva vicitro vismayakārī kusumeṣorvyāpāraḥ/ tvāmuddiśya smareṇa balavadabhibhūyata ityarthaḥ/ tattasmādanyonyasamāgamenobhayorvaidagdhyasya sakalakalāparijñānasya kṛtārthatā bhavatu/
analyzed: tasyām viṣayebhinavaḥ kena api virahiṇā an anubhūta pūrvaḥ atas eva vicitraḥ vismaya kārī kusumeṣoḥ vyāpāraḥ tvām uddiśya smareṇa balavat abhibhūyate iti arthaḥ tat tasmāt anyonya samāgamena ubhayoḥ vaidagdhyasya sakala kalā parijñānasya kṛtārtha tā bhavatu

original: tvadīyavaidagdhyasāraṃ saiva loke veditumarhā tasyāśca tvamevetyanyonyasadṛśābhijñaviṣayalābhādubhayorvaidagdhyaṃ caritārthamastvirthaḥ[tyarthaḥ]/ vaidagdhyalakṣaṇaṃ ca - ``laukike vaidike vārthe tathā sāmayike'pi ca/ samyakparicayaprauḍhirvaidagdhyamiti gīyate//'' iti/
analyzed: tvadīya vaidagdhya sāram sā eva loke veditum arhā tasyāḥ ca tvam eva iti anyonya sadṛśa abhijña viṣaya lābhāt ubhayoḥ vaidagdhyam caritārtham astu irthaḥ iti arthaḥ vaidagdhya lakṣaṇam ca laukike vaidike vā arthe tathā sāmayike api ca samyak paricaya prauḍhiḥ vaidagdhyam iti gīyate iti

original: nirmāṇasya bhavadubhayasṛṣṭilakṣaṇasya vidhātṛvyāpārasya ramaṇīyatā sarvalokātiśāyisaundaryasaṃpādakatvena manoharatā bhavadubhayasamāgamenaiva phalena phalatu/ anyathedṛksṛṣṭiśramaguṇojjvalastrīpuṃsanirmāṇaprayāso vidhervyartha eva bhavediti bhāvaḥ/
analyzed: nirmāṇasya bhavat ubhaya sṛṣṭi lakṣaṇasya vidhātṛ vyāpārasya ramaṇīya tā sarvaloka atiśāyi saundarya saṃpādaka tvena manohara tā bhavat ubhaya samāgamena eva phalena phalatu anyathā īdṛś sṛṣṭi śrama guṇa ujjvala strīpuṃsa nirmāṇa prayāsaḥ vidheḥ vyarthaḥ eva bhavet iti bhāvaḥ

original: tadeṣa tribhuvanaratnabhūtaḥ sarasaḥ sānurāgo rasikāgraṇīśca bhavāṃstasyāḥ kaṇṭhāvalambanena kaṇṭhāliṅganena mahārghatāṃ prāpnotu/ sā hyamūlyaratnabhūtaṃ bhavantaṃ svakaṇṭhāliṅganasaukhyena ratiramaṇaparīkṣake kalpitena mahatādhikena lāvaṇyadraviṇena daridrasvetarayuvatijanāsaṃpādyena mūlyena kretumarhā nānyā kāciditi bhāvaḥ/
analyzed: tat eṣa tribhuvana ratna bhūtaḥ sa rasaḥ sa anurāgaḥ rasikā agraṇīḥ ca bhavān tasyāḥ kaṇṭha avalambanena kaṇṭha āliṅganena mahārgha tām prāpnotu sā hi amūlya ratna bhūtam bhavantam sva kaṇṭha āliṅgana saukhyena rati ramaṇa parīkṣake kalpitena mahatā adhikena lāvaṇya draviṇena daridra sva itara yuvati jana a saṃpādyena mūlyena kretum arhā na anyā kācid iti bhāvaḥ

original: atra kusumadāmaprārthanāvyājena pūrvaṃ niṣpannārthasya mālatīviraharūpasya bhāvinaśca nirvahaṇaparyantānuvartamānabakuladāmasākṣikasarvavyāpārasūcanātpatākāsthānakamidam/ yathā - ``atītānāgate kārye kathyete yatra vastunaḥ/ anyāpadeśavyājena patākāsthānakaṃ [hi] tat//'' iti/
analyzed: atra kusuma dāma prārthanā vyājena pūrvam niṣpanna arthasya mālatī viraha rūpasya bhāvinaḥ ca nirvahaṇa paryanta anuvartamāna bakula dāma sākṣika sarva vyāpāra sūcanāt patākāsthānakam idam yathā atīta anāgate kārye kathyete yatra vastunaḥ anya apadeśa vyājena patākāsthānakam hi tat iti

original: ata eva cirakālāvasthāyinī mlānāpi saurabhyamayī bakulamālā saiva kavinā nirdiṣṭā na tvitarakusumamāleti// makarandaḥ/ vaidagdhyaṃ tatparicārikāyā evedṛśaṃ vacanakauśalaṃ citramityarthaḥ// mādhavaḥ/ anuyuktayā keyaṃ kasya sutā veti pṛṣṭayā/ kathitaṃ tayā - iyamityādi/ prasūtirapatyam/ na tu dattā saṃkarajātā vā/ tena vivāhayogyatā sūcitā/
analyzed: atas eva cira kāla avasthāyinī mlānā api saurabhya mayī bakula mālā sā eva kavinā nirdiṣṭā na tu itara kusuma mālā iti makarandaḥ vaidagdhyam tad paricārikāyāḥ eva īdṛśam vacana kauśalam citram iti arthaḥ mādhavaḥ anuyuktayā kā iyam kasya sutā vā iti pṛṣṭayā kathitam tayā iyam ityādi prasūtiḥ apatyam na tu dattā saṃkara jātā vā tena vivāha yogya tā sūcitā

original: prasādabhūmirvisrambhabhājanam/ tena mayi śaṅkā na kāryetyuktam/ dhātreyītyanullaṅghyavacanatvaṃ sakalatanmarmajñānaṃ cātmanaḥ sūcitam// kalahaṃsaḥ - saharṣamiti/ yayā likhitamasya praticchandakamānītaṃ mayā tasyāmeva mālatyāmāsakto'yamiti saphala idānīṃ mama vyāpāra iti harṣahetuḥ/ kiṃ nāma mālatīti/ anenāsyānurāgaviṣayabhūtā mālatītyucyate/
analyzed: prasāda bhūmiḥ visrambha bhājanam tena mayi śaṅkā na kāryā iti uktam dhātreyi iti an ullaṅghya vacana tvam sakala tad marma jñānam ca ātmanaḥ sūcitam kalahaṃsaḥ sa harṣam iti yayā likhitam asya praticchandakam ānītam mayā tasyām eva mālatyām āsaktaḥ yam iti saphalaḥ idānīm mama vyāpāraḥ iti harṣa hetuḥ kim nāma mālatī iti anena asya anurāga viṣaya bhūtā mālatī iti ucyate

original: kiṃ nāmeti harṣātiśayasūcakā kākuḥ/ tarhi diṣṭyā vilasitaṃ vijṛmbhitaṃ bhagavatā devena kusumāyudhena/ jitamasmābhiḥ/ taddūtyavyāpṛtaiḥ sarvaireva kāryatatparairityarthaḥ/ svāminaḥ prāṇasaṃkaṭasamaye tadujjīvanauṣadhapraticchandakānayanena tatprāṇatrāṇādātmani gauravamāropyāsmābhiriti bahuvacananirdeśaḥ// makarandaḥ - svagatam/ amātyeti/
analyzed: kim nāma iti harṣa atiśaya sūcakā kākuḥ tarhi diṣṭyā vilasitam vijṛmbhitam bhagavatā devena kusumāyudhena jitam asmābhiḥ tad dūtya vyāpṛtaiḥ sarvaiḥ eva kārya tatparaiḥ iti arthaḥ svāminaḥ prāṇa saṃkaṭa samaye tad ujjīvana auṣadha praticchandaka ānayanena tad prāṇa trāṇāt ātmani gauravam āropya asmābhiḥ iti bahuvacana nirdeśaḥ makarandaḥ svagatam amātya iti

original: amātyātmajetyetāvanmātragauravaṃ tasyā aparyāptamityarthaḥ/ nahyamātyaduhitetyeva sā bahumānāspadam/ kiṃtu lokātiśāyilāvaṇyaprabhṛtiguṇayogenāpi/ tena daivādupanato'pyasya kāmavikāraḥ samucitaviṣayatvācchlāghanīya eveti bhāvaḥ/ gauravāparyāptimevopapādayati - api ceti/ atyādarasūcanārthaṃ vīpsā/ svayaṃ sadaiva enāṃ ślāghata ityarthaḥ/ tāṃ ceti/
analyzed: amātya ātmajā iti etāvat mātra gauravam tasyāḥ aparyāptam iti arthaḥ na hi amātya duhitā iti eva sā bahu māna āspadam kiṃtu loka atiśāyi lāvaṇya prabhṛti guṇa yogena api tena daivāt upanatā upi asya kāma vikāraḥ samucita viṣaya tvāt ślāghanīyaḥ eva iti bhāvaḥ gaurava aparyāptim eva upapādayati api ca iti atyādara sūcana artham vīpsā svayam sadā eva enām ślāghate iti arthaḥ tām ca iti

original: rājāpi narmasuhṛde kanyāsahasraṃ kvacitsaṃpādya pradātuṃ śakto'pi tadabhilāṣāspadamālatīsadṛśayuvatisaṃpādanāśaktatvānnīcadūtyamaṅgīkṛtavān/ kimu vaktavyaṃ tasyāḥ ślāghanīyatvamiti bhāvaḥ// mādhavaḥ - tayetyādi/ anubadhyamānaḥ priyavacanaiḥ punaḥpunarabhyarthyamānaḥ/
analyzed: rājā api narma suhṛde kanyā sahasram kvacid saṃpādya pradātum śaktaḥ api tad abhilāṣa āspada mālatī sadṛśa yuvati saṃpādana aśakta tvāt nīca dūtyam aṅgīkṛtavān kimu vaktavyam tasyāḥ ślāghanīya tvam iti bhāvaḥ mādhavaḥ tayā ityādi anubadhyamānaḥ priya vacanaiḥ punar punar abhyarthyamānaḥ

original: priyopabhuktamuktatayā mālatīṃ prati ślāghyatāṃ srajo darśayitumātmanaḥ kaṇṭhādityuktam/ asāvityādi/ abhiniviṣṭayā duṣprāpavastuprāptestadekasaṃlagnayā dṛśā tāmeva srajaṃ bahumanyamāneti saṃbandhaḥ/
analyzed: priya upabhukta mukta tayā mālatīm prati ślāghya tām srajaḥ darśayitum ātmanaḥ kaṇṭhāt iti uktam asau ityādi abhiniviṣṭayā duṣprāpa vastu prāpteḥ tad eka saṃlagnayā dṛśā tām eva srajam bahu manyamānā iti saṃbandhaḥ

original: mālatīdarśanena manaso'nyatrāsaṅgātprastutakriyāvikalahastatayā vipamaṃ prāggrathitabhāgāpekṣayā virūpamaśobhanaṃ yathā tathā racitaikabhāgo mālatīdarśanāntaragrathito bhāgo yasyāstāmapi srajam/ saundaryāttatra tasyā na bahumānaḥ kiṃ tu madgrathitatveneti bhāvaḥ/ ata eva vakṣyati - ``premṇā madgrathiteti vā priyasakhīhastopanīteti vā'' iti/
analyzed: mālatī darśanena manasaḥ anyatra āsaṅgāt prastuta kriyā vikala hasta tayā vipamam prāk grathita bhāga apekṣayā virūpam aśobhanam yathā tathā racita eka bhāgaḥ mālatī darśana antara grathitaḥ bhāgaḥ yasyāḥ tām api srajam saundaryāt tatra tasyāḥ na bahu mānaḥ kim tu mad grathita tvena iti bhāvaḥ atas eva vakṣyati premṇā mad grathitā iti vā priya sakhī hasta upanītā iti vā iti

original: anantaraṃ cetyādi/ paurasya naigamasya ca janasya/ puranigamabhedaḥ kathyate - ``adrauvane'thavā rāṣṭre
analyzed: anantaram ca ityādi paurasya naigamasya ca janasya pura nigama bhedaḥ kathyate rāṣṭre

original: ṛ)sarvajanāvāsasaṃkīrṇam/ krayavikrayakairyuktaṃ puramuditaṃ yattadeva nagaramiti// cāturvarṇyasametaṃ sarvajanāvāsasaṃkīrṇam/ bahukarmakārayuktaṃ yattannigamaṃ samuddiṣṭam//'' iti/ saṃkulena saṃmardena vighaṭitāyāṃ nayanavighaṭitāyām/ nayanasaṃnikarṣādvibhraṣṭāyāṃ tirohitāyāmityarthaḥ//
analyzed: ṛ sarva jana āvāsa saṃkīrṇam kraya vikrayakaiḥ yuktam puram uditam yat tat eva nagaram iti cāturvarṇya sametam sarva jana āvāsa saṃkīrṇam bahu karmakāra yuktam yat tat nigamam samuddiṣṭam iti saṃkulena saṃmardena vighaṭitāyām nayana vighaṭitāyām nayana saṃnikarṣāt vibhraṣṭāyām tirohitāyām iti arthaḥ

original: makarandaḥ idānīṃ mādhavenāpi sāmānyato jñātaṃ mālatyāḥ svasminnanurāgamātmanyapratyayādāśaṅkyamānaṃ liṅgairdṛḍhaṃ kṛtvā tanmano'vasthāpayitumāha - makarandaḥ - vayasyeti/ tasyā api tvadvacanāttvayyanurāgapratīteretatkāryaṃ sādhu saṃghaṭitamityarthaḥ/
analyzed: makarandaḥ idānīm mādhavena api sāmānyatas jñātam mālatyāḥ svasmin anurāgam ātmani apratyayāt āśaṅkyamānam liṅgaiḥ dṛḍham kṛtvā tad manaḥ vasthāpayitum āha makarandaḥ vayasya iti tasyāḥ api tvad vacanāt tvayi anurāga pratīteḥ etat kāryam sādhu saṃghaṭitam iti arthaḥ

original: na ca mama darśanātpūrvameva sā kapolapāṇḍimādyupetā vartate, tena madanyasminneva kvāpi yūni prāgavalokite baddhabhāveyaṃ na tu mayītyāśaṅkanīyam/ yatastvameva kutracitpūrvaṃ dṛṣṭastasyāścirādanubadhyamānasya manmathavikārābhiniveśasya hetuḥ/ kiṃ tu kva vā tayā prāgavalokito'bhūrityetāvadeva jñātavyamityāha - yohītyādinā/
analyzed: na ca mama darśanāt pūrvam eva sā kapola pāṇḍima ādi upetā vartate tena mad anyasmin eva kvāpi yūni prāk avalokite baddha bhāvā iyam na tu mayi iti āśaṅkanīyam yatas tvam eva kutracid pūrvam dṛṣṭaḥ tasyāḥ cirāt anubadhyamānasya manmatha vikāra abhiniveśasya hetuḥ kim tu kva vā tayā prāk avalokitaḥ bhūḥ iti etāvat eva jñātavyam iti āha yaḥ hi ityādinā

original: ahameva tatra heturiti kuto'vadhāraṇamityata āha - na khalviti/ tādṛśyaḥ praśastakulaśīlaguṇagaṇojjvalā mahābhāgadheyajanmānaḥ prakṛṣṭasucaritaparipākalabdhajanuṣaḥ/ cakṣūrāgaścakṣuḥprītirāsāmastīti tathā/ yathā - ``kulīnā guṇavatyaśca kumāryo bhāgyabhūṣaṇāḥ/ īdṛśāstvayaśodoṣabhājanaṃ naiva jātucit// yadyanyāsaktacittā sā na cakṣustvayi pātayet/
analyzed: aham eva tatra hetuḥ iti kutas vadhāraṇam iti atas āha na khalu iti tādṛśyaḥ praśasta kula śīla guṇa gaṇa ujjvalāḥ mahā bhāgadheya janmānaḥ prakṛṣṭa su carita paripāka labdha januṣaḥ cakṣū rāgaḥ cakṣuḥ prītiḥ āsām asti iti tathā yathā kulīnāḥ guṇavatyaḥ ca kumāryaḥ bhāgya bhūṣaṇāḥ īdṛśāḥ tu ayaśaḥ doṣa bhājanam na eva jātucit yadi anya āsakta cittā sā na cakṣuḥ tvayi pātayet

original: mano'nyatra dṛganyatra ceṭīnāṃ nottamastriyāḥ//'' iti bhāvaḥ/ anyadapi tvayi pūrvānurāge liṅgamastītyāha - api ceti/ anyonyeti/ anyonyasaṃbhinnadṛśāṃ sapratyabhijñaṃ sa evāyamiti nirdhārayituṃ parasparamukhāvalokanena saṃmiśradṛṣṭīnāṃ tasyāḥ sakhīnāṃ kasyāpi janasya ko'pi dayita ihaiva vartata ityevaṃrūpaṃ niveditam/
analyzed: manaḥ nyatra dṛś anyatra ceṭīnām na uttama striyāḥ iti bhāvaḥ anyat api tvayi pūrva anurāge liṅgam asti iti āha api ca iti anyonya iti anyonya saṃbhinna dṛśām sa pratyabhijñam saḥ eva ayam iti nirdhārayitum paraspara mukha avalokanena saṃmiśra dṛṣṭīnām tasyāḥ sakhīnām kasya api janasya kaḥ api dayitaḥ iha eva vartate iti evaṃrūpam niveditam

original: svasakhyai prajñāpanaṃ caikaṃ tasyāstvayyevāsau pāṇḍimādisūcitaḥ prāganurāga ityasminnarthe cihnaṃ liṅgamityarthaḥ//
analyzed: sva sakhyai prajñāpanam ca ekam tasyāḥ tvayi eva asau pāṇḍima ādi sūcitaḥ prāk anurāgaḥ iti asmin arthe cihnam liṅgam iti arthaḥ

original: atha mādhavaḥ svanirdhāritaṃ liṅgāntaraṃ lavaṅgikāśliṣṭavacanarūpamasāvudbhāvayiṣyati vā na vetyautsukyāttadvacanāvasarapratīkṣaṇamasahamānaḥ kasyāpi ko'pīti niveditaṃ ceti caśabdena kimanyatsamuccinoṣīti pṛcchati - mādhavaḥ - kiṃ ceti/ cakāraḥ/ kimanyatprāganurāgaliṅgaṃ dyotayatītyarthaḥ// makarandaḥ - dhātreyikāyā iti/ caturaṃ śliṣṭam/
analyzed: atha mādhavaḥ sva nirdhāritam liṅga antaram lavaṅgikā śliṣṭa vacana rūpam asau udbhāvayiṣyati vā na vā iti autsukyāt tad vacana avasara pratīkṣaṇam asahamānaḥ kasya api kopī iti niveditam ca iti caśabdena kim anyat samuccinoṣi iti pṛcchati mādhavaḥ kim ca iti cakāraḥ kim anyat prāk anurāga liṅgam dyotayati iti arthaḥ makarandaḥ dhātreyikāyāḥ iti caturam śliṣṭam

original: prāganurāgacihnamiti śeṣaḥ//36//
analyzed: prāk anurāga cihnam iti śeṣaḥ

original: kalahaṃsaḥ/ etacca/ idamapi prāganurāgacihnamiti prāptāvasaraścitramarpayatītyarthaḥ//  citralekhanaparyantasya mālatīvyāpārasya makarandenāpātato'dhigamātkeneti sāmānyato nirdeśaḥ// kalahaṃsaḥ/ punarvimarśapūrvakaṃ tenaiva vācayitumāha - yenaivāsya hṛdayamapahṛtamiti// makarandaḥ/ api nāmeti praśne/ likhitamiti śeṣaḥ// kalahaṃsaḥ/
analyzed: kalahaṃsaḥ etat ca idam api prāk anurāga cihnam iti prāpta avasaraḥ citram arpayati iti arthaḥ citra lekhana paryantasya mālatī vyāpārasya makarandena āpātataḥ adhigamāt kena iti sāmānyatas nirdeśaḥ kalahaṃsaḥ punar vimarśa pūrvakam tena eva vācayitum āha yena eva asya hṛdayam apahṛtam iti makarandaḥ api nāma iti praśne likhitam iti śeṣaḥ kalahaṃsaḥ

original: atha kimityaṅgīkāre/ bāḍhaṃ mālatyaivetyarthaḥ// mādhavaḥ - vayasyeti/ prasannaprāyaḥ saṃdehalakṣaṇakāluṣyāpagamānnirmalībhūtastarkastvayyeva sānuraktetyūhaḥ/ atra citradarśanātsvasminmālatyanurāganiścayena sukhāgamapratīteḥ prāptirnāma saṃdhyaṅgamuktaṃ bhavati/ yathā - ``prāptiḥ ko'pi sukhāgamaḥ'' iti// makarandaḥ/
analyzed: atha kim iti aṅgīkāre bāḍham mālatyā eva iti arthaḥ mādhavaḥ vayasya iti prasanna prāyaḥ saṃdeha lakṣaṇa kāluṣya apagamāt nirmalībhūtaḥ tarkaḥ tvayi eva sā anuraktā iti ūhaḥ atra citra darśanāt svasmin mālatī anurāga niścayena sukha āgama pratīteḥ prāptiḥ nāma saṃdhi aṅgam uktam bhavati yathā prāptiḥ kaḥ api sukha āgamaḥ iti makarandaḥ

original: kalahaṃsaka, kasmādetattvayā prāptamityarthaḥ// kalahaṃsaḥ/ mama tāvanmandārikāhastāt/ tasyā api lavaṅgikāsakāśāt// kalahaṃsaḥ/ utkaṇṭhāvinodanamiti// yā kaumudīti/ yā tvannetracakorayoścandrikeva niratiśayasauhityakāriṇī tasyāḥ sujanmā tvamapi manorathabandhasya dṛḍhānurāgasya bandhurāśraya ityarthaḥ/ tatastasyāḥ saṃgamaṃ prati saṃdeho nāsti/
analyzed: kalahaṃsaka kasmāt etat tvayā prāptam iti arthaḥ kalahaṃsaḥ mama tāvat mandārikā hastāt tasyāḥ api lavaṅgikā sakāśāt kalahaṃsaḥ utkaṇṭhā vinodanam iti yā kaumudī iti yā tvad netra cakorayoḥ candrikā iva niratiśaya sauhitya kāriṇī tasyāḥ sujanmā tvam api manoratha bandhasya dṛḍha anurāgasya bandhuḥ āśrayaḥ iti arthaḥ tatas tasyāḥ saṃgamam prati saṃdehaḥ na asti

original: yato yasminsaṃgame vidhiranyonyānurūpanirmāṇenodbhūtaprayāso madanaścākasmādevotpāditagāḍhānurāgaḥ kṛtābhiyogaḥ etatkāryasaṃgame racitābhiniveśo baddhakacchaḥ/ tato na tadarthaṃ tvayā cintanīyamityarthaḥ//37//
analyzed: yatas yasmin saṃgame vidhiḥ anyonya anurūpa nirmāṇena udbhūta prayāsaḥ madanaḥ ca akasmāt eva utpādita gāḍha anurāgaḥ kṛta abhiyogaḥ etad kārya saṃgame racita abhiniveśaḥ baddha kacchaḥ tatas na tad artham tvayā cintanīyam iti arthaḥ

original: draṣṭavyeti/ atidhīrasyāpi te yā manovikāramutpādayitā
analyzed: draṣṭavyā iti ati dhīrasya api te yā manaḥ vikāram utpādayitā

original: (trī) sā mayā draṣṭavyarūpā darśanīyākṛtiḥ/ anena mādhavasya saṃśayaṃ nirasya parasparānurāgasya bījasya sthāpanātsamādhānaṃ nāma saṃdhyaṅgamuktam/ yathā - ``bījāgamaḥ samādhānam''/ iti// draṣṭavyarūpā darśanīyākṛtiḥ/ keyaṃ kalāsu prāgalbhyaṃ prakāśitavatī, tadbhavānapi tadvilekhanena vyājena tasyai svavaidagdhyaṃ prakaṭīkarotviti pratītiḥ//
analyzed: trī sā mayā draṣṭavya rūpā darśanīya ākṛtiḥ anena mādhavasya saṃśayam nirasya paraspara anurāgasya bījasya sthāpanāt samādhānam nāma saṃdhi aṅgam uktam yathā bīja āgamaḥ samādhānam iti draṣṭavya rūpā darśanīya ākṛtiḥ kā iyam kalāsu prāgalbhyam prakāśitavatī tat bhavān api tad vilekhanena vyājena tasyai sva vaidagdhyam prakaṭīkarotu iti pratītiḥ

original: mādhavaḥ/ vayasyāyeti/ ``rucyarthānām'' iti saṃpradānatvam/ tatkaromīti śeṣaḥ/ atha tattadavayavasādṛśyalekhanārthaṃ manasaiva mālatyāḥ sarvāvayavasamyaṅnirvarṇanena samupajātabāṣpādisāttvikabhāvo mādhavaścitrakriyāyāṃ svasya dṛkkarādisāmagryā ananukūlatāmupapādayannāha - vāraṃvāramiti/
analyzed: mādhavaḥ vayasyāya iti ruci arthānām iti saṃpradānatvam tat karomi iti śeṣaḥ atha tad tad avayava sādṛśya lekhana artham manasā eva mālatyāḥ sarva avayava samyak nirvarṇanena samupajāta bāṣpa ādi sāttvika bhāvaḥ mādhavaḥ citra kriyāyām svasya dṛkkara ādi sāmagryāḥ ananukūla tām upapādayan āha vāram vāram iti

original: likhāmi priyāmiti saṃkalpya yatkiṃcidbhrūnetrādyavayavasya smaraṇaṃ tatsamayasamudgato bāṣpapūro vāraṃvāraṃ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe/ ``vāraścāvasaraḥ kṣaṇaḥ'' iti vacanāt/ punaḥpunarunmṛjyamāno'pi dṛśau tirayatyāvṛṇoti/ anenāśrunāmakaḥ sāttvikabhāva uktaḥ/ yathā - ``aśrunetrodbhavaṃ vāri duḥkhakrodhapraharṣajam'' iti/
analyzed: likhāmi priyām iti saṃkalpya yat kiṃcid bhrū netra ādi avayavasya smaraṇam tad samaya samudgataḥ bāṣpa pūraḥ vāram vāram kṣaṇe kṣaṇe vāraḥ ca avasaraḥ kṣaṇaḥ iti vacanāt punar punar unmṛjyamānaḥ api dṛśau tirayati āvṛṇoti anena aśru nāmakaḥ sāttvika bhāvaḥ uktaḥ yathā aśru netra udbhavam vāri duḥkha krodha praharṣa jam iti

original: tasyāḥ saṃkalpena cintayopahitaḥ prāpto jaḍimā yena tadgātraṃ stambhamabhyeti/ jāḍyastambhau yathā - ``kriyāsvapāṭavaṃ jāḍyaṃ cintotkaṇṭhābhayādibhiḥ/ stambhaśceṣṭāpratīghāto bhayarāgāmayādibhiḥ//'' iti/
analyzed: tasyāḥ saṃkalpena cintayā upahitaḥ prāptaḥ jaḍimā yena tat gātram stambham abhyeti jāḍya stambhau yathā kriyāsu apāṭavam jāḍyam cintā utkaṇṭhā bhaya ādibhiḥ stambhaḥ ceṣṭā apratīghātaḥ bhaya rāga āmaya ādibhiḥ iti

original: tathā sadyastadupasmṛtikṣaṇa eva svidyansvedajalārdro bhavannayaṃ me pāṇirlekhāvidhiṣu lekhanakriyāsvaviratotkampenānavaratavepathunā lolāścañcalā aṅgulayo yasya sa tādṛśo vartate/ tatkiṃkaromi/ idānīṃ citrakarmavaidagdhyaprakaṭanaṃ durghaṭamityarthaḥ/ svedavepathū yathā - ``vapurjalodgamasvedo ratidharmaśramādibhiḥ/
analyzed: tathā sadyas tad upasmṛti kṣaṇe eva svidyan svedajala ārdraḥ bhavan ayam me pāṇiḥ lekhā vidhiṣu lekhana kriyāsu avirata utkampena anavarata vepathunā lolāḥ cañcalāḥ aṅgulayaḥ yasya sa tādṛśaḥ vartate tat kim karomi idānīm citra karma vaidagdhya prakaṭanam durghaṭam iti arthaḥ sveda vepathū yathā vapuḥ jala udgama svedaḥ rati dharma śrama ādibhiḥ

original: rāgarogabhayādibhyaḥ kampo gātrasya vepathuḥ//'' iti//38//
analyzed: rāga roga bhaya ādibhyaḥ kampaḥ gātrasya vepathuḥ iti

original: tathāpītyādi spaṣṭaḥ// jagatīti/ jagati bhuvane te te navendukalādayo bhāvāḥ padārthā jayino manmathasāhāyyācaraṇena virahijanavaśīkaraṇaśīlāḥ/ prakṛtimadhurāḥ svabhāvenaiva manoharāḥ/ ``iha vaṭe yakṣaḥ'' iti nyāyena na kevalamandhaparamparayā prasiddhāḥ/
analyzed: tathā api ityādi spaṣṭaḥ jagatī iti jagati bhuvane te te nava indu kalā ādayaḥ bhāvāḥ padārthāḥ jayinaḥ manmatha sāhāyya ācaraṇena virahi jana vaśīkaraṇa śīlāḥ prakṛti madhurāḥ svabhāvena eva manoharāḥ iha vaṭe yakṣaḥ iti nyāyena na kevalam andha paramparayā prasiddhāḥ

original: anye mālatīvyatiriktāḥ santyeva ye'nyeṣāmadṛṣṭamālatīmukhāmbujānāmavivekināṃ vā mano madayantyutsukayanti/ naitadapūrvam/ santu nāma/ taiḥ kimidānīṃ tadapekṣayā varākaprāyairiti bhāvaḥ/ ``bhinnarucirhi lokaḥ'' iti nyāyenānyeṣāṃ yathā tathā vāstu nāma/ mama punarvilocanacandrikā netrāhlādakāriṇī/
analyzed: anye mālatī vyatiriktāḥ santi eva vā manaḥ madayanti utsukayanti na etat apūrvam santu nāma taiḥ kim idānīm tad apekṣayā varāka prāyaiḥ iti bhāvaḥ bhinna ruciḥ hi lokaḥ iti nyāyena anyeṣām yathā tathā vā astu nāma mama punar vilocana candrikā netra āhlāda kāriṇī

original: loke lokaprasidhdyā kevalamidamucyate, na tu svāpekṣayā/ mādhavasya mālatyapekṣayā candrikāderatitucchatvena mālatyāmutkarṣapratipādanārthaṃ candrikātvāropasya svavacovyāhatatvāt/ tena yathā lokasya candrikā netrayorāhlādakāriṇī evaṃ mama mālatītyetāvatā candrikātvāropaḥ/ na tūtkarṣapratipādanāyeti vyākhyeyam/
analyzed: loke loka prasidhdyā kevalam idam ucyate na tu sva apekṣayā mādhavasya mālatī apekṣayā candrikā ādeḥ ati tuccha tvena mālatyām utkarṣa pratipādana artham candrikā tva āropasya sva vacaḥ vyāhata tvāt tena yathā lokasya candrikā netrayoḥ āhlāda kāriṇī evam mama mālatī iti etāvatā candrikā tva āropaḥ na tu utkarṣa pratipādanāya iti vyākhyeyam

original: evaṃ ca vyāhatārthadoṣa iti tu parihṛtam/ iyaṃ mālatī nayanaviṣayam/ bhāvaprādhānyena nirdeśaḥ/ netragocaratāmāpanneti yatsa evāsmiñjanmani loke kṛtsne'pi prapañca eko'dvitīyo mahānutsavaḥ saukhyahetuḥ/ nānye candrakalādaya ityarthaḥ/ atiśayoktiralaṃkāraḥ//39//
analyzed: evam ca vyāhata artha doṣaḥ iti tu parihṛtam iyam mālatī nayana viṣayam bhāva prādhānyena nirdeśaḥ netra gocara tām āpannā iti yat saḥ eva asmin janmani loke kṛtsne api prapañcaḥ mahān utsavaḥ saukhya hetuḥ na anye candra kalā ādayaḥ iti arthaḥ atiśayoktiḥ alaṃkāraḥ

original: praviśya/ mandāriketi/ mādhavāya pradarśya śīghraṃ pratyānayeti kalahaṃsasya haste citramarpitavatī madanodyānātpratinivṛtya krīḍāsaudhavartinyāṃ mālatyāmadya viśeṣadarśanaprabalatarotkaṇṭhāvinodanāya kva citraphalakamiti vimṛśantyāṃ tadasaṃnidhānādupajātasaṃbhramā mandārikā janasaṃkule kalahaṃsamanviṣya tatrādṛṣṭavatī praviśya vadatīti bhāvaḥ/
analyzed: praviśya mandārikā iti mādhavāya pradarśya śīghram pratyānaya iti kalahaṃsasya haste citram arpitavatī madana udyānāt pratinivṛtya krīḍā saudha vartinyām mālatyām adya viśeṣa darśana prabalatara utkaṇṭhā vinodanāya kva citra phalakam iti vimṛśantyām tad asaṃnidhānāt upajāta saṃbhramā mandārikā jana saṃkule kalahaṃsam anviṣya tatra adṛṣṭavatī praviśya vadati iti bhāvaḥ

original: dviruktiḥ saṃbhramasūcanārthā/ plutaśca ``nigṛhyānuyoge ca'' iti vihito deśabhāṣāsvapi vyavahriyate/ coretyāmantraṇaṃ madgṛhāccitraphalakaṃ tvayā coreṇānītamityupahāsaparam/ ata evāha - pādānusāreṇa labdho'sīti/ coro hi padanyāsaliṅgānusaraṇenaiva gṛhyate/ salajjamiti/ tatsvāmisaṃnidhau tena sahopahasanānaucityāt/
analyzed: dviruktiḥ saṃbhrama sūcana arthā plutaḥ ca nigṛhya anuyoge ca iti vihitaḥ deśa bhāṣāsu api vyavahriyate cora iti āmantraṇam mad gṛhāt citra phalakam tvayā coreṇa ānītam iti upahāsa param atas eva āha pāda anusāreṇa labdhaḥ asi iti coraḥ hi pada nyāsa liṅga anusaraṇena eva gṛhyate sa lajjam iti tad svāmi saṃnidhau tena saha upahasana anaucityāt

original: kathaṃ tāvapi sahānubhāvāvatraiva// ita āgamyatāmityādaroktiḥ/ tasyāḥ samanantarakāryopayogāttadanunayārtham// mandārikā/ kalahaṃsaka, upanaya citraphalakam// kalahaṃsaḥ/ gṛhāṇedam// mandārikā/ kalahaṃsakaṃ prati/ kena kiṃnimittaṃ vātra mālatyabhilikhitā// kalahaṃsaḥ/
analyzed: katham tau api saha anubhāvau atra eva itas āgamyatām iti ādara uktiḥ tasyāḥ samanantara kārya upayogāt tad anunaya artham mandārikā kalahaṃsakaḥ upanaya citra phalakam kalahaṃsaḥ gṛhāṇa idam mandārikā kalahaṃsakam prati kena kiṃnimittam vā atra mālatī abhilikhitā kalahaṃsaḥ

original: ya eva yannimittaṃ ca mālatyā likhito mādhavastenaiva tadarthamevotkaṇṭhāvinodārthameva mālatī likhitetyarthaḥ// mandādi[ri]kā - saharṣamiti/ kāmandakīparijanasyāsmadāderdūtyavyāpāraḥ phalonmukha iti harṣahetuḥ/ diṣṭyā upadarśitaphalaṃ vijñānaṃ prajāpateḥ/
analyzed: yaḥ eva yad nimittam ca mālatyā likhitaḥ mādhavaḥ tena eva tad artham eva utkaṇṭhā vinoda artham eva mālatī likhitā iti arthaḥ mandādirikā sa harṣam iti kāmandakī parijanasya asmad ādeḥ dūtya vyāpāraḥ phala unmukhaḥ iti harṣa hetuḥ diṣṭyā upadarśita phalam vijñānam prajāpateḥ

original: īdṛśayuvadvayanirmāṇaṃ vidhātuḥ śilpakauśalamanayoranyonyānurāgaprakarṣeṇa darśitaphalaṃ jātam/ pariṇayarūpā pariṇatirevetaḥparamavaśiṣṭeti bhāvaḥ// makarandaḥ/ atra praticchandakarūpe vastuni yadeṣa te patiḥ kathayati mālatyā likhitamutkaṇṭhāvinodanāyeti/ api praśne/ kiṃ tattathā satyamityarthaḥ// mandārikā/ mahābhāga, tattathā//
analyzed: īdṛśa yuva dvaya nirmāṇam vidhātuḥ śilpa kauśalam anayoḥ anyonya anurāga prakarṣeṇa darśita phalam jātam pariṇaya rūpā pariṇatiḥ evā itas param avaśiṣṭā iti bhāvaḥ makarandaḥ atra praticchandaka rūpe vastuni yat eṣa te patiḥ kathayati mālatyā likhitam utkaṇṭhā vinodanāya iti api praśne kim tat tathā satyam iti arthaḥ mandārikā mahābhāga tat tathā

original: makarandaḥ - kveti/ yena utkaṇṭhāvinodanāya tadrūpamalikhaditi bhāvaḥ// mandārikā/ lavaṅgikā bhaṇati vātāyanagateti// etadgavākṣamārgeṇa darśanamityarthaḥ/ mandārikā/ anumanyatāṃ mahābhāgaḥ/
analyzed: makarandaḥ kva iti yena utkaṇṭhā vinodanāya tad rūpam alikhat iti bhāvaḥ mandārikā lavaṅgikā bhaṇati vātāyana gatā iti etat gavākṣa mārgeṇa darśanam iti arthaḥ mandārikā anumanyatām mahābhāgaḥ

original: yāvadidaṃ bhagavato'pratihatabhāvasya devasyāśakyasaṃghaṭanedṛśamithunasaṃghaṭanānuguṇavyāpārātmakakrīḍāvato madanasya sucaritamanyonyākṛtinirmāṇasetuparasparānurāgalakṣaṇaṃ lavaṅgikāyai nivedayiṣyāmi/ tayaivāhamatra niyuktā, tamimaṃ vṛttāntaṃ tasyai nivedayāmi/ sā punaryathocitamācariṣyatīti bhāvaḥ// makarandaḥ - prāpteti/ bhavatyā/
analyzed: yāvat idam bhagavatā upratihata bhāvasya devasya aśakya saṃghaṭana īdṛśa mithuna saṃghaṭana anuguṇa vyāpāra ātmaka krīḍāvataḥ madanasya su caritam anyonya ākṛti nirmāṇa setu paraspara anurāga lakṣaṇam lavaṅgikāyai nivedayiṣyāmi tayā eva aham atra niyuktā tam imam vṛttāntam tasyai nivedayāmi sā punar yathocitam ācariṣyati iti bhāvaḥ makarandaḥ prāptā iti bhavatyā

original: etanmādhavālokitasya dṛḍhīkṛtatadanurāgasya tadabhilikhitamālatīrūpasaṃpādayiṣyamāṇamālatīmanaḥpratyayasyāsya praticchandakasya lavaṅgikāyai nivedanaṃ prāpto'vasaro yasya tat/ avasarocitamityarthaḥ// saṃstyāyaṃ sadanam// dharmāmbha ityādi/
analyzed: etat mādhava ālokitasya dṛḍhīkṛta tad anurāgasya tad abhilikhita mālatī rūpa saṃpādayiṣyamāṇa mālatī manaḥ pratyayasya asya praticchandakasya lavaṅgikāyai nivedanam prāptaḥ uvasaraḥ yasya tat avasara ucitam iti arthaḥ saṃstyāyam sadanam dharma ambhaḥ ityādi

original: mugdhe sundare akṣiṇī yasyāstasyāḥ paricārikāṇāṃ vāravilāsinīnāṃ kapolakuṅkumāni kartṝṇi kapolayoranuliptāni kuṅkumāni/ anenānulepanaviśeṣa uktaḥ/ yathā - ``vaidagdhyenoparacitaṃ stanayorvā kapolayoḥ/ unmādanaṃ nayanayoryattatsyādanulepanam//'' iti/ dharmāmbhasaḥ svedajalasya visaro bindusamūhastasya vivartanaiḥ prasaraṇaiḥ/
analyzed: mugdhe sundare akṣiṇī yasyāḥ tasyāḥ paricārikāṇām vāravilāsinīnām kapola kuṅkumāni kartṝṇi kapolayoḥ anuliptāni kuṅkumāni anena anulepana viśeṣaḥ uktaḥ yathā vaidagdhyena uparacitam stanayoḥ vā kapolayoḥ unmādanam nayanayoḥ yat tat syāt anulepanam iti dharmāmbhasaḥ sveda jalasya visaraḥ bindu samūhaḥ tasya vivartanaiḥ prasaraṇaiḥ

original: tattadā mayā dṛṣṭaṃ prātaḥkāle vihitā yā vicitrā camatkārakāriṇī patralekhā patraracanā saiva vaidagdhyaṃ tatkarmabhūtaṃ jahati tyajantīti manye/ tarkayāmītyarthaḥ/ svedavaśātpramṛṣṭaracanāni vicchinnacāturyāṇi kapolakuṅkumāni madhyāhne syuriti bhāvaḥ//40//
analyzed: tat tadā mayā dṛṣṭam prātaḥkāle vihitā yā vicitrā camatkāra kāriṇī patra lekhā patra racanā sā eva vaidagdhyam tad karma bhūtam jahati tyajanti iti manye tarkayāmi iti arthaḥ sveda vaśāt pramṛṣṭa racanāni vicchinna cāturyāṇi kapola kuṅkumāni madhyāhne syuḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: athonmādavijṛmbhaṇamahimnā vāyoracetanādapi tatsaṃgamaṃ prārthayannāha - unmīladityādi/ he pavana, tāmāliṅganneva, na tu tadanantaraṃ kiṃcidvilambya, mamāṅgamaṅgaṃ pratyavayavaṃ spṛśa/ priyatamāmāśliṣyatastavāṅgasaṃsparśo'pi priyatamāṅgasaṃsparśakalpa eveti bhāvaḥ/ yathāha - ``vāhi vāta yataḥ kāntā tāṃ spṛṣṭvā māmapi spṛśa/
analyzed: atha unmāda vijṛmbhaṇa mahimnā vāyoḥ acetanāt api tad saṃgamam prārthayan āha unmīlat ityādi he pavana tām āliṅgan eva na tu tad anantaram kiṃcid vilambya mama aṅgam aṅgam prati avayavam spṛśa priyatamām āśliṣyataḥ tava aṅga saṃsparśaḥ api priyatamā aṅga saṃsparśa kalpaḥ eva iti bhāvaḥ yathā āha vāhi vāta yatas kāntā tām spṛṣṭvā mām api spṛśa

original: tvayi me gātrasaṃsparśaścandre dṛṣṭisamāgame//'' iti/ tāmiti/ yādṛśī pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭā tāmeva smarati/ īṣatpracale vilāsavaśātkiṃciccañcale/ athavānimiṣadarśanena sakhyo jñāsyantīti tatpracchādanāya kiṃciccañcale locane yasyāstām/ pīvarakucabhareṇa virahaglānyā vā natamavanatamaṅgaṃ yasyāstām/ pavanaṃ viśinaṣṭi - unmīladiti/
analyzed: tvayi me gātra saṃsparśaḥ candre dṛṣṭi samāgame iti tām iti yādṛśī pūrvam dṛṣṭā tām eva smarati īṣat pracale vilāsa vaśāt kiṃcid cañcale athavā animiṣa darśanena sakhyaḥ jñāsyanti iti tad pracchādanāya kiṃcid cañcale locane yasyāḥ tām pīvara kuca bhareṇa viraha glānyā vā natam avanatam aṅgam yasyāḥ tām pavanam viśinaṣṭi unmīlat iti

original: unmīladbhirvikāsonmukhairmukulaiḥ korakaiḥ karālo danturaḥ/ ``karālo danture tuṅge viśāle vikṛte'pi ca'' iti darśanāt/ yaḥ kundakośaḥ kundalatāpratānaṃ tataḥ pracyotanto ghanā niviḍā ye makarandāḥ puṣparasāsteṣāṃ gandhasya bandho tasya sahacaretyanena vilāpākhyā madanāvasthā darśitā/ yathā - ``iha dṛṣṭamiha śliṣṭamihāgatamiha sthitam/
analyzed: unmīladbhiḥ vikāsa unmukhaiḥ mukulaiḥ korakaiḥ karālaḥ danturaḥ karālaḥ danture tuṅge viśāle vikṛte api ca iti darśanāt yaḥ kundakośaḥ kunda latā pratānam tatas pracyotantaḥ ghanāḥ nibiḍāḥ ye makarandāḥ puṣpa rasāḥ teṣām gandhasya bandho tasya sahacara iti anena vilāpa ākhyā madana avasthā darśitā yathā iha dṛṣṭam iha śliṣṭam iha āgatam iha sthitam

original: iha nirvṛtamatraiva śayitaṃ cāpyalaṃkṛtam// evamādīni vākyāni vilāpa iti kathyate// antarbahiḥ puraḥ paścāddūrādārātsamīpataḥ// kvacitpaśyati yātyeva kvacitkvāpyavatiṣṭhate/ āste kvacitkvacicchete kvacinnindati nandati// itaścetaśca rathyāyāṃ rauti bhrāmyati dhāvati/ evaṃ vilāpajā bhāvā manobhavavaśānugāḥ//'' iti//41//
analyzed: iha nirvṛtam atra eva śayitam ca api alaṃkṛtam evamādīni vākyāni vilāpaḥ iti kathyate antar bahis puras paścāt dūrāt ārāt samīpatas kvacid paśyati yāti eva kvacid kvāpi avatiṣṭhate āste kvacid kvacid śete kvacid nindati nandati itas ca itas ca rathyāyām rauti bhrāmyati dhāvati evam vilāpa jāḥ bhāvāḥ manobhava vaśa anugāḥ iti

original: makarandaḥ - svagatam/ abhihantīti/ hanteti viṣāde/ ``hanta harṣe'nukampāyāṃ vākyārambhaviṣādayoḥ'' iti darśanāt/ abhihantyābhīkṣṇyena praharati/ anavagraho'pratibandhaḥ/ durnivāra iti yāvat/ kathamidamatyantānucitamārabdhamatinṛśaṃsena manmathahatakenetyarthaḥ/
analyzed: makarandaḥ svagatam abhihanti iti hantā iti viṣāde hanta harṣa inukampāyām vākya ārambha viṣādayoḥ iti darśanāt abhihanti ābhīkṣṇyena praharati durnivāraḥ iti yāvat katham idam atyanta anucitam ārabdham ati nṛśaṃsena manmatha hatakena iti arthaḥ

original: acireṇotpattisamaya eva yathā cikitsānavasaraparo hataḥ syāt, tathā pravṛddha ityarthaḥ/ vikṛtaṃ doṣatrayam/ vikṛtasaṃbandhivivarto vaikṛtavivarta udriktadoṣatrayapariṇatirūpaḥ sāṃnipātiko jvaraḥ/ sa cāsau dāruṇaśceti vigrahaḥ/ kaṭhoro'titīvraḥ/ kūṭapākalo gajarogaviśeṣaḥ/ kūṭena kapaṭenākasmādāgatya tasminneva nipāyatīti kūṭapākalaḥ/
analyzed: acireṇa utpatti samaye eva yathā cikitsā anavasara paraḥ hataḥ syāt tathā pravṛddhaḥ iti arthaḥ vikṛtam doṣatrayam vikṛta saṃbandhi vivartaḥ vaikṛta vivartaḥ udrikta doṣatraya pariṇati rūpaḥ sāṃnipātikaḥ jvaraḥ sa ca asau dāruṇaḥ ca iti vigrahaḥ kaṭhora uti tīvraḥ kūṭapākalaḥ gaja roga viśeṣaḥ kūṭena kapaṭena akasmāt āgatya tasmin eva nipāyati iti kūṭapākalaḥ

original: yathā - ``yathābhihanyātkūṭena mṛgayūthaṃ vanecaraḥ/ tathā pātātmako nāgaṃ hanti vai kūṭapākalaḥ// mṛgaḥ kūṭena śabarairhanyate dāruṇaṃ yathā/ tathā tena dvipaḥ sīdatyataḥ syātkūṭapākalaḥ//'' iti/ kecitkūṭībhūya saṃdhībhūya doṣatrayeṇa janito gajajvaraviśeṣaḥ kūṭapākala iti vyācakṣate/ anenonmādāvasthā sūcitā/ upamālaṃkāraḥ//42//
analyzed: yathā yathā abhihanyāt kūṭena mṛga yūtham vanecaraḥ tathā pāta ātmakaḥ nāgam hanti vai kūṭa pākalaḥ mṛgaḥ kūṭena śabaraiḥ hanyate dāruṇam yathā tathā tena dvipaḥ sīdati atas syāt kūṭa pākalaḥ iti kecid kūṭībhūya saṃdhībhūya doṣa trayeṇa janitaḥ gaja jvara viśeṣaḥ kūṭapākalaḥ iti vyācakṣate anena unmāda avasthā sūcitā upamā alaṃkāraḥ

original: tadatreti/ nānyā gatirastītyarthaḥ/ iyamarthasaṃprasāraṇarūpā yuktirmukhasaṃdheraṅgam/ yathā - ``saṃprasāraṇamarthānāṃ yuktirityabhidhīyate'' iti/ mādhavastu tāmeva gamanasamaye dṛṣṭāmidānīṃ sarvatrāpi vilokayannātmanyeva svakīyamunmādātiśayaṃ vimṛśannāha - paśyāmīti/ tāmeva gamanasamaye dṛṣṭāmidānīṃ bahudhā vivartamānām/
analyzed: tat atra iti na anyā gatiḥ asti iti arthaḥ iyam artha saṃprasāraṇa rūpā yuktiḥ mukha saṃdheḥ aṅgam yathā saṃprasāraṇam arthānām yuktiḥ iti abhidhīyate iti mādhavaḥ tu tām eva gamana samaye dṛṣṭām idānīm sarvatra api vilokayan ātmani eva svakīyam unmāda atiśayam vimṛśan āha paśyāmi iti tām eva gamana samaye dṛṣṭām idānīm bahudhā vivartamānām

original: yadvā sthirakrodhatātkālikakopau/ yathāhuḥ - ``krodhaḥ kṛtāparādheṣu sthiro'marṣatvamaśnute/ roṣastātkālikaḥ kopaḥ'' iti/ tayorvyatikareṇa saṃmelanena yo balātkārastena pūrvaṃ vighaṭitaṃ bhañjitaṃ paścādudghāṭitamapasāritadvārabandhanaṃ yallohapañjaraṃ tatraiva pratilagnaḥ saṃsaktaḥ saṃgalitaḥ svacaraṇādvigalito nigalaḥ śṛṅkhalā yasya saḥ/

original: nijaḥ svakīyaḥ pañjaranigalabandhāpagamāccirasya labdho yo līlayā svācchandyena vilāsaścaṅkramaṇārūpo vihārastenodvella ūrdhvaprasārito vallabhaḥ priyatamastuṅga unnato yo lāṅgalo bāladaṇḍaḥ sa eva vikaṭavaijayantikā vikṛtākārapatākā tayā viṣamo durdarśo ḍāmaro bhīṣaṇa uddāmaḥ prācaṇḍyamaṇḍitaḥ śarīrasaṃniveśo yasya saḥ/

original: mālatī/ saharṣasādhvasamiti/ lavaṅgikāniveditasvakīyavirahavedanācitraphalakabakulāvalīvṛttāntaḥ sarvo'pyatraiva vartamānenādhigata iti harṣaḥ, vivikte māmenaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā kaścittātāya nivedayiṣyatīti sādhvasaṃ ca/ ahmahe aho pramādaḥ/ ``cintāyāṃ sapramādāyāmahmahe iti kalpitam/ śabdarūpaṃ viśeṣeṇa prayoktavyaṃ prayoktṛbhiḥ//'' iti vacanāt/

original: eṣo'pyatraiva/ mādhavaḥ/ yadityādi ślokopaskāraḥ/ aviraleti/ atarkitopanatamaśaṅkitameva haṭhādupāgataṃ yaddarśanaṃ madviṣayaṃ tenollasitayāścaryaharṣaparavaśatayānayā kartryā sphāritena vistāritena/ ``āyataṃ visphurattāraṃ visphāritamudāhṛtam'' iti lakṣaṇāt/ cakṣuṣā karaṇena pauṇḍarīkeṇa sitāmbhojanirmitena dāmnāviralaṃ naddho baddha iva/

original: kṛtsnaḥ samasta evāhaṃ kavalito nigīrṇo viṣayamādhuryotkarṣāccakṣuṣā svāntaḥpraveśita iva/ tasyāścirakāladarśanenāpyatṛptimanena sūcayati/ amṛtavarṣiṇā meghena sāndreṇa sikta iva/ anena dhārāsāranyāyena kaṭākṣapravṛtterlolākhyo dṛṣṭivyāpāra uktaḥ/ yathā - ``dhārāvāhikasaṃcāro yasya tallolamucyate'' iti mālopamālaṃkāraḥ//16//

original: lavaṅgikā/ pratīṣṭaḥ khalu naḥ priyasakhyāyaṃ prasādaḥ/ ayameva mahānprasādo yatpriyasakhyadhīne tvanmanojīvite iti kimataḥ paraṃ ślāghanīyamityarthaḥ// madayantikā/ jānāti mahānubhāvo'yaṃ jano ramaṇīyaṃ mantrayitum/ ramaṇīyaṃ manogatābhiprāyaprakaṭanaṃ bāhyopacāranaipuṇyapradarśanaṃ yathā bhavati tathā manoharam// mālatī/
analyzed: lavaṅgikā pratīṣṭaḥ khalu naḥ priya sakhyā ayam prasādaḥ ayam eva mahān prasādaḥ yat priya sakhī adhīne tvad manaḥ jīvite iti kim atas param ślāghanīyam iti arthaḥ madayantikā jānāti mahā anubhāvaḥ yam janaḥ ramaṇīyam mantrayitum ramaṇīyam manaḥ gata abhiprāya prakaṭanam bāhya upacāra naipuṇya pradarśanam yathā bhavati tathā manoharam mālatī

original: kiṃ nāma makarandenodvegakāraṇaṃ śrutaṃ bhaviṣyati/ mādhavasyeti śeṣaḥ// praviśyetyādi/ jyāyāñjyeṣṭhaḥ/ parameśvareṇānatikramaṇīyaśāsanena rājñā paraṃ viśvāsamasmadīyaṃ sarvasvam/ tasya yatheṣṭaviniyogārhaṃ tadīyamasmākamityanyonyasya niratiśayaṃ manaḥsaṃmelanaṃ prakaṭayatetyarthaḥ/ pratipāditā dattā/ saṃbhāvayāvaḥ/
analyzed: kim nāma makarandena udvega kāraṇam śrutam bhaviṣyati mādhavasya iti śeṣaḥ praviśya ityādi jyāyān jyeṣṭhaḥ parameśvareṇa an atikramaṇīya śāsanena rājñā param viśvāsam asmadīyam sarvasvam tasya yatheṣṭa viniyoga arham tadīyam asmākam iti anyonyasya niratiśayam manaḥ saṃmelanam prakaṭayatā iti arthaḥ pratipāditā dattā saṃbhāvayāvaḥ

original: pramodena bahumanyāvaha ityarthaḥ/ idaṃ ca prastutaprāptinirodhānnirodho nāmāṅgam/ yathā - ``hitarodho nirodhaḥ syāt'' iti// makarandaḥ/ iyaṃ seti/ yā tvayodvegakāriṇī vārtā śrutā saiveyamityarthaḥ/ vaivarṇyaṃ vivarṇabhāvamapratisamādheyavipatprāptijanitatāpahetukaṃ sāttvikabhāvarūpam/
analyzed: pramodena bahu manyāvahaḥ iti arthaḥ idam ca prastuta prāpti nirodhāt nirodhaḥ nāma aṅgam yathā hita rodhaḥ nirodhaḥ syāt iti makarandaḥ iyam sā iti yā tvayā udvega kāriṇī vārtā śrutā sā eva iyam iti arthaḥ vaivarṇyam vivarṇa bhāvam apratisamādheya vipad prāpti janita tāpa hetukam sāttvika bhāva rūpam

original: yadāha - ``vaivarṇyaṃ varṇabhedaḥ syāttāpaśaṅkābhayādibhiḥ'' iti// madayantikā/ sakhi mālati, tvaṃ khalvekanagaranivāsena pāṃsukrīḍanātprabhṛti priyasakhī bhaginī ca sāṃprataṃ punarbhrātṛbhāryātvenāsmākaṃ gṛhasya maṇḍanaṃ jātāsi// kāmandakī/ vardhasa iti sopahāseyamuktiḥ// madayantikā/ yuṣmākamāśiṣāṃ prasādena/
analyzed: yat āha vaivarṇyam varṇa bhedaḥ syāt tāpa śaṅkā bhaya ādibhiḥ iti madayantikā sakhi mālati tvam khalu eka nagara nivāsena pāṃsu krīḍanāt prabhṛti priya sakhī bhaginī ca sāṃpratam punar bhrātṛ bhāryā tvena asmākam gṛhasya maṇḍanam jātā asi kāmandakī vardhase iti sa upahāsā iyam uktiḥ madayantikā yuṣmākam āśiṣām prasādena

original: kevalaṃ bhavadāśīrvādānmālatīlābho na tu daṃpatyoranyonyānurāgātiśayādityāśayaḥ/ sakhi lavaṅgike, bharitāḥ saṃpūrṇā manorathāḥ/ yuṣmākaṃ lābhena saparijanāyā eva mālatyā lābhādyuṣmākamiti bahutvam// lavaṅgikā/ sakhi, asmākamapyetanmantrayitavyam/ pūrṇā no manorathā yuṣmākaṃ sadṛśaślāghyasaṃbandhānāṃ lābhenaivetyasmābhirapi vaktavyamityarthaḥ/
analyzed: kevalam bhavat āśīrvādāt mālatī lābhaḥ na tu daṃpatyoḥ anyonya anurāga atiśayāt iti āśayaḥ sakhi lavaṅgike bharitāḥ saṃpūrṇāḥ manorathāḥ yuṣmākam lābhena sa parijanāyāḥ eva mālatyāḥ lābhāt yuṣmākam iti bahu tvam lavaṅgikā sakhi asmākam api etat mantrayitavyam pūrṇāḥ naḥ manorathāḥ yuṣmākam sadṛśa ślāghya saṃbandhānām lābhena eva iti asmābhiḥ api vaktavyam iti arthaḥ

original: atha ca yuṣmākaṃ saparijanāyā bhavatyā makarandaprāptirūpeṇa bhāvinā lābhenāsmākaṃ pūrṇā manorathā bhavitāra ityasmābhirevaitanmantrayitavyam/ na tu tvayā saparijanamālatīlābhasya bhavatsaṃkalpamātrasya niścitatvādityapi pratītiḥ// madayantikā/ sakhi buddharakṣite, ehi tāvat/ mahotsavaṃ saṃbhāvayāvaḥ// lavaṅgikā/
analyzed: atha ca yuṣmākam sa parijanāyāḥ bhavatyāḥ makaranda prāpti rūpeṇa bhāvinā lābhena asmākam pūrṇāḥ manorathāḥ bhavitāraḥ iti asmābhiḥ eva etat mantrayitavyam na tu tvayā sa parijana mālatī lābhasya bhavat saṃkalpa mātrasya niścita tvāt iti api pratītiḥ madayantikā sakhi buddha rakṣite ehi tāvat mahā utsavam saṃbhāvayāvaḥ lavaṅgikā

original: yathā hṛdaye bharitau pūrṇāvata evodvamantau yau vismayānandau tābhyāṃ sundaraṃ yathā syāttathā ghūrṇitā bhrāmitā dhīrā ākāragopanārthamavalambitadhairyāḥ paryante'pāṅgadeśe manoharāśca paryasyante paritaḥ kṣipyante'lasavalitādiprakāravaicitryeṇa pravartante/
analyzed: yathā hṛdaye bharitau pūrṇau atas eva udvamantau yau vismaya ānandau tābhyām sundaram yathā syāt tathā ghūrṇitāḥ bhrāmitāḥ dhīrāḥ ākāra gopana artham avalambita dhairyāḥ manoharāḥ ca paryasyante paritas kṣipyante ilasa valita ādi prakāra vaicitryeṇa pravartante

original: madayantikāmakarandayordalitanīlotpalamāṃsalacchavayo dṛṣṭisaṃbhedāḥ saṃmukhapravṛttyā miśrībhūtāḥ kaṭākṣavikṣepāḥ, tathā manye manorathanirvṛttasamāgamāvetāviti/ dṛṣṭivikṣepā yathā yena prakāreṇa pravartante tathā tena prakāreṇaivamunnīyata ityarthaḥ// kāmandakī/ nanvityādi/ mānasaṃ mohanaṃ saṃkalpanirmitasaṃbhogam/
analyzed: madayantikā makarandayoḥ dalita nīlotpala māṃsala chavayaḥ dṛṣṭi saṃbhedāḥ saṃmukha pravṛttyā miśrībhūtāḥ kaṭākṣa vikṣepāḥ tathā manye manoratha nirvṛtta samāgamau etau iti dṛṣṭi vikṣepāḥ yathā yena prakāreṇa pravartante tathā tena prakāreṇa evam unnīyate iti arthaḥ kāmandakī nanu ityādi mānasam mohanam saṃkalpa nirmita saṃbhogam

original: tadvyañjakaṃ liṅgamāha - tathā hīti/ īṣaditi/ anayordṛṣṭaṃ darśanaṃ vyaktaṃ yathā syāttathā śaṃsati/ saṃkalpanirmitaṃ saṃbhogaṃ kathayatītyarthaḥ/ kīdṛśaṃ dṛṣṭam/ īṣattiryagvalanena manāktiryagudañcanena viṣamaṃ vakram/ vakrākhyo'yaṃ śṛṅgāravikāraḥ/ yathā - ``valito vāṅgasaṃcāro yatra tadvakramucyate'' iti/ kūṇitaṃ prāntekūṇitaprāntam/
analyzed: tad vyañjakam liṅgam āha tathā hi iti īṣat iti anayoḥ dṛṣṭam darśanam vyaktam yathā syāt tathā śaṃsati saṃkalpa nirmitam saṃbhogam kathayati iti arthaḥ kīdṛśam dṛṣṭam īṣat tiryak valanena manāk tiryak udañcanena viṣamam vakram vakra ākhyaḥ yam śṛṅgāra vikāraḥ yathā valitaḥ vā aṅga saṃcāraḥ yatra tat vakram ucyate iti kūṇitam prāntekūṇita prāntam

original: apāṅgadeśe bhāgatrayeṇa saṃkucitamityarthaḥ/ kūṇitaṃ yathā - ``bhāgatrayasya saṃkoco vikāsastvaparasya ca/ yasyā dṛṣṭervilakṣeṇa tadvikūṇitamucyate//'' iti/ ``purastribhāgasaṃkoce premṇā tatkūṇitaṃ bhavet''/ iti/ etaditi purovartitvena nirdiśati/ premṇo'nurāgasyodbhedena prakaṭībhāvena stimitaṃ niṣpandaṃ lalitaṃ premārdraṃ ca/
analyzed: apāṅga deśe bhāga trayeṇa saṃkucitam iti arthaḥ kūṇitam yathā bhāga trayasya saṃkocaḥ vikāsaḥ tu aparasya ca yasyāḥ dṛṣṭeḥ vilakṣeṇa tat vikūṇitam ucyate iti puras tri bhāga saṃkoce premṇā tat kūṇitam bhavet iti etat iti purovarti tvena nirdiśati premṇaḥ anurāgasya udbhedena prakaṭībhāvena stimitam niṣpandam lalitam prema ārdram ca

original: niṣpandalalite yathā - ``niṣpandaṃ tadyadanyatra dṛṣṭānna spandate kvacit/ premārdramantarvikasattāraṃ lalitamīritam//'' iti/ kiṃcidākuñciteṣaducchvasantī bhrūryatra taccaturākhyo bhrūvikāraḥ prasannadṛṣṭivikāraścoktaḥ/ tallakṣaṇaṃ tūktaṃ prāk/ antarunmādasyāntarānandasyānubhavena masṛṇaṃ premṇānurañjitam/
analyzed: niṣpanda lalite yathā niṣpandam tat yat anyatra dṛṣṭāt na spandate kvacid prema ārdram antar vikasat tāram lalitam īritam iti kiṃcid ākuñcita īṣat ucchvasantī bhrūḥ yatra tad catur ākhyaḥ bhrū vikāraḥ prasanna dṛṣṭi vikāraḥ ca uktaḥ tad lakṣaṇam tu uktam prāk antar unmādasya antar ānandasya anubhavena masṛṇam premṇā anurañjitam

original: ``masṛṇaṃ tattu vijñeyamanurāgakaṣāyitam'' ityetadapyuktaṃ prāk/ srastānyavasannāni niṣkampāni niścalāni pakṣmāṇi yatra tat/ ākekare akṣiṇī/ ``ākuñcitapuṭā yāṅgasaṃgatārthanimīlitā/ muhurvyāvartatārā ca dṛṣṭirākekarā matā//'' ityākekaradṛṣṭiruktā/ kecittu ``dṛṣṭamākekarākṣamityākekaradṛṣṭireva dṛṣṭaśabdenoktā/
analyzed: masṛṇam tat tu vijñeyam anurāga kaṣāyitam iti etat api uktam prāk srastāni avasannāni niṣkampāni niścalāni pakṣmāṇi yatra tat ākekare akṣiṇī ākuñcita puṭā yā aṅga saṃgata artha nimīlitā muhur vyāvarta tārā ca dṛṣṭiḥ ākekarā matā iti ākekara dṛṣṭiḥ uktā kecid tu dṛṣṭam ākekara akṣam iti ākekara dṛṣṭiḥ eva dṛṣṭa śabdena uktā

original: ākekaradṛṣṭisvarūpameveṣattiryagityādi viśeṣaṇairnirūpitam'' iti vyācakṣate/ aciramiti darśanakriyāviśeṣaṇam//2//
analyzed: ākekara dṛṣṭi svarūpam eva īṣat tiryak ityādi viśeṣaṇaiḥ nirūpitam iti vyācakṣate aciram iti darśana kriyā viśeṣaṇam

original: madayantikā/ sakhi buddharakṣite, api punardrakṣyata eṣa jīvitapradāyī puṇḍarīkalocanaḥ/ api punarityautsukyātiśayo dyotyate// buddharakṣitā/ yadi daivamanukūlayiṣyati/ atha mādhavaḥ samadhigatamālatīpradānaniścayī nairāśyasaṃjātamudvegātiśayaṃ vivṛṇvannāha - cirāditi/
analyzed: madayantikā sakhi buddha rakṣite api punar drakṣyate eṣa jīvita pradāyī puṇḍarīka locanaḥ api punar iti autsukya atiśayaḥ dyotyate buddha rakṣitā yadi daivam anukūlayiṣyati atha mādhavaḥ samadhigata mālatī pradāna niścayī nairāśya saṃjātam udvega atiśayam vivṛṇvan āha cirāt iti

original: cirādanuvṛtto bisinīsūtravanmṛṇālatantuvadbhiduraḥ svameva bhidyamāna āśātantustatprāptyāśaiva tanturidānīṃ truṭatu chinno bhavatu/ priyatamāsamāgamāśā durbalaiveyantaṃ kālamanuvṛttā sedānīṃ chinnetyarthaḥ/ tathedānīṃ mahānādhirmānasī vyathā sa eva vyādhirniravadhirniravasaraḥ prasaratu/
analyzed: cirāt anuvṛttaḥ bisinī sūtra vat mṛṇāla tantu vat bhiduraḥ svam eva bhidyamānaḥ āśā tantuḥ tad prāpti āśā eva tantuḥ idānīm truṭatu chinnaḥ bhavatu priyatamā samāgama āśā durbalā eva iyantam kālam anuvṛttā sā idānīm chinnā iti arthaḥ tathā idānīm mahān ādhiḥ mānasī vyathā saḥ eva vyādhiḥ niravadhiḥ niravasaraḥ prasaratu

original: mālatīprāptilakṣaṇamavadhiṃ pratīkṣya kathaṃcidādhiḥ soḍha idānīṃ tasyāvadherabhāvaniścayānnirmaryādo vijṛmbhatāmityarthaḥ/ tathā pāriplavasya cittacāñcalyasyāratirūpasya dhurotkarṣo mayyavyājaṃ niṣkapaṭam/ visrambheṇeti yāvat/ pratiṣṭhāṃ sthitiṃ vrajatu/ mālatīprāptyāśayā ālambanabhūtāyā apagamādvātyākṣiptatūlavadapratiṣṭhāṃ prāpnotvityarthaḥ/
analyzed: mālatī prāpti lakṣaṇam avadhim pratīkṣya kathaṃcid ādhiḥ soḍhaḥ idānīm tasya avadheḥ abhāva niścayāt nirmaryādaḥ vijṛmbhatām iti arthaḥ tathā pāriplavasya citta cāñcalyasya arati rūpasya dhurā utkarṣaḥ mayi avyājam niṣkapaṭam visrambheṇa iti yāvat pratiṣṭhām sthitim vrajatu mālatī prāpti āśayā ālambana bhūtāyāḥ apagamāt vā ati ākṣipta tūla vat apratiṣṭhām prāpnotu iti arthaḥ

original: tathā vidhiḥ sthairyaṃ dhattām/ madanaśca kṛtakṛtyo bhavatu/ ubhābhyāmapi kartavyasya mahataḥ prayojanasya mahatā prayatnena nirvartitatvādityarthaḥ/ jīvanamitaḥ paraṃ kṣaṇamātramapi durlabhamiti bhāvaḥ/ ekasminkārye'nekakāraṇasamuccayātsamuccayālaṃkāraḥ//3//
analyzed: tathā vidhiḥ sthairyam dhattām madanaḥ ca kṛtakṛtyaḥ bhavatu ubhābhyām api kartavyasya mahataḥ prayojanasya mahatā prayatnena nirvartita tvāt iti arthaḥ jīvanam itas param kṣaṇa mātram api durlabham iti bhāvaḥ ekasmin kāryena eka kāraṇa samuccayāt samuccaya alaṃkāraḥ

original: atha veti/ svayameva svātmānaṃ samāśvāsayati - samāneti/ samānapremāṇaṃ tulyānurāgamasulabhaṃ parādhīnatvena duṣprāpaṃ janaṃ prārthitavato mama vidhau vāmārambhe vakrodyoga eṣā pariṇatiriyaṃ vipattirūpā daśā samucitaiva/
analyzed: atha vā iti svayam eva sva ātmānam samāśvāsayati samāna iti samāna premāṇam tulya anurāgam asulabham para adhīna tvena duṣprāpam janam prārthitavataḥ mama vidhau vāma ārambhe vakra udyoge eṣā pariṇatiḥ iyam vipatti rūpā daśā samucitā eva

original: tato na mayā vaiklavyamaṅgīkāryamityeva yadyapi hṛdayaṃ vyavasthāpayāmi tathāpyasmindānaśravaṇasamaye nandanāya rājñā mālatī dattetyetadvārtākarṇanasamaye pravigalatprabhaṃ tatkṣaṇaprakṣaritakānti ata eva prātaścandradyuti asyā vadanaṃ māmantardahati/ vārtāśravaṇamātreṇaivāsyā īdṛśyavasthā/
analyzed: tatas na mayā vaiklavyam aṅgīkāryam iti eva yadi api hṛdayam vyavasthāpayāmi tathā api asmin dāna śravaṇa samaye nandanāya rājñā mālatī dattā iti etad vārtā ākarṇana samaye pravigalat prabham tad kṣaṇa prakṣarita kānti atas eva prātar candra dyuti asyāḥ vadanam mām antar dahati vārtā śravaṇa mātreṇa eva asyāḥ īdṛśī avasthā

original: niṣpanne tu tatprayojane kimasyā bhaviṣyatītyeṣa eva mama vyathāheturnāsmadvipattiniścaya ityarthaḥ//4//
analyzed: niṣpanne tu tad prayojane kim asyāḥ bhaviṣyati iti eṣaḥ eva mama vyathā hetuḥ na asmad vipatti niścayaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: kāmandakī/ durmanāyamāno durmanasko bhavan/ vatsā mālatī ca/ nirāśā prāṇitīti yattadeva duṣkaram/ tādṛśī kāpyavasthā vartate yajjīvanameva maraṇāpekṣayā kutsanīyam/ aśakyapratīkāraścāsāvanarthaḥ kapaṭasaṃvidhānamantareṇa/ tacca duṣkaramiti mamaiva cittavyākṣepo balavānityarthaḥ/ bhavatu tāvat/
analyzed: kāmandakī durmanāyamānaḥ durmanaskaḥ bhavan vatsā mālatī ca nirāśā prāṇiti iti yat tat eva duṣkaram tādṛśī kā api avasthā vartate yat jīvanam eva maraṇa apekṣayā kutsanīyam aśakya pratīkāraḥ ca asau anarthaḥ kapaṭa saṃvidhānam antareṇa tat ca duṣkaram iti mama eva citta vyākṣepaḥ balavān iti arthaḥ bhavatu tāvat

original: dhārṣṭhyāvalambanena samāśvāsayāmīti prakāśamāha - pṛcchāmīti/ āyuṣmanniti saṃbodhanena mayi vartamānāyāṃ jīvanasaṃdeho na kartavya iti sūcayati/ pūrvāpekṣayedānīmudvegātiśayasya kiṃ vā kāraṇamiti pṛcchāmi/ etāvantaṃ kālaṃ bhūrivasureva mahyaṃ sutāṃ dāsyatīti niścitya kimevaṃ prāṇadhāraṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tadetatpṛcchāmi kathaya/
analyzed: dhārṣṭhya avalambanena samāśvāsayāmi iti prakāśam āha pṛcchāmi iti āyuṣman iti saṃbodhanena mayi vartamānāyām jīvana saṃdehaḥ na kartavyaḥ iti sūcayati pūrva apekṣayā idānīm udvega atiśayasya kim vā kāraṇam iti pṛcchāmi etāvantam kālam bhūrivasuḥ eva mahyam sutām dāsyati iti niścitya kim evam prāṇa dhāraṇam kṛtam tat etat pṛcchāmi kathaya

original: tathā cedidānīṃ yuktaḥ paritāpātiśayaḥ/ tenaivānyasmai tasyāḥ pradānāditi bhāvaḥ// mādhavaḥ - salajjamiti/ bālacāpalena kevalaṃ bhavānasyāmanuraktaḥ/ nahi bhūrivasunā svasutāṃ dāsyāmītyāhūto bhavānatrāgata iti kāmandakīvacanābhiprāyamavagamya salajjamāhetyarthaḥ/ nahi nahīti kutastasya dāsyāmīti vacanam/ sa tāvadasmannāmāpi na jānātītyāśayaḥ//
analyzed: tathā ced idānīm yuktaḥ paritāpa atiśayaḥ tena eva anyasmai tasyāḥ pradānāt iti bhāvaḥ mādhavaḥ sa lajjam iti bāla cāpalena kevalam bhavān asyām anuraktaḥ nahi bhūrivasunā sva sutām dāsyāmi iti āhūtaḥ bhavān atra āgataḥ iti kāmandakī vacana abhiprāyam avagamya sa lajjam āha iti arthaḥ nahi nahi iti kutas tasya dāsyāmi iti vacanam sa tāvat asmad nāma api na jānāti iti āśayaḥ

original: kāmandakī/ tarhi pūrvāvasthāyā bhūrivasurna parihīyate nānyathā bhavati/ pūrvamapi bhūrivasurdāsyatīti na tava pratyāśā/ idānīmapi sā nāstīti/ kimidānīmudvegādhikye kāraṇam/ bhavatoranyonyānurāgo'pi pūrvāvasthāto na parihīyate/ yadvaśādubhayorjīvitadhāraṇamiyantaṃ kālaṃ tato nedānīṃ kiṃcidapi nūtanamasti/ kimiti saṃtāpa iti bhāvaḥ// makarandaḥ/
analyzed: kāmandakī tarhi pūrva avasthāyāḥ bhūrivasuḥ na parihīyate na anyathā bhavati pūrvam api bhūrivasuḥ dāsyati iti na tava pratyāśā idānīm api sā na asti iti kim idānīm udvega ādhikye kāraṇam bhavatoḥ anyonya anurāgaḥ upi pūrva avasthātaḥ na parihīyate yad vaśāt ubhayoḥ jīvita dhāraṇam iyantam kālam tatas na idānīm kiṃcid api nūtanam asti kim iti saṃtāpaḥ iti bhāvaḥ makarandaḥ

original: yadyapi bhūrivasunā mādhavāya sutāṃ dāsyāmīti noktaṃ, na tadvacanāśayā cānena sthitaṃ, tathāpi mālatyāḥ pūrvaṃ pitrā kasmaicidapyapratipādanādātmanaśca yogyatāsaṃbhāvanādāśāmātraṃ sthitam/ idānīṃ tu pūrvaṃ rājñā yācito nandanāya dattavāniti vārtāṃ śrutvā bhagnāśatvādaniṣṭamāśaṅkyata ityasti pūrvottarayoḥ kālayorvaiṣamyamityarthaḥ//
analyzed: yadi api bhūrivasunā mādhavāya sutām dāsyāmi iti nā uktam na tad vacana āśayā ca anena sthitam tathā api mālatyāḥ pūrvam pitrā kasmaicid api apratipādanāt ātmanaḥ ca yogyatā asaṃbhāvanāt āśā mātram sthitam idānīm tu pūrvam rājñā yācitaḥ nandanāya dattavān iti vārtām śrutvā bhagna āśa tvāt aniṣṭam āśaṅkyate iti asti pūrva uttarayoḥ kālayoḥ vaiṣamyam iti arthaḥ

original: kāmandakī - jānāmīti/ astyevaiṣā vārtā/ tathāpi mālatīṃ dattavato rājñaḥ parasvapratipādane'dhikārābhāvādadhikāravatā ca pitrā manaḥpūrvakamadattatvādidānīmapi pūrvavadāśāstyeveti naitāvatā bhetavyamityarthaḥ/ kathaṃ pitrā niścitaṃ na dattetyāśaṅkya tadvacanaparyālocanayāpi varītuṃ tāvadastyeṣā prasiddhirityāha - idaṃ tāvaditi// makarandaḥ/
analyzed: kāmandakī jānāmi iti asti eva eṣā vārtā tathā api mālatīm dattavataḥ rājñaḥ para sva pratipādana idhikāra abhāvāt adhikāravatā ca pitrā manaḥ pūrvakam adatta tvāt idānīm api pūrvavat āśā asti eva iti na etāvatā bhetavyam iti arthaḥ katham pitrā niścitam na dattā iti āśaṅkya tad vacana paryālocanayā api varītum tāvat asti eṣā prasiddhiḥ iti āha idam tāvat iti makarandaḥ

original: astyetat/ mayāpi śrutamityarthaḥ/ adyatano'pi vṛttānto rājñā svayameva mālatī dattā na tu pitrā tatpradānādhikāriṇetyevaṃrūpaḥ śruta evetyāha// kāmandakī - adya ceti/
analyzed: asti etat mayā api śrutam iti arthaḥ adyatanaḥ api vṛttāntaḥ rājñā svayam eva mālatī dattā na tu pitrā tad pradāna adhikāriṇā iti evaṃrūpaḥ śrutaḥ eva iti āha kāmandakī adya ca iti

original: nanu yadyapi svayamevādya rājñā dattā na bhūrivasunā tathāpi pūrvameva prabhavatītyādivākyena tasyāpyanumatiḥ pratīyata ityāśaṅkya tadvacanasya chalātmakatayā vañcanārthaṃ prayuktatvānna tena vyavahāraśuddhiriti vaktuṃ prathamaṃ lokavyavahārasya pramāṇatvaṃ darśayati - tadvatseti/ dehināṃ vyavahārarūpāṇi tantrāṇi kuṭumbakṛtyāni/
analyzed: nanu yadi api svayam eva adya rājñā dattā na bhūrivasunā tathā api pūrvam eva prabhavatī ityādi vākyena tasya api anumatiḥ pratīyate iti āśaṅkya tad vacanasya chala ātmaka tayā vañcana artham prayukta tvāt na tena vyavahāra śuddhiḥ iti vaktum prathamam loka vyavahārasya pramāṇa tvam darśayati tadvat sā iti dehinām vyavahāra rūpāṇi tantrāṇi kuṭumba kṛtyāni

original: ``tantraṃ kuṭumbakṛtye syāt'' iti halāyudhaḥ/ vāci pratiṣṭhā sthitiryeṣāṃ tāni/ vacanamātranibandhanānītyarthaḥ/ puṇyāpuṇyahetavo vyavasthāḥ ``satyaṃ vadennānṛtaṃ vadet'' ityādayaḥ śāstrīyā maryādā vācyevāyatante vāgāyattā eva bhavanti/ vāṅmūla eva sarvo'pi śubhāśubhaheturvyavahāra ityarthaḥ/
analyzed: tantram kuṭumba kṛtye syāt iti halāyudhaḥ vāci pratiṣṭhā sthitiḥ yeṣām tāni vacana mātra nibandhanāni iti arthaḥ puṇya apuṇya hetavaḥ vyavasthāḥ satyam vadet na anṛtam vadet ityādayaḥ śāstrīyāḥ maryādāḥ vāci iva āyatante vāc āyattāḥ eva bhavanti vāc mūle eva sarvaḥ api śubha aśubha hetuḥ vyavahāraḥ iti arthaḥ

original: iyaṃ tu bhūrivasorvākchalātmikā na tu śuddhetyāha - sā ceti/ anṛtātmikaivopacārokticāturyeṇāpātataḥ satyavatpratibhāse'pi vicāryamāṇe paramārthadṛṣṭyā mithyābhūtaiva/ kuta ityata āha - na khalviti/ īśvaratvāttasya parakīyakanyakāsvapi svātantryamastītyata āha - kanyaketi/ nṛpatayaḥ pramāṇaṃ paricchettāraḥ/ svatantrakartāra iti yāvat/
analyzed: iyam tu bhūrivasoḥ vāc chala ātmikā na tu śuddhā iti āha sā ca iti anṛta ātmikā eva upacāra ukti cāturyeṇa āpātataḥ satya vat pratibhāse api vicāryamāṇe paramārtha dṛṣṭyā mithyā bhūtā eva kutas iti atas āha na khalu iti īśvara tvāt tasya parakīya kanyakāsu api svātantryam asti iti atas āha kanyakā iti nṛpatayaḥ pramāṇam paricchettāraḥ svatantra kartāraḥ iti yāvat
