original: ityevaṃvidho dharmācāro dhārmikāṇāmācārastasya samayastatpravartakaṃ śāstram/ kvacidapi na dṛṣṭamiti śeṣaḥ/ tasmātpitrā cāpradānādrājñaścānadhikārādrājakartṛkapradānaṃ lokaśāstraviruddhamityetadavasthitamityāha - tasmāditi/ tadasyā vārtāyāḥ paspaśaprāyakatvena naitāvatā nairāśyaṃ bhāvanīyamityāśayaḥ/
analyzed: iti evaṃvidhaḥ dharma ācāraḥ dhārmikāṇām ācāraḥ tasya samayaḥ tad pravartakam śāstram kvacid api na dṛṣṭam iti śeṣaḥ tasmāt pitrā ca apradānāt rājñaḥ ca anadhikārāt rāja kartṛka pradānam loka śāstra viruddham iti etat avasthitam iti āha tasmāt iti tat asyāḥ vārtāyāḥ paspaśa prāyaka tvena na etāvatā nairāśyam bhāvanīyam iti āśayaḥ

original: kiṃca mayi jīvantyāmapi kathaṃ bhavadvyatiriktagāminī syāditi viśvāsajananārthaṃ sāhaṃkāramāha - kathaṃ ceti/ apramattaivāhaṃ bhavatsaṃghaṭane varte/ tannāniṣṭamāśaṅkanīyamityarthaḥ/ tadevāha - mā vāmiti/
analyzed: kiṃca mayi jīvantyām api katham bhavat vyatirikta gāminī syāt iti viśvāsa janana artham sa ahaṃkāram āha katham ca iti apramattā eva aham bhavat saṃghaṭane varte tat na aniṣṭam āśaṅkanīyam iti arthaḥ tat eva āha mā vām iti

original: asyāṃ tvayi ca yatpāpamaniṣṭaṃ viśaṅkyaṃ yuvābhyāmanyonyamasmadādibhiśca ``prema paśyati bhayānyapade'pi'' iti nītyā premavaśādasthāne'pyaniṣṭaśaṅkibhirāśaṅkanīyaṃ tadvāṃ yuvayoḥ sapatneṣvapi mābhūt aniṣṭaṃ hi śatrugāmitveneṣyate/ idaṃ tu teṣvapi nāpekṣituṃ yuktamityavasthādausthyātiśayoktiḥ/
analyzed: asyām tvayi ca yat pāpam aniṣṭam viśaṅkyam yuvābhyām anyonyam asmat ādibhiḥ ca prema paśyati bhaya anya pade pi iti nītyā prema vaśāt asthāne pi aniṣṭa śaṅkibhiḥ āśaṅkanīyam tat vām yuvayoḥ sapatneṣu api mā abhūt aniṣṭam hi śatru gāmi tvena iṣyate idam tu teṣu api nā apekṣitum yuktam iti avasthā dausthya atiśayoktiḥ

original: tasmātsarvathāntato gatvā prāṇavyayenāpi bhavatsaṃgamanāya yatno mayā vidheyaḥ/ kārya ityarthaḥ/ iyaṃ ca yatnākhyā dvitīyāvasthā/ yathā - ``apaśyataḥ phalaprāptiṃ yo vyāpāraḥ phalaṃ prati/ paraṃ tvautsukyagamanaṃ sa yatna iti kathyate//'' iti//5//
analyzed: tasmāt sarvathā antatas gatvā prāṇa vyayena api bhavat saṃgamanāya yatnaḥ mayā vidheyaḥ kāryaḥ iti arthaḥ iyam ca yatna ākhyā dvitīya avasthā yathā apaśyataḥ phala prāptim yaḥ vyāpāraḥ phalam prati param tu autsukya gamanam sa yatnaḥ iti kathyate iti

original: makarandaḥ/ api cetyādi/ saṃsārādvirataṃ rāgadveṣavāsanāvivarjitamapi cittaṃ dravayati kṛpārdraṃ karoti/ dayeti/ dayānukampā, snehaḥ premākhyo bhāvaḥ/ ato dayāsnehaparavaśatvāttvadantaḥkaraṇasya pravrajyāsamaye saṃnyāsasaṃpradāye sulabho yo'ṣṭāṅgayogābhyāsādirācārastasya vimukho virodhī/ ayaṃ yatnaḥ prasakto balādāpatitaḥ/
analyzed: makarandaḥ api ca ityādi saṃsārāt viratam rāga dveṣa vāsanā vivarjitam api cittam dravayati kṛpā ārdram karoti dayā iti dayā anukampā snehaḥ prema ākhyaḥ bhāvaḥ atas dayā sneha paravaśa tvāt tvad antaḥkaraṇasya pravrajyā samaye saṃnyāsa saṃpradāye sulabhaḥ yoṣṭa aṅga yoga abhyāsa ādiḥ ācāraḥ tasya vimukhaḥ virodhī ayam yatnaḥ prasaktaḥ balāt āpatitaḥ

original: aparaṃ punaritaḥ paraṃ tu daivamanayorbhāgadheyaṃ prabhavati/ tvayā tu yāvatkartavyaṃ tāvatkriyata ityarthaḥ/ idaṃ cānunayarūpaṃ paryupāsanaṃ nāmāṅgam/ yathā - ``anunītiḥ paryupāstiḥ'' iti//6//
analyzed: aparam punar itas param tu daivam anayoḥ bhāgadheyam prabhavati tvayā tu yāvat kartavyam tāvat kriyate iti arthaḥ idam ca anunaya rūpam paryupāsanam nāma aṅgam yathā anunītiḥ paryupāstiḥ iti

original: nepathye/ bhagavati kāmandaki, eṣā devī vijñāpayati yathā mālatīṃ gṛhītvā tvaritamāgaccheti// mālatīmādhavau sakaruṇaṃ parasparāniṣṭaśaṅkayā sānurāgamanyonyabhāvādhigamenāvalokayataḥ// mādhavaḥ/ mādhavasya duḥkhaikabhājanasya mametyarthāntarasaṃkramitavācyatā/
analyzed: nepathye bhagavati kāmandaki eṣā devī vijñāpayati yathā mālatīm gṛhītvā tvaritam āgaccha iti mālatī mādhavau sa karuṇam paraspara aniṣṭa śaṅkayā sa anurāgam anyonya bhāva adhigamena avalokayataḥ mādhavaḥ mādhavasya duḥkha eka bhājanasya mama iti artha antara saṃkramita vācya tā

original: mālatyā samaṃ lokayātrā darśanasaṃlāpādirūpo'nuraktajanavyavahāra etāvatīyatyeva parisamāptā/ tadetatkaṣṭamityarthaḥ/ aho āścarye/ nu vitarke/ khalu prasiddhau/ bhoḥ saṃbodhane/ he hṛdaya, āścaryaṃ khalu vidherdurvilasitamiti vitarkayāmītyarthaḥ/ tadeva durvilasitamāha - suhṛdiveti/
analyzed: mālatyā samam lokayātrā darśana saṃlāpa ādi rūpa unurakta jana vyavahāraḥ etāvatī iyatī eva parisamāptā tat etat kaṣṭam iti arthaḥ aho āścarye nu vitarke khalu prasiddhau bhoḥ saṃbodhane he hṛdaye āścaryam khalu vidheḥ durvilasitam iti vitarkayāmi iti arthaḥ tat eva durvilasitam āha suhṛd iva iti

original: asau vidhiḥ prathamaṃ suhṛnmitramivaikarasāṃ tadekasvabhāvāṃ prakārāntaraśūnyāmanukūlatāṃ prastutakāryānuguṇyaṃ prakaṭīkṛtya punaḥ sa evākāṇḍe'navasare yadvivartanaṃ viruddhāvṛttiḥ prātikūlyena vyavaharaṇaṃ tena dāruṇo vidhiḥ/ manorujaṃ cittarogaṃ praviśinaṣṭi/ prayojanaṃ vighaṭayyādhimātramavaśeṣayatītyarthaḥ/ vidhinindayā viṣādo vyajyate//7//
analyzed: asau vidhiḥ prathamam suhṛd mitram iva eka rasām tad eka svabhāvām prakāra antara śūnyām anukūla tām prastuta kārya ānuguṇyam prakaṭīkṛtya punar saḥ eva akāṇḍena avasare yat vivartanam viruddha āvṛttiḥ prātikūlyena vyavaharaṇam tena dāruṇaḥ vidhiḥ manaḥ rujam citta rogam praviśinaṣṭi prayojanam vighaṭayya adhimātram avaśeṣayati iti arthaḥ vidhi nindayā viṣādaḥ vyajyate

original: mālatī/ mahānubhāva locanānandakara, etāvaddṛṣṭo'si/ na punardṛśyase mama jīvanābhāvādityāśayaḥ/ locanayorevānandastvayā kṛtaḥ/ manasastu mahatī vyathaiva saṃpāditetyasya dhvaniḥ/ idaṃ ca pratyakṣaniṣṭhuratvādvajraṃ nāmāṅgam/ yathā - ``pratyakṣaniṣṭhuraṃ vajram'' iti/ lavaṅgikā/ hā dhik/ śarīrasaṃśayameva naḥ priyasakhī samāropitāmātyena/
analyzed: mālatī mahā anubhāva locana ānanda karaḥ etāvat dṛṣṭaḥ asi na punar dṛśyase mama jīvana abhāvāt iti āśayaḥ locanayoḥ eva ānandaḥ tvayā kṛtaḥ manasaḥ tu mahatī vyathā eva saṃpāditā iti asya dhvaniḥ idam ca pratyakṣa niṣṭhura tvāt vajram nāma aṅgam yathā pratyakṣa niṣṭhuram vajram iti lavaṅgikā hā dhik śarīra saṃśayam eva naḥ priya sakhī samāropitā amātyena

original: tadidānīṃ bhagavati, tvameva gurujanaspṛhāṃ vihāya mālatīprāṇatrāṇe tvaritaṃ yatasvetyāśayaḥ// mālatī/ pariṇatamidānīṃ jīvitatṛṣṇāyāḥ phalam/ nirvyūḍhaṃ ca niṣkaruṇatayā tātasya kāpālikatvam/ kāpālika eva paraṃ strībālādivadhe niṣkaruṇaḥ/ tena pañcamāṅkakṛtyaṃ ca kiṃcitsūcitam/
analyzed: tat idānīm bhagavati tvam eva guru jana spṛhām vihāya mālatī prāṇa trāṇe tvaritam yatasva iti āśayaḥ mālatī pariṇatam idānīm jīvita tṛṣṇāyāḥ phalam nirvyūḍham ca niṣkaruṇa tayā tātasya kāpālika tvam kāpālikaḥ eva param strī bāla ādi vadhe niṣkaruṇaḥ tena pañcama aṅka kṛtyam ca kiṃcid sūcitam

original: pariniṣṭhitaḥ parisamāptiṃ gamito daivahatakasya dāruṇasamārambhapariṇāmaḥ/ kamupālabhe mandabhāgyā/ kaṃ vāśaraṇāśaraṇaṃ pratipadye/ anena/ mādhavaṃ kāmandakīṃ ca prati kathaṃ yuvayoḥ satorapyahamīdṛśīṃ daśāmanubhavāmīti tadupakramyatāṃ yathocitaṃ prayatna iti sūcyate/
analyzed: pariniṣṭhitaḥ parisamāptim gamitaḥ daiva hatakasya dāruṇa samārambha pariṇāmaḥ kam upālabhe mandabhāgyā kam vā aśaraṇa aśaraṇam pratipadye anena mādhavam kāmandakīm ca prati katham yuvayoḥ satoḥ api aham īdṛśīm daśām anubhavāmi iti tat upakramyatām yathocitam prayatnaḥ iti sūcyate

original: etatsūcanārthamevādhīrayāpi mālatyā mādhavasaṃnidhāne'pi nistrapībhūyākranditamiti mantavyam// lavaṅgikā/ sakhi, ita itaḥ/ āgamyatāmiti śeṣaḥ// mādhavaḥ/ nūnamiti/ kathaṃ vā rājani pratipakṣe tadvirodhena bhagavatī kāryaṃ niṣpādayet/ tadasyā vacanamāśvāsanārthamevetyarthaḥ/ saṃśayitaṃ janmasāphalyaṃ mālatīprāptilakṣaṇaṃ yasya tādṛśaḥ saṃvṛtto'smi/
analyzed: etad sūcana artham eva adhīrayā api mālatyā mādhava saṃnidhāne api nistrapībhūya ākranditam iti mantavyam lavaṅgikā sakhi itas itas āgamyatām iti śeṣaḥ mādhavaḥ nūnam iti katham vā rājani pratipakṣe tad virodhena bhagavatī kāryam niṣpādayet tat asyāḥ vacanam āśvāsana artham eva iti arthaḥ saṃśayitam janma sāphalyam mālatī prāpti lakṣaṇam yasya tādṛśaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ asmi

original: atra mālatīprāptireva jīvitasāphalyamityanena tadanurāgatadguṇātiśayaprakhyāpanātsātiśayavacanarūpaṃ puṣpaṃ nāmāṅgamuktam/ yathā - ``puṣpaṃ sātiśayaṃ vacaḥ'' iti/ idānīṃ jātyanucitenāpi kṣipraphalapradena bāhyāgamaprasiddhena sāhasikajanakṛtyena mahāmāṃsavikrayeṇāpi prayojanaṃ sādhanīyamiti vicintya nirdhārayati - na khalviti/
analyzed: atra mālatī prāptiḥ eva jīvita sāphalyam iti anena tad anurāga tad guṇa atiśaya prakhyāpanāt sātiśaya vacana rūpam puṣpam nāma aṅgam uktam yathā puṣpam sātiśayam vacaḥ iti idānīm jāti anucitena api kṣipra phala pradena bāhya āgama prasiddhena sāhasika jana kṛtyena mahāmāṃsa vikrayeṇa api prayojanam sādhanīyam iti vicintya nirdhārayati na khalu iti

original: mahāmāṃsaṃ puruṣamāṃsam/ iyamapi dvitīyāvasthā draṣṭavyā/ vayasyeti/ api praśne/ utkaṇṭhata utsuko bhavati// makarandaḥ/ atha kim/ bāḍhamutkaṇṭhito'hamityarthaḥ/ tadevāha - taditi/ sarasaprahāraṃ saśoṇitaśārdūlakarajakṣataṃ māmālokyāvicāritavigalatkucāvaraṇāṃśukā/ anena tātkālikī tasyāḥ kāntiruktā/
analyzed: mahāmāṃsam puruṣa māṃsam iyam api dvitīya avasthā draṣṭavyā vayasyā iti api praśne utkaṇṭhataḥ utsukaḥ bhavati makarandaḥ atha kim bāḍham utkaṇṭhitaḥ ham iti arthaḥ tat eva āha tat iti sa rasa prahāram sa śoṇita śārdūla karaja kṣatam mām ālokya avicārita vigalat kuca āvaraṇa aṃśukā anena tātkālikī tasyāḥ kāntiḥ uktā

original: maraṇasamaye tasyāḥ prāṇavipattikāle kravyādaṃ māṃsāśanaṃ vyāghraṃ pramathya nihatya rakṣitavatastādṛśavyasane prāṇatrāṇalakṣaṇamupakāraṃ kṛtavatastava pariṣvaṅgaṃ svayaṃgrahāśleṣaṃ labdhvā kathamivānyatra tvadvyatirikte ramatāmanuraktacittā bhavet/
analyzed: maraṇa samaye tasyāḥ prāṇa vipatti kāle kravyādam māṃsa aśanam vyāghram pramathya nihatya rakṣitavataḥ tādṛśa vyasane prāṇa trāṇa lakṣaṇam upakāram kṛtavataḥ tava pariṣvaṅgam svayaṃgraha āśleṣam labdhvā katham iva anyatra tvad vyatirikte ramatām anurakta cittā bhavet

original: tathā hi tadānīmeva svajīvitapradāyinastava madīyaṃ jīvitaṃ śarīraṃ ca samarpitamiti svayaṃgrahāliṅganena kathitam/ atastvadarpitajīviteyaṃ nānyatrānurajyata iti bhāvaḥ/

original: yathā mayā niścitaṃ tathā ca tadanurūpa eva tasyā nayanayorvyāpāro vyaktasnehaḥ prakaṭīkṛtapremātiśayastathā stimitatayā viṣayāntarāsaṃsparśena tatraiva nimagnatayā ramaṇīyo manoharastvayi viṣaye ciramabhūt/ sasnehāvalokanādeva niścīyate tasyāstvayyevāsaktirityarthaḥ/ idaṃ copapattyā nirṇayarūpamupanyāso nāmāṅgam/

original: varadeti/ varadā sindhuśceti nadyau/ tayoḥ saṃbhedaḥ saṃgamaḥ// makarandaḥ/ vyatikaro'pi sa eva/ ya eṣa iti/ yo'yaṃ nadyoḥ saṃbhedaḥ/ jaleti/ puṇyatīrthatvādavagāhanārthamāgatābhirvadhūbhiḥ sakalapaurāṅganābhiḥ parigatataṭabhūmirvyāptatīrapradeśaḥ/ dṛśyata iti śeṣaḥ/ vadhūrviśinaṣṭi - snātamātrotthitābhiḥ snānasamanantarameva nirgatābhiḥ/
analyzed: varadā iti varadā sindhuḥ ca iti nadyau tayoḥ saṃbhedaḥ saṃgamaḥ makarandaḥ vyatikaraḥ api saḥ eva yaḥ eṣaḥ iti yaḥ yam nadyoḥ saṃbhedaḥ jala iti puṇya tīrtha tvāt avagāhana artham āgatābhiḥ vadhūbhiḥ sakala paura aṅganābhiḥ parigata taṭa bhūmiḥ vyāpta tīra pradeśaḥ dṛśyate iti śeṣaḥ vadhūḥ viśinaṣṭi snāta mātra utthitābhiḥ snāna samanantaram eva nirgatābhiḥ

original: ata eva jalena nibiḍitamatyantasaṃśliṣṭaṃ yadvastraṃ tena vyaktāḥ samyagvibhāvyamānā nimnonnatapradeśā nābhimadhyakucamaṇḍalanitambajaghanādyavayasaṃniveśā yāsāṃ tāḥ/

original: tathā ramaṇīyakāñcanakalaśakāntimanta ābhogena paripūrṇatayā tuṅgāśca ye stanāstatra vinihitāni nyastāni hastasvastikāni vyatyastasaṃkucitasvastikākārahastayugalāni yāsāṃ tābhiriti tatkṣaṇasnātotthitavadhūsvabhāvoktiḥ/ atha ca snānārthamāgatābhirvadhūbhirityanena nānājātinagarāṅganāpratītervarṇasaṃhāro nāma pratimukhasaṃdheraṅgamiti draṣṭavyam/

original: atha pūrvāṅkasūcitamahāmāṃsavikrayopayogivṛttāntaṃ sūcayitumekapātraprayojyaṃ śuddhaviṣkambhamārabhate - tata iti/ ekenāpi madhyapātreṇa śuddhaviṣkambho bhavatyeva/ yathāha - ``śuddho'nekena vaikena madhyapātreṇa yojitaḥ'' iti/ ākāśayāneneti yoginītvena khecaragamanādisiddhisaṃpatteḥ/ bhīṣaṇo bhayaṃkara ujjvalo dīptaśca veṣo yasyāḥ sā/
analyzed: atha pūrva aṅka sūcita mahāmāṃsa vikraya upayogi vṛttāntam sūcayitum eka pātra prayojyam śuddha viṣkambham ārabhate tatas iti ekena api madhya pātreṇa śuddha viṣkambhaḥ bhavati eva yathā āha śuddhaḥ ūnekena vā ekena madhya pātreṇa yojitaḥ iti ākāśa yānena iti yoginī tvena khecara gamana ādi siddhi saṃpatteḥ bhīṣaṇaḥ bhayaṃkaraḥ ujjvalaḥ dīptaḥ ca veṣaḥ yasyāḥ sā

original: kapālakuṇḍaletyanvarthaṃ nāma// ṣaḍadhiketi/ śaktīnāṃ jñānecchākriyopalakṣitasvabhāvaparispandarūpāṇāṃ nāthaḥ prayoktā/ ata eva tābhiḥ pariṇaddho vyāptaḥ/ vicitraviśvaparispandasvatantranirmāteti yāvat/ yadvā śaktīnāṃ brāhmyādīnāṃ nāthaḥ/
analyzed: kapāla kuṇḍala iti anvartham nāma ṣaṣ adhikā iti śaktīnām jñāna icchā kriyā upalakṣita svabhāva parispanda rūpāṇām nāthaḥ prayoktā atas eva tābhiḥ pariṇaddhaḥ vyāptaḥ vicitra viśva parispanda svatantra nirmātā iti yāvat yat vā śaktīnām brāhmī ādīnām nāthaḥ

original: ata eva tābhiḥ pariṇaddhaḥ svaprāṇeśvarabuddhyā praṇayādveṣṭitaḥ kāpālikadarśanapratipādyabhūtanātho jayati sarvotkarṣeṇa prakāśate/ tādṛśasyaiva namaskāryatvāt/ kīdṛśo'sāvityata āha - ṣaḍadhiketi/ ṣaḍadhikā daśa ṣoḍaśa yā nāḍyastāsāṃ yaccakraṃ maṇḍalaṃ piṇḍarūpaṃ tasya madhyaṃ hṛdayaṃ tatra sthita ātmā svarūpaṃ yasya saḥ/
analyzed: atas eva tābhiḥ pariṇaddhaḥ sva prāṇeśvara buddhyā praṇayāt veṣṭitaḥ kāpālika darśana pratipādya bhūtanāthaḥ jayati sarva utkarṣeṇa prakāśate tādṛśasya eva namaskārya tvāt kīdṛśaḥ usau iti atas āha ṣaṣ adhika iti ṣaṣ adhikāḥ daśa ṣoḍaśa yāḥ nāḍyaḥ tāsām yat cakram maṇḍalam piṇḍa rūpam tasya madhyam hṛdayam tatra sthitaḥ ātmā svarūpam yasya saḥ

original: nāḍīnāmanantatve'pi pradhānanāḍīnāmiḍādīnāṃ ṣoḍaśasaṃkhyātvātṣaḍadhikadaśetyuktam/ iḍādayo nāḍyaśca/ ``iḍā ca piṅgalā caiva suṣumnā ca parā smṛtā/ gāndhārī hastijihvā ca pūṣā vasuvaśā tathā// alambuṣā kuhūścaiva śaṅkhinī daśamī smṛtā/ tālujihvā ca jihvā ca vijayā kāmadā parā// amṛtā bahulā nāma nāḍyo vāyusamīritāḥ//'' iti/
analyzed: nāḍīnām ananta tve pi pradhāna nāḍīnām iḍā ādīnām ṣoḍaśa saṃkhyā tvāt ṣaṣ adhika daśa iti uktam iḍā ādayaḥ nāḍyaḥ ca iḍā ca piṅgalā ca eva suṣumnā ca parā smṛtā gāndhārī hastijihvā ca pūṣā vasuvaśā tathā alambuṣā kuhūḥ ca eva śaṅkhinī daśamī smṛtā tālujihvā ca jihvā ca vijayā kāmadā parā amṛtāḥ bahulāḥ nāma nāḍyaḥ vāyu samīritāḥ iti

original: aparimitasūkṣmanāḍīsahitapradhānaṣoḍaśanāḍīsamūha eva rudhiravasāmāṃsādidhātuparipūritaṃ tvagācchannaṃ piṇḍaśabdavācyaṃ śarīramiti yogamārgaḥ/ yadvā/ ṣaḍbhyaścakrebhyo'dhikasya/ saptamasyetyarthaḥ/ daśanāḍīcakraṃ daśanāḍyātmakaṃ cakraṃ nābhikamalarūpam/ yadvā/
analyzed: aparimita sūkṣma nāḍī sahita pradhāna ṣoḍaśa nāḍī samūhaḥ eva rudhira vasā māṃsa ādi dhātu paripūritam tvac ācchannam piṇḍa śabda vācyam śarīram iti yoga mārgaḥ yat vā ṣaḍbhyaḥ cakrebhyaḥ adhikasya saptamasya iti arthaḥ daśa nāḍī cakram daśa nāḍī ātmakam cakram nābhi kamala rūpam yat vā

original: ṣaḍadhikadaśanāḍīnāṃ ṣoḍaśanāḍīnāṃ cakraṃ ṣoḍaśanāḍyātmakaṃ cakraṃ kaṇṭhavilavartyanāhatākhyam/ tatra sthita upāsanāviśeṣārthaṃ saṃnidhāpita ātmā svarūpaṃ yasyetyarthaḥ/ tadyathā cakrāṇi yogaśāstre - ``caturdalaṃ syādādhāre svādhiṣṭhāne ca ṣaḍdalam/ nābhau daśadalopetaṃ sūryasaṃkhyadalaṃ hṛdi// kaṇṭhe syātṣoḍaśadalaṃ bhrūmadhye'śītisaṃmitam/
analyzed: ṣaṣ adhika daśa nāḍīnām ṣoḍaśa nāḍīnām cakram ṣoḍaśa nāḍī ātmakam cakram tatra sthitaḥ upāsanā viśeṣa artham saṃnidhāpitaḥ ātmā svarūpam yasya iti arthaḥ tat yathā cakrāṇi yoga śāstre catur dalam syāt ādhāre svādhiṣṭhāne ca ṣaṣ dalam nābhau daśa dala upetam sūrya saṃkhya dalam hṛdi kaṇṭhe syāt ṣoḍaśa dalam bhrū madhya aśīti saṃmitam

original: sahasradalamākhyātaṃ brahmarandhre tu paṅkajam// etāni sapta padmāni cakrasthāni pracakṣate//'' iti/ nāḍīcakrātmakakamalānāṃ nāḍya eva dalāni/ anena cāṇuraṅguṣṭhaparimāṇo vā jīva iti tanmatam/ tadvidāṃ tādṛgātmasvarūpadarśināṃ yogināṃ hṛdi vinihitaṃ rūpaṃ yasya saḥ/ tathāvidhaḥ sansiddhido bhuktimuktipradaḥ/
analyzed: sahasra dalam ākhyātam brahmarandhre tu paṅkajam etāni sapta padmāni cakra sthāni pracakṣate iti nāḍī cakra ātmaka kamalānām nāḍyaḥ eva dalāni anena ca aṇuḥ aṅguṣṭha parimāṇaḥ vā jīvaḥ iti tat matam tad vidām tādṛś ātma svarūpa darśinām yoginām hṛdi vinihitam rūpam yasya saḥ tathāvidhaḥ san siddhi daḥ bhukti mukti pradaḥ

original: avicalitamanobhirviṣayāntaraparityāgena svaikatānamanaskaiḥ sādhakaiḥ svopāsakairyogibhirmṛgyamāṇo'nviṣyamāṇa iti/ atra nāḍīcakrādipadānāṃ kevalayogaśāstraprasiddhatvādapratītatvamapi svātmavimarśane na duṣṭatvaṃ kiṃtu guṇatvamevetyāhuḥ//1//
analyzed: avicalita manobhiḥ viṣaya antara parityāgena sva ekatāna manaskaiḥ sādhakaiḥ sva upāsakaiḥ yogibhiḥ mṛgyamāṇaḥ anviṣyamāṇaḥ iti atra nāḍī cakra ādi padānām kevala yoga śāstra prasiddha tvāt apratīta tvam api svātma vimarśane na duṣṭatvam kiṃtu guṇatvam eva iti āhuḥ

original: iyamityādi/ nityamiti/ nityaṃ pratidinaṃ japopakramasamaye'nuṣṭheyamantrāṅgatvena yannyastaṃ tattatsthāneṣu ``hṛdayāya namaḥ, śirase svāhā'' ityādi ṣaḍaṅganyāsaprakāreṇa vinyastaṃ/ ṣaḍaṅgānāṃ hṛdayaśiraḥśikhākavacanetrāstrāṇāṃ cakraṃ saṅghastatra nihitastanmadhyagatatvena dhyātaḥ/
analyzed: iyam ityādi nityam iti nityam pratidinam japa upakrama samaye nuṣṭheya mantra aṅga tvena yat nyastam tad tad sthāneṣu hṛdayāya namaḥ śirase svāhā ityādi ṣaḍaṅga nyāsa prakāreṇa vinyastam ṣaḍaṅgānām hṛdaya śiraḥ śikhā kavaca netra astrāṇām cakram saṅghaḥ tatra nihitaḥ tad madhya gata tvena dhyātaḥ

original: ``māṃ ko'pi mantrādhidevatātmakatvenātmānaṃ dhyātvā mantramanutiṣṭheta'' ityāgamaḥ/ ata eva hṛtpadmasyahṛdayakamalasya madhya uditaṃ prakāśamānaṃ śivarūpiṇamātmānaṃ paśyantī/ iyamahaṃ layavaśādūrdhvamākṛṣṭasya vāyosteṣu teṣu nāḍīniveśeṣu vṛttinirodho gaganagamanahetubhūto yogaśāstraprasiddho layaḥ/
analyzed: mām kaḥ api mantra adhidevatā ātmaka tvena ātmānam dhyātvā mantram anutiṣṭheta iti āgamaḥ atas eva hṛd padmasya hṛdaya kamalasya madhye uditam prakāśamānam śiva rūpiṇam ātmānam paśyantī iyam aham laya vaśāt ūrdhvam ākṛṣṭasya vāyoḥ teṣu teṣu nāḍī niveśeṣu vṛtti nirodhaḥ gagana gamana hetu bhūtaḥ yoga śāstra prasiddhaḥ layaḥ

original: tadvaśāddhetornāḍīnāṃ pārthivāpyāgneyavāyavyanābhasākhyānāṃ pañcabhūtaprakṛtikānāṃ nāḍīviśeṣāṇāmudayasāmyāvasthātirodhānakrameṇa tattadbhūtāṃśākarṣaṇasādhanena jagatojaṅgamasya jantuvargasya yānyārambhakāṇi pañcāmṛtāni na mriyante nātyantaṃ vinaśyanti kāryakāraṇarūpeṇa sarvadāvasthānādityamṛtāni pañcamahābhūtāni teṣāmākarṣaṇāt/
analyzed: tad vaśāt hetoḥ nāḍīnām pārthiva api āgneya vāyavya nābhasa ākhyānām pañcabhūta prakṛtikānām nāḍī viśeṣāṇām udaya sāmya avasthā tirodhāna krameṇa tad tad bhūta aṃśa ākarṣaṇa sādhanena jagataḥ jaṅgamasya jantu vargasya yāni ārambhakāṇi pañcāmṛtāni na mriyante na atyantam vinaśyanti kārya kāraṇa rūpeṇa sarvadā avasthānāt iti amṛtāni pañca mahābhūtāni teṣām ākarṣaṇāt

original: yadvā - ``viṭ ca mūtramasṛṅmajjā śukraṃ pañcāmṛtaṃ smṛtam'' iti/ teṣāmākarṣaṇādaprāptotpatanaśramānutpannākāśodgamanaprayāsā/ satyata evāgrenabho nabhaso'gre'mbhomuco meghānvighaṭayantyapasārayantīdānīmabhyāgatā/ uddeśyaṃ karālāyatanaṃ prāptetyarthaḥ//2//

original: tadeva ramaṇīyaḍāmaratvaṃ prakaṭayati - viṣvagiti/ viṣvaksarvato vṛttiravasthānaṃ yasya sa tādṛśo jaṭānāṃ bhāro dṛḍhataragranthibandho'pi vegavaśātpracalati/ tathā khaṭvāṅge naddhā ghaṇṭā saṃskāreṇa śabdajanakābhighātādijanyenābhihanyamānagatenātiśayena kāryaikaparikalpena janito yaḥ kvāṇo raṇaraṇadhvanistena dīrghaṃ yathā tathā/ paṭu/

original: kṛtā āvṛttiḥ punaḥpunarabhyāso yathā syāttatheti kriyāviśeṣaṇatrayam/ raṭati dhvanati/ tathā vivṛtāni yāni śavaśirāṃsi teṣāṃ yā śreṇī tasyāḥkuñjeṣu sarandhrakuhareṣu guñjañśabdāyamāna uttāla udbhaṭaḥ kiṃkiṇīnāmanavarataraṇatkārasyāvicchinnanikvāṇasya heturvāyurvegotpanno'nilaḥ patākāṃ khaṭvāṅgāvabaddhāmūrdhvaṃ yathā syādevaṃ dhūnoti kampayati//4//
analyzed: kṛtā āvṛttiḥ punar punar abhyāsaḥ yathā syāt tathā iti kriyā viśeṣaṇa trayam raṭati dhvanati tathā vivṛtāni yāni śava śirāṃsi teṣām yā śreṇī tasyāḥ kuñjeṣu sarandhra kuhareṣu guñjan śabdāyamānaḥ uttālaḥ udbhaṭaḥ kiṃkiṇīnām anavarata raṇatkārasya avicchinna nikvāṇasya hetuḥ vāyuḥ vega utpannaḥ nilaḥ patākām khaṭvāṅga avabaddhām ūrdhvam yathā syāt evam dhūnoti kampayati

original: parikramyetyādi/ idaṃ ca tatkarālāyatanam/ kīdṛśam/ śmaśānavāṭasya pitṛvanapradeśasya nedīyo'tisaṃnihitam/ śmaśānavāṭaṃ viśinaṣṭi - purāṇena nimbatailenāktasya paribhṛjyamānasya rasonakasya laśunasya/ ``laśunaṃ gṛñjā[ja]nāriṣṭamahākandarasonakāḥ'' ityamaraḥ/

original: yo raso niryāsastasya gandha iva gandho yeṣāṃ taiścitādhūmairgaganaṃkaṣairadhastādbhūtale vibhāvitasyānumitasya mahato vistīrṇasyeti/ yatra karālāyatane paryavasitamantrasādhanasya parisamāpitapuraścaraṇasya saviśeṣaṃ pūrvāpekṣayā viśeṣasahakṛtaṃ yathā syāttathā pūjāsaṃbhāraḥ pūjopakaraṇakalāpaḥ saṃnidhāpanīya upasthāpanīyaḥ/
analyzed: yaḥ rasaḥ niryāsaḥ tasya gandhaḥ iva gandhaḥ yeṣām taiḥ citā dhūmaiḥ gaganaṃkaṣaiḥ adhastāt bhū tale vibhāvitasya anumitasya mahataḥ vistīrṇasya iti yatra karāla āyatane paryavasita mantra sādhanasya parisamāpita puraścaraṇasya sa viśeṣam pūrva apekṣayā viśeṣa sahakṛtam yathā syāt tathā pūjā saṃbhāraḥ pūjā upakaraṇa kalāpaḥ saṃnidhāpanīyaḥ upasthāpanīyaḥ

original: viśeṣaḥ ko vetyapekṣāyāmāha - kathitamiti/ prāgupayācitaṃ pūrvaṃ prārthitaṃ siddhe'sminmantre bhagavatyai strīratnamupahārīkariṣyāmīti saṃkalpitam/ upahartavyamānetavyam/ tatstrīratnaṃ cātraiva saṃnihite nagare viditaṃ sarvajanaprasiddhamāsta iti// sakautukamiti/
analyzed: viśeṣaḥ kaḥ vā iti apekṣāyām āha kathitam iti prāk upayācitam pūrvam prārthitam siddhe asmin mantre bhagavatyai strī ratnam upahārīkariṣyāmi iti saṃkalpitam upahartavyam ānetavyam tat strī ratnam ca atra eva saṃnihite nagare viditam sarva jana prasiddham āste iti sa kautukam iti

original: etādṛśasukumāramadhurākārasya kathaṃ niśāyāmatra nirnimittaṃ saṃcaraṇamiti sakautukam/ atigambhīramadhurākṛtirgāmbhīryamādhuryaguṇaśālinyākṛtiryasya saḥ/ ``bhīśokakrodhaharṣeṣu gāmbhīryaṃ nirvikāratā/ sarvāvasthāsu mādhuryaṃ priyāṇāṃ mṛdukāritā//'' uttambhito jūṭīkṛtya baddhaḥkuṭilaḥ karālaḥ kuntalabhāraḥ keśakalāpo yasya saḥ/
analyzed: etādṛśa sukumāra madhura ākārasya katham niśāyām atra nirnimittam saṃcaraṇam iti sa kautukam ati gambhīra madhura ākṛtiḥ gāmbhīrya mādhurya guṇa śālinī ākṛtiḥ yasya saḥ bhī śoka krodha harṣeṣu gāmbhīryam nirvikāra tā sarva avasthāsu mādhuryam priyāṇām mṛdu kāri tā uttambhitaḥ jūṭīkṛtya baddhaḥ kuṭilaḥ karālaḥ kuntala bhāraḥ keśa kalāpaḥ yasya saḥ

original: kṛpāṇapāṇiḥ khaḍgahastaḥ śmaśānamavatarati/ tatko'pyayaṃ mṛduprakṛtirapi kutaściddhetoraciraparigṛhītasāhasavyāpāraḥ/ tadeṣa vicāraṇīya ityāśayaḥ/ tameva nirvarṇayati - ya eṣaḥ/ kuvalayeti/
analyzed: kṛpāṇa pāṇiḥ khaḍga hastaḥ śmaśānam avatarati tat kaḥ pi ayam mṛdu prakṛtiḥ api kutaścid hetoḥ acira parigṛhīta sāhasa vyāpāraḥ tat eṣa vicāraṇīyaḥ iti āśayaḥ tam eva nirvarṇayati yaḥ eṣaḥ kuvalaya iti

original: svabhāvata indīvaradalanīlo'pi virahādinimittasaṃskārarāhityātparidhūsaraṃ vivarṇamaṅgaṃ dadhadbibhrāṇaḥ tathā mahānāyakatayā vinayagāmbhīryadhairyaśālitvenātrāpi śmaśānapradeśe lalito gāmbhīryamanoharo niḥśaṅkaścaraṇavinyāso yasya saḥ/
analyzed: svabhāvataḥ indīvara dala nīla upi viraha ādi nimitta saṃskāra rāhityāt paridhūsaram vivarṇam aṅgam dadhat bibhrāṇaḥ tathā mahānāyaka tayā vinaya gāmbhīrya dhairya śāli tvena atra api śmaśāna pradeśe lalitaḥ gāmbhīrya manoharaḥ niḥśaṅkaḥ caraṇa vinyāsaḥ yasya saḥ

original: śrīmānmahābhāgyadyotakakāntiviśeṣayukto mṛgāṅkanibhānanaḥ pūrṇacandramaṇḍalasaṃnibhavadano ya eṣa paridṛśyate'to nedamasya samucitaṃ karma/ kiṃtu ``na sāhasamanāruhya naro bhadrāṇi paśyati'' iti nyāyena jīvitavyayenāpi sādhanīyaṃ kiṃcidabhilaṣitaṃ sādhayitumevaṃ sāhasamavalambitamiti bhāvaḥ/
analyzed: śrīmān mahābhāgya dyotaka kānti viśeṣa yuktaḥ mṛgāṅka nibha ānanaḥ pūrṇa candra maṇḍala saṃnibha vadanaḥ yaḥ eṣa paridṛśyate itas na idam asya samucitam karma kiṃtu na sāhasam an āruhya naraḥ bhadrāṇi paśyati iti nyāyena jīvita vyayena api sādhanīyam kiṃcid abhilaṣitam sādhayitum evam sāhasam avalambitam iti bhāvaḥ

original: yasyāsyaprakṣaradrudhirakardamo lalannarajāṅgalo vilasannaramāṃsakhaṇḍaḥ prakaṭīkṛtasāhaso vāmaḥ pāṇireva kevalaṃ vinayaṃ haratyavinayaṃ dyotayati/ samāṃsakhaṇḍavāmakaradarśanādevāsya sāhasaṃ pratīyate/ tadatiriktāvayavadarśane tu praśānto vinītākāra eva pratīyate/ na sāhasamityarthaḥ//5//
analyzed: yasya āsya prakṣarat rudhira kardamaḥ lalat nara jāṅgalaḥ vilasat nara māṃsa khaṇḍaḥ prakaṭīkṛta sāhasaḥ vāmaḥ pāṇiḥ eva kevalam vinayam harati avinayam dyotayati sa māṃsa khaṇḍa vāma kara darśanāt eva asya sāhasam pratīyate tad atirikta avayava darśane tu praśāntaḥ vinīta ākāraḥ eva pratīyate na sāhasam iti arthaḥ

original: nirūpya niścitya/ sa eṣa iti/ yaḥ kāmandakīsuhṛdo devarātasya kuṇḍineśvarasacivasya putro bāla evāsmābhirdṛṣṭaḥ sa evāsau kāryavaśādihāgataḥ kiṃcidatiduḥsādhakaṃ kāryaṃ sādhayitumavalambitasāhaso mahāmāṃsasya vikretā bhūtveha saṃcarati/ yujyate cāsyaitanmanuṣyaduṣkaraṃ karma/ yadasaumahāyoginyāḥ kāmandakyāḥ suhṛtputra  iti bhāvaḥ/
analyzed: nirūpya niścitya saḥ eṣaḥ iti yaḥ kāmandakī suhṛdaḥ devarātasya kuṇḍina īśvara sacivasya putraḥ bālaḥ eva asmābhiḥ dṛṣṭaḥ saḥ eva asau kārya vaśāt iha āgataḥ kiṃcid ati duḥsādhakam kāryam sādhayitum avalambita sāhasaḥ mahāmāṃsasya vikretā bhūtvā iha saṃcarati yujyate ca asya etat manuṣya duṣkaram karma yat asau mahā yoginyāḥ kāmandakyāḥ suhṛd putraḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: paṇayitā vyavahartā/ vikreteti yāvat/ ``paṇa vyavahāre stutau ca'' iti dhātostṛci rūpaṃ paṇayiteti/ tatkimanena/ ayamapi svakṛtyaṃ nirvartayatu/ ahamapi madiṣṭaṃ saṃpādayāmītyarthaḥ/ gurvājñānuṣṭhānasya kālo'pyanuguṇo'yaṃ prāpta ityāha - vigalitaprāya iti/ nirvṛttakalpa ityarthaḥ/ vyomna iti/
analyzed: paṇayitā vyavahartā vikretā iti yāvat vyavahāre stutau ca iti dhātoḥ tṛci rūpam paṇayitā iti tat kim anena ayam api sva kṛtyam nirvartayatu aham api mad iṣṭam saṃpādayāmi iti arthaḥ guru ājñā anuṣṭhānasya kālaḥ api anuguṇaḥ yam prāptaḥ iti āha vigalita prāyaḥ iti nirvṛtta kalpaḥ iti arthaḥ vyomnaḥ iti

original: vyomnaḥ paryantā avanītalaprānteṣvavanatāstiraskariṇīvatpratibhāsamānā viyattaṭāḥ/ tamovallarībhirandhakāralatābhistāpicchagucchāvalibhiriva tamālastabakapaṅktibhiriva vriyanta ācchādyante/ tathā pṛthivīprāntavṛttyā paritaḥ paryantadeśanimajjanakrameṇa nūtane pratyagratayā kaluṣe payasi majjatīva/ andhakārāvṛtā payorāśinimagnevetyutprekṣate/
analyzed: vyomnaḥ paryantāḥ avanī tala prānteṣu avanatāḥ tiraskariṇī vat pratibhāsamānāḥ viyat taṭāḥ tamaḥ vallarībhiḥ andhakāra latābhiḥ tāpiccha guccha āvalibhiḥ iva tamāla stabaka paṅktibhiḥ iva vriyante ācchādyante tathā pṛthivī prānta vṛttyā paritas paryanta deśa nimajjana krameṇa nūtane pratyagra tayā kaluṣe payasi majjati iva andhakāra āvṛtā payorāśi nimagnā iva iti utprekṣate

original: tathā triyāmā rātriḥ prārambhe svapraveśasamaye'pi vātyānāṃ maṇḍalākāravātānāṃ samyagvegena viṣvaksarvato vitatā vistāritā tato valayitā saṃjātavalayākārā sphītā pracurā yā dhūmyā dhūmamaṇḍalī tasyāḥ prakāśo yatra taṃ nijaṃ svakīyaṃ nīlimānaṃ taruṇayati/ pramukha eva saṃtamasanailyaṃ yauvanadaśāṃ prāpayatītyarthaḥ//6//
analyzed: tathā triyāmā rātriḥ prārambhe sva praveśa samaye api vātyānām maṇḍala ākāra vātānām samyak vegena viṣvak sarvatas vitatā vistāritā tatas valayitā saṃjāta valaya ākārā sphītā pracurā yā dhūmyā dhūma maṇḍalī tasyāḥ prakāśaḥ yatra tam nijam svakīyam nīlimānam taruṇayati pramukhe eva saṃtamasa nailyam yauvana daśām prāpayati iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃ mahāmāṃsavikrayārthaṃ mādhavapraveśaṃ, karālāyatane pūjārthamaghoraghaṇṭasya saṃnidhānam, tatra mālatyānayanaṃ ca sūcayitvā kapālakuṇḍalā niṣkrāntā// iti śuddhaviṣkambhaḥ// tata ityādi/ yathānirdiṣṭaḥ kapālakuṇḍalayā nirūpitarūpaḥ// mādhavaḥ - sāśaṃsamiti/
analyzed: evam mahāmāṃsa vikraya artham mādhava praveśam karālāyatane pūjā artham aghoraghaṇṭasya saṃnidhānam tatra mālatī ānayanam ca sūcayitvā kapāla kuṇḍalā niṣkrāntā iti śuddha viṣkambhaḥ tatas ityādi yathā nirdiṣṭaḥ kapāla kuṇḍalayā nirūpita rūpaḥ mādhavaḥ sa āśaṃsam iti

original: yaduddeśena mahāmāṃsavikrayākhyaṃ karma cikīrṣitaṃ tatprayojanāśaṃsāpūrvakamāhetyarthaḥ/ premeti/ śṛṅgārasya sthāyībhāvasya ratirūpasya prakarṣalakṣaṇāvasthāviśeṣaḥ premetyucyate/ premamānapraṇayasnehānurāgā raterevāvasthābhedāḥ/ yaduktam - ``iyamaṅkuritā premṇā mānātpallavitā bhavet/ sakorakā praṇayataḥ snehātkusumitā bhavet//
analyzed: yad uddeśena mahāmāṃsa vikraya ākhyam karma cikīrṣitam tad prayojana āśaṃsā pūrvakam āha iti arthaḥ prema iti śṛṅgārasya sthāyībhāvasya rati rūpasya prakarṣa lakṣaṇa avasthā viśeṣaḥ prema iti ucyate prema māna praṇaya sneha anurāgāḥ rateḥ eva avasthā bhedāḥ yat uktam iyam aṅkuritā premṇā mānāt pallavitā bhavet sakorakā praṇayataḥ snehāt kusumitā bhavet

original: rāgātphalavatī seyamanurāgeṇa bhujyate//'' iti ``parasparāśrayaghanaṃ nirūḍhaṃ bhāvabandhanam/ yadekāyattatopādhi tatpremeti nigadyate//'' iti/ tenārdrāḥ sarasāḥ ānukūlyaśālinya iti yāvat/ uktaṃ ca - ``yadyadasyāḥ priyo vakti tasya tasyāśukāritām/ yogyatāmārdratāmāhurmanaḥkāluṣyanāśinīm//'' iti/
analyzed: rāgāt phalavatī sā iyam anurāgeṇa bhujyate iti paraspara āśraya ghanam nirūḍham bhāva bandhanam yat eka āyatta tā upādhi tat prema iti nigadyate iti tena ārdrāḥ sarasāḥ ānukūlya śālinyaḥ iti yāvat uktam ca yat yat asyāḥ priyaḥ vakti tasya tasya āśukāri tām yogya tām ārdra tām āhuḥ manaḥ kāluṣya nāśinīm iti

original: tathā praṇayaṃ spṛśanti tenānurajyanta iti praṇayaspṛśaḥ/ praṇayo yathā - ``upacārairmitho yūnoryadbāhyābhyantarābhidhaiḥ/ prema nītaṃ prakarṣaṃ cetsa eva praṇayaḥ smṛtaḥ//'' iti/ tathā paricayāttasyaiva praṇayasya punaḥpunaravalokanasaṃbhāṣaṇasparśādibhiḥ paripoṣāt/ ``videśasthe mṛte vāpi durbale pratiyogini/
analyzed: tathā praṇayam spṛśanti tena anurajyante iti praṇaya spṛśaḥ praṇayaḥ yathā upacāraiḥ mithas yūnoḥ yat bāhya abhyantara abhidhaiḥ prema nītam prakarṣam ced saḥ eva praṇayaḥ smṛtaḥ iti tathā paricayāt tasya eva praṇayasya punar punar avalokana saṃbhāṣaṇa sparśa ādibhiḥ paripoṣāt videśa sthe mṛte vā api durbale pratiyogini

original: nanu kathametāvāneva viśeṣo darśanasyaivedānīmabhāvāditi śaṅkāṃ svasaṃvedanasiddhatanmayībhāvopanyāsena śamayati - mama hi saṃpratīti/ sātiśayo dṛḍhatarasaṃskārādhānasāmarthyalakṣaṇātiśayasahito yaḥ prāktana upalambhaḥ pūrvānubhavaḥ/ āpātadarśanaṃ hi kadācinna saṃskāramādadhyāt/ āhito vā saṃskāro dārḍhyābhāvānna smṛtiṃ janayet/
analyzed: nanu katham etāvān eva viśeṣaḥ darśanasya eva idānīm abhāvāt iti śaṅkām sva saṃvedana siddha tanmayībhāva upanyāsena śamayati mama hi saṃprati iti sa atiśayaḥ dṛḍhatara saṃskāra ādhāna sāmarthya lakṣaṇa atiśaya sahitaḥ yaḥ prāktanaḥ upalambhaḥ pūrva anubhavaḥ āpāta darśanam hi kadācid na saṃskāram ādadhyāt āhitaḥ vā saṃskāraḥ dārḍhya abhāvāt na smṛtim janayet

original: bubhutsāpūrvakaṃ tu saṃpāditaḥ sādhīyānanubhavaḥ saṃskārotpādanāvyabhicārī tadutpāditaśca saṃskāro dṛḍhatvādavaśyaṃ smṛtiṃ janayatīti sātiśayetyuktam/
analyzed: bubhutsā pūrvakam tu saṃpāditaḥ sādhīyān anubhavaḥ saṃskāra utpādana avyabhicārī tad utpāditaḥ ca saṃskāraḥ dṛḍha tvāt avaśyam smṛtim janayati iti sa atiśayā iti uktam

original: tena saṃbhāvitaḥ saṃjanita ātmā svarūpaṃ yasya tādṛśasya saṃskārasya bhāvanākhyasyānavarataprabodhādudbodhahetościntāyā nirantarānuvṛttinimittako yo'navarataprabodha udbodhaḥ svakāryajananaunmukhyaṃ tasmātpratāyamāno dhārāvāhikarītyā vistāramadhirohan/ atra tādṛśa eva saṃskāraḥ pūrvānubhavena sātiśayotpāditaḥ/
analyzed: tena saṃbhāvitaḥ saṃjanitaḥ ātmā sva rūpam yasya tādṛśasya saṃskārasya bhāvanā ākhyasya anavarata prabodhāt udbodha hetoḥ cintāyāḥ nirantara anuvṛtti nimittakaḥ udbodhaḥ sva kārya janana aunmukhyam tasmāt pratāyamānaḥ dhārāvāhika rītyā vistāram adhirohan atra tādṛśaḥ eva saṃskāraḥ pūrva anubhavena sa atiśaya utpāditaḥ

original: yo naikāṃ smṛtiṃ janayitvā svayaṃ naśyati kiṃ tu ghaṭādyanuraṇanaśabdanimittavatpravāharūpeṇa kāryamutpādayati/ yathā līlāvatīkārapakṣe sātiśayaḥ prāthamikakarmajanyaḥ prāthamika eva śarādigato vegaḥ samanantarabhāvinīmāpatanātkarmasaṃtatiṃ janayati tadvaditi vā/ saṃskārasyeti jātyabhiprāyamekavacanam/
analyzed: yaḥ na ekām smṛtim janayitvā svayam naśyati kim tu ghaṭa ādi anuraṇana śabda nimitta vat pravāha rūpeṇa kāryam utpādayati yathā līlāvatīkāra pakṣe sa atiśayaḥ prāthamika karma janyaḥ prāthamikaḥ eva śara ādi gataḥ vegaḥ samanantara bhāvinīm āpatanāt karma saṃtatim janayati tadvat iti vā saṃskārasya iti jāti abhiprāyam ekavacanam

original: tena dhārāvāhikasmṛtijananasamarthaḥ karmabhāvī saṃskārarāśirutpannaḥ kramikakāryadarśanādeva krameṇaivodbodho'dṛṣṭavaśātparikalpanīya iti vyākhyeyam/ punaḥ kiṃbhūtaḥ/ tadvisadṛśairmālatīsmṛtijātīyairviṣayāntarāvagāhibhiḥ pratyayāntarairjñānaiḥ/ vibhinnaviṣayāvagāhitvameva jñānānāmanyonyaṃ vaisādṛśyam/ atiraskṛto'nantaritaḥ pravāho yasya/
analyzed: tena dhārāvāhika smṛti janana samarthaḥ karma bhāvī saṃskāra rāśiḥ utpannaḥ kramika kārya darśanāt eva krameṇa eva udbodhaḥ udṛṣṭa vaśāt parikalpanīyaḥ iti vyākhyeyam punar kiṃbhūtaḥ tad visadṛśaiḥ mālatī smṛti jātīyaiḥ viṣaya antara avagāhibhiḥ pratyaya antaraiḥ jñānaiḥ vibhinna viṣaya avagāhi tvam eva jñānānām anyonyam vaisādṛśyam atiraskṛtaḥ unantaritaḥ pravāhaḥ yasya

original: vijātīyapratyayāsaṃvalita ityarthaḥ/ priyatamāviṣayāḥ smṛtaya eva pratyayāsteṣāmutpattisaṃtānaḥ saṃtanyamānatvenotpadyamānāḥ smṛtipratyayā iti yāvat/ mama caitanyaṃ cidrūpamātmānaṃ tanmayaṃ mālatīmayamiva tattādātmyāpannamiva karoti/ kutaḥ/ vṛttisārūpyataḥ/
analyzed: vijātīya pratyaya asaṃvalitaḥ iti arthaḥ priyatamā viṣayāḥ smṛtayaḥ eva pratyayāḥ teṣām utpatti saṃtānaḥ saṃtanyamāna tvena utpadyamānāḥ smṛti pratyayāḥ iti yāvat mama caitanyam cit rūpam ātmānam tad mayam mālatī mayam iva tad tādātmya āpannam iva karoti kutas vṛtti sārūpyataḥ

original: vṛttermālatīgocarāyāḥ smṛtirūpāyā antaḥkaraṇavṛtteḥ sārūpyaṃ mālatyākārakāritatvaṃ tasmādayamarthaḥ/ vedāntinaḥ khalvevamāhuḥ - indriyārthasaṃnikarṣe satyantaḥkaraṇaṃ pariṇāmisvabhāvaṃ vṛttyākāreṇa pariṇamate/ antaḥkaraṇāvacchinnaṃ ca pramātṛcaitanyaṃ vṛttāvapi pratiphalati/ tadeva vṛttipratiphalitaṃ caitanyaṃ pramāṇamityucyate/
analyzed: vṛtteḥ mālatī gocarāyāḥ smṛti rūpāyāḥ antaḥkaraṇa vṛtteḥ sārūpyam mālatī ākāra kārita tvam tasmāt ayam arthaḥ vedāntinaḥ khalu evam āhuḥ indriya artha saṃnikarṣe sati antaḥkaraṇam pariṇāmi svabhāvam vṛtti ākāreṇa pariṇamate antaḥkaraṇa avacchinnam ca pramātṛ caitanyam vṛttau api pratiphalati tat eva vṛtti pratiphalitam caitanyam pramāṇam iti ucyate

original: sā ca vṛttirviṣayadeśaṃ gatvā viṣayākārakāritā bhavantī viṣayādhiṣṭhānacaitanyāvaraṇakamajñānaṃ virodhitvātpradīpatamonyoyena nivartayati/ tataśca viṣayādhiṣṭhānacaitanyaṃ vṛttipratiphalitapramātṛcaitanyābhedena kūpakulyālavālasalilanyāyenaikyamāpannaṃ sphurati/ adhiṣṭhānacaitanyasya cāntaḥkaraṇatādātmyādhyāsābhāvādahamiti na pratītiḥ/
analyzed: sā ca vṛttiḥ viṣaya deśam gatvā viṣaya ākāra kāritā bhavantī viṣaya adhiṣṭhāna caitanya āvaraṇakam ajñānam virodhi tvāt pradīpa tamaḥ nyoyena nivartayati tatas ca viṣaya adhiṣṭhāna caitanyam vṛtti pratiphalita pramātṛ caitanya abhedena kūpa kulyā ālavāla salila nyāyena aikyam āpannam sphurati adhiṣṭhāna caitanyasya ca antaḥkaraṇa tādātmya adhyāsa abhāvāt aham iti na pratītiḥ

original: kiṃ tvidamarthena tādātmyādhyāsādviṣayākāreṇedamityeveti/ tathā ca prakṛte'pi smṛtermālatyākārakāritvāttatpratiphalitacaitanyaṃ viṣayacaitanyenaikyamāpannaṃ viṣayākāreṇa sphuratīti/ nanvevaṃ tarhi sā mālatītyevaṃ pratītiḥ syānna tu tanmayatvam/ satyam/
analyzed: kim tu idam arthena tādātmya adhyāsāt viṣaya ākāreṇa idam iti eva iti tathā ca prakṛte api smṛteḥ mālatī ākāra kāri tvāt tad pratiphalita caitanyam viṣaya caitanyena aikyam āpannam viṣaya ākāreṇa sphurati iti nanu evam tarhi sā mālatī iti evam pratītiḥ syāt na tu tad maya tvam satyam

original: kiṃtu saṃtānapadaṃ paryālocitaṃ tvayā nairantaryeṇa smaryamāṇatattāṃśavigalaneneyamiti purovartitvapratyakṣe pratibhāti/ tato'pi cirakālaṃ tathaiva bhāvanayedaṃtayāpi pravilayātpramātṛcaitanyatādātmyāpannaiva pratīyata iti bhāvanāyā māhātmyametadeva/ evaṃ hi kāmāturakāminīsākṣātkāraḥ prasiddhaḥ śāstreṣviti/
analyzed: kiṃtu saṃtāna padam paryālocitam tvayā nairantaryeṇa smaryamāṇa tad tā aṃśa vigalanena iyam iti purovarti tva pratyakṣe pratibhāti tatas upi cira kālam tathā eva bhāvanayā idaṃtayā api pravilayāt pramātṛ caitanya tādātmya āpannā eva pratīyate iti bhāvanāyāḥ māhātmyam etat eva evam hi kāma ātura kāminī sākṣātkāraḥ prasiddhaḥ śāstreṣu iti

original: ata evevaśabdaprayogaḥ sarvatra tanmayamiva līnevetyādāvapāramārthikatvadyotanāya/ tena satyapyevaṃvidhe darśane pāramārthikadarśanaprārthanaṃ yuktameveti bhāvaḥ/ tanmayameveti yaduktaṃ tadeva viśadayati - līnevetyādi/
analyzed: atas eva ivaśabda prayogaḥ sarvatra tad mayam iva līnā iva ityādau apāramārthika tva dyotanāya tena sati api evaṃvidhe darśane pāramārthika darśana prārthanam yuktam eva iti bhāvaḥ tad mayam eva iti yat uktam tat eva viśadayati līnā iva ityādi

original: yā madanodyāne madviṣayaprāganurāgadyotakānanubhavānprakāśitavatī sā priyā no'smākaṃ tādṛśe strīratne matto'pi prāgeva mayyanurakta āsaktacitta ityaho me saubhāgyamityātmani gauravamāropya bahuvacanam/ cetasi lagnā/ kathaṃ lagneti jijñāsāyāṃ lagnatvaprakāraviśeṣānutprekṣate - līneveti/
analyzed: yā madana udyāne mad viṣaya prāk anurāga dyotakān anubhavān prakāśitavatī sā priyā na usmākam tādṛśe strī ratne mattaḥ upi prāk eva mayi anuraktaḥ āsakta cittaḥ iti aho me saubhāgyam iti ātmani gauravam āropya bahuvacanam cetasi lagnā katham lagnā iti jijñāsāyām lagna tva prakāra viśeṣān utprekṣate līnā iva iti

original: layaṃ gateva pāṃsurāśiparipatitapayaḥkaṇavaccite'ntarhitevetyarthaḥ/ nanu tarhi tatsphuraṇameva na syādityāśaṅkyāha - pratibimbateveti/ vimalasalilāśaye candramaṇḍalamiva maccetasi pratibimbiteva/ antaḥsphuraṇamupapannamirtthaḥ/ nanu tarhi bimbāsaṃnidhau kathaṃ pratibimba ityata āha - likhiteveti/
analyzed: layam gatā iva pāṃsu rāśi paripatita payaḥ kaṇa vat citā intarhitā iva iti arthaḥ nanu tarhi tad sphuraṇam eva na syāt iti āśaṅkya āha pratibimba tā iva iti vimala salilāśaye candra maṇḍalam iva mad cetasi pratibimbitā iva antar sphuraṇam upapannam irtthaḥ nanu tarhi bimba asaṃnidhau katham pratibimbaḥ iti atas āha likhitā iva iti

original: maccittabhitau manmathenaiva citrakāreṇa cintātūlikayānurāgavarṇakena likhiteva/ ataḥ sākṣātsphuratītyarthaḥ/ nanu tarhi citrasya rekhoparekhāsaṃsthānaviśeṣātmakatvena tadrūpatvābhāvānmālatīcitrameva lagnaṃ na tu mālatī syādata āha - utkīrṇarūpeveti/
analyzed: mad citta bhitau manmathena eva citrakāreṇa cintā tūlikayā anurāga varṇakena likhitā iva atas sākṣāt sphurati iti arthaḥ nanu tarhi citrasya rekhā uparekhā saṃsthāna viśeṣa ātmaka tvena tad rūpa tva abhāvāt mālatī citram eva lagnam na tu mālatī syāt atas āha utkīrṇa rūpā iva iti

original: yathā śilāyāmeva śilāputrikā śilpinā ṭaṅkenotkīryate, evaṃ mama citte madanaśilpinā śaraireva ṭaṅkairutkīrṇarūpamaccittameva priyākāreṇotkīrṇamityarthaḥ/ nanvaṇīyaso manaso niravayavatvātkathaṃ priyā tatrotkīrṇetyata āha - pratyupteveti/
analyzed: yathā śilāyām eva śilāputrikā śilpinā ṭaṅkena utkīryate evam mama citte madana śilpinā śaraiḥ eva ṭaṅkaiḥ utkīrṇa rūpam accittam eva priya ākāreṇa utkīrṇam iti arthaḥ nanu aṇīyasaḥ manasaḥ niravayava tvāt katham priyā tatra utkīrṇā iti atas āha pratyuptā iva iti

original: yathā kanakavikāreṣu vajrādikaṃ ghaṭitaṃ bhavati, evaṃ manmanasi virahānalasaṃdīpitatvādujjvalasuvarṇapiṇḍasaṃnibhe'ta eva dravībhūte strīratnaṃ madanasuvarṇakāreṇa sthāpitamityarthaḥ/ nanu prativāpasya saṃyogaviśeṣatvādvibhāgo'pi syādityataḥ saṃyogadārḍhyārthaṃ prakāraviśeṣamāha - vajreti/ guḍamāṣarasādidravyabhāvitaḥ sudhālepo vajralepaḥ/
analyzed: yathā kanaka vikāreṣu vajra ādikam ghaṭitam bhavati evam mad manasi viraha anala saṃdīpita tvāt ujjvala suvarṇa piṇḍa saṃnibhāt itas eva dravībhūte strī ratnam madana suvarṇakāreṇa sthāpitam iti arthaḥ nanu prativāpasya saṃyoga viśeṣa tvāt vibhāgaḥ api syāt iti atas saṃyoga dārḍhya artham prakāra viśeṣam āha vajra iti guḍa māṣa rasa ādi dravya bhāvitaḥ sudhā lepaḥ vajra lepaḥ

original: taddhaṭitaṃ vastu yathā dṛḍhataraṃ bhavati tadvatpriyāpītyarthaḥ/ nanu tarhi manasaḥ priyāyāśca saṃsparśo na syāt/ manasa upari vajralepastadupari tasyā ghaṭitatvādityata āha - antarnikhāteveti/ bhūtale nidhānavanmanogarte yathā yatṃkicinnikhātyate tadbatpriyāpi nikhātetyarthaḥ/ tarhi tadvadeva pratītirna syādityata āha - kīliteveti/
analyzed: tad haṭitam vastu yathā dṛḍhataram bhavati tadvat priyā api iti arthaḥ nanu tarhi manasaḥ priyāyāḥ ca saṃsparśaḥ na syāt manasaḥ upari vajra lepaḥ tad upari tasyāḥ ghaṭita tvāt iti atas āha antar nikhātā iva iti bhū tale nidhāna vat manaḥ garte yathā yat kicid nikhātyate tadbat priyā api nikhātā iti arthaḥ tarhi tadvat eva pratītiḥ na syāt iti atas āha kīlitā iva iti

original: yathā dārudvayamayaḥśalākāviddhaṃ kīlitaṃ bhavati tadvatpañcabhirapi pañcabāṇairatitīkṣṇairubhayatrānuvṛttatayā protairmama manasi priyatamā kīlitevetyarthaḥ/
analyzed: yathā dāru dvayam ayaḥ śalākā viddham kīlitam bhavati tadvat pañcabhiḥ api pañcabāṇaiḥ ati tīkṣṇaiḥ ubhayatra anuvṛtta tayā protaiḥ mama manasi priyatamā kīlitā iva iti arthaḥ

original: atra svacittasya kaṭhinatvādayaḥśalākāvedhavyathāsahiṣṇutve'pi priyāyāḥ saukumāryātiśayaśālinyāḥ kusumasaṃsparśenāpi khidyadaṅgaṃ kathaṃ śalākāvedhavyathāṃ soḍhumarhatītyarucyā prakārāntaramāha - cinteti/ cintāsaṃtatiḥ kathaṃ tatprāptiḥ syādityevaṃrūpaiva tantujālaṃ tena niviḍaṃ syūtā baddhevālagneti sarvatrānvayaḥ/
analyzed: atra sva cittasya kaṭhina tva ādi ayaḥ śalākāvedha vyathā sahiṣṇu tve pi priyāyāḥ saukumārya atiśaya śālinyāḥ kusuma saṃsparśena api khidyat aṅgam katham śalākāvedha vyathām soḍhum arhati iti arucyā prakāra antaram āha cintā iti cintā saṃtatiḥ katham tad prāptiḥ syāt iti evaṃrūpā eva tantu jālam tena nibiḍam syūtā baddhā iva ālagnā iti sarvatra anvayaḥ

original: atra līnetyatrātyantābhedasyopakramāttasya cottarottaraṃ bhedapratīteḥ patatprakarṣatvādarthasya patatprakarṣātiśayasyaitadudāharaṇaṃ syāditi bhītyā ``pāṭhakramādarthakramo balīyān'' iti nyāyena sopānāvarohaṇarītyā cintāsaṃtatītyārabhya līnevetiparyantaṃ cottarottarasaṃśleṣotkarṣapratīteḥ patatprakarṣatvaṃ na bhavatīti kecidvidagdhā vyācakṣate/
analyzed: atra līnā iti atra atyanta abhedasya upakramāt tasya ca uttarottaram bheda pratīteḥ patat prakarṣa tvāt arthasya patat prakarṣa atiśayasya etat udāharaṇam syāt iti bhītyā pāṭha kramāt artha kramaḥ balīyān iti nyāyena sopāna avarohaṇa rītyā cintā saṃtati iti ārabhya līnā iva iti paryantam ca uttarottara saṃśleṣa utkarṣa pratīteḥ patat prakarṣa tvam na bhavati iti kecid vidagdhāḥ vyācakṣate

original: atra lagnatayā nirdiṣṭāyāḥ prakṛtāyāḥ priyāyā layādikriyānimittakālīnādyaprakṛtavastvātmakatvādhyavasāyapradhānakriyānimittakadravyasvarūpabhāvotprekṣeti niṣkarṣaḥ/ yatsūtram - ``aprakṛtaguṇakriyāsaṃbandhādaprakṛtatvena prakṛtasya saṃbhāvanamutprekṣā'' iti/ ekasyānekadhādhyavasāyācceyaṃ mālotprekṣā//10//
analyzed: atra lagna tayā nirdiṣṭāyāḥ prakṛtāyāḥ priyāyāḥ laya ādi kriyā nimitta kālīna ādi aprakṛta vastu ātmaka tva adhyavasāya pradhāna kriyā nimittaka dravya sva rūpa bhāva utprekṣā iti niṣkarṣaḥ yat sūtram aprakṛta guṇa kriyā saṃbandhāt aprakṛta tvena prakṛtasya saṃbhāvanam utprekṣā iti ekasya anekadhā adhyavasāyāt ca iyam mālā utprekṣā

original: nepathye kalakalaḥ/ piśācānāmutpanna iti śeṣaḥ/ kauṇapāḥ rākṣasāḥ/ raudratā bhīṣaṇatā/ atra hi śmaśānapradeśe/ paryanteti/ tamaḥ kartṛ citājyotiṣāmaujjvalyaṃ parabhāgato varṇotkarṣātprakaṭayati/ tamorūpasaṃnidhau hi tejorūpamujjvalaṃ prakāśate/ kīdṛśaṃ tamaḥ/ paryante jyotiṣāṃ prāntapradeśe pratiroddhuṃ śīlamasya tattathā/
analyzed: nepathye kalakalaḥ piśācānām utpannaḥ iti śeṣaḥ kauṇapāḥ rākṣasāḥ raudra tā bhīṣaṇa tā atra hi śmaśāna pradeśe paryanta iti tamaḥ kartṛ citā jyotiṣām aujjvalyam parabhāgataḥ varṇa utkarṣāt prakaṭayati tamaḥ rūpa saṃnidhau hi tejaḥ rūpam ujjvalam prakāśate kīdṛśam tamaḥ paryante jyotiṣām prānta pradeśe pratiroddhum śīlam asya tat tathā

original: jyotiḥ samīpaparyantamāvṛtya vartamānamityarthaḥ/ tayā meduraṃ māṃsalaṃ ghanaṃ nibiḍaṃ styānaṃ piṇḍībhūtam/ sūcībhedyamityarthaḥ/ tathā bhogena vistāreṇa bahudeśavyāpitvena bhīmaṃ bhīṣaṇam/ kiṃcaitesaṃsaktāvicchinnākulā keliryeṣāṃ te/ uttālā udbhaṭāḥ/
analyzed: jyotiḥ samīpa paryantam āvṛtya vartamānam iti arthaḥ tayā meduram māṃsalam ghanam nibiḍam styānam piṇḍībhūtam sūcībhedyam iti arthaḥ tathā bhogena vistāreṇa bahu deśa vyāpi tvena bhīmam bhīṣaṇam kiṃca ete saṃsaktā avicchinna ākulā keliḥ yeṣām te uttālāḥ udbhaṭāḥ

original: kaṭapūtanā nāma piśācaviśeṣāstatprabhṛtayaḥ piśācāḥ saṃmadātkilakilārūpaiḥ kolāhalaiḥ sāṃrāviṇaṃ sarvato'pi visṛtvaramākrośaṃ kurvate/ saṃpūrvāt ``ru śabde'' ityasmāddhātoḥ ``abhividhau bhāva inuṇ'' itīnuṇpratyayaḥ/ ``tadantādaṇ'' iti taddhito'ṇpratyayaḥ svārthikaḥ//11//
analyzed: kaṭapūtanāḥ nāma piśāca viśeṣāḥ tad prabhṛtayaḥ piśācāḥ saṃmadāt kilakilā rūpaiḥ kolāhalaiḥ sāṃrāviṇam sarvatas pi visṛtvaram ākrośam kurvate saṃpūrvāt śabde iti asmāt dhātoḥ abhividhau bhāvaḥ inuṇ iti inuṇ pratyayaḥ tad antāt aṇ iti taddhita uṇ pratyayaḥ svārthikaḥ

original: āghoṣayāmi/ uccairvikrayārthaṃ vikreyavastu nivedayāmītyarthaḥ/ bho bhoḥ saṃbhramādāmantraṇe/ aśastreti/ śastreṇāspṛṣṭham/ aśastrakṣatamityarthaḥ/ śastraspṛṣṭaṃ hi pavitratvātpiśācaiḥ spraṣṭumaśakyamiti tadabhāvasteṣāṃ tasya sugrahatvapratipādanāyoktaḥ/
analyzed: āghoṣayāmi uccais vikraya artham vikreya vastu nivedayāmi iti arthaḥ bho bhoḥ saṃbhramāt āmantraṇe aśastra iti śastreṇa a spṛṣṭham a śastra kṣatam iti arthaḥ śastra spṛṣṭam hi pavitra tvāt piśācaiḥ spraṣṭum aśakyam iti tad abhāvaḥ teṣām tasya sugraha tva pratipādanāya uktaḥ

original: avyājamakapaṭaṃ vastuto vikrayārthamevānītaṃ na tu māṃsavikrayavyājena viśvāsamutpādya prahartumānītamityarthaḥ/ yadvā vyājaḥ kṛtrimo gaḍvādirmāṃsadūṣako rogaviśeṣastadrahitaṃ yatpuruṣasyāṃgaṃ tenopakalpitam/ gaḍvādikṛtrimadoṣadūṣitaṃ hi māṃsaṃ rasahīnatvādanāsvādyaṃ syāt/ strīmāṃsāpekṣayā puruṣamāṃsasya praśastatvadyotanāya puruṣagrahaṇam/
analyzed: avyājam akapaṭam vastutas vikraya artham eva ānītam na tu māṃsa vikraya vyājena viśvāsam utpādya prahartum ānītam iti arthaḥ yat vā vyājaḥ kṛtrimaḥ gaḍvādiḥ māṃsa dūṣakaḥ roga viśeṣaḥ tad rahitam yat puruṣasya aṃgam tena upakalpitam gaḍvādi kṛtrima doṣa dūṣitam hi māṃsam rasa hīna tvāt anāsvādyam syāt strī māṃsa apekṣayā puruṣa māṃsasya praśasta tva dyotanāya puruṣa grahaṇam

original: uktaṃ hi kāpālikāgame - ``aśastrasaṃchinnamayoṣidīyaṃ nṛmāṃsamārdraṃ galadasrabindu yat''/ anye tu - ``ātmasiddhiṃ paṇīkṛtya sāhasādyadupārjitam/ aśastrapūtamavyājaṃ nṛmāṃsaṃ parikīrtitam//'' ityāhuḥ/ etadeva mahāmāṃsaśabdenocyate/
analyzed: uktam hi kāpālika āgame aśastra saṃchinnam ayoṣidīyam nṛ māṃsam ārdram galat asra bindu yat anye tu ātma siddhim paṇīkṛtya sāhasāt yat upārjitam aśastra pūtam avyājam nṛ māṃsam parikīrtitam iti āhuḥ etat eva mahāmāṃsa śabdena ucyate

original: gṛhyatāṃ gṛhyatāmiti vīpsā durlabhatvādetādṛśasya prathamamāgatasyaivāsti na paścādāgatasyetyādarātiśayasūcanārthā//12//
analyzed: gṛhyatām gṛhyatām iti vīpsā durlabha tvāt etādṛśasya prathamam āgatasya eva asti na paścāt āgatasya iti ādara atiśaya sūcana arthā

original: sarvataḥ samuccalannuttālo bhīṣaṇastumulaḥ saṃkīrṇo vyaktaḥ sphuṭaṃ vibhāvyamānaśca yaḥ kalakalastenākula āvirbhavadbhistadaiva prakaṭībhavadbhirbhūtaiḥ saṃkaṭaḥ saṃkīrṇaḥ śmaśānapradeśaḥ pracalita iva/ piśācagatasaṃcaraṇakriyāyāstadgatatayā pratīteḥ kampamāna iva vartata ityarthaḥ/ karṇābhyarṇeti/
analyzed: sarvatas samuccalan uttālaḥ bhīṣaṇaḥ tumulaḥ saṃkīrṇaḥ vyaktaḥ sphuṭam vibhāvyamānaḥ ca yaḥ kalakalaḥ tena ākulaḥ āvirbhavadbhiḥ tadā eva prakaṭībhavadbhiḥ bhūtaiḥ saṃkaṭaḥ saṃkīrṇaḥ śmaśāna pradeśaḥ pracalitaḥ iva piśāca gata saṃcaraṇa kriyāyāḥ tad gata tayā pratīteḥ kampamānaḥ iva vartate iti arthaḥ karṇa abhyarṇa iti

original: lakṣyaṃ mukhagatolkādīptivaśādīṣallakṣyamandhakāravaśātsphuṭamalakṣyaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ śuṣkaṃ kṛśaṃ dīrghamatyunnataṃ ca vapuryeṣāmulkāmukhānāmanvarthānāṃ piśācaviśeṣāṇāṃ mukhairnabha ākīryata ākīrṇaṃ bhavatīti/ kīdṛśaiḥ/
analyzed: lakṣyam mukha gata ulkā dīpti vaśāt īṣat lakṣyam andhakāra vaśāt sphuṭam alakṣyam ca viśeṣataḥ śuṣkam kṛśam dīrgham ati unnatam ca vapuḥ yeṣām ulkā mukhānām anvarthānām piśāca viśeṣāṇām mukhaiḥ nabhaḥ ākīryate ākīrṇam bhavati iti kīdṛśaiḥ

original: karṇayorabhyarṇamantikaṃ yāvadvidīrṇe vipāṭite te sṛkkaṇī āṣṭhaprāntau tābhyāṃ vikaṭaṃ yadvyādānaṃ vadanakuharavivaraṇaṃ tena dīptaḥ prakāśamāno'gniryeṣu taiḥ/ daṃṣṭrāṇāṃ koṭibhiragrairviśaṅkaṭairākulaiḥ/ itaścetaśca dhāvadbhiḥ/ pradīptolkāsaṃbandhena mukhamātradarśanātteṣāmapasaraṇamuktam/ taḍitsamūhasaṃnibhakeśādibhirānanaiḥ//13//
analyzed: karṇayoḥ abhyarṇam antikam yāvat vidīrṇe vipāṭite te āṣṭha prāntau tābhyām vikaṭam yat vyādānam vadana kuhara vivaraṇam tena dīptaḥ prakāśamāna agniḥ yeṣu taiḥ daṃṣṭrāṇām koṭibhiḥ agraiḥ viśaṅkaṭaiḥ ākulaiḥ itas ca itas ca dhāvadbhiḥ pradīpta ulkā saṃbandhena mukha mātra darśanāt teṣām apasaraṇam uktam taḍit samūha saṃnibha keśa ādibhiḥ ānanaiḥ

original: etaditi/ etatpūtanānāṃ piśācaviśeṣāṇāṃ cakramālokyate dṛśyate/ kīdṛśam/ paritaḥ sarvata ādardaramīṣadghargharaṃ yathā tathā/ ``āghargharam'' iti kvacitpāṭhaḥ/
analyzed: etat iti etat pūtanānām piśāca viśeṣāṇām cakram ālokyate dṛśyate kīdṛśam paritas sarvatas ādardaram īṣat ghargharam yathā tathā āghargharam iti kvacid pāṭhaḥ

original: krandata ākrandanaṃ kurvāṇānvṛkānmāṃsāhārānmṛgaviśeṣānakrameṇātitṛṣṇayā yaugapadyenaikīkṛtya gṛhīto yo grāsaḥ kavalapiṇḍastasmādardhamuktairādhikyādvadanavivare'dyamānādbhūmau patitairnṛmāṃsasya vighasairbhuktaśeṣaiḥ/ ucchiṣṭairiti yāvat/ utpuṣṇatpoṣaṇaṃ kurvāṇam/ kharjūradrumadaghnā tatpramāṇā jaṅghā yasya tattathā/
analyzed: krandataḥ ākrandanam kurvāṇān vṛkān māṃsa āhārān mṛga viśeṣān akrameṇa ati tṛṣṇayā yaugapadyena ekīkṛtya gṛhītaḥ yaḥ grāsaḥ kavala piṇḍaḥ tasmāt ardha muktaiḥ ādhikyāt vadana vivaredyamānāt bhūmau patitaiḥ nṛ māṃsasya vighasaiḥ bhukta śeṣaiḥ ucchiṣṭaiḥ iti yāvat utpuṣṇat poṣaṇam kurvāṇam kharjūra druma daghnā tad pramāṇā jaṅghā yasya tat tathā

original: asitayā tvacā naddhāḥ parītāḥ viṣvaksarvatastatā vyāptāḥ snāyugranthayaḥ sirāgranthayastābhirghanaṃ nibiḍamasthipañjaraṃ raktamāṃsamajjādibhirvihīnatayā kevalaṃ pañjarībhūtānyasthīni yasya tādṛkca jarato'ticirakālajīvanājjarājīrṇāḥ kaṅkālāḥ śarīrāsthīni yasya tattādṛkceti viśeṣaṇasamāsaḥ/ ``kaṅkālaḥ puṃsi kāyāsthni'' iti viśvaḥ//14//
analyzed: asitayā tvacā naddhāḥ parītāḥ viṣvak sarvatas tatāḥ vyāptāḥ snāyu granthayaḥ sirā granthayaḥ tābhiḥ ghanam nibiḍam asthipañjaram rakta māṃsa majja ādibhiḥ vihīna tayā kevalam pañjarībhūtāni asthīni yasya tādṛś ca jaratā uti cira kāla jīvanāt jarā jīrṇāḥ kaṅkālāḥ śarīra asthīni yasya tat tādṛś ca iti viśeṣaṇa samāsaḥ kaṅkālaḥ puṃsi kāya asthni iti viśvaḥ

original: samantādavalokya vihasya ca/ āheti śeṣaḥ/ vihasanena ca tādṛśabhayaṃkaradarśane'pi vītaśaṅkatāsūcanānnāyakasyātimanasvitā kathitā/ pṛthucaleti/
analyzed: samantāt avalokya vihasya ca āha iti śeṣaḥ vihasanena ca tādṛśa bhayaṃkara darśane api vīta śaṅka tā sūcanāt nāyakasya ati manasvi tā kathitā pṛthu calā iti

original: viśīrṇā viśeṣeṇa śīrṇā vraṇakiṇagaṇḍādibahūpadravavaśādviśakalitāḥ śuṣkā māṃsarudhirādiśūnyatayā nīrasā dehā yeṣāṃ te piśācāḥ pṛthu viśālaṃ calayā kampamānayā rasanayogram ``pṛthutararasanogram'' iti pāṭhe'tisthūlatayā rasanayogramāsyagartaṃ gartamivāsyam/ upamitasamāsaḥ/ ata eva samāsasāmyāttadvācilope luptopamā/
analyzed: viśīrṇāḥ viśeṣeṇa śīrṇāḥ vraṇa kiṇa gaṇḍa ādi bahu upadrava vaśāt viśakalitāḥ śuṣkāḥ māṃsa rudhira ādi śūnya tayā nīrasāḥ dehāḥ yeṣām te piśācāḥ pṛthu viśālam calayā kampamānayā rasanayā ugram pṛthutara rasanā ugram iti pāṭha iti sthūla tayā rasanayā ugram āsya gartam gartam iva āsyam upamita samāsaḥ atas eva samāsa sāmyāt tad vāci lope lupta upamā

original: tadvidārya vipāṭya sthitāḥ santaḥ/ caladbhiścañcalaiḥ ``galat'' iti pāṭhe koṭarānnirgacchadbhirajagarairmahāsarpairdhorāṇi bhīṣaṇāni koṭarāṇi yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ tādṛśānāṃ purāṇānāṃ ciraṃtanānām/ jīrṇatvaśuṣkatvasuṣiropetatvādisūcanāya purāṇatvoktiḥ/ rohiṇānāṃ candanānām/ ``rohiṇaścandanadrumaḥ'' iti viśvaḥ/ dyutiṃ śobhāṃ dadhati/
analyzed: tat vidārya vipāṭya sthitāḥ santaḥ caladbhiḥ cañcalaiḥ galat iti pāṭhe koṭarāt nirgacchadbhiḥ ajagaraiḥ mahā sarpaiḥ dhorāṇi bhīṣaṇāni koṭarāṇi yeṣām teṣām tādṛśānām purāṇānām ciraṃtanānām jīrṇa tva śuṣka tva suṣira upeta tva ādi sūcanāya purāṇa tva uktiḥ rohiṇānām candanānām rohiṇaḥ candana drumaḥ iti viśvaḥ dyutim śobhām dadhati

original: candanagrahaṇaṃ teṣāṃ svabhāvataḥ puṣpādiśūnyatvānnīrasatvādajagarādisamāśrayatvāccāsyagartasya koṭareṇa calantyā rasanāyā ajagareṇa sādharmyaṃ vivakṣitam/ tena nidarśanamalaṃkāraḥ/ na hyanyagatāṃ dyutimanyo dadhātīti candanatarugatadyuteḥ piśāceṣvasaṃbhavānnibandhanatayārthādbimbapratibimbabhāvenopameyatvādyākṣepāt/
analyzed: candana grahaṇam teṣām svabhāvataḥ puṣpa ādi śūnya tvāt nīrasa tvāt ajagara ādi samāśraya tvāt ca āsya gartasya koṭareṇa calantyāḥ rasanāyāḥ ajagareṇa sādharmyam vivakṣitam tena nidarśanam alaṃkāraḥ na hi anya gatām dyutim anyaḥ dadhāti iti candana taru gata dyuteḥ piśāceṣu asaṃbhavāt nibandhanatayā arthāt bimba pratibimba bhāvena upameya tva ādi ākṣepāt

original: yaduktam - ``asaṃbhavaddharmayogādupamānopameyayoḥ/ pratibimbakriyā gamyā yatra sā syānnidarśanā//'' iti//15//
analyzed: yat uktam asaṃbhavat dharma yogāt upamāna upameyayoḥ pratibimba kriyā gamyā yatra sā syāt nidarśanā iti

original: atibībhatsam/ atijugupsālambanamityarthaḥ/ utkṛtyeti/ pretaraṅko'tyantadīnaḥ piśācaviśeṣaḥ/ prathamaṃ kṛttiṃ tvacamutkṛtyotkṛtya chittvāthānantaraṃ pṛthunotsedhena vapurunnatyā bhūyāṃsi pracuratarāṇi/
analyzed: ati bībhatsam ati jugupsā ālambanam iti arthaḥ utkṛtya iti preta raṅka utyanta dīnaḥ piśāca viśeṣaḥ prathamam kṛttim tvacam utkṛtya utkṛtya chittvā atha anantaram pṛthunā utsedhena vapuḥ unnatyā bhūyāṃsi pracuratarāṇi

original: aṃsayorbhujaśikharayoḥ sphijorjaghanābhogayoḥ pṛṣṭhapīṭhādiṣu ca māṃsaleṣvavayaveṣu sulabhānyanāyāsaprāpyāṇyugrapūtīni duḥsahadurgandhīni māṃsāni jagdhvā bhakṣayitvā samanantaramāttāni snāyvāntranetrāṇi yena sa tādṛk/ snāyurvasā, āntra[ntraṃ] purītat/ snāyvādīnāmādānaṃ tadantargatamāṃsagrahaṇārtham/
analyzed: aṃsayoḥ bhuja śikharayoḥ sphijoḥ jaghana ābhogayoḥ pṛṣṭha pīṭha ādiṣu ca māṃsaleṣu avayaveṣu sulabhāni anāyāsa prāpyāṇi ugra pūtīni duḥsaha durgandhīni māṃsāni jagdhvā bhakṣayitvā samanantaram āttāni snāyu āntra netrāṇi yena sa tādṛś snāyuḥ vasā āntrantram purītat snāyu ādīnām ādānam tad antargata māṃsa grahaṇa artham

original: tadanantaraṃ cāṅkasthātsamīpe vartamānātkaraṅkānnirmāṃsāsthipañjarācchavaśarīrādasthisaṃsthamasthnāmanmargataṃ sthapuṭagataṃ nimnonnataviṣamapradeśasthitamapi kravyaṃ māṃsam/ prakaṭitā viṣamakaṭhinasthānasthitaṃ māṃsaṃ saṃniṣkraṣṭuṃ prakāśitā daśanā yena sa tādṛśaḥ san/ avyagraṃ tvarārahitaṃ yathātathāttīti/
analyzed: tad anantaram ca aṅka sthāt samīpe vartamānāt karaṅkāt nirmāṃsa asthipañjarāt śava śarīrāt asthi saṃstham asthnām anmargatam sthapuṭa gatam nimna unnata viṣama pradeśa sthitam api kravyam māṃsam prakaṭitāḥ viṣama kaṭhina sthāna sthitam māṃsam saṃniṣkraṣṭum prakāśitāḥ daśanāḥ yena sa tādṛśaḥ san avyagram tvarā rahitam yathā tathā atti iti

original: atra jugupsāyāḥ paripoṣādbībhatsaraso dhvanyate//16//
analyzed: atra jugupsāyāḥ paripoṣāt bībhatsa rasaḥ dhvanyate

original: imameva rasaṃ prakārāntareṇa nirvarṇayati - api ca/ niṣṭāpeti/ kuṇapabhujaḥ śavaśarīrābhyavahāriṇaḥ piśācāḥ/ niṣṭāpena niḥśeṣeṇa tāpo niṣṭāpastena samyaktāpena svidyanti kṣaranmajjānyasthīni yeṣāṃ tān/
analyzed: imam eva rasam prakāra antareṇa nirvarṇayati api ca niṣṭāpa iti kuṇapa bhujaḥ śava śarīra abhyavahāriṇaḥ piśācāḥ niṣṭāpena niḥśeṣeṇa tāpaḥ niṣṭāpaḥ tena samyak tāpena svidyanti kṣarat majjāni asthīni yeṣām tān

original: tathā kvathanenāvartanena parito galatsraṃsamānaṃ medo yeṣāṃ tānevaṃvidhānsaṃsaktadhūmāṃścitāsu dahyamānānpretakāyānbhūyasībhyaścitābhyo mṛtaśarīradahanendhanarāśibhyaḥ kṛṣṭvākṛṣya/ utpakvamutkarṣeṇa pakvamata eva sraṃsi vigalanmāṃsaṃ yasya tat/ pracalatkāyāpṛthaktvena svatantrakriyam/
analyzed: tathā kvathanena āvartanena paritas galat sraṃsamānam medaḥ yeṣām tān evaṃvidhān saṃsakta dhūmān citāsu dahyamānān preta kāyān bhūyasībhyaḥ citābhyaḥ mṛta śarīra dahana indhana rāśibhyaḥ kṛṣṭvā ākṛṣya utpakvam utkarṣeṇa pakvam atas eva sraṃsi vigalat māṃsam yasya tat pracalat kāya apṛthaktvena svatantra kriyam

original: ubhayato mūlāgrabhāgayoyag saṃdhī tābhyāṃ tayorvā nirmuktaṃ jaṅghānalakaṃ jaṅghākāṇḍamārātsamīpe niṣkṛṣya śarīrātpṛthakkṛtya/ ``niścūṣya'' iti pāṭhe prathamaṃ dravībhūtagalanmāṃsatvānmedādivaccūṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā paścāttata udayinīrniṣpratibandhaṃ niḥsarantīrmajjadhārā āsthisuṣirapūrakadhātuviśeṣadhārāḥ pibanti/
analyzed: ubhayatas saṃdhī tābhyām tayoḥ vā nirmuktam jaṅghānalakam jaṅghā kāṇḍam ārāt samīpe niṣkṛṣya śarīrāt pṛthakkṛtya niścūṣyaḥ iti pāṭhe prathamam dravībhūta galat māṃsa tvāt meda ādi vat cūṣaṇam kṛtvā paścāt tatas udayinīḥ niṣpratibandham niḥsarantīḥ majja dhārāḥ ā asthi suṣira pūraka dhātu viśeṣa dhārāḥ pibanti

analyzed: niḥśabda pāna āsecanam iti atra āsecanam īṣat secanam tad vyatiriktena āsecanena iṣatvat tva vidhānāt niṣṭāpanaḥ iti ṣatvam niṣṭaptam rakṣaḥ ityādau niḥśeṣa tāpasya eva vivakṣita tvāt pūrva śloke māṃsa bhakṣaṇasya ukta tvāt atra pāna kriyā varṇanena bībhatsa rasa paripoṣaḥ

original: prādoṣika iti/ rajanīmukhasamudbhūtaḥ pramodaḥ prakṛṣṭo harṣaḥ/ teṣāṃ rātriṃcaratvātpradoṣasamaye prāpte yuktaḥ pramoda iti bhāvaḥ/ āntrairiti/ pūrvaṃ piśācavṛttānta uktaḥ/ idānīṃ samṛddhavadhūkānāṃ teṣāṃ vijṛmbhaṇamucyate/ āntraiḥ kalpitā maṅgalārthaṃ pratisarā raktasūtrādinirmitavalayā yāsāṃ tāḥ/
analyzed: prādoṣikaḥ iti rajanī mukha samudbhūtaḥ pramodaḥ prakṛṣṭaḥ harṣaḥ teṣām rātriṃcara tvāt pradoṣa samaye prāpte yuktaḥ pramodaḥ iti bhāvaḥ āntraiḥ iti pūrvam piśāca vṛttāntaḥ uktaḥ idānīm samṛddha vadhūkānām teṣām vijṛmbhaṇam ucyate āntraiḥ kalpitāḥ maṅgala artham pratisarāḥ raktasūtra ādi nirmita valayāḥ yāsām tāḥ

original: strīṇāṃ mṛtānāṃ hastā eva raktotpalāni tānyeva vyaktānuttaṃsānbibhratīti tathoktāḥ/ śoṇitapaṅka eva rudhirakardama eva kuṅkumaṃ tajjuṣanti sevanta iti tathābhūtāḥ piśācāṅganāḥ sahasā hṛdbhireva puṇḍarīkaiḥ kṛtasrajaḥ/ ``pinahya śirasā'' iti pāṭhe svakīlena śirasā dhṛtvā/
analyzed: strīṇām mṛtānām hastāḥ eva rakta utpalāni tāni eva vyaktān uttaṃsān bibhrati iti tathā uktāḥ śoṇita paṅkaḥ eva rudhira kardamaḥ eva kuṅkumam tat juṣanti sevante iti tathābhūtāḥ piśāca aṅganāḥ sahasā hṛdbhiḥ eva puṇḍarīkaiḥ kṛta srajaḥ pinahya śirasā iti pāṭhe sva kīlena śirasā dhṛtvā

original: evamalaṃkṛtāḥ kāntaiḥ samaṃ kapālaiḥ śavaśiraḥkaroṭibhireva caṣakaiḥ pānapātrairasthisnehamajjānyeva surāṃ prītāḥ satyaḥ pibantītyekadeśavartisāvayavaṃ rūpakamatrālaṃkāraḥ/ piśācānāṃ saṃbhoganāyakatvasya tadaṅganānāṃ tannāyikātvasya ca śrutyāropaṇābhāvādarthātpratīteḥ/ yadāha - ``tadrūpakamabhedo ya upamānopameyayoḥ'' iti/
analyzed: evam alaṃkṛtāḥ kāntaiḥ samam kapālaiḥ śava śiraḥ karoṭibhiḥ eva caṣakaiḥ pāna pātraiḥ asthi sneha majjāni eva surām prītāḥ satyaḥ pibanti iti eka deśa varti sa avayavam rūpakam atra alaṃkāraḥ piśācānām saṃbhoga nāyaka tvasya tad aṅganānām tad nāyikā tvasya ca śruti āropaṇa abhāvāt arthāt pratīteḥ yat āha tat rūpakam abhedaḥ yaḥ upamāna upameyayoḥ iti

original: ``śrautā ārthāśca te yasminnekadeśavivarti tat''iti ca ``āntraiḥ kalpitamaṅgalapratisarāḥ'' ityatra tu pariṇāmaḥ/ āntrapratisaratvasya prakṛtopayogitvenāropaṇāt/ yathāha - ``āropyamāṇasya prakṛtopayogitve pariṇāmaḥ'' iti/ ``āropyamāṇamāropaviṣayātmatayā sthitam/ prakṛtasyopayogitvātpariṇāma udāhṛtaḥ//'' iti/
analyzed: śrautāḥ ārthāḥ ca te yasmin eka deśa vivarti tatiti ca āntraiḥ kalpita maṅgala pratisarāḥ iti atra tu pariṇāmaḥ āntra pratisara tvasya prakṛta upayogi tvena āropaṇāt yathā āha āropyamāṇasya prakṛta upayogi tve pariṇāmaḥ iti āropyamāṇam āropa viṣaya ātma tayā sthitam prakṛtasya upayogi tvāt pariṇāmaḥ udāhṛtaḥ iti

original: aṅgāṅgibhāvāpatteśca śṛṅgārabībhatsayorvirodhaparihāraḥ/ ``ayaṃ sa raśanotkarṣī'' ityevamādau karuṇāṅgatvātkaruṇaśṛṅgārayoriva/ yadāha dhvanikṛt - ``vivakṣite rase labdhapratiṣṭhe tu virodhinām/ bādhyānāmaṅgabhāvaṃ vā prāptānāmuktiracchalā//'' iti/
analyzed: aṅga aṅgi bhāva āpatteḥ ca śṛṅgāra bībhatsayoḥ virodha parihāraḥ ayam sa raśanā utkarṣī iti evamādau karuṇa aṅga tvāt karuṇa śṛṅgārayoḥ iva yat āha dhvanikṛt vivakṣite rase labdha pratiṣṭhe tu virodhinām bādhyānām aṅga bhāvam vā prāptānām uktiḥ acchalā iti

original: atra ``premārdrāḥ'' ityārabhya ``līneva'' ityantaṃ paripoṣitasya śṛṅgārasya ``āntraiḥ'' ityanena bībhatsena saha virodha iti nāśaṅkanīyam/ madhye ``itastataḥ parivartamāna-'' ityādināścaryasya, ``karṇābhyarṇa-'' ityādinā cādbhutarasasya nairantaryakṛtavirodhaparihārāyaiva niveśanāt/ ``rasāntarāntaritayorekavākyasthayorapi/
analyzed: atra prema ārdrāḥ iti ārabhya līnā iva ityantam paripoṣitasya śṛṅgārasya āntraiḥ iti anena bībhatsena saha virodhaḥ iti na āśaṅkanīyam madhye itas tatas parivartamānaḥ ityādinā āścaryasya karṇa abhyarṇaḥ ityādinā ca adbhuta rasasya nairantarya kṛta virodha parihārāya eva niveśanāt rasa antara antaritayoḥ eka vākya sthayoḥ api

original: nivartate hi rasayoḥ samāveśe virodhitā//'' iti ekavākyasthayorapi rasāntaravyavadhāne virodho nivartate kila/ kimuta bhinnavākyasthayorityapiśabdārthaḥ/ na cātraikāśrayatvakṛto virodhaḥ śaṅkanīyaḥ śṛṅgāriṇo mādhavasya bībhatsarasālambanatvānupapatterna virodhaśaṅkāpīti prāgeva nirūpitam/
analyzed: nivartate hi rasayoḥ samāveśe virodhi tā iti eka vākya sthayoḥ api rasa antara vyavadhāne virodhaḥ nivartate kila kim uta bhinna vākya sthayoḥ iti apiśabda arthaḥ na ca atra eka āśraya tva kṛtaḥ virodhaḥ śaṅkanīyaḥ śṛṅgāriṇaḥ mādhavasya bībhatsa rasa ālambana tva anupapatteḥ na virodha śaṅkā api iti prāk eva nirūpitam

original: na ca yāvatpradhānarasaparipoṣaḥ kṛtastāvānatra paripoṣastenāpi virodhābhāvaḥ/ yadāha - ``avirodhī virodhī vā raso'ṅgini rasāntare/ paripoṣaṃ na netavyastathā syādavirodhitā//'' iti/ paripoṣābhāve kathaṃ rasatvamiti vācyam/ yato yāvānaṅgino rasasya paripoṣaḥ kṛtastāvānatra na kartavya ityasyā dhvanikārikāyāstātparyamityalaṃ prapañcena//18//
analyzed: na ca yāvat pradhāna rasa paripoṣaḥ kṛtaḥ tāvān atra paripoṣaḥ tena api virodha abhāvaḥ yat āha avirodhī virodhī vā rasa uṅgini rasa antare paripoṣam na netavyaḥ tathā syāt avirodhi tā iti paripoṣa abhāve katham rasa tvam iti vācyam yatas yāvān aṅginaḥ rasasya paripoṣaḥ kṛtaḥ tāvān atra na kartavyaḥ iti asyāḥ dhvani kārikāyāḥ tātparyam iti alam prapañcena

original: ``punaraśastra-'' ityādipāṭhaḥ paścādāgatānāmapi prajñāpanārtham/ atibhīṣaṇā vibhīṣikāḥ parasya bhayamutpādayituṃ ye vikārā vikṛtaveṣabhāṣādayo yeṣāṃ taiḥ piśācairjhaṭityapakrāntaṃ satvaraṃ palāyitam/ niḥsattvā nirvīryāḥ/ sanirvedamiti/ piśācaiḥ sarvairapi bhītabhītairapasṛtaṃ na tu dhārṣṭyamavalambya madantikamāgatya māṃsaṃ vikrītam/
analyzed: punar aśastraḥ ityādi pāṭhaḥ paścāt āgatānām api prajñāpana artham ati bhīṣaṇāḥ vibhīṣikāḥ parasya bhayam utpādayitum ye vikārāḥ vikṛta veṣa bhāṣā ādayaḥ yeṣām taiḥ piśācaiḥ jhaṭiti apakrāntam satvaram palāyitam niḥsattvāḥ nirvīryāḥ sa nirvedam iti piśācaiḥ sarvaiḥ api bhīta bhītaiḥ apasṛtam na tu dhārṣṭyam avalambya mad antikam āgatya māṃsam vikrītam

original: akrīte cāsminna me kāryasiddhiriti nirvedahetuḥ/ sarvo'pi śmaśānavāṭaḥ śmaśānapradeśo vicito'nviṣṭaḥ/ netaḥ paraṃ pitṛvanabhāgabhūmirasti yatra kretāro labhyante/ tadanucite'pi sāhase pravṛttasya me na kāryasiddhirityaho daivasya mayi prātikūlyamiti bhāvaḥ/
analyzed: akrīte ca asmin na me kārya siddhiḥ iti nirveda hetuḥ sarvaḥ api śmaśāna vāṭaḥ śmaśāna pradeśaḥ vicitaḥ unviṣṭaḥ na itas param pitṛvana bhāga bhūmiḥ asti yatra kretāraḥ labhyante tad anucite api sāhase pravṛttasya me na kārya siddhiḥ iti aho daivasya mayi prātikūlyam iti bhāvaḥ

original: tataḥ paraṃ śmaśānapradeśasyābhāvamevāha - iha khalu purata eva pāreśmaśānaṃ saridvartata ityanenānvayaḥ/ guñjaditi/ pāreśmaśānaṃ śmaśānasya pāre paryante/ ``pāre madhye ṣaṣṭyā vā'' ityavyayībhāvaḥ/ sīmabhūtā saritparyanta eva vartate/ ato netaḥ paraṃ śmaśānabhūmirastīti bhāvaḥ/ kīdṛśī sarit/
analyzed: tatas param śmaśāna pradeśasya abhāvam eva āha iha khalu puratas eva pāreśmaśānam sarit vartate iti anena anvayaḥ guñjat iti pāreśmaśānam śmaśānasya pāre paryante pāre madhye ṣaṣṭyā vā iti avyayībhāvaḥ sīma bhūtā sarit paryante eva vartate atas na itas param śmaśāna bhūmiḥ asti iti bhāvaḥ kīdṛśī sarit

original: guñjatāṃ kūjatāṃ kuñjakuṭīreṣu latādipihitodarapradeśeṣu sthitānāṃ kauśikānāmulūkānāṃ yā ghaṭāstāsāṃ dhūtkāraiḥ saṃvellitaḥ saṃvardhito yaḥ krandatāṃ pheravāṇāṃ jambukānāṃ caṇḍo bhīṣaṇo dhātkṛtiranukaraṇaśabdastena bhṛto bharaṇaśīlaḥ prāgbhārastena bhīmairbhīṣaṇaistaṭairupalakṣitā/
analyzed: guñjatām kūjatām kuñja kuṭīreṣu latā ādi pihita udara pradeśeṣu sthitānām kauśikānām ulūkānām yāḥ ghaṭāḥ tāsām dhūtkāraiḥ saṃvellitaḥ saṃvardhitaḥ yaḥ krandatām pheravāṇām jambukānām caṇḍaḥ bhīṣaṇaḥ dhāt kṛtiḥ anukaraṇa śabdaḥ tena bhṛtaḥ bharaṇa śīlaḥ prāgbhāraḥ tena bhīmaiḥ bhīṣaṇaiḥ taṭaiḥ upalakṣitā

original: tathāntaḥkīrṇānāṃ karaṅkāṇāṃ nirmāṃsāsthipañjaraśavaśarīrāṇāṃ yāni karparāṇi kapālāni teṣu taradata eva saṃrodho'syāstīti saṃrodhi tata evaikadeśe saṅghībhūya vegātiśayena pravahaṇātkūlaṃkaṣaṃ taṭabhedakam/ ``sarvakūlābhrakarīṣeṣu kaṣaḥ'' iti khacmumāgamaśca/
analyzed: tathā antar kīrṇānām karaṅkāṇām nirmāṃsa asthi pañjara śava śarīrāṇām yāni karparāṇi kapālāni teṣu tarat atas eva saṃrodhaḥ usya asti iti saṃrodhi tatas eva eka deśe saṅghībhūya vega atiśayena pravahaṇāt kūlam kaṣam taṭa bhedakam sarva kūla abhra karīṣeṣu kaṣaḥ iti khacmumāgamaḥ ca

original: tādṛśaṃ yatsrotastasya nirgamastena ghoro bhīṣaṇastathāvidhau ghargharaḥ śravaṇakaṭū ravo yasyāḥ sā tādṛśīti/ atrolūkādibhī rasābhāve'pi vācyāyāḥ sarito bhīṣaṇatvāttadanuguṇā paruṣavṛttiriti draṣṭavyam//19//
analyzed: tādṛśam yat srotaḥ tasya nirgamaḥ tena ghoraḥ bhīṣaṇaḥ tathāvidhau ghargharaḥ śravaṇa kaṭuḥ ravaḥ yasyāḥ sā tādṛśī iti atra ulūka ādibhiḥ rasa abhāve pi vācyāyāḥ saritaḥ bhīṣaṇa tvāt tad anuguṇā paruṣa vṛttiḥ iti draṣṭavyam

original: nepathya iti/ itthaṃ vāṇī samutthiteti śeṣaḥ/ hā tāta niṣkaruṇa, eṣa idānīṃ te narendracittārādhanopakaraṇaṃ janovipadyate/ tāta, janaka evāsi kevalam, na tu janakānurūpavyāpāro'sīti bhāvaḥ/ ato niṣkaruṇo mayi kṛpārahito mādhavāya māmadattvā nandanāya prayacchatā tvayaivāhaṃ niṣkaruṇena māritā/ śramastu maraṇasya kevalaṃ vyapadeśabhāk/
analyzed: nepathye iti ittham vāṇī samutthitā iti śeṣaḥ hā tāta niṣkaruṇaḥ eṣaḥ idānīm te narendra citta ārādhana upakaraṇam tāta janakaḥ eva asi kevalam na tu janaka anurūpa vyāpāraḥ asi iti bhāvaḥ atas niṣkaruṇaḥ mayi kṛpā rahitaḥ mādhavāya mām a dattvā nandanāya prayacchatā tvayā eva aham niṣkaruṇena māritā śramaḥ tu maraṇasya kevalam vyapadeśa bhāj

original: anyathā maraṇasya niścitatvāditi bhāvaḥ/ eṣa ityātmanirdeśaḥ/ jano yaḥ kaścijjanturityeva mayi buddhiḥ na tvapatyamiti snehaleśo'pīti bhāvaḥ/ narendrasya cittānurañjanopakaraṇadravyatayaivāhaṃ tavopayuktā maṇisuvarṇādivat/ na tu punarātmajetyādyatra draṣṭavyam// mādhavaḥ/ sākūtaṃ sābhiprāyam/ nāda iti/
analyzed: anyathā maraṇasya niścita tvāt iti bhāvaḥ eṣaḥ iti ātma nirdeśaḥ janaḥ yaḥ kaścid jantuḥ iti eva mayi buddhiḥ na tu apatyam iti sneha leśaḥ api iti bhāvaḥ narendrasya citta anurañjana upakaraṇa dravya tayā eva aham tava upayuktā maṇi suvarṇa ādi vat na tu punar ātmaja ityādi atra draṣṭavyam mādhavaḥ sa ākūtam sa abhiprāyam nādaḥ iti

original: vikalā bhayodvignā yā kurarī krauñcavadhūstasyāḥ kūjitavatsnigdho masṛṇastāraśca mālatīdhvaniriva cittākarṣī manohāryayaṃ nādastāvatprathamaṃ paricita iva pūrvamanubhūta iva śrotrasaṃvādaṃ pūrvaṃ vyāghrāvaskandanasamaye makarandavipattivihvalāyā mālatyā yo dhvanirmayānubhūtaḥ sa evāyamiti pratyabhijñāgocaratvameti gacchati/
analyzed: vikalā bhaya udvignā yā kurarī krauñca vadhūḥ tasyāḥ kūjita vat snigdhaḥ masṛṇaḥ tāraḥ ca mālatī dhvaniḥ iva citta ākarṣī manohārī ayam nādaḥ tāvat prathamam paricitaḥ iva pūrvam anubhūtaḥ iva śrotra saṃvādam pūrvam vyāghra avaskandana samaye makaranda vipatti vihvalāyāḥ mālatyāḥ yaḥ dhvaniḥ mayā anubhūtaḥ saḥ eva ayam iti pratyabhijñā gocara tvam eti gacchati

original: daivādāgatya mocayedvā/ tadā kaṣṭaṃ mantrasādhanapratyūhaḥ saṃbhāvita iti viṣādaḥ// ``taṃ bhadre'' iti ślokasyottarārdham - cāmuṇḍe bhagavatīti/ mantrasādhanasyādāvupakramasamaya uddiṣṭāṃ saṃkalpitāmidānīṃ tatparyavasāna upanihitāṃ samarpitāṃ pūjāṃ strīratnopahāraṃ bhajasveti//25//

original: mādhavaḥ/ khaḍgaṃ kāpālikasyodyataṃ prakoṣṭhena maṇibandhena vikṣipyāpasārya/ apehyapasara/ pratihato'si vaiparītyena tvameva hato'si// mālatī/ paritrāyatāṃ mahābhāgaḥ// mādhavaḥ/ maraṇasamaya iti/ tyaktāśaṅkā yasminkarmaṇi tattathā/ pralāpe'narthakavacojalpane idānīmevainaṃ saṃhariṣyāmītyevaṃrūpe nirargalo niṣpratirodhaḥ/

original: mahānubhāvāḥ khalūpakāraṃ kurvantyeva na tu vacanapūrvakaṃ kurvantīti vacanasyānarthakyam/ yadyapyevaṃ kariṣyāmīti na vaktavyaṃ/ kevalaṃ kartavyameva/ tathāpīdṛśyāṃ durdaśāyāṃ priyāyāḥ prāṇatrāṇena majjanmano'tīva sāphalyamāsāditamiti harṣabharavaśena manasyavadhāritatvāllāghavaśaṅkāmapi visṛjyānarthakameva kiṃcitpralapitamiti bhāvaḥ/
analyzed: mahā anubhāvāḥ khalu upakāram kurvanti eva na tu vacana pūrvakam kurvanti iti vacanasya ānarthakyam yadi api evam kariṣyāmi iti na vaktavyam kevalam kartavyam eva tathā api īdṛśyām durdaśāyām priyāyāḥ prāṇa trāṇena mad janmanā utīva sāphalyam āsāditam iti harṣa bhara vaśena manasi avadhārita tvāt lāghava śaṅkām api visṛjya anarthakam eva kiṃcid pralapitam iti bhāvaḥ

original: tathā prakaṭito nijaḥ sahajaḥ sneho yena so'yaṃ te sakhā purata eva vartate/ ataḥ sutanu, utkampaṃ bhayanimittaṃ vepathuṃ visṛja/ saṃpratyevāsau pāpaḥ pāpakārīhaiva tavaiva purataḥ pratīpaṃ viparītaṃ yathā tathā vipākaḥ phalārambho yasya tādṛśasya pāpmanaḥ phalamanubhavati/ tvadvadhodyamenāyaṃ svayameva hata ityarthaḥ//26//
analyzed: tathā prakaṭitaḥ nijaḥ sahajaḥ snehaḥ yena saḥ ayam te sakhā puratas eva vartate atas su tano utkampam bhaya nimittam vepathum visṛja saṃprati eva asau pāpaḥ pāpa kārī iha eva tava eva puratas pratīpam viparītam yathā tathā vipākaḥ phala ārambhaḥ yasya tādṛśasya pāpmanaḥ phalam anubhavati tvad vadha udyamena ayam svayam eva hataḥ iti arthaḥ

original: aghoraghaṇṭaḥ/ antarāyaḥ pratyūhaḥ/ kapālakuṇḍalā/ asyāḥ snehasya bhūmirekālambanamityanenāvaśyaṃ rakṣaṇīyeyamiti sūcitam/ kāmandakīsuhṛtputra ityanena mahāyoginyāstasyāḥ prasādādasminnāsmākaṃ maṇimantramāyādikaṃ prabhavatīti sūcitam/ mahāmāṃsasya paṇayitetyanenātiśūratvānna pauruṣeṇāpyasau sādhya iti darśayati/ mādhavaḥ - sāsramiti/
analyzed: aghoraghaṇṭaḥ antarāyaḥ pratyūhaḥ kapāla kuṇḍalāḥ asyāḥ snehasya bhūmiḥ eka ālambanam iti anena avaśyam rakṣaṇīyā iyam iti sūcitam kāmandakī suhṛd putraḥ iti anena mahā yoginyāḥ tasyāḥ prasādāt asmin na asmākam maṇi mantra māyā ādikam prabhavati iti sūcitam mahāmāṃsasya paṇayitā iti anena ati śūra tvāt na pauruṣeṇa api asau sādhyaḥ iti darśayati mādhavaḥ sa asram iti

original: ānandaviṣādābhyāṃ sāsratvam/ kimetat/ tatkathamasāvanarthopanipāta ityarthaḥ// mālatī/ mahābhāga, ahamapi na jānāmi etāvajjānāmi/ uparyalindameva prasupteha pratibuddhāsmi/ yūyaṃ punaḥ kva/ samāgatā iti śeṣaḥ// mādhavaḥ - salajjamiti/ svasyānucitaṃ svenācaritaṃ karma nṛmāṃsavikrayarūpaṃ nivedanīyaṃ jātamiti lajjāhetuḥ/

original: tvatprāptipratyāśayānucitamapi kṛtamiti dhārṣṭyamavalambyāha - tvaditi/ tvatpāṇipaṅkajaparigraheṇa dhanyajanmā bhūyāsamityanenābhiniveśenābhiṣaṅgeṇa kadarthyamāno dhairyamapasārya cāpalāpādanena vitathīkriyamāṇo'haṃ nṛmāṃsapaṇanāya vikrayāya paretabhūmau śmaśāne bhrāmyan/ he bhīru, tava ruditānyākarṇya samāgato'smīti/

analyzed: svarūpa siddhiḥ tu ive pratikṛtau iti iva artha prakaraṇe kuśa agrāt śaḥ iti atas chaḥ iti anuvartamāne samāsāt ca tad viṣayāt iti tad śabdena iva arthaḥ parāmṛśyate iva artha viṣayāt samāsāt iva arthe chaḥ bhavati iti sūtra arthaḥ nanu samāsena eva tad viṣayeṇa iva artha abhidhānāt kim pratyayena iti ced mā evam samāsa viṣayāt iva arthāt anyasmin iva arthe pratyaya utpattiḥ

original: tathā krodhena kathamayaṃ pāpakārī niraparādhinīṃ tribhuvanaratnabhūtāmimāmapīdānīṃ hantuṃ samudyataḥ, tasmādavaśyameṣa hantavya ityevaṃrūpādraudrarasasthāyinā/ ``pratikūleṣu taikṣṇyasya prakarṣaḥ krodha iṣyate'' ityevaṃlakṣaṇena jvalitaṃ raudrarasenoddīpitam/
analyzed: tathā krodhena katham ayam pāpa kārī niraparādhinīm tribhuvana ratna bhūtām imām api idānīm hantum samudyataḥ tasmāt avaśyam eṣa hantavyaḥ iti evaṃrūpāt raudra rasa sthāyinā pratikūleṣu taikṣṇyasya prakarṣaḥ krodhaḥ iṣyate iti evaṃlakṣaṇena jvalitam raudra rasena uddīpitam

original: tathā mudā matprāṇebhyo'pi garīyasīṃ priyāṃ parirakṣya kṛtārtho bhavāmītyādibahuprakārayā ratyā manaḥprasādarūpayā pradhānaśṛṅgārarasasthāyinyā vikasitaṃ rasāsvādena vistāramupagatam/ kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa vartate/ kathaṃcidetādṛśī daśāsyeti nirūpayituṃ na śakyata iti bhāvaḥ/
analyzed: tathā mudā mad prāṇebhyaḥ api garīyasīm priyām parirakṣya kṛtārthaḥ bhavāmi ityādi bahu prakārayā ratyā manaḥ prasāda rūpayā pradhāna śṛṅgāra rasa sthāyinyā vikasitam rasa āsvādena vistāram upagatam katham kena prakāreṇa vartate kathaṃcid etādṛśī daśā āsyā iti nirūpayitum na śakyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: atra ca prabandhapravṛttā mādhavasya mālatīgocarā ratiḥ preyasīmiti nirdiṣṭenālambanavibhāvena vibhāvyamānā tadavalokanādibhiruddīpitā manovikāsapriyavacanatadrakṣaṇavyāpārādibhiranubhāvairvāṅmanaḥśarīrārambharūpairanubhāvyamānā taddarśanajanitairmadaśramaharṣacintāsmṛtyādibhirvyabhicāribhirupacitā rasatāmāpannā prādhānyena dhvanyate/
analyzed: atra ca prabandha pravṛttā mādhavasya mālatī gocarā ratiḥ preyasīm iti nirdiṣṭena ālambana vibhāvena vibhāvyamānā tad avalokana ādibhiḥ uddīpitā manaḥ vikāsa priya vacana tad rakṣaṇa vyāpāra ādibhiḥ anubhāvaiḥ vāc manaḥ śarīra ārambha rūpaiḥ anubhāvyamānā tad darśana janitaiḥ mada śrama harṣa cintā smṛti ādibhiḥ vyabhicāribhiḥ upacitā rasa tām āpannā prādhānyena dhvanyate
