original: tadaṅgatayā tu rāhorānanacarīṃ candrakalāmivetyupamāsūcitabhīṣaṇākārakāpālikālambanastatsvarūpavibhāvanoddīpita ātaṅkapadanirdiṣṭabhayasthāyī vikalapadasūcitamanovaiklavyatadanuguṇaśarīravāgārambhānubhāvastanniyatakampaśaṅkānirvedaglānijāḍyadīnatāvegaviṣādonmādacintāmohādibhirvyabhicāribhiḥ pratīyamānairupacito bhayānakarasaḥ/
analyzed: tad aṅga tayā tu rāhoḥ ānana carīm candra kalām iva iti upamā sūcita bhīṣaṇa ākāra kāpālikā ālambanaḥ tad svarūpa vibhāvanā uddīpitaḥ ātaṅka pada nirdiṣṭa bhaya sthāyī vikala pada sūcita manaḥ vaiklavya tad anuguṇa śarīra vāc ārambha anubhāvaḥ tad niyata kampa śaṅkā nirveda glāni jāḍya dīna tā vega viṣāda unmāda cintā moha ādibhiḥ vyabhicāribhiḥ pratīyamānaiḥ upacitaḥ bhayānaka rasaḥ

original: tathā dasyoḥ kṛpāṇapātaviṣayāditi sūcitamṛtaprāyapriyatamālambanastaddurdaśāparibhāvanoddīpitaḥ karuṇayeti nirdiṣṭaḥ śokasthāyībhāvo drutamiti nirdiṣṭacittadravībhāvataducitaśarīravāgārambhānubhāvatanniyatāśruvaivarṇyavaisvaryajāḍyāvegamohonmādaviṣādādibhirvyabhicāribhiḥ pratīyamānaiḥ paripoṣaṃ gataḥ karuṇarasaśca/
analyzed: tathā dasyoḥ kṛpāṇa pāta viṣayāt iti sūcita mṛta prāya priyatama ālambanaḥ tad durdaśā paribhāvanā uddīpitaḥ karuṇayā iti nirdiṣṭaḥ śoka sthāyībhāvaḥ drutam iti nirdiṣṭa citta dravībhāva tad ucita śarīra vāc ārambha anubhāva tad niyata aśru vaivarṇya vaisvarya jāḍya āvega moha unmāda viṣāda ādibhiḥ vyabhicāribhiḥ pratīyamānaiḥ paripoṣam gataḥ karuṇa rasaḥ ca

original: tathā daivādāsādyeti sūcitayādṛcchikasamāgamālambanataddhetuvidhivaicitryapariśīlanoddīpito vismayāditi nirdiṣṭādbhutasthāyībhāvo vikṣobhitamiti manovikṣobhataducitaśarīravāgārambhānubhāvastanniyatastambhapralayasvedaharṣagarvasmṛtivitarkavibodhacintādibhirvyabhicāribhirupacito'dbhutarasaśca/
analyzed: tathā daivāt āsādya iti sūcita yādṛcchika samāgama ālambana tad hetu vidhi vaicitrya pariśīlana uddīpitaḥ vismayāt iti nirdiṣṭa adbhuta sthāyībhāvaḥ vikṣobhitam iti manaḥ vikṣobha tad ucita śarīra vāc ārambha anubhāvaḥ tad niyata stambha pralaya sveda harṣa garva smṛti vitarka vibodha cintā ādibhiḥ vyabhicāribhiḥ upacita udbhuta rasaḥ ca

original: tathācchindata iti sūcitaḥ priyāvadhodyatahantavya ityālambanastaddaurātmyavimarśanoddīpito jvalitamiti manojvalanataducitavāgārambhānubhāvatanniyatastambharomāñcasvedaharṣāvegabhramonmādamadaharṣacāpalāsūyāśramāmarṣādibhirvyabhicāribhiḥ sarvatra kathaṃ vartata ityanena sūcitairupacito raudrarasaścetyete rasā aṅgabhāvāpattyeva dūrato
analyzed: tathā ācchindataḥ iti sūcitaḥ priyā vadha udyata hantavyaḥ iti ālambanaḥ tad daurātmya vimarśana uddīpitaḥ jvalitam iti manaḥ jvalana tad ucita vāc ārambha anubhāva tad niyata stambha romāñca sveda harṣa āvega bhrama unmāda mada harṣa cāpala asūyā śrama amarṣa ādibhiḥ vyabhicāribhiḥ sarvatra katham vartate iti anena sūcitaiḥ upacitaḥ raudra rasaḥ ca iti ete rasāḥ aṅga bhāva āpattyā iva dūratas

original: nirastaparasparavirodhāḥ pradhānarasāpekṣayāvirodhāḥ/ pradhānarasaparipoṣāpekṣayā nyūnarasaparipoṣatvena ślāghanīyaucityanibandhanāvyatikarākhyayā śobhanākhyayā ca melanagatyā śṛṅgāreṇa saha saṃkīrtyante/ yathāha - ``samakālasamutpannaistribhirdvābhyāmathāpi vā/ rasaścedvyatikīryeta samavyatikaraḥ smṛtaḥ//
analyzed: nirasta paraspara virodhāḥ pradhāna rasa apekṣayā avirodhāḥ pradhāna rasa paripoṣa apekṣayā nyūna rasa paripoṣa tvena ślāghanīya aucitya nibandhana avyatikara ākhyayā śobhana ākhyayā ca melana gatyā śṛṅgāreṇa saha saṃkīrtyante yathā āha sama kāla samutpannaiḥ tribhiḥ dvābhyām atha api vā rasaḥ ced vyatikīryeta sama vyatikaraḥ smṛtaḥ

original: virodhe mitraśatrūṇāṃ rasānāṃ saṃkare'pi ca/ mahimnā śobhate svena yaḥ sa śobhana īritaḥ//'' ityalamatikathanena//28//
analyzed: virodhe mitra śatrūṇām rasānām saṃkare api ca mahimnā śobhate svena yaḥ sa śobhanaḥ īritaḥ iti alam ati kathanena

original: aghoraghaṇṭaḥ/ brāhmaṇaḍimbha/ vipratvācchiśutvācca bhīrusvabhāvatayā pauruṣaśūnyetyarthaḥ/ vyāghrāghrātetyādi/ vyāghreṇāghrātāyāṃ gṛhītāyāṃ mṛgyāṃ hariṇyāṃ kṛpākulaḥ kṛpāluryo mṛgo hariṇastannyāyena hiṃsāruceranavaratahiṃsāparasya prāṇināmupahārasya sādhakaiḥ kriyamāṇasya ketanamāsthānaṃ karālāsthānaṃ tajjuṣaḥ sevamānasya me gocaraṃ viṣayaṃ
analyzed: aghora ghaṇṭaḥ brāhmaṇa ḍimbha vipra tvāt śiśu tvāt ca bhīru svabhāva tayā pauruṣa śūnyā iti arthaḥ vyāghra āghrāta ityādi vyāghreṇa āghrātāyām gṛhītāyām mṛgyām hariṇyām kṛpā ākulaḥ kṛpāluḥ yaḥ mṛgaḥ hariṇaḥ tad nyāyena hiṃsā ruceḥ anavarata hiṃsā parasya prāṇinām upahārasya sādhakaiḥ kriyamāṇasya ketanam āsthānam karāla āsthānam tad juṣaḥ sevamānasya me gocaram viṣayam

original: prāpto'si gato'si/ yathā mṛgyāṃ dayālurmṛgo vyāghreṇa hanyate, tathā tvamapyasyāṃ mayopahārārthamānītāyāṃ dayālurmayā vadhyasa iti bhāvaḥ/ pāpeti prārabdhakarmapratyūhakāritvānmādhavasya saṃbodhanam/
analyzed: prāptaḥ asi gataḥ asi yathā mṛgyām dayāluḥ mṛgaḥ vyāghreṇa hanyate tathā tvam api asyām mayā upahāra artham ānītāyām dayāluḥ mayā vadhyase iti bhāvaḥ pāpa iti prārabdha karma pratyūha kāri tvāt mādhavasya saṃbodhanam

original: so'haṃ pūrvaṃ khaḍgāhatyā vyastaskandhaṃ vikṣiptaskandhaṃ yatkabandhaṃ vigataśiraskaṃ tasya randhrebhyo rudhiraprāgbhāraṃ raktapravāhaṃ niṣyandate varṣatīti tathoktena bhavataiva bhūtānāṃ jananīṃ mātaraṃ bhadrakālīmṛdhnomi prīṇayāmi/ paścādanayeti śeṣaḥ//29//
analyzed: sā u ham pūrvam khaḍga āhatyā vyasta skandham vikṣipta skandham yat kabandham vigata śiraskam tasya randhrebhyaḥ rudhira prāgbhāram rakta pravāham nisyandate varṣati iti tathā uktena bhavatā eva bhūtānām jananīm mātaram bhadrakālīm ṛdhnomi prīṇayāmi paścāt anayā iti śeṣaḥ

original: mādhavaḥ/ asāramiti/ aye durātmanpākhaṇḍacaṇḍāla, kathamevaṃ vidhātuṃ vyavasito'syudyukto'si/ kiṃ vidhātumityapekṣāyāmāha - saṃsāramākīṭamāvirañcaṃ devatiryaṅmanuṣyādivividhavicitraprāṇivargasya jananajīvanamaraṇatattaddeśakālocitaśarīraparigrahatattaccharīrānurūpasukhaduḥkhādyanubhavādivyāpārapravāhādicchedena saṃtanyamānaṃ prapañcamasāraṃ
analyzed: mādhavaḥ asāram iti aye durātman pākhaṇḍa caṇḍāla katham evam vidhātum vyavasitaḥ asi udyuktaḥ asi kim vidhātum iti apekṣāyām āha saṃsāram ākīṭam āvirañcam deva tiryak manuṣya ādi vividha vicitra prāṇi vargasya janana jīvana maraṇa tad tad deśa kāla ucita śarīra parigraha tad tad śarīra anurūpa sukha duḥkha ādi anubhava ādi vyāpāra pravāha ādi chedena saṃtanyamānam prapañcam asāram

original: parārdhyavastuśūnyaṃ kartuṃ kathaṃ vyavasitavānasīti sarvatra saṃbadhyate/ ayaṃ hi saṃsāraḥ satsvapi candanacāmīkarādiṣu padārtheṣu tairna sāravān/ kiṃtvanayaiva sārabhūtayā/ asyāṃ ca tvayā nihatāyāṃ kevalamṛjīṣakalpo'yaṃ niḥsāra eva syāt/ tadimāṃ hantumudyatastvaṃ saṃsāramevāsāraṃ kartumudyato'sītyarthaḥ/
analyzed: parārdhya vastu śūnyam kartum katham vyavasitavān asi iti sarvatra saṃbadhyate ayam hi saṃsāraḥ satsu api candana cāmīkara ādiṣu padārtheṣu taiḥ na sāravān kiṃtu anayā eva sāra bhūtayā asyām ca tvayā nihatāyām kevalam ṛjīṣa kalpaḥ yam niḥsāraḥ eva syāt tat imām hantum udyataḥ tvam saṃsāram eva asāram kartum udyatā usi iti arthaḥ

original: atra viṣayanigaraṇena mālatyāṃ sakalasaṃsāraikasāravastutvasyādhyavasitatvāt ``nigīryādhyavasānaṃ tatprakṛtasya pareṇa yat'' ityuktalakṣaṇādhyavasitaprayatnātiśayoktiḥ siddhavannirdiṣṭāyā vyavasāyakriyāyāḥ sarvatrānvayātkriyādīpakaṃ ca vācyālaṃkārau/ candanacāmīkarādīnāṃ na vastutaḥ sāratvam, kiṃtu pāmarajanaprasidhdyaiva/
analyzed: atra viṣaya nigaraṇena mālatyām sakala saṃsāra eka sāra vastu tvasya adhyavasita tvāt nigīrya adhyavasānam tat prakṛtasya pareṇa yat iti ukta lakṣaṇa adhyavasita prayatna atiśayoktiḥ siddha vat nirdiṣṭāyāḥ vyavasāya kriyāyāḥ sarvatra anvayāt kriyā dīpakam ca vācyālaṃkārau candana cāmīkara ādīnām na vastutas sāra tvam kiṃtu pāmara jana prasidhdyā eva

original: iyameva sārabhūtetyapahnavaḥ/ sarvasāravastūpamānāni yāni tebhyo'pi sārabhūteyameveti vyatirekaśca vyaṅgyāviti sarvatra draṣṭavyam/ tathā tribhuvanaṃ trayāṇāṃ bhuvanānāṃ samāhārastribhuvanam/ ``pātrādibhyaḥ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ'' iti vacanāt ``dvigoḥ'' iti ṅībna bhavati/ parimuṣitaṃ luṇṭhitaṃ ratnaṃ yasya tatkartum/
analyzed: iyam eva sāra bhūtā iti apahnavaḥ sarva sāra vastu upamānāni yāni tebhyaḥ api sāra bhūtā iyam eva iti vyatirekaḥ ca vyaṅgyau iti sarvatra draṣṭavyam tathā tribhuvanam trayāṇām bhuvanānām samāhāraḥ tribhuvanam pātra ādibhyaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ vaktavyaḥ iti vacanāt dvigoḥ iti ṅīp na bhavati parimuṣitam luṇṭhitam ratnam yasya tat kartum

original: satsvapi kaustubhakanakādiṣu na tai ratnavattribhuvanam/ na ca tāni vastuto ratnāni/ avivekināṃ tu tatra ratnatvavyapadeśaḥ samīcīnavastūpamānatvaprasiddhiśca/ iyameva tribhuvanasya sakalaratnātiśāyiguṇaśālinyekaṃ ratnamiti nigīryādhyavasānam/ tāṃ hantuṃ pravṛttaḥ/ ratnaśūnyameva jagatkartuṃ pravṛtto'sītyarthaḥ/ alaṃkārayogaḥ pūrvavat/
analyzed: satsu api kaustubha kanaka ādiṣu na taiḥ ratnavat tribhuvanam na ca tāni vastutas ratnāni avivekinām tu tatra ratna tva vyapadeśaḥ samīcīna vastu upamāna tva prasiddhiḥ ca iyam eva tribhuvanasya sakala ratna atiśāyi guṇa śālinī ekam ratnam iti nigīrya adhyavasānam tām hantum pravṛttaḥ ratna śūnyam eva jagat kartum pravṛttaḥ usi iti arthaḥ alaṃkāra yogaḥ pūrvavat

original: tathā lokaṃ pramāṇaṣaṭkapathapathikaṃ prapañcaṃ nirālokaṃ prakāśaśūnyaṃ kevalamandhakārākrāntaṃ kartum/ na khalu saurādibhirālokaiḥ sāloko'yaṃ lokaḥ/ teṣāṃ jaḍarūpāṇāṃ prakāśāntaraprakāśyatvenābhāsatvāt/ anayaiva punarānandaikarasasaṃvinmayaprakāśātmikayā tribhuvanabhavanalokottararatnapradīpakalikayā samudbhāsito'yaṃ sasūryacandrāditejasko lokaḥ/
analyzed: tathā lokam pramāṇa ṣaṭka patha pathikam prapañcam nirālokam prakāśa śūnyam kevalam andhakāra ākrāntam kartum na khalu saura ādibhiḥ ālokaiḥ sa ālokaḥ yam lokaḥ teṣām jaḍa rūpāṇām prakāśa antara prakāśya tvena ābhāsa tvāt anayā eva punar ānanda eka rasa saṃvid maya prakāśa ātmikayā tribhuvana bhavana lokottara ratna pradīpa kalikayā samudbhāsita uyam sa sūrya candra ādi tejaskaḥ lokaḥ

original: tadimāṃ nirvāpayitukāmaḥ/ jagadandhaṃ kartukāmo'sītyarthaḥ/ tathā bāndhavajanaṃ sakalamapi bandhuvargametadekajīvitaṃ maraṇameva śaraṇametadvipattijanitaśokanirākaraṇasamarthaṃ yasya tattādṛśaṃ kartum/ idaṃ cāvāntaravākyaṃ sahacarabhinnam/
analyzed: tat imām nirvāpayitu kāmaḥ jagat andham kartu kāmaḥ asi iti arthaḥ tathā bāndhava janam sakalam api bandhu vargam etat eka jīvitam maraṇam eva śaraṇam etad vipatti janita śoka nirākaraṇa samartham yasya tat tādṛśam kartum idam ca avāntara vākyam sahacara bhinnam

original: iha hi mahāvākyarūpe śloke'sāraṃ saṃsāramityādibhiravāntaravākyairmālatyāḥ sakalalokātiśāyilāvaṇyādiguṇaśālitvena sarvapadārthotkarṣatvaṃ tadanvayavyatirekābhyāmeva lokasyopādeyatvānvayavyatirekau cetyetāvadbhaṅgivaicitryeṇa prauḍhoktiyuktyā ca nirūpyate/ tatra cānena vākyena mālatyā utkarṣo na pratipādyate/
analyzed: iha hi mahāvākya rūpe śloke sāram saṃsāram ityādibhiḥ avāntaravākyaiḥ mālatyāḥ sakala loka atiśāyi lāvaṇya ādi guṇa śāli tvena sarva padārtha utkarṣa tvam tad anvaya vyatirekābhyām eva lokasya upādeya tva anvaya vyatirekau ca iti etāvat bhaṅgi vaicitryeṇa prauḍhā ukti yuktyā ca nirūpyate tatra ca anena vākyena mālatyāḥ utkarṣaḥ na pratipādyate

original: bāndhavā hi kāṇakubjaduḥśīlāpatyanāśe'pi maraṇaśaraṇā bhavanti/ na ca tadanvayāllokasyopādeyatā kadācit/ nāpi tadvyatirekādanupādeyatvam/ bahutaraśreṣṭhavastupracuratvādeva tadupādānasiddheḥ/
analyzed: bāndhavāḥ hi kāṇa kubja duḥśīla apatya nāśe pi maraṇa śaraṇāḥ bhavanti na ca tad anvayāt lokasya upādeya tā kadācid nā api tad vyatirekāt anupādeya tvam bahutara śreṣṭha vastu pracura tvāt eva tad upādāna siddheḥ

original: tataścātyutkarṣapratipādakavākyamadhye taddvijātīyatayā sahacarairbhinnaṃ tannikṛṣṭatvādviruddhamidaṃ vākyaṃ ṣāṇmāsikamuktāphalagrathitahāralatāmadhye varāṭikeva nāyakatvena niveśanaṃ nārhati prakramabhaṅgaśca syāt/ prakrāntātiśayoktyādyalaṃkārāṇāmuparyupari nibaddhānāmakāṇḍe vicchedāt/
analyzed: tatas ca ati utkarṣa pratipādaka vākya madhye tad dvijātīya tayā sahacaraiḥ bhinnam tat nikṛṣṭa tvāt viruddham idam vākyam ṣāṇmāsika muktāphala grathita hāralatā madhye varāṭikā iva nāyaka tvena niveśanam nā arhati prakrama bhaṅgaḥ ca syāt prakrānta atiśayokti ādi alaṃkārāṇām upari upari nibaddhānām akāṇḍe vicchedāt

original: kecittu janamityudāsīnavācinā janaśabdena mādhavaḥ preyasīvināśaduḥkhottaraṇopāyāntaramapaśyantaṃ maraṇameva tadupāyatvenādhigacchantamātmānaṃ nirdiśati/ tena tannāśe svasya maraṇameveti tallāvaṇyātiśayaprakāśanānnoktadoṣa iti vyācakṣate/ tadasat/ bāndhavajanamityukte svanirdeśasya kathaṃcidapyapratīteḥ pratītau vā naitāvatā tasyā utkarṣaḥ/
analyzed: kecid tu janam iti udāsīna vācinā jana śabdena mādhavaḥ preyasī vināśa duḥkha uttaraṇa upāya antaram apaśyantam maraṇam eva tad upāya tvena adhigacchantam ātmānam nirdiśati tena tad nāśe svasya maraṇam eva iti tad lāvaṇya atiśaya prakāśanāt na ukta doṣaḥ iti vyācakṣate tat asat bāndhava janam iti ukte sva nirdeśasya kathaṃcid api apratīteḥ pratītau vā na etāvatā tasyāḥ utkarṣaḥ

original: sarvo rāgāndhaḥ svahṛdayābhimatameva vastvadhamabhūtamapi sarvalokottaramityabhimanyate/ tathā hi - ``yā yasyābhimatā loke sā tasyādhikarūpiṇī'' iti/ ata eva cakravāko'pi svapriyāvirahe jagadeva śūnyamākalayaṃstāneva lokottarasaundaryaśālinīṃ manyata iti tiryakṣvapi prasiddham/
analyzed: sarvaḥ rāga andhaḥ sva hṛdaya abhimatam eva vastu adhama bhūtam api sarva loka uttaram iti abhimanyate tathā hi yā yasya abhimatā loke sā tasya adhika rūpiṇī iti atas eva cakravākaḥ api sva priyā virahe jagat eva śūnyam ākalayan tān eva loka uttara saundarya śālinīm manyate iti tiryakṣu api prasiddham

original: na cātrāpi mādhavābhimānamātrasiddhameva tasyā lokottaratvamiti vācyaṃ mā bhūt/ prabandharasāsvādayitṝṇāṃ sahṛdayānāmanyathābhāvapratītyānaucityasphuraṇādrasāsvādabhaṅgaḥ/ na ca svābhimānena tasyā ślāghyatve'pi na tāvatā tatsattvāsattvābhyāṃ jagato'sti kaścidviśeṣa ityupekṣaṇīyamevaitat/
analyzed: na ca atra api mādhava abhimāna mātra siddham eva tasyāḥ lokottara tvam iti vācyam mā bhūt prabandha rasa āsvādayitṝṇām sahṛdayānām anyathābhāva pratītyā anaucitya sphuraṇāt rasa āsvāda bhaṅgaḥ na ca sva abhimānena tasyāḥ ślāghya tve pi na tāvatā tad sattva asattvābhyām jagatoḥ sti kaścid viśeṣaḥ iti upekṣaṇīyam eva etat

original: ato ``vidhivilasitaṃ sarvamaphalam'' iti paṭhanīyamiti kuntakaprabhṛtayaḥ kāvyatattvajñāḥ sahṛdayāḥ/ evaṃ hi nāvadyaleśo'pi/ anādau hyasāre saṃsāre manoharataravastusṛṣṭau pravṛttasya vidheryo vilāso vyāpāro na tasya candrādinirmāṇaṃ phalam/ teṣāṃ tucchatayā tādṛśavidhiprayāsaphalatvāyogāt/ apitviyameva tasya phalamiti nigīryādhyavasānam/
analyzed: atas vidhi vilasitam sarvam aphalam iti paṭhanīyam iti kuntaka prabhṛtayaḥ kāvya tattva jñāḥ sahṛdayāḥ evam hi na avadya leśaḥ api anādau hi asāre saṃsāre manoharatara vastu sṛṣṭau pravṛttasya vidheḥ yaḥ vilāsaḥ vyāpāraḥ na tasya candra ādi nirmāṇam phalam teṣām tuccha tayā tādṛśa vidhi prayāsa phalatva ayogāt apitu iyam eva tasya phalam iti nigīrya adhyavasānam

original: tadetatphalamakāṇḍe hantumudyuktastvam/ vidhātṛvyāpārameva niṣphalaṃ kartumudyata ityarthaḥ/ tathā kandarpamadarpaṃ darpaśūnyaṃ kartum/ tasya hi satsvapi mandānilacandanacandrikādibhāveṣu na tānavalambya trilocanāvadhikāṃ trilokīmahaṃ jeṣyāmīti darpasteṣāṃ tatsahakāraśaktyabhāvāt/
analyzed: tat etat phalam akāṇḍe hantum udyuktaḥ tvam vidhātṛ vyāpāram eva niṣphalam kartum udyataḥ iti arthaḥ tathā kandarpam adarpam darpa śūnyam kartum tasya hi satsu api manda anila candana candrikā ādi bhāveṣu na tān avalambya trilocanau adhikām trilokīm aham jeṣyāmi iti darpaḥ teṣām tad sahakāra śakti abhāvāt

original: kiṃtvimāmevāpratihatāṃ nijāṃ śaktimavalambya na me kaścittrilokyāṃ pratibhaṭo'sti, ahameka eva vīra iti tasya darpaḥ/ tāmimāṃ hantukāmaḥ kandarpameva darpaśūnyaṃ nirutsāhaṃ kartukāmo'sītyarthaḥ/ tathā janānāṃ nayananirmāṇamaphalaṃ phalahīnaṃ kartum/ niratiśayasaundaryaśālivastudarśanameva hi nayananirmāṇasya phalam/
analyzed: kiṃtu imām eva apratihatām nijām śaktim avalambya na me kaścid trilokyām pratibhaṭaḥ asti aham ekaḥ eva vīraḥ iti tasya darpaḥ tām imām hantu kāmaḥ kandarpam eva darpa śūnyam nirutsāham kartu kāmaḥ asi iti arthaḥ tathā janānām nayana nirmāṇam aphalam phala hīnam kartum niratiśaya saundarya śāli vastu darśanam eva hi nayana nirmāṇasya phalam

original: na ca vastvantaradarśanaṃ phalaṃ tasya/ etādṛśasaundaryaśālino'nyasyābhāvāt/ iyameva lāvaṇyāsārasīmā tasya phalamiti tadvināśe netranirmāṇameva vandhyaṃ syādityarthaḥ/ tathā jagajjīrṇaṃ jaracchuṣkakaṇṭakakoṭarādiduṣprekṣavṛkṣamaraṇyaṃ krūrasatvarākṣasapulindādibhīṣaṇaṃ kāntāraṃ kartum/
analyzed: na ca vastu antara darśanam phalam tasya etādṛśa saundarya śālinaḥ nyasya abhāvāt iyam eva lāvaṇya āsāra sīmā tasya phalam iti tad vināśe netra nirmāṇam eva vandhyam syāt iti arthaḥ tathā jagat jīrṇam jarat śuṣka kaṇṭaka koṭara ādi duṣprekṣa vṛkṣam araṇyam krūra sattva rākṣasa pulinda ādi bhīṣaṇam kāntāram kartum

original: idaṃ hi jagadvanamanayaiva hi pramadavanavasantaśriyātisukumāravividhatarulatākusumavāsanāsurabhīkṛtaṃ sakalasaṃtāpanivārakamānandānubhavaikabhūmiḥ pramadodyānamabhūt/ na tu bhāvairanyairanīdṛśaguṇagaṇojjvalaiḥ/ tadimāṃ kathāvaśeṣitāṃ kartumicchatā jagadidamatyudvegadāyi bhayaṃkaramaraṇyameva kevalaṃ cikīrṣitamityarthaḥ/
analyzed: idam hi jagat vanam anayā eva hi pramada vana vasanta śriyā ati su kumāra vividha taru latā kusuma vāsanā surabhīkṛtam sakala saṃtāpa nivārakam ānanda anubhava eka bhūmiḥ pramada udyānam abhūt na tu bhāvaiḥ anyaiḥ anīdṛśa guṇa gaṇa ujjvalaiḥ tat imām kathā avaśeṣitām kartum icchatā jagat idam ati udvega dāyi bhayaṃkaram araṇyam eva kevalam cikīrṣitam iti arthaḥ

original: atra caikena vākyenotkarṣapratipādanāttasyaiva vākyāntarairapi pratipādanārthaṃ paunaruktyamāśaṅkya rasākṣiptavaktrā tasyaivārthasya prauḍhoktivaicitryena gambhīraviśeṣaṇopādānānna paunaruktyamiti bhojarājaḥ parijahāra/ yathāha - ``viśeṣaṇaṃ tu pūrvoktaṃ yadi bhūyo'pi kīrtyate/ tadekārthaṃ rasākṣiptaṃ tattasmāttu na dūṣyate//'' iti/
analyzed: atra ca ekena vākyena utkarṣa pratipādanāt tasya eva vākya antaraiḥ api pratipādana artham paunaruktyam āśaṅkya rasa ākṣipta vaktrā tasya eva arthasya prauḍha ukti vaicitryena gambhīra viśeṣaṇa upādānāt na paunaruktyam iti bhojarājaḥ parijahāra yathā āha viśeṣaṇam tu pūrva uktam yadi bhūyas api kīrtyate tat ekārtham rasa ākṣiptam tat tasmāt tu na dūṣyate iti

original: chekānuprāso'tra śabdālaṃkāraḥ/ ityalamalaṃkāragranthagauraveṇa//30//
analyzed: cheka anuprāsaḥ utra śabdālaṃkāraḥ iti alam alaṃkāra grantha gauraveṇa

original: praṇayeti/ praṇayasakhīnāṃ premāspadānāmālīnāṃ salīlo yaḥ parihāsaḥ krīḍāviśeṣaḥ kusumastabakaprahārādistatra rasena rāgeṇādhigataiḥ svecchayaiva labdhairlalitairatisukumāraiḥ śirīṣakusumairhananairapi kiṃ punaranyena kaṭhinadravyena yadvapustāmyati sadya eva mlāyate tatra vapuṣi vadhāya śastramupakṣipataḥ pātayatastava śirasyakasmādeva nipātī
analyzed: praṇaya iti praṇaya sakhīnām prema āspadānām ālīnām sa līlaḥ yaḥ parihāsaḥ krīḍā viśeṣaḥ kusuma stabaka prahāra ādiḥ tatra rasena rāgeṇa adhigataiḥ sva icchayā eva labdhaiḥ lalitaiḥ ati sukumāraiḥ śirīṣa kusumaiḥ hananaiḥ api kim punar anyena kaṭhina dravyena yat vapuḥ tāmyati sadyas eva mlāyate tatra vapuṣi vadhāya śastram upakṣipataḥ pātayataḥ tava śirasi akasmāt eva nipātī

original: yamadaṇḍaḥ kāladaṇḍa ivaiṣa bhujo vāmabāhuḥ patatviti samuddīpitakrodhasya mādhavasya raudrarasocito vāgārambhaḥ//31//
analyzed: yama daṇḍaḥ kāla daṇḍaḥ iva eṣa bhujaḥ vāma bāhuḥ patatu iti samuddīpita krodhasya mādhavasya raudra rasa ucitaḥ vāc ārambhaḥ

original: aghoraghaṇṭaḥ/ prahara prahareti/ paśyāmi tava pauruṣamityupahāsagarbhoktiḥ/ ayaṃ na bhavasīti mādhavasyeva saṃnihitatvenopacārātpurovartitvadharmiprādhānyenedaṃśabdenocyate/ anyonyamanyonyavadhasya niṣpannaprāyatayā niścitatvādvartamānasāmīpyena laḍubhayatrāpi// mālatī/ prasīda nātha sāhasika, dāruṇaḥ khalvayaṃ hatāśaḥ/ tatparitrāyasva mām/
analyzed: aghora ghaṇṭaḥ prahara prahara iti paśyāmi tava pauruṣam iti upahāsa garbha uktiḥ ayam na bhavasi iti mādhavasya iva saṃnihita tvena upacārāt purovarti tva dharmi prādhānyena idam śabdena ucyate anyonyam anyonya vadhasya niṣpanna prāya tayā niścita tvāt vartamāna sāmīpyena laṭ ubhayatra api mālatī prasīda nātha sāhasika dāruṇaḥ khalu ayam hata āśaḥ tat paritrāyasva mām

original: nivartatāmasmādanarthasaṃkaṭāt/ na mama strīmātrasya kṛte sakalalokamaulinā tvayā sāhasamācaraṇīyam/ yato'yaṃ dāruṇaḥ kiṃ kuryādvā/ tannivartasveti bhāvaḥ// kapālakuṇḍalā/ apramattaḥ sāvadhānaḥ// mādhavo mālatīmaghoraghaṇṭaśca kapālakuṇḍalāmekenobhābhyāṃ pāṭhyenobhayatrāpi tulyārthena ślokena samāśvāsayantau yugapadevāhatuḥ - mādhavāghoraghaṇṭau /
analyzed: nivartatām asmāt anartha saṃkaṭāt na mama strī mātrasya kṛte sakala loka maulinā tvayā sāhasam ācaraṇīyam yatas yam dāruṇaḥ kim kuryāt vā tat nivartasva iti bhāvaḥ kapāla kuṇḍalāḥ apramattaḥ sa avadhānaḥ mādhavaḥ mālatīm aghoraghaṇṭaḥ ca kapāla kuṇḍalām ekena ubhābhyām pāṭhyena ubhayatra api tulya arthena ślokena samāśvāsayantau yugapad eva āhatuḥ mādhava aghoraghaṇṭau

original: ayi bhīru, iti saṃbodhanamidamubhayorubhe prati/ dhairyamiti/ he bhīru strīsvabhāvasulabhasādhvase, hṛdaye dhairyaṃ nidhehi, mā kātaryaṃ gamaḥ/ hata eṣa pāpa ityubhābhyāmubhayornirdeśaḥ/ hata eva/ kathamatrāpi mama pramādamāśaṅkase/
analyzed: ayi bhīru iti saṃbodhanam idam ubhayoḥ ubhe prati dhairyam iti he bhīru strī svabhāva sulabha sādhvase hṛdaye dhairyam nidhehi mā kātaryam gamaḥ hataḥ eṣa pāpaḥ iti ubhābhyām ubhayoḥ nirdeśaḥ hataḥ eva katham atra api mama pramādam āśaṅkase

original: paśya kadācitkenacidvā sāraṅgasaṃhṛtividhau hariṇasaṃharaṇakṛtya ibhakumbhānāṃ kūṭasya saṅghasya kuṭṭākaḥ kuṭṭanaśīlaḥ/ ``jalpabhikṣakuṭṭaluṇṭhavṛṅaḥ ṣākan'' iti tācchīlye ṣākanpratyayaḥ/ pāṇikuliśasya pāṇireva kuliśaṃ kuliśamiva pāṇiryasya tādṛśasya hareḥ pramādaḥ kimanvabhāvi/ na kenacidanubhūtamityarthaḥ/
analyzed: paśya kadācid kenacid vā sāraṅga saṃhṛti vidhau hariṇa saṃharaṇa kṛtye ibha kumbhānām kūṭasya saṅghasya kuṭṭākaḥ kuṭṭana śīlaḥ jalpa bhikṣa kuṭṭa luṇṭha vṛṅaḥ iti tācchīlye ṣākan pratyayaḥ pāṇi kuliśasya pāṇiḥ eva kuliśam kuliśam iva pāṇiḥ yasya tādṛśasya hareḥ pramādaḥ kim anvabhāvi na kenacid anubhūtam iti arthaḥ

original: atra kṣudravipakṣapathe mama pramādo na saṃbhavatīti tadasaṃbhavalakṣaṇe vākyārthe hariṇapaterhareḥ pramādāsaṃbhavalakṣaṇo vākyārtho'dhyāropyamāṇaḥ sāraṅgavadhe siṃhasya pramādasaṃbhavena mamāpyetadvadhe pramādasaṃbhāvanetyupamānopameyabhāvaṃ parikalpayatīti ``asaṃbhavadharmasaṃbandha upamā parikalpitā'' ityuktalakṣaṇo nidarśanālaṃkāraḥ/
analyzed: atra kṣudra vipakṣa pathe mama pramādaḥ na saṃbhavati iti tad asaṃbhava lakṣaṇe vākya arthe hariṇa pateḥ hareḥ pramāda asaṃbhava lakṣaṇaḥ vākya arthaḥ adhyāropyamāṇaḥ sāraṅga vadhe siṃhasya pramāda saṃbhavena mama api etad vadhe pramāda saṃbhāvanā iti upamāna upameya bhāvam parikalpayati iti asaṃbhava dharma saṃbandhaḥ upamā parikalpitā iti ukta lakṣaṇaḥ nidarśana alaṃkāraḥ

original: kalakalaḥ kolāhalaḥ/ āśvāsayantī suśakunādinā duḥkhaṃ ślathayantī/ apratihatā kuṇṭhitā[apratihatākuṇṭhitā] prajñaiva cakṣuryasyāḥ sā bhagavatī kāmandakī samādiśati samājñāpayati/ kimiti/ paryavaṣṭabhyatāṃ pariveṣṭyatāmetatkarālāyatanam/ kimarthamityata āha - neti/
analyzed: kalakalaḥ kolāhalaḥ āśvāsayantī su śakuna ādinā duḥkham ślathayantī apratihatā kuṇṭhitā a pratihatā a kuṇṭhitā prajñā eva cakṣuḥ yasyāḥ sā bhagavatī kāmandakī samādiśati samājñāpayati kim iti paryavaṣṭabhyatām pariveṣṭyatām etat karāla āyatanam kimartham iti atas āha na iti

original: dāruṇādbhīṣaṇādaghoraghaṇṭādanyasmāttadvyatiriktādetanmālatyapaharaṇarūpaṃ karma nābhūt/ nāpi tadīyasya karmaṇo mantrasādhanārthaṃ karālopahārīkaraṇādanyaccāpi phalaṃ na vibhāvyate/ tasmāttenaiva kapālakuṇḍalayopahāritā devī balyarthamiti tadeva sthānaṃ vimṛśyatāmityājñāpayati bhagavatītyarthaḥ//33//
analyzed: dāruṇāt bhīṣaṇāt aghora ghaṇṭāt anyasmāt tad vyatiriktāt etat mālatī apaharaṇa rūpam karma na abhūt na api tadīyasya karmaṇaḥ mantra sādhana artham karāla upahārīkaraṇāt anyat ca api phalam na vibhāvyate tasmāt tena eva kapāla kuṇḍalayā upahāritā devī bali artham iti tat eva sthānam vimṛśyatām iti ājñāpayati bhagavatī iti arthaḥ

original: kapālakuṇḍalā/ bhagavan, paryavaṣṭabdhāḥ parivṛtā bhaṭaiḥ/ kimataḥparaṃ kartavyamiti kātaryoktiḥ// aghoraghaṇṭaḥ- saṃpratīti/ rakṣaṇārthamāgatānāmevāgrata evaṃ vyāpādayiṣyāmi/ tanna bhetavyaṃ tvayetyāśvāsanoktiḥ/ mālatī/ hā tāta, hā bhagavati// mādhavaḥ/
analyzed: kapāla kuṇḍalāḥ bhagavan paryavaṣṭabdhāḥ parivṛtāḥ bhaṭaiḥ kim atas param kartavyam iti kātarya uktiḥ aghora ghaṇṭaḥ saṃprati iti rakṣaṇa artham āgatānām eva agratas evam vyāpādayiṣyāmi tat na bhetavyam tvayā iti āśvāsana uktiḥ mālatī hā tāta hā bhagavati mādhavaḥ

original: bāndhavānāṃ rakṣaṇārthamāgatānāṃ samāje samūhe sukhena sthitāmenāṃ vidhāya paścānnaiścintyena yatnātteṣāmevāgrato haniṣyāmi/ yathā eka eva mālatīprāṇatrāṇanimittamasmatpurata evāsāvetaṃ durātmānaṃ hatvā mahāntamupakāraṃ kṛtavānityamātyāya nivedya tasya madarthaṃ mālatīpradāne rucimutpādayeyuriti bhāvaḥ/
analyzed: bāndhavānām rakṣaṇa artham āgatānām samāje samūhe sukhena sthitām enām vidhāya paścāt naiścintyena yatnāt teṣām eva agratas haniṣyāmi yathā ekaḥ eva mālatī prāṇa trāṇa nimittam asmad puratas eva asau etam durātmānam hatvā mahāntam upakāram kṛtavān iti amātyāya nivedya tasya mad artham mālatī pradāne rucim utpādayeyuḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: ekameva vākyamubhāvubhayoddeśena prayuñjāte - re re iti/ kaṭhoreti/ kaṭhorāḥ kaṭhinā ye'sthigranthayaḥ kīkasakūṭāni taiḥ saha vyatikareṇa tadabhighātena janito yo ghaṇātkāro'nukaraṇaśabdastena mukharaḥ/ tathā kharāṇāṃ snāyūnāṃ chedena kṣaṇamātraṃ janito vegasya vyuparamo viśrāntiryasya saḥ/
analyzed: ekam eva vākyam ubhau ubhaya uddeśena prayuñjāte re re iti kaṭhora iti kaṭhorāḥ kaṭhināḥ ye asthi granthayaḥ kīkasa kūṭāni taiḥ saha vyatikareṇa tad abhighātena janitaḥ yaḥ ghaṇātkāraḥ anukaraṇa śabdaḥ tena mukharaḥ tathā kharāṇām snāyūnām chedena kṣaṇa mātram janitaḥ vegasya vyuparamaḥ viśrāntiḥ yasya saḥ

original: tathā piśitakhaṇḍeṣvasthisnāyurahiteṣu māṃsakhaṇḍeṣu paṅkeṣviva nirātaṅko niṣpratirodho niṣpatannevaṃvidho'siḥ sapadi te gātraṃ gātraṃ pratyaṅgaṃ lavaśaḥ khaṇḍaśaḥ kṛtvā vikiratu dikṣu vikṣipatu/ bībhatsopaskṛto raudraraso vyajyate/ pratyakṣayuddhavarṇanasya niṣiddhatvānnoktam/ tatphalamagre sūcayiṣyate/
analyzed: tathā piśita khaṇḍeṣu asthi snāyu rahiteṣu māṃsa khaṇḍeṣu paṅkeṣu iva nirātaṅkaḥ niṣpratirodhaḥ niṣpatan evaṃvidhaḥ usiḥ sapadi te gātram gātram pratyaṅgam lavaśas khaṇḍaśas kṛtvā vikiratu dikṣu vikṣipatu bībhatsa upaskṛtaḥ raudra rasaḥ vyajyate pratyakṣa yuddha varṇanasya niṣiddha tvāt na uktam tad phalam agre sūcayiṣyate

original: yaduktam - ``dūrādhvānaṃ vadhaṃ yuddhaṃ rājyadeśādiviplavam/ saṃrodhaṃ bhojanaṃ snānaṃ surataṃ cānulepanam// ambaragrahaṇādīni pratyakṣāṇi na nirdiśet//'' iti//34//

original: kaviridānīmaṅkāntaramārabhamāṇo vṛttavartiṣyamāṇārthasūcanāyaikapātraprayojyaṃ śuddhaviṣkambhākhyamarthopakṣepakaṃ prastauti - tata ityādi/ kapālakuṇḍalā/ mālatīnimittaṃ vinipātito'smadgururyena tādṛśeti/

original: tādṛśena saṃbodhanena yuddhe mādhavenāghoraghaṇṭavadho, mālatyarthaṃ hi tvayāsmadgururnihatastanmālatyapaharaṇenaiva pratyupakariṣyāmīti kapālakuṇḍalābhiprāyaśca sūcyate/ tasminnavasare yuddhasamaye nirdayaṃ nighnatī strījātiprayuktaṃ bhīrutvaṃ parityajya guruvadhakopānniṣkaruṇaṃ praharantyahaṃ tvayā strītyavajñātāvadhīritā/
analyzed: tādṛśena saṃbodhanena yuddhe mādhavena aghora ghaṇṭa vadhaḥ mālatī artham hi tvayā asmad guruḥ nihataḥ tat mālatī apaharaṇena eva pratyupakariṣyāmi iti kapāla kuṇḍala abhiprāyaḥ ca sūcyate tasmin avasare yuddha samaye nirdayam nighnatī strī jāti prayuktam bhīru tvam parityajya guru vadha kopāt niṣkaruṇam praharantī aham tvayā strī iti avajñātā avadhīritā

original: tasmādavaśyaṃ madavajñāyāḥ phalamanubhaviṣyasīti/ asmadguruvadhapātakasya mayi baddhavairāyāṃ jāgratyāṃ kutaḥ sukhamityeva vākyārthe tadavaśyamityādivākyoktervākyārthāntaramasaṃbhavadvastusaṃbandhātmakamupamānopameyaparikalpitaṃ nidarśanālaṃkāracchāyayādhyāropayannāha - śāntiriti/ tasya bhujaṅgaśatrorāśīviṣasya hantuḥ śāntiḥ saukhyaṃ kutaḥ/
analyzed: tasmāt avaśyam mad avajñāyāḥ phalam anubhaviṣyasi iti asmad guru vadha pātakasya mayi baddhavairāyām jāgratyām kutas sukham iti eva vākya arthe tat avaśyam ityādi vākya ukteḥ vākya artha antaram asaṃbhavat vastu saṃbandha ātmakam upamāna upameya parikalpitam nidarśana alaṃkāra chāyayā adhyāropayan āha śāntiḥ iti tasya bhujaṅga śatroḥ āśīviṣasya hantuḥ śāntiḥ saukhyam kutas

original: yatra yasminnibaddhānuśayā dṛḍhatarabaddhavairātitīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrāgrā viṣodvamanabhīṣaṇā bhujaṅgī daṃśārthaṃ jāgarti sāvadhānā vartate/ tasyāḥ saukhyāsaṃbhavāttavāpi saukhyaṃ na saṃbhavatīti bhāvaḥ//1//
analyzed: yatra yasmin nibaddha anuśayā dṛḍhatara baddha vairā ati tīkṣṇa daṃṣṭra agrā viṣa udvamana bhīṣaṇā bhujaṅgī daṃśa artham jāgarti sa avadhānā vartate tasyāḥ saukhya asaṃbhavāt tava api saukhyam na saṃbhavati iti bhāvaḥ

original: vartiṣyamāṇaṃ sūcayati - bhorājāna iti/ he rājānaḥ sakaladigantaviśrāntaśāsanasya mahārājasya pādamūlasevārthamaṅgīkṛtakiṃkarabhāvāḥ sāmantamahīpatayaḥ caramavayasāṃ dṛṣṭaparāparavyavahārāṇāṃ vṛddhānāmājñayā kartavyavidāmājñayā kartavyeṣu prayojaneṣu saṃcaradhvam/ viprāśca śruteḥ śravaṇasya subhagaṃ yathā syāttathā paṭhantu/
analyzed: vartiṣyamāṇam sūcayati bho rājānaḥ iti he rājānaḥ sakala diganta viśrānta śāsanasya mahā rājasya pāda mūla sevā artham aṅgīkṛta kiṃkara bhāvāḥ sāmanta mahīpatayaḥ carama vayasām dṛṣṭa para apara vyavahārāṇām vṛddhānām ājñayā kartavya vidām ājñayā kartavyeṣu prayojaneṣu saṃcaradhvam viprāḥ ca śruteḥ śravaṇasya subhagam yathā syāt tathā paṭhantu

original: āśīrvādamantrāniti śeṣaḥ/ nānāvacananivahaiḥ saṃskṛtaprākṛtādinānābhāṣāviśeṣaiḥ sahitaṃ citramāścaryakāri gītavādyanṛttādikaṃ maṅgalebhyo maṅgalārtham/ tādarthye caturthī/ ceṣṭyatāṃ vyāpriyatām/ tato janyānāṃ varasaṃbandhināṃ janānām/ ``janyāḥ snigdhā varasya ye'' ityamaraḥ/ yātrāyā varagṛhādvadhūgṛhagamanakriyāyāḥ praveśaḥ prāptistvarayati/
analyzed: āśīrvāda mantrān iti śeṣaḥ nānā vacana nivahaiḥ saṃskṛta prākṛta ādi nānā bhāṣā viśeṣaiḥ sahitam citram āścarya kāri gīta vādya nṛtta ādikam maṅgalebhyaḥ maṅgala artham tādarthye caturthī ceṣṭyatām vyāpriyatām tatas janyānām vara saṃbandhinām janānām janyāḥ snigdhāḥ varasya ye iti amaraḥ yātrāyāḥ vara gṛhāt vadhū gṛha gamana kriyāyāḥ praveśaḥ prāptiḥ tvarayati

original: tvarāṃ janayatītyarthaḥ//2//
analyzed: tvarām janayati iti arthaḥ

original: na parāpatanti na samāgacchanti/ gṛhītaṃ saviśeṣamaṇḍanaṃ yena/ samyagalaṃkṛta ityarthaḥ/ ānuyātriko mālatyā anucaro janaḥ pratīkṣyatāṃ paripālyatām/ śīghramāhūyatāmityarthaḥ/ yadvānuyātriko varānugāmī tatsuhṛjjanaḥ/ gṛhītaṃ saviśeṣamaṇḍanamābharaṇavastrādikaṃ yasmātsa tādṛśaḥ pratīkṣyatāmabhyudgamanādinā saṃbhāvyatāmiti//
analyzed: na parāpatanti na samāgacchanti gṛhītam sa viśeṣa maṇḍanam yena samyak alaṃkṛtaḥ iti arthaḥ ānuyātrikaḥ mālatyāḥ anucaraḥ janaḥ pratīkṣyatām paripālyatām śīghram āhūyatām iti arthaḥ yat vā anuyātrikaḥ vara anugāmī tad suhṛd janaḥ gṛhītam sa viśeṣa maṇḍanam ābharaṇa vastra ādikam yasmāt sa tādṛśaḥ pratīkṣyatām abhyudgamana ādinā saṃbhāvyatām iti

original: kapālakuṇḍalā - bhavatvityādi/ tena nedānīṃ mālatyapaharaṇaṃ śakyamiti bhāvaḥ/ ākulājjanasaṃmardānmādhavasyāpakāro mālatyapaharaṇarūpastaṃ pratyabhiniviṣṭā dṛḍhataraprayatnā bhavāmi/ iti niṣkrāntā/ iti śuddhaviṣkambhaḥ// kalahaṃsaḥ/
analyzed: kapāla kuṇḍalā bhavatu ityādi tena na idānīm mālatī apaharaṇam śakyam iti bhāvaḥ ākulāt jana saṃmardāt mādhavasya apakāraḥ mālatī apaharaṇa rūpaḥ tam pratyabhiniviṣṭā dṛḍhatara prayatnā bhavāmi iti niṣkrāntāḥ iti śuddha viṣkambhaḥ kalahaṃsaḥ

original: ājñapto'smi nagaradevatāyā garbhagṛhavartinā makarandasanāthena mādhavena jānīhi tāvaditomukhaṃ pravṛttā mālatī na veti/ tadyāvadenamānandayiṣyāmi/ itomukhaṃ pravṛttā mālatīti priyanivedaneneti śeṣaḥ/
analyzed: ājñaptaḥ asmi nagara devatāyāḥ garbhagṛha vartinā makaranda sanāthena mādhavena jānīhi tāvat itomukham pravṛttā mālatī na vā iti tat yāvat enam ānandayiṣyāmi itomukham pravṛttā mālatī iti priya nivedanena iti śeṣaḥ

original: anena vākyena mādhavamakarandayoḥ kṛtrimapariṇayārthaṃ chadmanā nagaradevatāgarbhagṛhe pūrvameva praviśya nilīyāvasthānasūcanādabhūtāharaṇaṃ nāma garbhasaṃdhyaṅgamuktam/ yathā - ``abhūtāharaṇaṃ tatsyādvākyaṃ yatkapaṭāśrayam'' iti/ idameva tayoḥ praveśakaṃ ca// mādhavaḥ - mālatyā iti/
analyzed: anena vākyena mādhava makarandayoḥ kṛtrima pariṇaya artham chadmanā nagara devatā garbhagṛhe pūrvam eva praviśya nilīya avasthāna sūcanāt abhūtāharaṇam nāma garbha saṃdhi aṅgam uktam yathā abhūta āharaṇam tat syāt vākyam yat kapaṭa āśrayam iti idam eva tayoḥ praveśakam ca mādhavaḥ mālatyā iti

original: madanāyāsaprabandhasya smaravyathānubandhasya sarvathādya khalvito mālatīlābhānyatarakoṭiparicchedena paryavasānaṃ bhaviṣyatītyeṣa tattvārthakīrtanānmārgo nāma garbhasaṃdheraṅgamuktam/ yathā - ``tattvārthakīrtanaṃ mārgaḥ'' iti/
analyzed: madana āyāsa prabandhasya smara vyathā anubandhasya sarvathā adya khalu itas mālatī lābha anyatara koṭi paricchedena paryavasānam bhaviṣyati iti eṣa tattva artha kīrtanāt mārgaḥ nāma garbha saṃdheḥ aṅgam uktam yathā tattva artha kīrtanam mārgaḥ iti

original: kathamatrānyatarakoṭipariccheda ityapekṣāyāṃ bhagavatīprayuktopāyasiddhyasiddhibhyāmityāha - bhagavatyāḥ kāmandakyā nītiḥ kṛtrimavivāharūpa upāye kalyāṇaṃ mālatīpāṇigrahaṇarūpaṃ vā vidadhātu/ tathā sati tatprāptyaiva madanāyāsasyānto bhaviṣyati/ athavā madbhāgyavaikalyādviparyetu viparītā bhavatu/
analyzed: katham atra anyatara koṭi paricchedaḥ iti apekṣāyām bhagavatī prayukta upāya siddhi asiddhibhyām iti āha bhagavatyāḥ kāmandakyāḥ nītiḥ kṛtrima vivāha rūpe upāye kalyāṇam mālatī pāṇigrahaṇa rūpam vā vidadhātu tathā sati tad prāptyā eva madana āyāsasya antaḥ bhaviṣyati athavā mad bhāgya vaikalyāt viparyetu viparītā bhavatu

original: tathāpi prayuktopāyabhaṅgādupāyāntarābhāvācca tadalābhaniścaye dhruvaṃ mama vipattirityāśrayāntarābhāvādeva madanāyāsasyānto bhaviṣyatītyarthaḥ/ kīdṛśasya madanāyāsasyetyapekṣāyāṃ tāvadāha - mālatyāḥ prathamadarśanakṣaṇādārabhya vistāriṇaḥ pravardhamānasya/
analyzed: tathā api prayukta upāya bhaṅgāt upāya antara abhāvāt ca tad alābha niścaye dhruvam mama vipattiḥ iti āśraya antara abhāvāt eva madana āyāsasya antaḥ bhaviṣyati iti arthaḥ kīdṛśasya madana āyāsasya iti apekṣāyām tāvat āha mālatyāḥ prathama darśana kṣaṇāt ārabhya vistāriṇaḥ pravardhamānasya

original: tathā mṛgadṛśastasyāḥ snehasūcakairviceṣṭitaiḥ sābhiprāyāvalokanādibhiḥ parāṃ niratiśayāṃ koṭiṃ prakṛṣṭatāṃ nītasyeti yojyam/ eṣā prāptyāśā nāma tṛtīyā kāryāvasthā/ yathā - ``upāyāpāyacintābhyāṃ prāptyāśā prāptisaṃbhavaḥ'' iti//3//
analyzed: tathā mṛga dṛśaḥ tasyāḥ sneha sūcakaiḥ viceṣṭitaiḥ sa abhiprāya avalokana ādibhiḥ parām niratiśayām koṭim prakṛṣṭa tām nītasya iti yojyam eṣā prāptyāśā nāma tṛtīyā kārya avasthā yathā upāya apāya cintābhyām prāptyāśā prāpti saṃbhavaḥ iti

original: makarandaḥ/ viparyeṣyati viparītā bhaviṣyati// kalahaṃsaḥ/ nātha, diṣṭyā vardhase/ pravṛttā khalvitomukhaṃ mālatī/ mādhavaḥ/ apisatkim/ satyamitomukhaṃ pravṛttetyasaṃbhāvayataḥ praśnaḥ// makarandaḥ/ aśraddadhāno viśvāsarahitaḥ/ asmākamiti/
analyzed: makarandaḥ viparyeṣyati viparītā bhaviṣyati kalahaṃsaḥ nātha diṣṭyā vardhase pravṛttā khalu itomukham mālatī mādhavaḥ api sat kim satyam itomukham pravṛttā iti a saṃbhāvayataḥ praśnaḥ makarandaḥ aśraddadhānaḥ viśvāsa rahitaḥ asmākam iti

original: marutā prabalapavanena vikīrṇaṃ viśakalitaṃ yajjīmūtajālaṃ tadrasitānukārī gambhīro yo maṅgalārthaṃ mṛdaṅgasahasrajanmā ninādaḥ so'smākamekapada eva svavyatiriktaśabdaśravaṇasāmarthyaṃ nirasyati/ matsamīpamāgatyāhetyarthaḥ//4//
analyzed: marutā prabala pavanena vikīrṇam viśakalitam yat jīmūta jālam tad rasita anukārī gambhīraḥ yaḥ maṅgala artham mṛdaṅga sahasra janmā ninādaḥ saḥ usmākam eka pade eva sva vyatirikta śabda śravaṇa sāmarthyam nirasyati mad samīpam āgatya āha iti arthaḥ

original: kalahaṃsaḥ/ nātha, paśya/ ime tāvanmaṅgaladhavalātapatranivahā dṛśyanta ityanvayaḥ/ kīdṛśāḥ/ utpatitānāṃ rājahaṃsānāṃ vibhrameṇeva vibhrameṇābhirāmāṇāṃ cāmarāṇāṃ samīraṇenodvelordhvaṃ carantī yā kadalikāvalī patākāpaṅktistayā taraṅgitaṃ saṃjātataraṅgaṃ yaduttānaṃ gaganāṅgaṇaṃ nabhobhāgeva sarastatra nirantarāṇāṃ sāndrāṇāmuddaṇḍapuṇḍarīkāṇāṃ yo
analyzed: kalahaṃsaḥ nātha paśya ime tāvat maṅgala dhavala ātapatra nivahāḥ dṛśyante iti anvayaḥ kīdṛśāḥ utpatitānām rājahaṃsānām vibhrameṇa iva vibhrameṇa abhirāmāṇām cāmarāṇām samīraṇena udvelā ūrdhvam carantī yā kadalikā āvalī patākā paṅktiḥ tayā taraṅgitam saṃjāta taraṅgam yat uttānam gagana aṅgaṇam nabhaḥ bhāgā iva saraḥ tatra nirantarāṇām sāndrāṇām uddaṇḍa puṇḍarīkāṇām yoga anupūrva anupūrva anupūrva anupū

original: vibhramastaṃ vahanto vibhrāṇāḥ/ atra gaganāṅgaṇasyottānatvaṃ gāmbhīryadyotanārtham/ gambhīre sarasi puṇḍarīkāṇāmuddaṇḍakāṇḍā bhavanti nānyatra/ savilāseti/
analyzed: vibhramaḥ tam vahantaḥ vibhrāṇāḥ atra gagana aṅgaṇasya uttāna tvam gāmbhīrya dyotana artham gambhīre sarasi puṇḍarīkāṇām uddaṇḍa kāṇḍāḥ bhavanti na anyatra savilāsā iti

original: savilāsaṃ kavalitena tāmbūlenābhipūritasya kapolamaṇḍalasyābhogena vistāreṇa yo vyatikaraḥ saṃparko gītākṣarāṇāṃ tena skhalitaṃ yanmadhuraṃ maṅgalārthamudgītaṃ gaurīkalyāṇādi gānaṃ tena baddhaḥ kolāhalo yena taiḥ/
analyzed: savilāsam kavalitena tāmbūlena abhipūritasya kapola maṇḍalasya ābhogena vistāreṇa yaḥ vyatikaraḥ saṃparkaḥ gīta akṣarāṇām tena skhalitam yat madhuram maṅgala artham udgītam gaurī kalyāṇa ādi gānam tena baddhaḥ kolāhalaḥ yena taiḥ

original: vividhānāṃ ratnālaṃkārāṇāṃ kiraṇāvalībhirviḍambitā anukṛtā ye mahendracāpavicchedāstairvicchuritaṃ vyāptaṃ nabhaḥsthalaṃ gaganasthalaṃ yeṣāṃ tairvārasundarīkadambakairadhyāsitāḥ kvaṇatkanakakiṃkiṇīraṇitajhaṇajhaṇatkāriṇyaḥ kariṇyaḥ/ dṛśyanta iti śeṣaḥ// makarandaḥ/ preṅkhaditi/
analyzed: vividhānām ratna alaṃkārāṇām kiraṇa āvalībhiḥ viḍambitāḥ anukṛtāḥ ye mahā indracāpa vicchedāḥ taiḥ vicchuritam vyāptam nabhaḥ sthalam gagana sthalam yeṣām taiḥ vārasundarī kadambakaiḥ adhyāsitāḥ kvaṇat kanaka kiṃkiṇī raṇita jhaṇajhaṇat kāriṇyaḥ kariṇyaḥ dṛśyante iti śeṣaḥ makarandaḥ preṅkhat iti

original: diśa unmukhānāmūrdhvaṃ prasṛtānāṃ maṇijyotiṣāmanekavarṇānāṃ vitānairvistārairevaṃvidhā bhavanti/ kiṃvidhāḥ/ unmeṣiṇāṃ prasaraṇaśīlānāṃ cāṣāṇāṃ kuliṅgānāṃ marutā ākulā ye chadāḥ pakṣāsteṣāṃ chāyābhiḥ saṃvalitairmiśrībhūtairvivartibhirvisṛmaraiḥ preṅkhatāṃ pracalatāṃ bhūrīṇāṃ bahūnāṃ mayūrāṇāṃ mecakacayaiścandrakarasamūhaiḥ prānteṣu
analyzed: diśaḥ unmukhānām ūrdhvam prasṛtānām maṇi jyotiṣām aneka varṇānām vitānaiḥ vistāraiḥ evaṃvidhāḥ bhavanti kiṃvidhāḥ unmeṣiṇām prasaraṇa śīlānām cāṣāṇām kuliṅgānām marutā ākulāḥ ye chadāḥ pakṣāḥ teṣām chāyābhiḥ saṃvalitaiḥ miśrībhūtaiḥ vivartibhiḥ visṛmaraiḥ preṅkhatām pracalatām bhūrīṇām bahūnām mayūrāṇām mecaka cayaiḥ candrakara samūhaiḥ prānteṣu

original: paryantapradeśeṣu paritaḥ samantādāvṛtā iva bhavanti/ tathā vyaktākhaṇḍalakārmukā iva bhavanti/ tathā likhitacitrāṇāṃ cīnadeśodbhavānāmaṃśukānāṃ prastāreṇa saṃstareṇa sthagitā ācchāditā iva bhavantīti ratnālaṃkārabāhulyaṃ sūcitam/ tasmādatipuraṃdaravaibhavamamātyabhūrivasoraiśvaryamiti bhāvaḥ//5//
analyzed: paryanta pradeśeṣu paritas samantāt āvṛtāḥ iva bhavanti tathā vyakta ākhaṇḍala kārmukāḥ iva bhavanti tathā likhita citrāṇām cīna deśa udbhavānām aṃśukānām prastāreṇa saṃstareṇa sthagitāḥ ācchāditāḥ iva bhavanti iti ratna alaṃkāra bāhulyam sūcitam tasmāt ati puraṃdara vaibhavam amātya bhūrivasoḥ aiśvaryam iti bhāvaḥ

original: kalahaṃsaḥ/ kathaṃ sasaṃbhramamāgatānāmanekeṣāṃ pratihārāṇāṃ vetrahastānāṃ maṇḍalenāvarjitābhiravanamitābhirujjvalena kanakena kaladhautena rūpyeṇa cāntarāntarā ghaṭitena citrābhirvetralatābhiḥ parikṣiptā bhūmau likhitā yā rekhā sā na laṅghanīyeti sīmātvena parikalpitā/ tayā racitamaṇḍalaḥ pṛthagavasthitaḥ sa tādṛśo jano dūrata eva sthitaḥ/
analyzed: kalahaṃsaḥ katham sa saṃbhramam āgatānām anekeṣām pratihārāṇām vetra hastānām maṇḍalena āvarjitābhiḥ avanamitābhiḥ ujjvalena kanakena kaladhautena rūpyeṇa ca antarā antarā ghaṭitena citrābhiḥ vetra latābhiḥ parikṣiptā bhūmau likhitā yā rekhā sā na laṅghanīyā iti sīmā tvena parikalpitā tayā racita maṇḍalaḥ pṛthak avasthitaḥ sa tādṛśaḥ janaḥ dūratas eva sthitaḥ

original: eṣā ca bahulasindūranikareṇa saṃdhyārāgeṇevoparaktamukhe vadane prādurbhāve ca madhuraṃ manoharaṃ yathā syāttathā ghūrṇamānā prakāśamānā nakṣatramālā hāraviśeṣo'śvinyāditārāpaṅktiśca tadevābharaṇaṃ dhārayatīti dhāriṇī tāṃ kareṇurajanīm/ rajanīmiva kareṇumityupamitasamāsenopamā vācyā/
analyzed: eṣā ca bahula sindūra nikareṇa saṃdhyā rāgeṇa iva uparakta mukhe vadane prādurbhāve ca madhuram manoharam yathā syāt tathā ghūrṇamānā prakāśamānā nakṣatra mālā hāra viśeṣa uśvinī ādi tārā paṅktiḥ ca tat eva ābharaṇam dhārayati iti dhāriṇī tām kareṇu rajanīm rajanīm iva kareṇum iti upamita samāsena upamā vācyā

original: alaṃkurvatīta eva kautūhalotphullamukhasamastalokadṛśyamānamanoharāpāṇḍuraparikṣāmadehaśobhāvibhāvitānaṅgavedanā/ ata eva viśeṣaṇadvayasya sāmarthyātprathamacandralekhāyāḥ pratipaccandrakalāyā vibhramaṃ vahantī kiṃcidantaraṃ parijanamaṇḍalādapasṛtyānyadeśaṃ prasṛtā mālatī/
analyzed: alaṃkurvatī itas eva kautūhala utphulla mukha samasta loka dṛśyamāna manohara āpāṇḍura parikṣāma deha śobhā vibhāvita anaṅga vedanā atas eva viśeṣaṇa dvayasya sāmarthyāt prathama candra lekhāyāḥ pratipad candra kalāyāḥ vibhramam vahantī kiṃcid antaram parijana maṇḍalāt apasṛtya anya deśam prasṛtā mālatī

original: kathamanyavibhramamanyā vahedityasaṃbhavadharmayogātsaṃdhyārāgoparaktatārāvalīvibhūṣitarajanīprārambhoditā svabhāvādaprauḍhatvācca pāṇḍukṣāmakautūhalonmukhasamastalokadṛśyamānā pratipaccandralekheva sindūroparaktahārālaṃkṛtakareṇumalaṃkurvatī virahabhāvanātpāṇḍukṣāmā sarvalokaprekṣaṇīyā mālatīti
analyzed: katham anya vibhramam anyā vahet iti asaṃbhava dharma yogāt saṃdhyā rāga uparakta tārā āvalī vibhūṣita rajanī prārambha uditā svabhāvāt aprauḍha tvāt ca pāṇḍu kṣāma kautūhala unmukha samasta loka dṛśyamānā pratipad candra lekhā iva sindūra uparakta hāra alaṃkṛta kareṇum alaṃkurvatī viraha bhāvanāt pāṇḍu kṣāmā sarva loka prekṣaṇīyā mālatī iti

original: bimbapratibimbabhāvenārthāntarādhyāropānmukhanakṣatramālāśabdopāttaśleṣopaskṛtasindūrasaṃdhyārāgakareṇurajanīśabdopāttopamānugṛhīto nidarśanālaṃkāraḥ// makarandaḥ/ iyamiti/ iyaṃ varārohottamā nāyikā/ avayavaiḥ sahajalāvaṇyamayairvirahavaśātpāṇḍukṣāmaireva pratyutālaṃkṛtāni maṇḍanāni bhūṣaṇāni yasyāḥ sā/ alaṃkaraṇairna kaścidatiśayastadavayavānām/
analyzed: bimba pratibimba bhāvena artha antara adhyāropāt mukha nakṣatra mālā śabda upātta śleṣa upaskṛta sindūra saṃdhyā rāga kareṇu rajanī śabda upātta upamā anugṛhītaḥ nidarśana alaṃkāraḥ makarandaḥ iyam iti iyam varāroha uttamā nāyikā avayavaiḥ sahaja lāvaṇya mayaiḥ viraha vaśāt pāṇḍu kṣāmaiḥ eva pratyuta alaṃkṛtāni maṇḍanāni bhūṣaṇāni yasyāḥ sā alaṃkaraṇaiḥ na kaścid atiśayaḥ tad avayavānām

original: kiṃtu tadgatatvena teṣāmeva śobhātiśayo dṛśyata ityarthaḥ/ tādṛśī satī māṅgalyamaṇḍanasanāthatayā ramyāṃ vivāhamahotsavaśriyamaupayikīṃ gurunirbandhādāhṛtāṃ bahiḥ kevalaṃ vahati/ tathātyarthamudayinīmidānīṃ pratikṣaṇamupacīyamānāṃ manorujaṃ manmathavedanāmavayavagatapāṇḍimakṛśimādibhireva vyanakti/
analyzed: kiṃtu tad gata tvena teṣām eva śobhā atiśayaḥ dṛśyate iti arthaḥ tādṛśī satī māṅgalya maṇḍana sanātha tayā ramyām vivāha mahā utsava śriyam aupayikīm guru nirbandhāt āhṛtām bahis kevalam vahati tathā atyartham udayinīm idānīm pratikṣaṇam upacīyamānām manaḥ rujam manmatha vedanām avayava gata pāṇḍima kṛśima ādibhiḥ eva vyanakti

original: antargatamanupādhikaṃ duḥsahamanmathavyathāvikāraṃ dyotayatītyarthaḥ/ kathamiva/ bahiḥkalitakusumāntaḥkīṭādidoṣavaśātpariśoṣiṇī bālalatevetyupamālaṃkāraḥ/ dhīrā ceyaṃ nāyikā//6//
analyzed: antargatam anupādhikam duḥsaha manmatha vyathā vikāram dyotayati iti arthaḥ katham iva bahis kalita kusuma antar kīṭa ādi doṣa vaśāt pariśoṣiṇī bāla latā iva iti upamā alaṃkāraḥ dhīrā ca iyam nāyikā

original: niṣāditopaveśitā// tataḥ praviśatīti/ pūrvavākyenaiva sūcitatvādatra mādhavamakarandayoḥ kathānubandhena kāmandakyādipraveśasūcanāttayośca kāmandakīṃ prati śiṣyatayā parijanatvāt/ ``parijanakathānubandhaḥ praveśako nāma vijñeyaḥ'' ityuktalakṣaṇapraveśako'yaṃ granthabhāga iti kaścidvyācaṣṭe/ sa vaktavyaḥ/
analyzed: niṣādita upaveśitā tatas praviśati iti pūrva vākyena eva sūcita tvāt atra mādhava makarandayoḥ kathā anubandhena kāmandakī ādi praveśa sūcanāt tayoḥ ca kāmandakīm prati śiṣya tayā parijana tvāt parijana kathā anubandhaḥ praveśakaḥ nāma vijñeyaḥ iti ukta lakṣaṇa praveśakaḥ yam grantha bhāgaḥ iti kaścid vyācaṣṭe sa vaktavyaḥ

original: kathaṃ pratyakṣābhinayarūpāṅkamadhye kevalābhinayasūcanaikapātrasūcyārthasūcakasya praveśakasya niveśaḥ/ kathaṃ vā pradhānanāyakasya vastutaḥ śiṣyasyāpi praveśakapātratvaparijanatvādiparikalpanamanaucityāpādakamiti/ kathaṃ ca svapaṭhitasyottaraśloko na dṛṣṭaḥ/ ``aṅkacchedaṃ kṛtvā māsakṛtaṃ varṣasaṃcitaṃ vāpi/
analyzed: katham pratyakṣa abhinaya rūpa aṅka madhye kevala abhinaya sūcana eka pātra sūcya artha sūcakasya praveśakasya niveśaḥ katham vā pradhāna nāyakasya vastutas śiṣyasya api praveśaka pātra tva parijana tva ādi parikalpanam anaucitya āpādakam iti katham ca sva paṭhitasya uttaraślokaḥ na dṛṣṭaḥ aṅka chedam kṛtvā māsa kṛtam varṣa saṃcitam vā api

original: tattatra sūcanīyaṃ varṣādūrdhvaṃ tu na kadācit//'' iti/ tathā ``divasāvasānakāryaṃ yadyaṅkenopapadyate sarvam/ aṅkacchedaṃ kṛtvā praveśakaistadvidhātavyam//'' ityādi bharatagrantheṣu tadanantaraślokeṣu bahupraveśakānabhidheyārthasūcakatvena pṛthageva niveśābhidhānāt/ ``eteṣvaṅkabahirbhāvaḥ syādviṣkambhapraveśayoḥ/
analyzed: tat tatra sūcanīyam varṣāt ūrdhvam tu na kadācid iti tathā divasa avasāna kāryam yadi aṅkena upapadyate sarvam aṅka chedam kṛtvā praveśakaiḥ tat vidhātavyam ityādi bharata grantheṣu tad anantara ślokeṣu bahu praveśaka anabhidheya artha sūcaka tvena pṛthak eva niveśa abhidhānāt eteṣu aṅka bahirbhāvaḥ syāt viṣkambha praveśayoḥ

original: cūlikāyāḥ kvacidbāhye kvacinmadhye niveśanam''// iti bhāvaprakāśe'bhihitatvācca tasyāṅkamadhye niveśanaṃ pradhānanāyakasya naicyāṅgīkaraṇaṃ ca lokaśāstraviruddham/ atha praveśayatīti vyutpattyā praveśakatvasūcakamātreṇa praveśakatvavācoyuktistarhi na tasya parijanetyādikaṃ lakṣaṇam, kiṃtu viṣkambhakādipañcakāntargatasyeti tadudāharaṇamanugatam/
analyzed: cūlikāyāḥ kvacid bāhye kvacid madhye niveśanam iti bhāva prakāśa ibhihita tvāt ca tasya aṅka madhye niveśanam pradhāna nāyakasya naicya aṅgīkaraṇam ca loka śāstra viruddham atha praveśayati iti vyutpattyā praveśaka tva sūcaka mātreṇa praveśaka tva vācoyuktiḥ tarhi na tasya parijana ityādikam lakṣaṇam kiṃtu viṣkambhaka ādi pañcaka antargatasya iti tat udāharaṇam anugatam

original: cūlikādīnāṃ tu trayāṇāṃ pātrapraveśasūcanārthameva svīkārāttathaiva lakṣitatvācca yujyate kvacitteṣāmaṅkamadhye pāta ityāstām// kāmandakī - saharṣamiti/ svaprayuktopāyasya sidhyaunmukhyaṃ harṣahetuḥ/ ``śreyāṃsi bahuvighnāni'' iti saṃbhāvitavighnavighātāyeṣṭadevatāṃ prārthayate - vidhāteti/ vidhātā brahmā/
analyzed: cūlikā ādīnām tu trayāṇām pātra praveśa sūcana artham eva svīkārāt tathā eva lakṣita tvāt ca yujyate kvacid teṣām aṅka madhye pātaḥ iti āstām kāmandakī sa harṣam iti sva prayukta upāyasya sidhi aunmukhyam harṣa hetuḥ śreyāṃsi bahu vighnāni iti saṃbhāvita vighna vighātāya iṣṭadevatām prārthayate vidhātā iti vidhātā brahmā

original: anyonyānuguṇayogānmanoharāya vidhaye mālatīmādhavavivāharūpāya prayojanāya no'smākaṃ bhadraṃ vitaratu/ atra sarvajñāyā api bhagavatyā akārapraśleṣaṇādabhadramiti no iti ca niṣedhavācinā nipātena cāmaṅgalārthadyotakaṃ vākyaṃ kāryavyagratāhaṭhānnirgataṃ bhāvyaniṣṭamuttarāṅkasthaṃ dyotayatīti kecit/
analyzed: anyonya anuguṇa yogāt manoharāya vidhaye mālatī mādhava vivāha rūpāya prayojanāya na usmākam bhadram vitaratu atra sarvajñāyāḥ api bhagavatyāḥ akāra praśleṣaṇāt abhadram iti no iti ca niṣedha vācinā nipātena ca amaṅgala artha dyotakam vākyam kārya vyagra tā haṭhāt nirgatam bhāvi aniṣṭam uttara aṅka stham dyotayati iti kecid

original: devāḥ paramāmutkṛṣṭāṃ ramaṇīyāṃ pariṇatiṃ samucitavadhūvarasamāgamarūpāṃ vidheyāsuḥ/ ``erliṅi'' ityetvam/ priyasuhṛdapatyayorupanayataḥ saṃghaṭṭanādahaṃ kṛtārthā bhūyāsam/ uktaṃ hi prāk - ``prāṇaistapobhiḥ'' ityādi/ ayaṃ ca sarvaḥ suhṛdapatyapratijñāmārabhyaitadantaḥ prayatno'dya mālatīmādhavavivāharūpeṇa phalena phalatu/
analyzed: devāḥ paramām utkṛṣṭām ramaṇīyām pariṇatim samucita vadhū vara samāgama rūpām vidheyāsuḥ eḥ liṅi iti e tvam priya suhṛd apatyayoḥ upanayataḥ saṃghaṭṭanāt aham kṛtārthā bhūyāsam uktam hi prāk prāṇaiḥ tapobhiḥ ityādi ayam ca sarvaḥ suhṛd apatya pratijñām ārabhya etad antaḥ prayatna udya mālatī mādhava vivāha rūpeṇa phalena phalatu

original: śivatātiḥ śivaṃkaraśca bhavatu/ śivaśabdāt ``śivaśamariṣṭasya kare'' iti tātinpratyayaḥ/ ``kṣemaṃkaro'riṣṭatātiḥ śivatātiḥ śivaṃkaraḥ'' ityamaraḥ//7//
analyzed: śivatātiḥ śivaṃkaraḥ ca bhavatu śiva śabdāt kare iti tātin pratyayaḥ kṣemaṃkara uriṣṭatātiḥ śivatātiḥ śivaṃkaraḥ iti amaraḥ

original: atha mālatī muhūrtānantaraṃ nandanapāṇigrahaṇalakṣaṇavajranipātasamamutprekṣamāṇā durviṣahatatpāṇigrahaṇalakṣaṇaduḥkhātyantocchedakatvena maraṇameva śaraṇaṃ niḥśreyasaṃ manyamānā tamupāyamapi durlabhaṃ matvā vitarkayati - kena punaḥ sāṃpratamupāyena maraṇanirvāṇasyāntaramavasaraṃ saṃbhāvayiṣyāmi/ etadvitarkapratipādanādrūpaṃ nāmāṅgam/
analyzed: atha mālatī muhūrta anantaram nandana pāṇigrahaṇa lakṣaṇa vajra nipāta samam utprekṣamāṇā durviṣaha tad pāṇigrahaṇa lakṣaṇa duḥkha atyanta ucchedaka tvena maraṇam eva śaraṇam niḥśreyasam manyamānā tam upāyam api durlabham matvā vitarkayati kena punar sāṃpratam upāyena maraṇa nirvāṇasya antaram avasaram saṃbhāvayiṣyāmi etad vitarka pratipādanāt rūpam nāma aṅgam

original: yathā - ``vitarko rūpamucyate'' iti/ maraṇamapi mandabhāgadheyāyā me'bhimatamatidurlabhaṃ bhavati// lavaṅgikā/ atikleśitā khalu priyasakhyetenānukūlasya priyasya vipralambhena// praviśya/ āheti śeṣaḥ/ paṭalakamābharaṇadhāraṇapātram/ pratihārī/ amātyo bhagavatīṃ bhaṇati/
analyzed: yathā vitarkaḥ rūpam ucyate iti maraṇam api manda bhāgadheyāyāḥ mā ibhimatam ati durlabham bhavati lavaṅgikā ati kleśitā khalu priya sakhī etena anukūlasya priyasya vipralambhena praviśya āha iti śeṣaḥ paṭalakam ābharaṇa dhāraṇa pātram pratihārī amātyaḥ bhagavatīm bhaṇati

original: etena narendrānupreṣitavivāhanepathyena devatāyāḥ purato'laṃkartavyā mālatīti// kāmandakī/ māṅgalikaṃ maṅgalaprayojanamiti ṭhak// pratihārī/ etattāvaddhavalapaṭṭāṃśukayugalam/ etaccottarīyavarṇāṃśukam/ ime ca sarvāṅgikā ābharaṇasaṃyogā ābharaṇānyeva saṃyojyante sthāpyante yeṣvavayaveṣviti saṃyogāḥ/ karmaṇi ghañ/ sarvāṅgikāḥ sarvāṅgasthāpyāḥ/
analyzed: etena narendra anupreṣita vivāha nepathyena devatāyāḥ puratas ulaṃkartavyā mālatī iti kāmandakī māṅgalikam maṅgala prayojanam iti pratihārī etat tāvat dhavala paṭṭāṃśuka yugalam etat ca uttarīya varṇa aṃśukam ime ca sarva āṅgikāḥ ābharaṇa saṃyogāḥ ābharaṇāni eva saṃyojyante sthāpyante yeṣu avayaveṣu iti saṃyogāḥ karmaṇi ghañ sarva āṅgikāḥ sarva aṅga sthāpyāḥ

original: ime ca mauktikahārāḥ/ etaccandanam/ eṣa sitakusumaśekhara iti// kāmandakī/ ramaṇīyamiti/ anena prasādhanena prasādhitaṃ mālatīrūpadhāriṇaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ makarandaṃ jano vipralabdho mālatībuddhyā kṣaṇāntaramavekṣyatītyarthaḥ// lavaṅgikā/ bhagavatī punaḥ/ kva yāsyatīti śeṣaḥ// mālatī/ lavaṅgikāmātraparivārā tāvatsaṃvṛttā/

original: etacca prastutamaraṇotkarṣadyotakatvādudāharaṇaṃ nāmāṅgam/ yathā - ``yattu sātiśayaṃ vākyaṃ tadudāharaṇaṃ bhavet'' iti// makarandaḥ/ sakhe, śrutamityatra kākuḥ// mādhavaḥ/ asaṃtoṣastviti svanimittatvasyāsphuṭatvāt// mālatī/

original: paramārthabhagini priyasakhi lavaṅgike, eṣedānīṃ te priyasakhyanāthā maraṇe vartamānā āgarbhanirgamanirantaropārūḍhavisrambhasadṛśaṃ pariṣvajyābhyarthayate/ tatra prastutopayogisāmavacanatvātsaṃgraho nāmāṅgam/ yathā - ``saṃgrahaḥ sāmadānoktiḥ'' iti/

original: yadi te'hamanuvartanīyā tato māṃ hṛdayena dhārayantī samagrasaubhāgyalakṣmīparigrahaikamaṅgalaṃ mādhavasya śrīmukhāravindamānandamasṛṇaṃ yathā syādevaṃ pralokaya/ anena mannirviśeṣayā tvayā māṃ smarantyā priyatamo dṛṣṭaścenmayaiva dṛṣṭa iti pratītermādhavaviṣayaḥ premaiva parāṃ koṭimārūḍhaḥ/ sarvathā tadalābhaniścayānmaraṇaṃ niścitamiti vyajyate/

analyzed: ānanda masṛṇam iti anena ca yena prakāreṇa aham tam avalokayāmi tena eva avalokaya na tu svocitena tāṭasthyena iti uktam mādhavaḥ sva viṣaya tām prema bandhasya niratiśaya tām ca jñātvā āha mlānasya iti diṣṭyā bhāgyena mayā tādṛśa saubhāgya anarheṇa api vacaḥ mṛtāni etāni adhigatāni prāptāni kīdṛśāni

original: priyāprāptyasaṃbhāvanayā glānimupagatasya jīvasyaiva saukumāryātkusumasya vikāsanāni/ tathā saṃtarpaṇāni samyaktṛptijanakāni/ tena hi mālatyāḥ śataśo darśane'pīdṛśavacanaśravaṇādyādṛśī tṛptistādṛśī na bhavatīti vacanānāṃ saṃtarpakatvam/ tathā sakalendriyāṇāṃ mohanāni/ pralayākhyasāttvikabhāvahetutvāt/ indriyāstamayohi pralayaḥ/
analyzed: priya aprāpti asaṃbhāvanayā glānim upagatasya jīvasya eva saukumāryāt kusumasya vikāsanāni tathā saṃtarpaṇāni samyak tṛpti janakāni tena hi mālatyāḥ śataśas darśane pi īdṛśa vacana śravaṇāt yādṛśī tṛptiḥ tādṛśī na bhavati iti vacanānām saṃtarpaka tvam tathā sakala indriyāṇām mohanāni pralaya ākhya sāttvika bhāva hetu tvāt indriya astamayaḥ hi pralayaḥ

original: tathānandanāni niratiśayānandasyātmasaṃvedyatvādānandajanakāni/ tathā hṛdayasya virahaduḥkhaśoṣitasarvarasādidhātukasya rasāyanāni rasādidhātusaṃpādakatvena rasajanakāni/ ``nīrasānāṃ hi dhātūnāṃ lābhopāyo rasāyanam'' iti rasāyanam//8//

original: mālatī/ yathā tasya jīvitapradāyino'hamavasitā mṛteti māṃśrutvā saṃtapyamānasya tattathāvidhaṃ śarīraratnaṃ na parihīyate, yathā ca lokāntaragatāmapi māmuddiśya sa janaḥ smaraṇakathāmātrapariśeṣāṃ kālāntareṇāpi lokayātrāṃ na śithilīkaroti tathā kuru/ atra mādhavamaraṇaśaṅkābījaṃ svātmani mādhavānurāgotkarṣaḥ/
analyzed: mālatī yathā tasya jīvita pradāyinā uham avasitā mṛtā iti mām śrutvā saṃtapyamānasya tat tathāvidham śarīra ratnam na parihīyate yathā ca loka antara gatām api mām uddiśya sa janaḥ smaraṇa kathā mātra pariśeṣām kāla antareṇa api lokayātrām na śithilīkaroti tathā kuru atra mādhava maraṇa śaṅkā bījam sva ātmani mādhava anurāga utkarṣaḥ

original: yathāhaṃ tadalābhāttadanurāge jīvitaṃ tyakṣyāmi tathāsāvapi madanurāgotkarṣācchmaśānapradeśavṛttāntāvagamācca mayyavasitāyāmasau svajīvitanirapekṣastyajedapi śarīram/ yathā tu jīvati tathā kurviti/ tvatprayatnavaśātkathaṃcidaparityaktajīvito'sau kālakrameṇa yathā māṃ na vismarati tadapi tvayaiva kartavyamiti bhāvaḥ/

original: evaṃ te priyasakhī mālatī sakāmā bhavati// makarandaḥ/ hanteti premātiśayamaraṇodyogapratīterharṣaviṣādadyotakaḥ// mādhavaḥ - nairāśyeti/ nairāśyena matpāṇigrahaṇapratyāśābhāve taddhetukasvajīvitapratyāśābhāvena kātarā cakitā dhīryasyāstasyā hariṇekṣaṇāyā nikāmaṃ bhṛśaṃ karuṇaṃ maraṇodyogasūcanācchokātiśayajanakam/
analyzed: evam te priya sakhī mālatī sa kāmā bhavati makarandaḥ hantā iti prema atiśaya maraṇa udyoga pratīteḥ harṣa viṣāda dyotakaḥ mādhavaḥ nairāśya iti nairāśyena mad pāṇigrahaṇa pratyāśā abhāve tad hetuka sva jīvita pratyāśā abhāvena kātarā cakitā dhīḥ yasyāḥ tasyāḥ hariṇa īkṣaṇāyāḥ nikāmam bhṛśam karuṇam maraṇa udyoga sūcanāt śoka atiśaya janakam

original: atha svaviṣayānurāgaprakarṣapratītermanoharaṃ ca vātsalyena ratibhāvena/ yadyapi vātsalyaśabdo'patyaviṣayāṃ ratimācaṣṭe, tathāpyatra lakṣaṇayā ratisāmānyamātramāha, na tu vātsalyaṃ nāma daśamaṃ rasāntaram/ prasiddhālaṃkāraprasthāneṣvavyutpādanāt/ pratyuta niṣedhādeva gurunṛpaputrādiviṣayāyā raterbhāvatvameva hi vyavasthāpitam/
analyzed: atha sva viṣaya anurāga prakarṣa pratīteḥ manoharam ca vātsalyena rati bhāvena yadi api vātsalya śabda upatya viṣayām ratim ācaṣṭe tathā api atra lakṣaṇayā rati sāmānya mātram āha na tu vātsalyam nāma daśamam rasa antaram prasiddha alaṃkāra prasthāneṣu avyutpādanāt pratyuta niṣedhāt eva guru nṛpa putra ādi viṣayāyāḥ rateḥ bhāva tvam eva hi vyavasthāpitam

original: ``ratirdevādiviṣayā vyabhicārī tathā jitā''/ tasmāt ``tamaṅkamāropya śarīrayogajaiḥ'' ityādau putragocarāyā rateḥ paripoṣādasaṃlakṣyakramavyaṅgyabhedo bhāvadhvanireva rasāntaram/ na ca bharatenātra pṛthaksthāyī pradarśitaḥ/ nāpi ratirevāsya sthāyī/ tasyāḥ śṛṅgāraikasthāyitvāt, asya rasāntaratvābhāvaprasaṅgācca/ nāpi śṛṅgārabheda evāyam/
analyzed: ratiḥ deva ādi viṣayā vyabhicārī tathā jitā tasmāt tam aṅkam āropya śarīra yoga jaiḥ ityādau putra gocarāyāḥ rateḥ paripoṣāt asaṃlakṣya krama vyaṅgya bhedaḥ bhāva dhvaniḥ eva rasa antaram na ca bharatena atra pṛthak sthāyī pradarśitaḥ na api ratiḥ eva asya sthāyī tasyāḥ śṛṅgāra eka sthāyi tvāt asya rasa antara tva abhāva prasaṅgāt ca nā api śṛṅgāra bhedaḥ eva ayam

original: makarandaḥ/ paramā sīmā parākāṣṭhā/ netaḥparaṃ snehasyātiśaya iti bhāvaḥ/ atha pūrvameva vihitasaṃketā lavaṅgikā stambhāntaritaṃ mādhavaṃ pratyavasaro'yaṃ tvadāgamanasyeti hastasaṃjñayā bodhayatīti// mādhavaḥ/ paravānasmi parādhīnaḥ kṛto'smi sādhvasena vepathustambhādinā sāttvikena, na tu bhayena/
analyzed: makarandaḥ paramā sīmā parākāṣṭhā na itas param snehasya atiśayaḥ iti bhāvaḥ atha pūrvam eva vihita saṃketā lavaṅgikā stambha antaritam mādhavam pratyavasaraḥ yam tvad āgamanasya iti hasta saṃjñayā bodhayati iti mādhavaḥ paravān asmi para adhīnaḥ kṛtaḥ smi sādhvasena vepathu stambha ādinā sāttvikena na tu bhayena

original: tasyedānīmanucitatvāttena śaṅkāmātraṃ sādhvasaśabdena vivakṣitam/ śaṅkayā ca stambhādayo lakṣyanta iti grāhyam/ mālatīsamīpe lavaṅgikādhiṣṭhite pradeśe sthātuṃ paravānadhīno'smīti// makarandaḥ - iyamiti/ nedīyasāmatisaṃnihitānāṃ cirābhilaṣitānāmabhyudayānāṃ priyāprāptiprabhṛtīnāmabhīṣṭānāmiyameva prakṛtiḥ svabhāvaḥ/
analyzed: tasya idānīm anucita tvāt tena śaṅkā mātram sādhvasa śabdena vivakṣitam śaṅkayā ca stambha ādayaḥ lakṣyante iti grāhyam mālatī samīpe lavaṅgikā dhiṣṭhite pradeśe sthātum paravān adhīnaḥ asmi iti makarandaḥ iyam iti nedīyasām ati saṃnihitānām cira abhilaṣitānām abhyudayānām priyā prāpti prabhṛtīnām abhīṣṭānām iyam eva prakṛtiḥ svabhāvaḥ

original: yatstambhapralayavepathuprabhṛtisāttvikāvirbhāvakṛtaṃ pāravaśyamityarthaḥ/ etacca prakṛtopayogitvena vañcanādadhibalaṃ nāmāṅgam/ yathā - ``ceṣṭayā sātisaṃdhānaṃ vadantyadhibalaṃ hi tat''// mālatī/ sakhi, anukūlatayā prasādaṃ kuru/ maraṇamabhijānīhītyarthaḥ/
analyzed: yat stambha pralaya vepathu prabhṛti sāttvika āvirbhāva kṛtam pāravaśyam iti arthaḥ etat ca prakṛta upayogitvena vañcanāt adhibalam nāma aṅgam yathā ceṣṭayā sa atisaṃdhānam vadanti adhibalam hi tat mālatī sakhi anukūla tayā prasādam kuru maraṇam abhijānīhi iti arthaḥ

original: atha mādhavo lavaṅgikātvamivāpannastasyāśca svasya ca dhāraṇaṃ prākṛtasaṃskṛtayoḥ samānarūpaṃ vākyaṃ prayuṅkte - sarala iti/ sarale ṛjubuddhe/ rambhoru/ ``ūrūttarapadādaupamye'' ityūṅ/ sāhase maraṇodyoge rāgamicchāṃ parihara parityaja/ saṃrambhaṃ muñca/
analyzed: atha mādhavaḥ lavaṅgikā tvam iva āpannaḥ tasyāḥ ca svasya ca dhāraṇam prākṛta saṃskṛtayoḥ samāna rūpam vākyam prayuṅkte sarale iti sarale ṛju buddhe rambhā ūro ūru uttara padāt aupamye iti ūṅ sāhase maraṇa udyoge rāgam icchām parihara parityaja saṃrambham muñca

original: yatastava virahāyāsaṃ viyogaduḥkhaṃ virasamatyantavināśarūpaṃ mama hṛdayaṃ soḍhumasahamakṣamamiti tatsamatvādeteṣāṃ śabdānāṃ prākṛtasaṃskṛtayoḥ samānaṃ rūpam/ yathāha - ``tatsamaṃ tadbhavaṃ deśītyanekaḥ prākṛtakramaḥ'' iti/ na cātra bhāṣāśleṣabhrāntiḥ kāryā/ vācyabhedābhāvācchleṣatvānupapatteḥ/
analyzed: yatas tava viraha āyāsam viyoga duḥkham virasam atyanta vināśa rūpam mama hṛdayam soḍhum asaham akṣamam iti tad sama tvāt eteṣām śabdānām prākṛta saṃskṛtayoḥ samānam rūpam yathā āha tatsamam tad bhavam deśī iti anekaḥ prākṛta kramaḥ iti na ca atra bhāṣā āśleṣa bhrāntiḥ kāryā vācya bheda abhāvāt śleṣa tva anupapatteḥ

original: na ca lavaṅgikāmādhavayorvaktrorbhedādvācyabhedo'pyastyeveti vācyam/ mādhavasyātra vaktṛtvātkiṃtu haṭhādeva lavaṅgikābuddhitirodhānena svaprajñāpanena vailakṣaṇyānniḥśaṅkaṃ svamanogatasarvasvanivedanaṃ na kuryāditi lavaṅgikāvācyamevārthaṃ taducitaireva śabdairmādhavaḥ pratipāditavānityekameva vākyameka evārtha iti na śleṣāvakāśa iti//10//
analyzed: na ca lavaṅgikā mādhavayoḥ vaktroḥ bhedāt vācya bhedaḥ upi asti eva iti vācyam mādhavasya atra vaktṛ tvāt kiṃtu haṭhāt eva lavaṅgikā buddhi tirodhānena sva prajñāpanena vailakṣaṇyāt niḥśaṅkam sva manogata sarva sva nivedanam na kuryāt iti lavaṅgikā vācyam eva artham tad ucitaiḥ eva śabdaiḥ mādhavaḥ pratipāditavān iti ekam eva vākyam ekaḥ eva arthaḥ iti na śleṣa avakāśaḥ iti

original: mālatī/ alaṅghanīyaste mālatyāḥ praṇāmaḥ// pūrvavadeva mādhavastatsamaireva śabdairlavaṅgikevāha - kiṃ veti/ vicchedenātyantaviprayogeṇa dāruṇo ya āyāso maraṇodyogātmakaṃ duṣkaraṃ karma tatkāriṇīti saṃbodhanam/ īdṛśīṃ tvāṃ kiṃ vā bhaṇāmi kathaṃ mriyasvetyanujñāṃ dadyām/ na kathaṃcinmaraṇānujñāṃ kartuṃ śaknomītyarthaḥ/
analyzed: mālatī a laṅghanīyaḥ te mālatyāḥ praṇāmaḥ pūrvavat eva mādhavaḥ tad samaiḥ eva śabdaiḥ lavaṅgikā iva āha kim vā iti vicchedena atyanta viprayogeṇa dāruṇaḥ yaḥ āyāsaḥ maraṇa udyoga ātmakam duṣkaram karma tad kāriṇī iti saṃbodhanam īdṛśīm tvām kim vā bhaṇāmi katham mriyasva iti anujñām dadyām na kathaṃcid maraṇa anujñām kartum śaknomi iti arthaḥ

original: tasmāttvameva ``īpsitārthasthiraniścayaṃ manaḥ'' iti nītyā kāmaṃ svābhilaṣitaṃ kuru/ he varārohe, mama parirambhaṇaṃ dehi/ māmāliṅgetyarthaḥ/ atha ca mādhavaucityena kāmaṃ manorathaṃ kuruniṣpādaya/ varārohe cirasya prārthitaṃ parirambhaṇaṃ dehītyapi pratīyate/ lavaṅgikayā praśaṃsārthaṃ varārohe iti sakhīsaṃbodhanaṃ yuktameveti//11//
analyzed: tasmāt tvam eva īpsita artha sthira niścayam manaḥ iti nītyā kāmam sva abhilaṣitam kuru he varārohe mama parirambhaṇam dehi mām āliṅga iti arthaḥ atha ca mādhava aucityena kāmam manoratham kuru niṣpādaya varārohe cirasya prārthitam parirambhaṇam dehi iti api pratīyate lavaṅgikayā praśaṃsā artham varārohe iti sakhī saṃbodhanam yuktam eva iti

original: atha mālatī kāmaṃ kurviti sakhyā anumatiṃ matvāha - mālatī/ kathamanugṛhītāsmīti/ sakhyeti śeṣaḥ/ iyamāliṅgāmi/ darśanaṃ bāṣpotpīḍanenāśrūdgamena priyasakhyāḥ pratyakṣaṃ na labhyate/
analyzed: atha mālatī kāmam kuru iti sakhyāḥ anumatim matvā āha mālatī katham anugṛhītā asmi iti sakhyā iti śeṣaḥ iyam āliṅgāmi darśanam bāṣpa utpīḍanena aśru udgamena priya sakhyāḥ pratyakṣam na labhyate

original: evaṃ lavaṅgikābhrameṇa mādhavamāliṅgyāmṛtasarasīva nimagnā niratiśayaṃ nirvṛtiviśeṣamanubhavantyāha - sakhi, kaṭhorakamalagarbhapakṣmalo'nyādṛśa eva te'dya nirvāpayati māṃ śarīrasparśaḥ/ kaṭhorakamalagarbhavatpariṇatapaṅkajabījakośavatpakṣmalo romāñcakañcukitaḥ/
analyzed: evam lavaṅgikā bhrameṇa mādhavam āliṅgya amṛta sarasi iva nimagnā niratiśayam nirvṛti viśeṣam anubhavantī āha sakhi kaṭhora kamala garbha pakṣmalaḥ nyādṛśaḥ eva tedya nirvāpayati mām śarīra sparśaḥ kaṭhora kamala garbha vat pariṇata paṅkaja bīja kośa vat pakṣmalaḥ romāñca kañcukitaḥ

original: idānīṃ kṛtamaraṇaniścayā sakhyā cānumatiṃ kṛtāṃ manyamānā priyatamaṃ prativaktavyaṃ vācikaṃ saṃdiśati - kiṃ ca/ mauliviniveśitāñjalirmama vacanena vijñāpaya taṃ janam/ taṃ janamityanena tasya patitvaṃ niścitya sākṣānnāmagrahaṇānaucityaṃ sūcayati/
analyzed: idānīm kṛta maraṇa niścayā sakhyā ca anumatim kṛtām manyamānā priyatamam prativaktavyam vācikam saṃdiśati kim ca mauli viniveśita añjaliḥ mama vacanena vijñāpaya tam janam tam janam iti anena tasya pati tvam niścitya sākṣāt nāma grahaṇa anaucityam sūcayati

original: tena ca nāhaṃ kanyaiva saṃsthitā manmathenaiva mādhavāya dattā tatpatnyeva kevalam, tādṛśena patyā saha saṃsārasaukhyānyanubhavituṃ nāsti me bhāgyamiti, ata eva śarīraṃ tyajāmīti vyajyate/
analyzed: tena ca na aham kanyā eva saṃsthitā manmathena eva mādhavāya dattā tad patnī eva kevalam tādṛśena patyā saha saṃsāra saukhyāni anubhavitum nā asti me bhāgyam iti atas eva śarīram tyajāmi iti vyajyate

original: vijñāpanāprakāramevāha - yathā na mayā mandabhāgyayāvikasacchatapatralakṣmīvilāsahāriṇo mukhacandramaṇḍalasya te svacchandadarśanena saṃbhāvitaściraṃ locanamahotsavaḥ/ mudhā manorathairavirataṃ vijṛmbhamāṇadurvāraduḥkhāvegavyatikarodvartamānabandhanaṃ dhāritaṃ hṛdayam/ gamitāśca vāraṃvāraṃ saviśeṣaduḥsahāyāsadhūpāyitasakhījanāḥ śarīrasaṃtāpāḥ/
analyzed: vijñāpanā prakāram eva āha yathā na mayā mandabhāgyayā a vikasat śatapatra lakṣmī vilāsa hāriṇaḥ mukha candra maṇḍalasya te svacchanda darśanena saṃbhāvitaḥ ciram locana mahā utsavaḥ mudhā manorathaiḥ aviratam vijṛmbhamāṇa durvāra duḥkha āvega vyatikara udvartamāna bandhanam dhāritam hṛdayam gamitāḥ ca vāram vāram sa viśeṣa duḥsaha āyāsa dhūpāyita sakhī janāḥ śarīra saṃtāpāḥ

original: kathamapyativāhitāścandrātapamalayamārutapramukhā anarthaparamparāḥ/ sāṃprataṃ punarnirāśā saṃvṛttāsmīsi[] vijñāpayetyanvayaḥ/ udvartamānabandhanamunmūlitamūlamativāhitā duḥkhena gamitāḥ/
analyzed: katham api ativāhitāḥ candra ātapa malaya māruta pramukhāḥ anartha paramparāḥ sāṃpratam punar nirāśā saṃvṛttā asmi isi vijñāpaya iti anvayaḥ udvartamāna bandhanam unmūlita mūlam ativāhitāḥ duḥkhena gamitāḥ

original: eṣā ca mādhavaśrīhastanirmāṇamanoharā bakulamālā mālatīnirviśeṣaṃ priyasakhyā draṣṭavyā sarvadā hṛdayena dhāri[ra]ṇīyā ceti vadantī svakaṇṭhādunmucya mādhavahṛdi vinyasyantī stanaśūnyatvavyūḍhoraskatvādinā puruṣamadhigamya puruṣasya cānyasya tatrātyantamaśaṅkitatvānmādhavasyaiva kāmandakīprayatnena saṃnidhānasaṃbhavāttaditaraśarīrasparśe
analyzed: eṣā ca mādhava śrī hasta nirmāṇa manoharā bakula mālā mālatī nirviśeṣam priya sakhyā draṣṭavyā sarvadā hṛdayena ca iti vadantī sva kaṇṭhāt unmucya mādhava hṛdi vinyasyantī stana śūnya tva vyūḍha uraska tva ādinā puruṣam adhigamya puruṣasya ca anyasya tatra atyantam aśaṅkita tvāt mādhavasya eva kāmandakī prayatnena saṃnidhāna saṃbhavāt tad itara śarīra sparśe

original: tādṛśaparamanirvṛtisāttvikalajjāśaṅkātrāsādivyabhicārisaṃvalanonmeṣābhāvāttadaucityena sahasāpasṛtya sādhvasenotkampaṃ vepathumanubhāvaṃ ca nāṭayatītyarthaḥ/ sādhvasaṃ trāsaḥ/ tallakṣaṇaṃ ca - ``trāsaścittacamatkāra ākasmikabhayādibhiḥ'' iti/ anena saṃbhramo nāmāṅgamuktam/ yathā - ``śaṅkātrāsau ca saṃbhramaḥ'' iti// mādhavaḥ/ ekīkṛta iti/
analyzed: tādṛśa parama nirvṛti sāttvika lajjā śaṅkā trāsa ādi vyabhicāri saṃvalana unmeṣa abhāvāt tad aucityena sahasā apasṛtya sādhvasena utkampam vepathum anubhāvam ca nāṭayati iti arthaḥ sādhvasam trāsaḥ tad lakṣaṇam ca trāsaḥ citta camatkāraḥ ākasmika bhaya ādibhiḥ iti anena saṃbhramaḥ nāma aṅgam uktam yathā śaṅkā trāsau ca saṃbhramaḥ iti mādhavaḥ ekīkṛtaḥ iti

original: gāḍhāliṅganavaśānnirbhugnapīnakucakuḍmalayānayāvapīḍya gāḍhamāliṅgya me tvaci karpūrādisaṃtāpanirvāpakaśītaladravyavarga ekīkṛta ekarasatāṃ prāpto niṣikta iva/ āliṅganaṃ kṛtavatyā karpūrādirasaniṣekaḥ kṛta ivetyāliṅganakriyāyāṃ niṣekakriyādhyavasāyātpratīyamānasaṃtāpanirvāpaṇanimittakriyayā svabhāvotprekṣālaṃkāraḥ/
analyzed: gāḍha āliṅgana vaśāt nirbhugna pīna kuca kuḍmalayā anayā avapīḍya gāḍham āliṅgya me tvaci karpūra ādi saṃtāpa nirvāpaka śītala dravya vargaḥ ekīkṛtaḥ ekarasa tām prāptaḥ niṣiktaḥ iva āliṅganam kṛtavatyā karpūra ādi rasa niṣekaḥ kṛtaḥ iva iti āliṅgana kriyāyām niṣeka kriyā adhyavasāyāt pratīyamāna saṃtāpa nirvāpaṇa nimitta kriyayā svabhāva utprekṣā alaṃkāraḥ

original: eṣa saṃcintyamānārthaprāptirūpaḥ kramaḥ/ yathā - ``kramastu cintitāvāptiḥ'' iti//12//
analyzed: eṣa saṃcintyamāna artha prāpti rūpaḥ kramaḥ yathā kramaḥ tu cintita avāptiḥ iti

original: mālatī/ aho, lavaṅgikayā mālatī vipralabdhā vañcitā/ svābhilaṣitasaṃpādane'pyākāragopanārthaṃ vañcanamityuktam/ anenāvahitthākhyo vyabhicārī sūcitaḥ/ yathā - ``avahitthā tu lajjāderharṣādyākāragopanam'' iti// mādhavaḥ/ ayīti saṃbodhane/ svamanovyathāmeva tvaṃ prakaṭayasi na tu parajanamanorujaṃ jānāsi/ yato madāliṅganena vañcitamātmānaṃ manyase/
analyzed: mālatī aho lavaṅgikayā mālatī vipralabdhā vañcitā sva abhilaṣita saṃpādane pi ākāra gopana artham vañcanam iti uktam anena avahittha ākhyaḥ vyabhicārī sūcitaḥ yathā avahitthā tu lajjā ādeḥ harṣa ādi ākāra gopanam iti mādhavaḥ ayi iti saṃbodhane sva manaḥ vyathām eva tvam prakaṭayasi na tu para jana manaḥ rujam jānāsi yatas mad āliṅganena vañcitam ātmānam manyase

original: na punaryathā me tathaivāsyāpi samaḥ suduḥsahaḥ saṃtāpaḥ/ tanmadāliṅganenāsya bhavatu saṃtāpanirvāpa ityanukampā tvayi dṛśyate/ tasmāttvaṃ purata evopālabhasa ityarthaḥ/ svavyathāmevāha - uddāmeti/ uddāmaḥ prauḍhodehaparidāha eva mahājvaro yeṣu tāni/
analyzed: na punar yathā me tathā eva asya api samaḥ su duḥsahaḥ saṃtāpaḥ tad mad āliṅganena asya bhavatu saṃtāpa nirvāpaḥ iti anukampā tvayi dṛśyate tasmāt tvam puratas eva upālabhase iti arthaḥ sva vyathām eva āha uddāma iti uddāmaḥ prauḍhaḥ deha paridāhaḥ eva mahājvaraḥ yeṣu tāni

original: tathā manorathamātrakalpitenāpi tvatsamāgamena vinoditāpanoditā vedanā tvadvirahajanyā vyathā yeṣu tāni/ tathā ``asti mālatyā mayi snehaḥ'' iti saṃvedanamātreṇāvalambitaṃ kathaṃcittvatsnehaḥ kadācitphaliṣyatītyāśayā vidhṛtaṃ jīvitaṃ yeṣu tādṛśāni dināni mayāpi tvayeva na kimativāhitāni duḥkhena gamitāni/ yādṛśī tava virahavyathā tādṛśyeva mamāpi/
analyzed: tathā manoratha mātra kalpitena api tvad samāgamena vinodita apanoditā vedanā tvad viraha janyā vyathā yeṣu tāni tathā asti mālatyāḥ mayi snehaḥ iti saṃvedana mātreṇa avalambitam kathaṃcid tvad snehaḥ kadācid phaliṣyati iti āśayā vidhṛtam jīvitam yeṣu tādṛśāni dināni mayā api tvayā iva na kim ativāhitāni duḥkhena gamitāni yādṛśī tava viraha vyathā tādṛśī eva mama api

original: tattu kevalaṃ tvayā viditametanna viditamityarthaḥ/ etattu parasparānurāgabījasamutkṣepādākṣepo nāmāṅgam/ yathā - ``garbhabījasamutkṣepādākṣepaḥ parikīrtitaḥ'' iti//13//
analyzed: tat tu kevalam tvayā viditam etat na viditam iti arthaḥ etat tu paraspara anurāga bīja samutkṣepāt ākṣepaḥ nāma aṅgam yathā garbha bīja samutkṣepāt ākṣepaḥ parikīrtitaḥ iti

original: lavaṅgikā/ sakhi, upālambhanīyamupālabdhāsi/ yuktamevānena tvadupālambhanamityarthaḥ// kalahaṃsaḥ/ aho sarasaramaṇīyatā saṃvidhānasya// makarandaḥ/ etanmādhavenoktamevaṃ satyameva/ tadevāha - tvaṃ vatsaleti/
analyzed: lavaṅgikā sakhi upālambhanīyam upālabdhā asi yuktam eva anena tvad upālambhanam iti arthaḥ kalahaṃsaḥ aho sarasa ramaṇīya tā saṃvidhānasya makarandaḥ etat mādhavena uktam evam satyam eva tat eva āha tvam vatsalā iti

original: vatsalā premavatī svasminnityetāvataiva kathamapyatikleśenāvalambitātmā vidhṛtajīvito'yaṃ jana iyato divasānanaiṣīdativāhitavāniti satyameva tvatsnehādanyo nāsya prāṇadhāraṇe kaściddhetuḥ/ atastvayaivāsya jīvitarakṣaṇe niḥśaṅkaṃ pravartitavyam, na kāmandakyādiṣu bhāro nikṣeptavya iti bhāvaḥ/
analyzed: vatsalā premavatī svasmin iti etāvatā eva katham api ati kleśena avalambita ātmā vidhṛta jīvitaḥ yam janaḥ iyataḥ divasān anaiṣīt ativāhitavān iti satyam eva tvad snehāt anyaḥ na asya prāṇa dhāraṇe kaścid hetuḥ atas tvayā eva asya jīvita rakṣaṇe niḥśaṅkam pravartitavyam na kāmandakī ādiṣu bhāraḥ nikṣeptavyaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: etadevāha - ābaddhakaṃkaṇasya karasya yaḥ praṇayaḥ parigrahaḥ sa eva prasādo'nugrahastamāsādya prāpyāsau nandatu/ tathā cirāya cireṇa kāmā me manorathāścirakālakāṅkṣitā yuvayoḥ phalantviti//14//
analyzed: etat eva āha ābaddha kaṃkaṇasya karasya yaḥ praṇayaḥ parigrahaḥ saḥ eva prasādaḥ anugrahaḥ tam āsādya prāpya asau nandatu tathā cirāya cireṇa kāmāḥ me manorathāḥ cira kāla kāṅkṣitāḥ yuvayoḥ phalantu iti

original: lavaṅgikā/ mahānubhāva, hṛdaye'pyapratihatasvayaṃgrāhasāhaso'yaṃ janaḥ kimidānīṃ karagrahaṇe vicārayati/ yena mādhavena hṛdaye svayameva gṛhyamāṇena nivāritavatī kevalamayaṃ mahānpuruṣārtha ityaṅgīkṛtavatī sā kareṇa kare svayaṃ gṛhyamāṇe'pi na vicārayet, tasmānniḥśaṅkaṃ svayamevāsyāḥ karaṃ gṛhṇātvityāśayaḥ// mālatī/
analyzed: lavaṅgikā mahā anubhāva hṛdaye api apratihata svayaṃgrāha sāhasaḥ yam janaḥ kim idānīm kara grahaṇe vicārayati yena mādhavena hṛdaye svayam eva gṛhyamāṇena nivāritavatī kevalam ayam mahān puruṣa arthaḥ iti aṅgīkṛtavatī sā kareṇa kare svayam gṛhyamāṇe api na vicārayet tasmāt niḥśaṅkam svayam eva asyāḥ karam gṛhṇātu iti āśayaḥ mālatī
