original: hā dhik, kanyakājanaviruddhaṃ kimapyupanyasyati/ kimapītigurujanānanumataṃ svakaragrahaṇaṃ vyajyate// kāmandakī/ praviśya/ vadatīti śeṣaḥ/ putrīti tatpariṇayane mātṛtvādastyeva mamādhikāra iti vyaṅgyam/
analyzed: hā dhik kanyakā jana viruddham kim api upanyasyati kim api iti guru jana ananumatam sva kara grahaṇam vyajyate kāmandakī praviśya vadati iti śeṣaḥ putrī iti tad pariṇayane mātṛ tvāt asti eva mama adhikāraḥ iti vyaṅgyam

original: kātare kulakanyakājanaviruddhaṃ kathaṃ kuryāmiti duḥśaṅkodvignamānase kathaṃciddaivānugrahādupanate'vasare śīghravidheye kṛtya etadvilambanaṃ kiṃnimittam/ avicāryaiva śīghramasya pāṇiṃ gṛhāṇeti bhāvaḥ// pura iti/
analyzed: kātare kula kanyakā jana viruddham katham kuryām iti duḥśaṅka udvigna mānase kathaṃcid daiva anugrahāt upanata ivasare śīghra vidheye kṛtye etat vilambanam kiṃnimittam a vicārya eva śīghram asya pāṇim gṛhāṇa iti bhāvaḥ puras iti

original: yasya tvayi viṣaye yatra yasminviṣaye ca tava pūrvaṃ cakṣuḥprītistadanu cittāsaṅgastadanu saṃkalpādikrameṇa tanuglāniścetyādyā madanāvasthāḥ prādurāsan/
analyzed: yasya tvayi viṣaye yatra yasmin viṣaye ca tava pūrvam cakṣuḥ prītiḥ tadanu citta āsaṅgaḥ tadanu saṃkalpa ādi krameṇa tanu glāniḥ ca ityādyāḥ madana avasthāḥ prādurāsan

original: atra manaḥsaṅgakārśyāni vācyāni manaso'nanyaparatvena taccintaikavyāpṛtatvena saṃkalpajāgarakārśyatanuglānyaratayo vyajyante, sa evāyaṃ yuvā preyāniti vayasā premṇā cānurūpatvaṃ dhvanyate tasmādihāsminsuvadane sarvadā suvadane jaḍatāmapratipattiṃ muñca/
analyzed: atra manaḥ saṅga kārśyāni vācyāni manasaḥ ūna nya para tvena tad cintā eka vyāpṛta tvena saṃkalpa jāgara kārśya tanu glānya ratayaḥ vyajyante saḥ eva ayam yuvā preyān iti vayasā premṇā ca anurūpa tvam dhvanyate tasmāt iha asmin suvadane sarvadā suvadane jaḍatām apratipattim muñca

original: vidhāturvaidagdhyaṃ bhavadubhayanirmāṇanaipuṇyaṃ bhavadubhayasamāgamenaiva vilasatu saphalaṃ bhavatu/ madanaśca sakāmo bhavatu/ jāḍyaṃ vihāya yāvadunmadādyavasthāntarāṇi nollasanti tāvadeva preyāṃsaṃ vṛṇīṣveti bhāvaḥ/ jāḍyaṃ ca vyabhicāribhāvaḥ/ yathā - ``kriyāsvapāṭavaṃ jāḍyaṃ cintotkaṇṭhābhayādibhiḥ'' iti//15//
analyzed: vidhātuḥ vaidagdhyam bhavat ubhaya nirmāṇa naipuṇyam bhavat ubhaya samāgamena eva vilasatu sa phalam bhavatu madanaḥ ca sa kāmaḥ bhavatu jāḍyam vihāya yāvat unmada ādi avasthā antarāṇi na ullasanti tāvat eva preyāṃsam vṛṇīṣva iti bhāvaḥ jāḍyam ca vyabhicāri bhāvaḥ yathā kriyāsu apāṭavam jāḍyam cintā utkaṇṭhā bhaya ādibhiḥ iti

original: lavaṅgikā/ bhagavati, kṛṣṇacaturdaśīrajanyām/ tasyāmeva sāhasakarmaprasiddherāgamoktatvāt/ smaśānasaṃcāreṇa nirvyūḍho nirvartito mahāmāṃsavikrayarūpo viṣama āryajanānucito vyavasāyo yena/
analyzed: lavaṅgikā bhagavati kṛṣṇa caturdaśī rajanyām tasyām eva sāhasa karma prasiddheḥ āgama ukta tvāt smaśāna saṃcāreṇa nirvyūḍhaḥ nirvartitaḥ mahāmāṃsa vikraya rūpaḥ viṣamaḥ ārya jana anucitaḥ vyavasāyaḥ yena

original: anena mālatyāṃ mādhavasya prakṛṣṭo'nurāgabandha uktaḥ sa cāsau niṣṭhāpitaṃ nirāghāṭitaṃ pracaṇḍapāṣaṇḍadordaṇḍasāhasaṃ mālatīvadharūpaṃ karma yena sa ityanena jīvitatrāṇenopakārātiśaya uktaḥ/ sāhasikaḥ khalveṣaḥ/ ataḥ priyasakhyutkampitā/
analyzed: anena mālatyām mādhavasya prakṛṣṭaḥ anurāga bandhaḥ uktaḥ sa ca asau niṣṭhāpitam nirāghāṭitam pracaṇḍa pāṣaṇḍa dos daṇḍa sāhasam mālatī vadha rūpam karma yena saḥ iti anena jīvita trāṇena upakāra atiśayaḥ uktaḥ sāhasikaḥ khalu eṣaḥ atas priya sakhī utkampitā

original: atra lavaṅgikā tasyāṃ niśīthinyāmekākī bhūtvātyantajugupsitanṛmāṃsavikrayasāhasarasiko bhīṣaṇapākhaṇḍavadhādraudraprakṛtiravimṛśyakārī cāsau svayamevānayā dṛṣṭaḥ, tadasminbālāyā yuktaiva jaḍatā kampamānatā ceti mādhavamuddiśya narmoktivyājena niratiśayapremṇā paramopakāriṇi cāsminnucitamevāsminnavasare jāḍyādikamasyā iti vaiparītyenopālabhata hati
analyzed: atra lavaṅgikā tasyām niśīthinyām ekākī bhūtvā atyanta jugupsita nṛ māṃsa vikraya sāhasa rasikaḥ bhīṣaṇa pākhaṇḍa vadhāt raudra prakṛtiḥ avimṛśya kārī ca asau svayam eva anayā dṛṣṭaḥ tat asmin bālāyāḥ yuktā eva jaḍa tā kampamāna tā ca iti mādhavam uddiśya narma ukti vyājena niratiśaya premṇā parama upakāriṇi ca asmin ucitam eva asmin avasare jāḍya ādikam asyāḥ iti vaiparītyena upālabhata ha ti

original: voddhavyam// mālatī - hā tāteti/ evaṃvidhānucitakāriṇyahaṃ kathaṃ punarapi tvanmukhaṃ vilokayeyamiti śeṣaḥ// kāmandakī - iyamiti/
analyzed: voddhavyam mālatī hā tāta iti evaṃvidha anucita kāriṇī aham katham punar api tvad mukham vilokayeyam iti śeṣaḥ kāmandakī iyam iti

original: aśeṣetyanena niratiśayaiśvaryasaṃpannasyāpatyaṃ na daridrasyeti tasyāpyekatvenātīva premabhājanaṃ tadapi ratnamiva ratnaṃ saundaryādyanekaguṇaśālyapatyamiyaṃ mālatītyanenāsyāmanādarastvayā na kathaṃcidapi kartavya iti sūcayati/
analyzed: aśeṣa iti anena niratiśaya aiśvarya saṃpannasya apatyam na daridrasya iti tasya api ekatvena atīva prema bhājanam tat api ratnam iva ratnam saundarya ādi aneka guṇa śāli apatyam iyam mālatī iti anena asyām anādaraḥ tvayā na kathaṃcid api kartavyaḥ iti sūcayati

original: seyaṃ prathamaṃ sadṛśayoranyonyānurūpayoryuvayoḥ saṃyogarasikena vedhasā sa khalūtpādayanneveyamasmā ayaṃ cāsyā iti nirṇayaṃ bhālatale likhitavān/ tadanantaraṃ manmathenākasmādeva dvayormanoghaṭakena mayā ca taducitamānuṣaprayatnavidhāyinyā tubhyaṃ dīyate// rodanaṃ ca kanyāpradānānantaraṃ mātṛtvādvātsalyācca// bāṣpāyitaṃ bāṣpodvamanaṃ kṛtam/
analyzed: sā iyam prathamam sadṛśayoḥ anyonya anurūpayoḥ yuvayoḥ saṃyoga rasikena vedhasā sa khalu utpādayan eva iyam asmai ayam ca asyāḥ iti nirṇayam bhāla tale likhitavān tad anantaram manmathena akasmāt eva dvayoḥ manaḥ ghaṭakena mayā ca tad ucita mānuṣa prayatna vidhāyinyā tubhyam dīyate rodanam ca kanyā pradāna anantaram mātṛ tvāt vātsalyāt ca bāṣpāyitam bāṣpa udvamanam kṛtam

original: ``bāṣpoṣmabhyāmudvamane'' iti ṇijantādbhāve ktaḥ// vijñāpayāmītyuktiḥ kāmandakyāḥ kanyāpradānameva tatkaiṅkaryamiti nītyā vinayadyotanārtham// mādhavastu gurujanaucityenāha - ājñāpayeti// kāmandakī - pariṇatīti/
analyzed: bāṣpa ūṣmabhyām udvamane iti ṇic antāt bhāve ktaḥ vijñāpayāmi iti uktiḥ kāmandakyāḥ kanyā pradānam eva tat kaiṅkaryam iti nītyā vinaya dyotana artham mādhavaḥ tu guru jana aucityena āha ājñāpaya iti kāmandakī pariṇatī iti

original: tvadvidhānāṃ mahākulīnatvādiguṇaśālināṃ mahānāyakānāṃ prītayaḥ snehāḥ pariṇatiramaṇīyāḥ paripākena manoharāḥ na tu kṣudrajanasnehavatpariṇativirasāḥ/ ato na mayā kiṃcidapi vaktavyam/ tathāhamapi taistairhetubhirnimittaiḥ pitṛsnehavātsalyādibhirmānyānullaṅghyavacanā/ tattasmādihāsyāṃ suvadanāyām/ he tāta/
analyzed: tvadvidhānām mahā kulīna tva ādi guṇa śālinām mahā nāyakānām prītayaḥ snehāḥ pariṇati ramaṇīyāḥ paripākena manoharāḥ na tu kṣudra jana sneha vat pariṇati virasāḥ atas na mayā kiṃcid api vaktavyam tathā aham api taiḥ taiḥ hetubhiḥ nimittaiḥ pitṛ sneha vātsalya ādibhiḥ mānya an ullaṅghya vacanā tat tasmāt iha asyām su vadanāyām he tāta

original: vātsalyātiśayādapatye'pi tātaśabdaḥ prayojyaḥ/ sa tādṛśaḥ paricayo gāḍhasneha eva karuṇā kṛpā tasyāḥ sakāśānmā viraṃsīrvirato mā bhūḥ/ asyāṃ snehānubandhenaiva mayi tvayā kṛpā kṛtetyarthaḥ/ viraṃsīriti ``vyāṅparibhyo ramaḥ'' iti parasmaipadam/ ramiśca śyani paṭhyate manirityanij tkam
analyzed: vātsalya atiśayāt apatye api tāta śabdaḥ prayojyaḥ sa tādṛśaḥ paricayaḥ gāḍha snehaḥ eva karuṇā kṛpā tasyāḥ sakāśāt mā viraṃsīḥ virataḥ mā bhūḥ asyām sneha anubandhena eva mayi tvayā kṛpā kṛtā iti arthaḥ viraṃsīḥ iti ramaḥ iti parasmaipadam ramiḥ ca śyani paṭhyate maniḥ iti anic t kam

original: ṛ)/ māṅyogādaḍāgamapratiṣedhaḥ/ vināvyavadhānādaḍāgamapratiṣedho nāstītyaśābdikoktaṃ heyam/ ``mā tāta sāhasaṃ kārṣīrmama pūrvaparigrahaḥ/ praśnānuktvā tu kaunteya pibasva ca harasva ca//'' ityādau bahuvyavadhāne'pi pratiṣedhadarśanāt//16//
analyzed: ṛ māṅ yogāt aṭ āgama pratiṣedhaḥ vinā avyavadhānāt aṭ āgama pratiṣedhaḥ na asti iti a śābdika uktam heyam mā tāta sāhasam kārṣīḥ mama pūrva parigrahaḥ praśnān uktvā tu kaunteya pibasva ca harasva ca ityādau bahu vyavadhāne api pratiṣedha darśanāt

original: iti pādayoḥ patitumicchati// mādhavaḥ/ vātsalyādapatyapremṇaḥ prasaṅgaḥ prastāvo'tikrāmatyaucityamullaṅghayate/ yatsakalalokavandyā bhagavatī svayaṃ matpraṇāmaṃ kartumicchati/ anucitakarmaṇi pravartata iti bhāvaḥ// makarandaḥ - bhagavatīti/ ślāghyeti/ ślāghyānvayā mahākulaprasūteti hetoḥ/ tathā nayanotsavakāriṇīti niratiśayasaundaryaśālinīti/
analyzed: iti pādayoḥ patitum icchati mādhavaḥ vātsalyāt apatya premṇaḥ prasaṅgaḥ yat sakala loka vandyā bhagavatī svayam mad praṇāmam kartum icchati anucita karmaṇi pravartate iti bhāvaḥ makarandaḥ bhagavatī iti ślāghyā iti ślāghya anvayā mahā kula prasūtā iti hetoḥ tathā nayana utsava kāriṇī iti niratiśaya saundarya śālinī iti

original: tathā nirvyūḍho nirvāhaṃ gamitaḥ sauhṛdarasaḥ sauhārdasārabhūtā ratiryayā sā tādṛśīti/ tathā guṇairanyaiḥ sauśīlyādibhiraparigaṇanīyairujjvalā nirmaleti/ eteṣvekaikamevānyanirapekṣaṃ garīyo'natikramaṇīyaṃ vaśīkaraṇametadāyattībhāvasādhanam/ tadupari yuṣmākaṃ nirupādhikahitācaraṇapravṛttānāṃ sarvalokamānyānāmapīyamevaṃvidhā dṛśyate/
analyzed: tathā nirvyūḍhaḥ nirvāham gamitaḥ sauhṛda rasaḥ sauhārda sāra bhūtā ratiḥ yayā sā tādṛśī iti tathā guṇaiḥ anyaiḥ sauśīlya ādibhiḥ a parigaṇanīyaiḥ ujjvalā nirmalā iti eteṣu ekaikam eva anya nirapekṣam garīyaḥ an atikramaṇīyam vaśīkaraṇam etat āyattībhāva sādhanam tad upari yuṣmākam nirupādhika hita ācaraṇa pravṛttānām sarva loka mānyānām api iyam evaṃvidhā dṛśyate

original: vātsalyātiśayācchiśormādhavasya praṇāmaścikīrṣita ityukte'tha kimahaṃ bravīmi/ itaḥ paramasyāmādarātiśayānubandhane kiṃ vaktavyamityarthaḥ//17//
analyzed: vātsalya atiśayāt śiśoḥ mādhavasya praṇāmaḥ cikīrṣitaḥ iti uktā itha kim aham bravīmi itas param asyām ādara atiśaya anubandhane kim vaktavyam iti arthaḥ

original: athobhayoḥ sādhāraṇaṃ dharmyamupadeśamāha - preya iti/ preyaḥ priyatamaḥ/ mitraṃ sakhā/ tathā samagrā sakalā bandhutā bandhusamūhaḥ/ sarve'khilāḥ kāmyanta iti kāmā viṣayāstathā/ śevadhirnidhiḥ/ kiṃ bahunā jīvitaṃ vā strīṇāṃ bhartaiva, puṃsāṃ ca dharmadārāḥ/
analyzed: atha ubhayoḥ sādhāraṇam dharmyam upadeśam āha preyaḥ iti preyaḥ priyatamaḥ mitram sakhā tathā samagrā sakalā bandhu tā bandhu samūhaḥ sarve akhilāḥ kāmyante iti kāmāḥ viṣayāḥ tathā śevadhiḥ nidhiḥ kim bahunā jīvitam vā strīṇām bhartā eva puṃsām ca dharma dārāḥ

original: evaṃ snigdhamitrāṇītyetaddharmarahasyaṃ lokaśāstrasiddhaṃ vatsayorjñātaṃ manogataṃ sarvathāstu/ etāvatsarvadānusaṃdheyamityarthaḥ/ vatsayorityatra ``pumānstriyā'' ityekaśeṣaḥ/ ubhayorvātsalyasya tulyatvādvatsaśabdaprayogaḥ//18//
analyzed: evam snigdha mitrāṇi iti etat dharma rahasyam loka śāstra siddham vatsayoḥ jñātam manogatam sarvathā astu etāvat sarvadā anusaṃdheyam iti arthaḥ vatsayoḥ iti atra pumān striyāḥ iti ekaśeṣaḥ ubhayoḥ vātsalyasya tulya tvāt vatsa śabda prayogaḥ

original: makarandaḥ/ atha kim/ evamevaitadityarthaḥ// lavaṅgikā/ yathā yūyamājñāpayatha// kāmandakī/ evamatra vivāhamaṅgalaṃ nirvartyetaḥ paraṃ nandanavandanārthaṃ kṛtakamālatīveṣaṃ makarandaṃ madayantikālābhalobhādadabhyupagatastrībhāvaṃ sajjīkurvantyāha - vatseti/ ita ārabhya makarandavṛttāntaḥ patāketi pūrvamevoktam/
analyzed: makarandaḥ atha kim evam eva etat iti arthaḥ lavaṅgikā yathā yūyam ājñāpayatha kāmandakī evam atra vivāha maṅgalam nirvartya itas param nandana vandana artham kṛtaka mālatī veṣam makarandam madayantikā lābha lobhāt ad abhyupagata strī bhāvam sajjīkurvantī āha vatsa iti itas ārabhya makaranda vṛttāntaḥ patākā iti pūrvam eva uktam

original: mālatyarthaṃ rājñā preṣitena nepathyena maṅgalālaṃkāreṇa/ pariṇayāya nandanapariṇayāya madayantikāpariṇayāya cetyarthaḥ/ citrayavanikāṃ citrapaṭanirmitāṃ tiraskariṇīm/ antardhānaṃ strīsaṃnidhau vastrādiparidhāne strījanocite'pāṭavātparidhānacalanaśaṅkayā// mādhavaḥ/
analyzed: mālatī artham rājñā preṣitena nepathyena maṅgala alaṃkāreṇa pariṇayāya nandana pariṇayāya madayantikā pariṇayāya ca iti arthaḥ citra yavanikām citra paṭa nirmitām tiraskariṇīm antardhānam strī saṃnidhau vastra ādi paridhāne strī jana ucita īpāṭavāt paridhāna calana śaṅkayā mādhavaḥ

original: sulabhamapi bahvanarthakamanekapratyavāyamatisaṃkaṭaṃ suduṣkaraṃ karma nandanavañcanātmakaṃ vayasyasya/ ``śubhamapi'' ityapi pāṭhaḥ// kāmandakī kastvamiti/ asyāṃ cintāyām/ prabhūtānarthakaṃ suduṣkaraṃ cedaṃ karma, kathamasya rakṣisahasrākule nandanabhavane praveśanirgamau, yadi rājā daivādvijānīyāttadānarthaḥ, kiṃ vā tava bhavedityevaṃrūpāyām/
analyzed: sulabham api bahu anarthakam aneka pratyavāyam ati saṃkaṭam su duṣkaram karma nandana vañcana ātmakam vayasyasya śubham api iti api pāṭhaḥ kāmandakī kaḥ tvam iti asyām cintāyām prabhūta anarthakam su duṣkaram ca idam karma katham asya rakṣi sahasra ākule nandana bhavane praveśa nirgamau yadi rājā daivāt vijānīyāt tadā anarthaḥ kim vā tava bhavet iti evaṃrūpāyām

original: kastvaṃ ko vā tava bhāro mayi vartamānāyāmiti bhāvaḥ/ gāḍhotkaṇṭheti/ gāḍhayā pravṛddhayotkaṇṭhayā priyānavāptijanitena smaradaśānimittenautsukyena vyabhicāriṇā kaṭhoraḥ prauḍho yaḥ keralavadhūnāṃ kapolastadvadacchāḥ pāṇḍuvarṇāśchadāḥ parṇāni yeṣāṃ taistāmbūlīnāṃ nāgavallīnāṃ paṭalaiḥ samūhaiḥ pinaddhāḥ saṃbaddhāḥ phalitā ata eva vyānamrāḥ
analyzed: kaḥ tvam kaḥ vā tava bhāraḥ mayi vartamānāyām iti bhāvaḥ gāḍha utkaṇṭhā iti gāḍhayā pravṛddhayā utkaṇṭhayā priya anavāpti janitena smara daśā nimittena autsukyena vyabhicāriṇā kaṭhoraḥ prauḍhaḥ yaḥ kerala vadhūnām kapolaḥ tadvat acchāḥ pāṇḍu varṇāḥ chadāḥ parṇāni yeṣām taiḥ tāmbūlīnām nāgavallīnām paṭalaiḥ samūhaiḥ pinaddhāḥ saṃbaddhāḥ phalitāḥ atas eva vyānamrāḥ

original: madayantikāgamanaṃ yāvaditi/ tatra yuvayormadayantikāmakarandayośca yugapadeva vivāho nirvartayiṣyata ityāśayaḥ// mādhavaḥ/ kalyāṇāntarāvataṃsā kalyāṇāntarālaṃkārā kalyāṇasaṃpanmālatīprāptilakṣaṇamaṅgalasamṛddhiḥ// kalahaṃsaḥ/ diṣṭyā idamapi priyaṃ no bhaviṣyati/ yannistīrṇavipanmadayantikāsahito makarando'smābhirdraṣṭavyaḥ// lavaṅgikā/
analyzed: madayantikā gamanam yāvat iti tatra yuvayoḥ madayantikā makarandayoḥ ca yugapad eva vivāhaḥ nirvartayiṣyate iti āśayaḥ mādhavaḥ kalyāṇa antara avataṃsā kalyāṇa antara alaṃkārā kalyāṇa saṃpad mālatī prāpti lakṣaṇa maṅgala samṛddhiḥ kalahaṃsaḥ diṣṭyā idam api priyam naḥ bhaviṣyati yat nistīrṇa vipad madayantikā sahitaḥ makarandaḥ usmābhiḥ draṣṭavyaḥ lavaṅgikā ādi api priyam naḥ bhaviṣyati yat nistīrṇa vipad madayantikā

original: śra[śru]taṃ priyasakhyā/ bhagavatyā vihārikāgamanāya makarandāgamanapratīkṣaṇāya ca yaduktaṃ tacchrūtaṃ kim/ tadetatkuruṣvetyarthaḥ// mālatī/ sakhi, tvayāpi gantavyam/ māṃ visṛjyeti śeṣaḥ// lavaṅgikā/ sāṃprataṃ khalu vayameva śiṣṭā bāhyāḥ/ tvaṃ bhartrā saha sukhamāssveti bhāvaḥ// mādhavaḥ/ āmūleti/ anaṅga eva nidāgho gharmasamayaḥ saṃtāpakāritvāt/
analyzed: śraśrutam priya sakhyā bhagavatyā vihārikā gamanāya makaranda āgamana pratīkṣaṇāya ca yat uktam tat śrūtam kim tat etat kuruṣva iti arthaḥ mālatī sakhi tvayā api gantavyam mām visṛjya iti śeṣaḥ lavaṅgikā sāṃpratam khalu vayam eva śiṣṭāḥ bāhyāḥ tvam bhartrā saha sukham āssva iti bhāvaḥ mādhavaḥ āmūla iti anaṅgaḥ eva nidāghaḥ gharma samayaḥ saṃtāpa kāri tvāt

original: tena tapto'yamahamidānīṃ nidāghatapto dvirada ivāmūlaṃ kaṇṭakito romāñcakañcukitaḥ saṃjātakaṇṭakaśca komalo bāhunālo nālasadṛśo bāhuryasya tam/ tathārdrāḥ svedākhyasāttvikabhāvavaśātsalilasaṃbandhavaśāccāṅgulyo dalānīva dalasadṛśyo'ṅgulyo yasya tam/

original: kaviridānīmaṅkāntaramārabhate - tata ityādinā/ kāmandakyā hi nisṛṣṭārthadūtīvyāpāraṃ mālatīmādhavakṛtakapariṇayalakṣaṇaphalaparyavasitaṃ saṃpādya kāmandakīniyuktāyā buddharakṣitāyā api tadvyāpāre ``niyuktaiva hi mayā tatra priyasakhī buddharakṣitā'' iti prāksūcitaṃ madayantikāmakarandasaṃghaṭanena saphalayituṃ kaveraṅkāvatāra iti draṣṭavyam//
analyzed: kaviḥ idānīm aṅka antaram ārabhate tatas ityādinā kāmandakyāḥ hi nisṛṣṭa artha dūtī vyāpāram mālatī mādhava kṛtaka pariṇaya lakṣaṇa phala paryavasitam saṃpādya kāmandakī niyuktāyāḥ buddha rakṣitāyāḥ api tad vyāpāre niyuktā eva hi mayā tatra priya sakhī buddha rakṣitā iti prāk sūcitam madayantikā makaranda saṃghaṭanena saphalayitum kaveḥ aṅka avatāraḥ iti draṣṭavyam

original: buddharakṣitā/ suśliṣṭākṛtimattvena nāśaṅkanīyā mālatīnepathyalakṣmīstayā vipralabdhena nandanena kṛtaḥ karagraho yasya saḥ/
analyzed: buddha rakṣitā su śliṣṭa ākṛtimat tvena na āśaṅkanīyā mālatī nepathya lakṣmīḥ tayā vipralabdhena nandanena kṛtaḥ karagrahaḥ yasya saḥ

original: amātyabhūrivasumandire bhagavatīvacanasaṃvidhānaiḥ ``samāgateyaṃ mālatī samabhyarcya nagaradevatām'' ityādivacanairmālatīsamucitatattadupacārasaṃpādanādivyāpāraiśca kṣemeṇa kenacidapyalakṣitatvādanupadraveṇa gopāyito rakṣito rājñastadanucarebhyaḥ paritrāto makarandaḥ/ yathā vijñāya tairna prahriyate tathā kṛta ityarthaḥ/
analyzed: amātya bhūrivasu mandire bhagavatī vacana saṃvidhānaiḥ samāgatā iyam mālatī samabhyarcya nagara devatām iti ādi vacanaiḥ mālatī samucita tad tad upacāra saṃpādana ādi vyāpāraiḥ ca kṣemeṇa kenacid api alakṣita tvāt anupadraveṇa gopāyitaḥ rakṣitaḥ rājñaḥ tad anucarebhyaḥ paritrātaḥ makarandaḥ yathā vijñāya taiḥ na prahriyate tathā kṛtaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: anena ca kṛtakamālatīnandanapariṇayaniṣpattiḥ sūcitā/ adya vayaṃ nandanāvāsamupagatāḥ/ madayantikāsakhītvena svasya varasaṃbandhādvidvadvaravargāṇāṃ ca bahutvādvayamiti bahuvacanam/ vivāhārthaṃ varamanusṛtya vayaṃ janyāśca vivāhaṃ nirvartya varagṛhameva pratyāgatā ityarthaḥ/ ato bhagavatī nandanamāpṛcchyāmantrya gatāvasathaṃ svāvāsam/
analyzed: anena ca kṛtaka mālatī nandana pariṇaya niṣpattiḥ sūcitā adya vayam nandana āvāsam upagatāḥ madayantikā sakhī tvena svasya vara saṃbandhāt vidvas vara vargāṇām ca bahu tvāt vayam iti bahuvacanam vivāha artham varam anusṛtya vayam janyāḥ ca vivāham nirvartya vara gṛham eva pratyāgatāḥ iti arthaḥ atas bhagavatī nandanam āpṛcchya āmantrya gata āvasatham sva āvāsam

original: ayaṃ ca navavadhūgṛhapraveśārthaṃ viracito yo'kāla āśvayujapaurṇamāsīvyatiriktakāle kaumudyā abhāvātpaurṇamāsyāṃ kartavyo yo mahotsavastena pramatto'navahitastathā paryākulaḥ kāryāntaravyāsaṅgādvikṣiptacetasko'śeṣaparijano yasminsa tādṛśaḥ pradoṣo rajanīmukhamanukūlayiṣyatyabhimatasiddhisāhāyyakānukūlyena siddhyunmukhaṃ kariṣyati/
analyzed: ayam ca nava vadhū gṛha praveśa artham viracitaḥ yaḥ kālaḥ āśvayuja paurṇamāsī vyatirikta kāle kaumudyāḥ abhāvāt paurṇamāsyām kartavyaḥ yaḥ mahā utsavaḥ tena pramattaḥ anavahitaḥ tathā paryākulaḥ kārya antara vyāsaṅgāt vikṣipta cetaskośeṣa parijanaḥ yasmin sa tādṛśaḥ pradoṣaḥ rajanī mukham anukūlayiṣyati abhimata siddhi sāhāyyaka ānukūlyena siddhi unmukham kariṣyati

original: adya no'smākaṃ vyavasitaṃ madayantikāmakarandasaṃghaṭanaviṣayadūtyavyāpāraṃ mālatīveṣadhāriṇo makarandasya kṛtrimanirvartitamadayantikāpariṇayasya madayantikāṃ gṛhītvā nirgantuṃ kālo'pyeṣa evānukūlo vartate/ yato madīyāḥ sarve'pyapramattā rakṣiṇaḥ sarve pramattāḥ paryākulāśca/ tannirgamaprajñānatannivāraṇādāvasamarthā vartanta ityarthaḥ/
analyzed: adya na usmākam vyavasitam madayantikā makaranda saṃghaṭana viṣaya dūtya vyāpāram mālatī veṣa dhāriṇaḥ makarandasya kṛtrima nirvartita madayantikā pariṇayasya madayantikām gṛhītvā nirgantum kālaḥ api eṣaḥ eva anukūlaḥ vartate yatas madīyāḥ sarve api apramattāḥ rakṣiṇaḥ sarve pramattāḥ paryākulāḥ ca tad nirgama prajñāna tad nivāraṇa ādau asamarthāḥ vartante iti arthaḥ

original: anena ca vartamāno'rthaḥ sūcitaḥ/ sāṃprataṃ ca tvaramāṇakāmo navavadhūsaṃbhogotkaṇṭhāsamunmīlitamanmathāvegaḥ kāmayituṃ māṃ kāmayasvetyevameva bahuśaḥ sapādapatanamabhyarthya punarbalātkāreṇābhidravanprasahya svayaṃgrāhasāhasapravṛttaḥ sanniṣṭhuraṃ paruṣaṃ yathā syānmakarandena kapaṭamālatyā pratihato nirākṛto jāmātā varo nandanaḥ/
analyzed: anena ca vartamāna arthaḥ sūcitaḥ sāṃpratam ca tvaramāṇa kāmaḥ nava vadhū saṃbhoga utkaṇṭhā samunmīlita manmatha āvegaḥ kāmayitum mām kāmayasva iti evam eva bahuśas sa pāda patanam abhyarthya punar balātkāreṇa abhidravan prasahya svayaṃgrāha sāhasa pravṛttaḥ san niṣṭhuram paruṣam yathā syāt makarandena kapaṭa mālatyā pratihataḥ nirākṛtaḥ jāmātā varaḥ nandanaḥ

original: sa ca vailakṣyaroṣāveśaskhaladakṣaro mantharavacanaḥ/ tathāvaruditanayanaṃ prasphuracca vadanaṃ yasya saḥ/ na me sāṃpratamanayā kaumāravardhakyā kaumāre kumārībhāve kanyātva eva vardhakīcalitacāritratayā/ mādhavaikānurakteyaṃ mālatīti pūrvameva nandano'pi śrutavānityevamupālambhaḥ/ prayojanamiti saśapathaṃ pratijñāṃ kṛtvā vāsabhavanānnirgataḥ/
analyzed: sa ca vailakṣya roṣa āveśa skhalat akṣaraḥ manthara vacanaḥ tathā avarudita nayanam prasphurat ca vadanam yasya saḥ na me sāṃpratam anayā kaumāravardhakyā kaumāre kumārī bhāve kanyā tve eva vardhakī calita cāritra tayā mādhava eka anuraktā iyam mālatī iti pūrvam eva nandanaḥ upi śrutavān iti evam upālambhaḥ prayojanam iti sa śapatham pratijñām kṛtvā vāsa bhavanāt nirgataḥ

original: tasmādanena prasaṅgena bhrātṛkāryānukūlyārthamanunayavyājaprastāvena madayantikāmānīya makarandena saha saṃyojayiṣyāmi/ iti vṛttaṃ vartiṣyamāṇaṃ ca saṃsūcya niṣkrāntā buddharakṣitā/ ayaṃ ca granthakāṇḍaḥ praveśako vṛttavartiṣyamāṇoditalakṣaṇayogāt/ na caikapātraprayogānupapattiḥ tallakṣaṇe'nekapātratvaniyamāpratīteḥ/
analyzed: tasmāt anena prasaṅgena bhrātṛ kārya ānukūlya artham anunaya vyāja prastāvena madayantikām ānīya makarandena saha saṃyojayiṣyāmi iti vṛttam vartiṣyamāṇam ca saṃsūcya niṣkrāntā buddha rakṣitā ayam ca grantha kāṇḍaḥ praveśakaḥ vṛtta vartiṣyamāṇa udita lakṣaṇa yogāt na ca eka pātra prayoga anupapattiḥ tad lakṣaṇena ika pātra tva niyama apratīteḥ

original: asya viṣkambhavadekenāpyupapatteśceti// tata ityādi/ śayyāgata iti vāsabhavane navavadhūvarasaṃbhogārthaṃ racite talpe śayitaḥ prārthanābhaṅgatiraskāraniṣkāsinandanaḥ/ mālatīrūpadhārītyarthaḥ// makarandaḥ/ api nāmeti saṃbhāvanāyām/
analyzed: asya viṣkambha vat ekena api upapatteḥ ca iti tatas ityādi śayyā gataḥ iti vāsa bhavane nava vadhū vara saṃbhoga artham racite talpe śayitaḥ prārthanā bhaṅga tiraskāra niṣkāsi nandanaḥ mālatī rūpa dhārī iti arthaḥ makarandaḥ api nāma iti saṃbhāvanāyām

original: buddharakṣitāsaṃkrāntā bhagavatyaiva niveśitā bhagavatīnītiḥ kṛtyaṃ madayantikāṃ prati na buddharakṣitābuddhidoṣeṇa pratihatā phalatīti saṃbhāvyate/ ``na viparyeṣyati'' iti pāṭhe buddharakṣitāyā svaprajñābalenāpramattena doṣeṇa vaiparītyaṃ na saṃbhāvyate/ api tu bhagavatyaiva pravartitatvātphalaparyavasāyinī nītirbhaviṣyatītyarthaḥ// lavaṅgikā/
analyzed: buddha rakṣitā saṃkrāntā bhagavatyā eva niveśitā bhagavatī nītiḥ kṛtyam madayantikām prati na buddha rakṣitā buddhi doṣeṇa pratihatā phalati iti saṃbhāvyate na viparyeṣyati iti pāṭhe buddha rakṣitāyāḥ sva prajñā balena apramattena doṣeṇa vaiparītyam na saṃbhāvyate api tu bhagavatyā eva pravartita tvāt phala paryavasāyinī nītiḥ bhaviṣyati iti arthaḥ lavaṅgikā

original: kaḥ saṃdeho mahābhāgasya/ saṃbhāvanāyā ulbaṇaikakoṭisaṃdeharūpatvādapināmaśabdasūcitā saṃbhāvanaiva saṃdehaśabdenoktā/ kathaṃ tarhi saṃdehaleśasyāpyavakāśa ityarthaḥ/ kiṃ bahunā/
analyzed: kaḥ saṃdehaḥ mahābhāgasya saṃbhāvanāyāḥ ulbaṇa eka koṭi saṃdeha rūpatvāt apināma śabda sūcitā saṃbhāvanā eva saṃdeha śabdena uktā katham tarhi saṃdeha leśasya api avakāśaḥ iti arthaḥ kim bahunā

original: yathaiṣa mañjīraśabdaḥ śrūyate, tathā tenaiva nūpuradhvaniśravaṇaprakāreṇa hetunā tarkayāmi tena vyapadeśenālīkabhrātṛbhāryāyāstavānunayavyājenānītā buddharakṣitayā madayantiketi/ taduttarīyāpavāritaḥ suptalakṣaṇaḥ supta iva lakṣyamāṇastiṣṭha// madayantikā/ sakhi, satyameva parikopitaḥ parikupitaḥ kṛto me bhrātā mālatyā// buddharakṣitā/ atha kim/
analyzed: yathā eṣa mañjīra śabdaḥ śrūyate tathā tena eva nūpura dhvani śravaṇa prakāreṇa hetunā tarkayāmi tena vyapadeśena alīka bhrātṛ bhāryāyāḥ tava anunaya vyājena ānītā buddha rakṣitayā madayantikā iti tad uttarīya apavāritaḥ supta lakṣaṇaḥ suptaḥ iva lakṣyamāṇaḥ tiṣṭha madayantikā sakhi satyam eva parikopitaḥ parikupitaḥ kṛtaḥ me bhrātā mālatyā buddha rakṣitā atha kim

original: satyamevetyarthaḥ// madayantikā/ aho, atyāhitaṃ mahābhītiḥ/ kupitā bhrāturmālatī samīpamupanītaivetyarthaḥ/ tadehi/ vāmaśīlāṃ vakrasvabhāvāṃ mālatīṃ nirbhartsayāvaḥ// buddharakṣitā/ idaṃ vāsabhavanam// madayantikā/ sakhi lavaṅgike jñāyate prasuptā te priyasakhīti// lavaṅgikā/ sakhi, maināṃ pratibodhaya/
analyzed: satyam eva iti arthaḥ madayantikā aho atyāhitam mahā bhītiḥ kupitā bhrātuḥ mālatī samīpam upanītā eva iti arthaḥ tat ehi vāma śīlām vakra svabhāvām mālatīm nirbhartsayāvaḥ buddha rakṣitā idam vāsa bhavanam madayantikā sakhi lavaṅgike jñāyate prasuptā te priya sakhī iti lavaṅgikā sakhi mā enām pratibodhaya

original: eṣā ciraṃ durmanāyamānā duḥkhitamanaskā bhavantī/ ``bhṛśādibhyo bhuvi-'' ityādinā kyaṅ/ idānīmeveṣanmanye prasupteti/ ataḥ śanairihaiva śayanārdha upaviśa// madayantikā/ durmanāyate kathamiyaṃ vāmaśīlā/ svayameva bhartuḥ pratikūlakāritvenāparādhaṃ kṛtvā kathamātmanaiva durmanaskā bhavatītyarthaḥ// lavaṅgikā/
analyzed: eṣā ciram durmanāyamānā duḥkhita manaskā bhavantī bhṛśa ādibhyaḥ bhuvi iti ādinā kyaṅ idānīm eva īṣat manye prasuptā iti atas śanais iha eva śayana ardhe upaviśa madayantikā durmanāyate katham iyam vāma śīlā svayam eva bhartuḥ pratikūla kāri tvena aparādham kṛtvā katham ātmanā eva durmanaskā bhavati iti arthaḥ lavaṅgikā

original: kathaṃ nāma navavadhvā visṛmbhaṇe visrambhajanane ya upāyā kāmatantroktāstaccittavṛttyanurodhastanmanorañjanaṃ tadanivāritārdhāṅgīkṛtānāṃ lajjayā kevalaṃ bahiralīkameva kiṃcinniṣiddhānāmapyantaranumoditānāmavayavasparśādisaṃbhogavyāpārāṇāṃ mandamandamupakramānnātiprasahya kiṃcidācaraṇamityādayasteṣāmabhijñamiti viparītalakṣaṇayoktiḥ/
analyzed: katham nāma nava vadhvā visṛmbhaṇe visrambha janane ye upāyā kāmatantra uktāḥ tad cittavṛtti anurodhaḥ tad manaḥ rañjanam tad anivārita ardha aṅgīkṛtānām lajjayā kevalam bahis alīkam eva kiṃcid niṣiddhānām api antar anumoditānām avayava sparśa ādi saṃbhoga vyāpārāṇām manda mandam upakramāt na ati prasahya kiṃcid ācaraṇam iti ādayaḥ teṣām abhijñam iti viparīta lakṣaṇayā uktiḥ

original: yato'sau brahmacaryārthaṃ śayanādiniyamabāhye vaivāhika eva trirātre svacittavṛttyanabhijñāṃ kiṃcidapyaśithilīkṛtabāhubharāmatyantāparicayādaherivodvijamānāṃ balādenāṃ bālāṃ mukhata eva pāmarabāliśajanarītyā nirdayaṃ niṣpīḍayitumārabdhavān/ ato na kāmatantravārtāmapyasau jānātītyarthaḥ/ laḍaho vidagdho madhurabhāṣī/ laḍahaḥ sundaraḥ vidagdhaḥ/
analyzed: yatas asau brahmacarya artham śayana ādi niyama bāhye vaivāhike eva tri rātre sva cittavṛtti anabhijñām kiṃcid api a śithilīkṛta bāhu bharām atyanta aparicayāt aheḥ iva udvijamānām balāt enām bālām mukhataḥ eva pāmara bāliśa jana rītyā nirdayam niṣpīḍayitum ārabdhavān atas na kāmatantra vārtām api asau jānāti iti arthaḥ laḍahaḥ vidagdhaḥ madhura bhāṣī laḍahaḥ sundaraḥ vidagdhaḥ

original: suratakalānipuṇaḥ/ atrāpi saundaryagandhavihīnaṃ suratakalāvārtānabhijñamatiparuṣabhāṣiṇamiti vaiparītyenoktiḥ/ aroṣaṇamakopanamatimūrkhamityanyathoktiḥ/ bhrātaraṃ te bhartāramāsādya priyasakhī na durmanāyate/ yuktamevaivaṃvidhabhartṛsamāgame kleśenāsyā durmanaskatvamityarthaḥ// madayantikā/ paśya buddharakṣite, vipratīpamupālabdhāḥ smaḥ/
analyzed: surata kalā nipuṇaḥ atra api saundarya gandha vihīnam surata kalā vārttā anabhijñam ati paruṣa bhāṣiṇam iti vaiparītyena uktiḥ aroṣaṇam akopanam ati mūrkham iti anyathā uktiḥ bhrātaram te bhartāram āsādya priya sakhī na durmanāyate yuktam eva evaṃvidha bhartṛ samāgame kleśena asyāḥ durmanaska tvam iti arthaḥ madayantikā paśya buddha rakṣite vipratīpam upālabdhāḥ smaḥ

original: asmābhirupālabdhavye pratyutāsmānevopālabhata ityarthaḥ// buddharakṣitā/ vipratīpaṃ na vā vipratīpam/ āpātato vipratīpamiva pratibhāsamānamapi tattvanirūpaṇenaiva vipratīpaṃ vayamevopālabdhā ityarthaḥ// madayantikā/ kathamiva/ tatkathamiti praśnaḥ// buddharakṣitā/
analyzed: asmābhiḥ upālabdhavye pratyuta asmān eva upālabhate iti arthaḥ buddha rakṣitā vipratīpam na vā vipratīpam āpātataḥ vipratīpam iva pratibhāsamānam api tattva nirūpaṇena eva vipratīpam vayam eva upālabdhāḥ iti arthaḥ madayantikā katham iva tat katham iti praśnaḥ buddha rakṣitā

original: yattāvaccaraṇapatito bhartā na bahumānito'nullaṅghitapraṇāmo'yamati gauravaviṣayo bharteti na vijñātaḥ/ atra na kiṃcidasyā dūṣaṇaṃ pratibhāti/ kiṃtu kulakanyakājanocitā navapariṇayasamayasulabhā lajjaiva paramārthataḥ ślāghanīyaguṇabhūtāpi kāmāndhasyāvivekino'smadbhrāturdoṣatvena sphuritā/ tena lajjādoṣeṇaiva janopālambhanīyaḥ/
analyzed: yat tāvat caraṇa patitaḥ bhartā na bahu mānitaḥ na ullaṅghita praṇāmaḥ yam ati gaurava viṣayaḥ bhartā iti na vijñātaḥ atra na kiṃcid asyāḥ dūṣaṇam pratibhāti kiṃtu kula kanyakā jana ucitā nava pariṇaya samaya sulabhā lajjā eva paramārthataḥ ślāghanīya guṇa bhūtā api kāma andhasya avivekinaḥ usmad bhrātuḥ doṣa tvena sphuritā tena lajjā doṣeṇa eva jana upālambhanīyaḥ

original: yadyapyabhinavavadhūviruddhaṃ lokasiddhanavoḍhāsaṃbhogakramaviparītaṃ rabhasopakramaskhalanaṃ prasahyānucitaprakramarūpaṃ skhalanaṃ tena yadvailakṣyaṃ tena viccharditaṃ mahānubhāvatvaṃ yasyeti/ viccharditaṃ vivarjitam/ prakaṭitamaurkhyasyeti yāvat/
analyzed: yadi api abhinava vadhū viruddham loka siddha navoḍhā saṃbhoga krama viparītam rabhasa upakrama skhalanam prasahya anucita prakrama rūpam skhalanam tena yat vailakṣyam tena viccharditam mahā anubhāva tvam yasya iti viccharditam vivarjitam prakaṭita maurkhyasya iti yāvat

original: bhrātṛste kimapi śrotumapyanarhaṃ vācāgatamapratiṣṭhānaṃ na me tvayā kaumāravardhakyā prayojanamiti garhitavacanacāpalam/ tena vayamevopālambhanīyā iti pratibhāti/ śāstraviruddhaṃ caitadityāha - kiṃceti/ yoṣicchabdo'tra navavadhūparaḥ/
analyzed: bhrātṛḥ te kim api śrotum api anarham vācā āgatam a pratiṣṭhānam na me tvayā kaumāravardhakyā prayojanam iti garhita vacana cāpalam tena vayam eva upālambhanīyāḥ iti pratibhāti śāstra viruddham ca etat iti āha kiṃca iti yoṣit śabdaḥ utra nava vadhū paraḥ

original: yathā kusumaṃ mlāyate tathā mṛdurītyā sukumārakrameṇopakramyamāṇaṃ saurabhamaśeṣamudgirati, na tu prasabhameva niṣpīḍyamānam/ evaṃ tatsamānadharmāṇo navoḍhā api sukumāreṇaiva saṃbhogakrameṇopakramyamāṇā anuraktāḥ sukhahetavo bhavanti/ tāstvanadhigato viśvāso navoḍhābhiprāyo yaiste tathā/
analyzed: yathā kusumam mlāyate tathā mṛdu rītyā sukumāra krameṇa upakramyamāṇam saurabham aśeṣam udgirati na tu prasabham eva niṣpīḍyamānam evam tad samāna dharmāṇaḥ navoḍhāḥ api sukumāreṇa eva saṃbhoga krameṇa upakramyamāṇāḥ anuraktāḥ sukha hetavaḥ bhavanti tāḥ tu anadhigataḥ viśvāsaḥ navoḍha abhiprāyaḥ yaiḥ te tathā

original: yadvānadhigato navoḍhayā paricayābhāvādaprāpto viśvāso visrambho yeṣu te tathoktāḥ/ tairapyetanmanovedibhiraparicitaiśca prasabhaṃ balādevātyudvegakāribhirvyāpārairupakramyamāṇāḥ prayogasya saṃprayogasyaiva vidveṣiṇyo bhavanti/ na kevalaṃ tādṛśapuruṣeṇānurajyante/ api tu ripusamāgamavadviṣīdantītyarthaḥ/ evaṃ kila kāmasūtrakārā mantrayante/
analyzed: yat vā anadhigataḥ na voḍhayā paricaya abhāvāt aprāptaḥ viśvāsaḥ visrambhaḥ yeṣu te tathā uktāḥ taiḥ api etad manaḥ vedibhiḥ aparicitaiḥ ca prasabham balāt eva ati udvega kāribhiḥ vyāpāraiḥ upakramyamāṇāḥ prayogasya saṃprayogasya eva vidveṣiṇyaḥ bhavanti na kevalam tādṛśa puruṣeṇa anurajyante api tu ripu samāgama vat viṣīdanti iti arthaḥ evam kila kāmasūtra kārāḥ mantrayante

original: yadāhuḥ- ``rabhasena hyupakrāntā kanyābhāvamavindatā/ bhayaṃ cintāsamudvegaṃ sadyo dveṣaṃ ca gacchati//'' iti// lavaṅgikā/ gṛhe gṛhe puruṣāḥ kulakanyakā udvahanti/ na ca ko'pi lajjāprasādhanamanaparādhamugdhasvabhāvaṃ kulakumārījanaṃ prabhavāmīti samartho'hamityetāvatā vāganalenāvācyavacanarūpeṇānalena prajvalayati/
analyzed: yat āhuḥ rabhasena hi upakrāntā kanyā bhāvam avindatā bhayam cintā samudvegam sadyas dveṣam ca gacchati iti lavaṅgikāḥ gṛhe gṛhe puruṣāḥ kula kanyakāḥ udvahanti na ca kaḥ api lajjā prasādhanam anaparādha mugdha svabhāvam kula kumārī janam prabhavāmi iti samarthaḥ ham iti etāvatā vāc analena avācya vacana rūpeṇa analena prajvalayati

original: ete khalu te hṛdayaśalya nikṣepā āmaraṇaṃ saṃbhriyamāṇā vismartumaśakyatvena manasi saṃtataṃ dhāryamāṇā ata eva duḥsahāḥ paragṛhanivāsavairāgyakāriṇo mahāparibhavāḥ/ yeṣāṃ kṛte strījanmalābhaṃ jugupsante bāndhavāḥ// madayantikā/ buddharakṣite, atimlānā priyasakhī lavaṅgikā/ atimahānko'pi me bhrātrā vāgaparādhaḥ kṛtaḥ// buddharakṣitā/ atha kim/
analyzed: ete khalu te hṛdaya śalya nikṣepāḥ āmaraṇam saṃbhriyamāṇāḥ vismartum aśakya tvena manasi saṃtatam dhāryamāṇāḥ atas eva duḥsahāḥ para gṛha nivāsa vairāgya kāriṇaḥ mahā paribhavāḥ yeṣām kṛte strī janma lābham jugupsante bāndhavāḥ madayantikā buddha rakṣite ati mlānā priya sakhī lavaṅgikā ati mahān kaḥ api me bhrātrā vāc aparādhaḥ kṛtaḥ buddha rakṣitā atha kim

original: kṛta evetyarthaḥ/ tadevāha - śrutamevāsmābhiryathā na me sāṃpratamanayā kaumāravardhakyā prayojanamiti saśapathaṃ pratijñāṃ kṛtvā vāsabhavanānnirgataḥ// madayantikā/ aho atikramo maryādollaṅghanam/ aho pramādo'navadhānatā/ sakhi lavaṅgike, asamarthāsmi te mukhaṃ sāṃprataṃ draṣṭum/
analyzed: kṛtaḥ eva iti arthaḥ tat eva āha śrutam eva asmābhiḥ yathā na me sāṃpratam anayā kaumāravardhakyā prayojanam iti sa śapatham pratijñām kṛtvā vāsa bhavanāt nirgataḥ madayantikā aho atikramaḥ maryādā ullaṅghanam aho pramāda ūna vadhāna tā sakhi lavaṅgike asamarthā asmi te mukham sāṃpratam draṣṭum

original: tathāpi prabhavāmīti mayyatisnigdhāyāṃ tvayi prabhutvamastīti kimapi sakhitvamevāvalambya tadanurūpaṃ kiṃcinmantrayiṣye// lavaṅgikā/ svādhīnaste'yaṃ janaḥ/ tadvisrabdhaṃ mantrayasveti bhāvaḥ// madayantikā/ tiṣṭhatu tāvanmama bhrāturduḥśīlatāpratiṣṭhānaṃ ca/ yuṣmābhirmālatyāptakoṭibhirapīdṛśo'pyeṣa sāṃprataṃ yathācittamanuvartanīyaḥ/
analyzed: tathā api prabhavāmi iti mayi ati snigdhāyām tvayi prabhu tvam asti iti kim api sakhi tvam eva avalambya tad anurūpam kiṃcid mantrayiṣye lavaṅgikā svādhīna steyam janaḥ tat visrabdham mantrayasva iti bhāvaḥ madayantikā tiṣṭhatu tāvat mama bhrātuḥ duḥśīla tā pratiṣṭhānam ca yuṣmābhiḥ mālatī āpta koṭibhiḥ api īdṛśaḥ api eṣa sāṃpratam yathācittam anuvartanīyaḥ

original: cittaśabdenātra tatsādhāraṇo vyāpāraḥ saṃkalpākhyo lakṣyate/ tena tadicchāpratikūlaṃ nācaraṇīyamityāśayaḥ/ yena bhartaiṣa iti/ nirguṇo doṣavānapi bhartā bhartṛtvena strībhiranuvartanīyaḥ/ na tu tasya prātikūlyaṃ kulavadhūnāmucitamiti bhāvaḥ/
analyzed: citta śabdena atra tad sādhāraṇaḥ vyāpāraḥ saṃkalpa ākhyaḥ lakṣyate tena tad icchā pratikūlam na ācaraṇīyam iti āśayaḥ yena bhartā eṣa iti nirguṇaḥ doṣavān api bhartā bhartṛ tvena strībhiḥ anuvartanīyaḥ na tu tasya prātikūlyam kula vadhūnām ucitam iti bhāvaḥ

original: na ca yūyamasyānabhijātākṣarādhikṣepopālambhasyānabhijātāni kitavajanayogyānyakṣarāṇi yatra sa tādṛśo'dhikṣepo dharṣaṇaṃ chidropālambhasya yanmūlaṃ tanna jānītha// lavaṅgikā/ kathaṃ vayamasantaṃ jānīmaḥ/ etadupālambhasya bījaṃ mālatīgataṃ kiṃcidanucitamasti cetkathaṃ vayaṃ na jānīmaḥ/ nāstyevaitat/ anyattu kāraṇamasaṃbhāvitamevetyāśayaḥ/
analyzed: na ca yūyam asya anabhijāta akṣara adhikṣepa upālambhasya anabhijātāni kitava jana yogyāni akṣarāṇi yatra sa tādṛśaḥ adhikṣepaḥ dharṣaṇam chidra upālambhasya yat mūlam tat na jānītha lavaṅgikā katham vayam asantam jānīmaḥ etat upālambhasya bījam mālatī gatam kiṃcid anucitam asti ced katham vayam na jānīmaḥ na asti eva etat anyat tu kāraṇam asaṃbhāvitam eva iti āśayaḥ

original: anyadeva tanmūlamāha - madayantikā/ yadidānīṃ tasminmahānubhāve mādhave kimapi kila mālatyā vāṅmātraṃ mādhavānurakteyaṃ mālatīti pravādamātramāsītsa eva sarvalokasyātibhūmiṃ gataḥ parāṃ koṭimārūḍhaḥ pravādaḥ/ ``tārāmaitramāsīt'' iti pāṭhe tārāmaitraṃ darśanamātrasnehaḥ/ tasminsarvalokasyeti pāṭhaḥ/ tatkhalvetadvijṛmbhate/
analyzed: anyat eva tad mūlam āha madayantikā yat idānīm tasmin mahā anubhāve mādhave kim api kila mālatyāḥ vāc mātram mādhava anuraktā iyam mālatī iti pravāda mātram āsīt saḥ eva sarva lokasya atibhūmim gataḥ parām koṭim ārūḍhaḥ pravādaḥ tārāmaitram āsīt iti pāṭhe tārāmaitram darśana mātra snehaḥ tasmin sarva lokasya iti pāṭhaḥ tat khalu etat vijṛmbhate

original: upālambhamūlatvenetiśeṣaḥ/ tatpriyasakhi, yathaiṣa bharturupekṣābhiniveśo mālatyā bhartṛviṣayaudāsīnyāgraho niravaśeṣo hṛdayādudbhriyate tathā kuru/ anyathā mahānpramāda iti jñātaṃ bhavatu/
analyzed: upālambha mūla tvena iti śeṣaḥ tat priya sakhi yathā eṣa bhartuḥ upekṣā abhiniveśaḥ mālatyāḥ bhartṛ viṣaya audāsīnya āgrahaḥ niravaśeṣaḥ hṛdayāt udbhriyate tathā kuru anyathā mahān pramādaḥ iti jñātam bhavatu

original: niṣkampadāruṇāsvānukūlyaṃ[niṣkampadāruṇā svānukūlyaṃ] pratipadya kevalaṃ niśceṣṭībhūtāsvata[niśceṣṭībhūtā svata] eva dāruṇāsu kulakanyakāsu viṣayabhūtāsu dūnayati hṛdayaṃ manuṣyāṇāmīdṛśāddurabhiṣaṅgāditi/ durabhiṣaṅgo duṣṭānurāgabandhaḥ/
analyzed: niṣkampa dāruṇā sva ānukūlyam niṣkampa dāruṇā sva ānukūlyam pratipadya kevalam svatas eva dāruṇāsu kula kanyakāsu viṣaya bhūtāsu dūnayati hṛdayam manuṣyāṇām īdṛśāt durabhiṣaṅgāt iti durabhiṣaṅgaḥ duṣṭa anurāga bandhaḥ

original: tanmā bhaṇa madayantikayā kathitamiti mālatyupālambhabījametadasmadbhrāturmanogataṃ bhavatīṣu snehānmayā gūḍhamapi kathitam, tadetanmayoktamiti na kvacidapi prakaṭanīyamityabhiprāyaḥ// lavaṅgikā/ ayi asaṃbaddhalokapravādamohite, apehi/ na tvayā saha mantrayiṣye// madayantikā/ sakhi, prasīda/ athavā na yūyaṃ sphuṭaṃ bhaṇitāstiṣṭhatha/
analyzed: tat mā bhaṇa madayantikayā kathitam iti mālatī upālambha bījam etat asmad bhrātuḥ manogatam bhavatīṣu snehāt mayā gūḍham api kathitam tat etat mayā uktam iti na kvacid api prakaṭanīyam iti abhiprāyaḥ lavaṅgikā ayi asaṃbaddha loka pravāda mohite apehi na tvayā saha mantrayiṣye madayantikā sakhi prasīda athavā na yūyam sphuṭam bhaṇitāḥ tiṣṭhatha

original: kiṃca vayaṃ satyameva mādhavaikamayajīvitāṃ mālatīṃ jānīmaḥ/ kena vā kaṭhoraketakīgarbhavibhramāvayavadaurbalyānnirvartitasundaratvaviśeṣaṃ mādhavasvahastanirmitabakulāvalīviracitakaṇṭhāvalambanamātrasaṃjīvanaṃ mālatyā mādhavasya ca prabhātacandramaṇḍalapāṇḍuraparikṣāmaramaṇīyadarśanaṃ na vibhāvitaṃ śarīram/

original: viśuddhaḥ parapuruṣānurāgakalaṅkarahito mugdho madanavyāpāravārtānabhijñaḥ kulakanyakājanaḥ/ sābhiprāyairvacainarvaiparītyaṃ[sābhiprāyairvacanavaiparītyaṃ] dyotyate/ kathāntare goṣṭīmadhya eva, na tu taddarśanādau/ vikalaḥ svavyāpārākṣamaḥ sankadambagolakasya nīpatarusaṃsthānasyākṛtimudyanmukulālaṃkṛtamākaraṃ kathamāśritaḥ/

original: madayantikā/ salajjam/ sakhi, kiṃ māmupahasasi/ nanu bhaṇāmi/ nirvāpayati/ ``sukhayati'' iti pāṭhaḥ/ tādṛśasyātmanirapekṣavyavasāyinaḥ kṛtāntakavalīkriyamāṇajīvitabalātkārapratyānayanagurūpakāriṇo janasya saṃkathāmātrasya nāmagrahaṇaṃ smaraṇaṃ ca/

original: tathā ca tvayāpi gāḍhagurunakhaprahāravedanārambhavihvalitaśarīrasaṃgalitasvedasalilodgamo mohamukulīkriyamāṇanetranīlotpalayugalo bhūmivigalitāsiyaṣṭiviṣṭambhadhairyapratidhāritaśarīrabhāraḥ pratyakṣīkṛta eva madayantikāmātraviccharditamahārghajīvito mahānubhāva iti// buddharakṣitā/ asvasthaśarīre, kiṃ vācā/

original: darśitaṃ śarīreṇa makarandasamāgamautsukyam/ svedādibhirvyabhicāribhiriti śeṣaḥ// madayantikā/ salajjam/ kanyakājanānucitasvamanovṛttivyaktībhāvo'tra lajjāhetuḥ/ sakhi, apehyapehīti cāvahitthākhyavyabhicārivyañjakaṃ vacanam/ yathāha - ``avahitthā tu lajjāderharṣādyākāragopanam'' iti/ udbhinnāsmi sahavāsinyā mālatyā/

original: bālyātprabhṛti sahapāṃsukrīḍādibhirviśvāsasthānabhūtayā mālatyaiva svayaṃ nirupādhikajīvitadāyini mahānubhāve kumārītve'pi pravṛttaprakṛṣṭānurāgayāhamapyudbhinnāsmi tādṛśopakārināyakasamāgamaṃ prati darśitasvaprasarāsmi/ tāṃ dṛṣṭvāhamapi tathaiva pravṛttā, na tu svātantryeṇeti bhāvaḥ// lavaṅgikā/ sakhi madayantike, vayamapi jñātavyaṃ jānīmaḥ/

original: kimataḥ paraṃ tadācchādaneneti bhāvaḥ/ tatprasīda prasannāntaḥkaraṇā bhava/ na punarasmattaḥ śaṅkitavyamiti bhāvaḥ/ virama vyapadeśāt/ kapaṭavacanairākṛtigopanaṃ na śakyamiti bhāvaḥ/ ehi/ visrambhagarbhakathāprabandhasarasaṃ sukhaṃ tiṣṭhāmaḥ/ asmāsu visrabdhā bhūtvā niḥśaṅkaṃ svahṛdayaṃ nivedaya/ tatsiddhyupāyamupadekṣyāma iti bhāvaḥ//
analyzed: kim atas param tad ācchādanena iti bhāvaḥ tat prasīda prasanna antaḥkaraṇā bhava na punar asmattaḥ śaṅkitavyam iti bhāvaḥ virama vyapadeśāt kapaṭa vacanaiḥ ākṛti gopanam na śakyam iti bhāvaḥ ehi visrambha garbha kathā prabandha sarasam sukham tiṣṭhāmaḥ asmāsu visrabdhāḥ bhūtvā niḥśaṅkam sva hṛdayam nivedaya tad siddhi upāyam upadekṣyāmaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: buddharakṣitā/ sakhi, śobhanaṃ lavaṅgikayā bhaṇitam/ viditasvābhiprāye jane na vañcanaṃ yuktam/ kiṃtu tannivedanena tadupāyo'nveṣṭavya iti bhāvaḥ// madayantikā/ vidheyāsmi sāṃprataṃ sakhīnām// lavaṅgikā/ yadyevamasmadvidheyāsi tatkathaya kathaṃ nu te kālo gacchatīti/
analyzed: buddha rakṣitā sakhi śobhanam lavaṅgikayā bhaṇitam vidita sva abhiprāye jane na vañcanam yuktam kiṃtu tad nivedanena tad upāyaḥ nveṣṭavyaḥ iti bhāvaḥ madayantikā vidheyā asmi sāṃpratam sakhīnām lavaṅgikā yadi evam asmad vidheyā asi tat kathaya katham nu te kālaḥ gacchati iti

original: tādṛśakāṣṭhāprāptānurāgaviṣayaṃ dayitamalabhamānā kathaṃ divasānativāhayasīti bhāvaḥ// madayantikā/ niśāmaya śṛṇu priyasakhi, mama buddharakṣitāpakṣapātapratyayena prathamameva tasmiñjane'viralakautūhalotkaṇṭhāmanoharaṃ hṛdayamāsīt/
analyzed: tādṛśa kāṣṭhā prāpta anurāga viṣayam dayitam alabhamānā katham divasān ativāhayasi iti bhāvaḥ madayantikā niśāmaya śṛṇu priya sakhi mama buddha rakṣitā pakṣapāta pratyayena prathamam eva tasmin jane virala kautūhala utkaṇṭhā manoharam hṛdayam āsīt

original: nāsthāne buddharakṣitāpakṣapātaṃ karotīti tatsnehādeva saṃbhāvitasakalanāyakagaṇagarīyāniti pratyayo viśvāso'styeveti bhāvaḥ/
analyzed: na asthāne buddha rakṣitā pakṣapātam karoti iti tad snehāt eva saṃbhāvita sakala nāyaka gaṇa garīyān iti pratyayaḥ viśvāsaḥ usti eva iti bhāvaḥ

original: tato vidhiniyojitaciranirvṛttadarśanā bhūtvā durvāradāruṇāyāsaduḥkhasantāpadahyamānacittavighaṭamānajīvitāśā dūravijṛmbhitāpūrvasarvāṅgaprajvalanamadanahutavahoddāmadāhaduḥsahāyāsadurmanāyamānaparijanā pratyāśāvimokṣamātrasulabhamṛtyunirvāṇapratikūlabuddharakṣitāvacanavivardhitāvegavyatikaravisaṃsthulemaṃ jīvalokaparivartamanubhavāmi/
analyzed: tatas vidhi niyojita cira nirvṛtta darśanā bhūtvā durvāra dāruṇa āyāsa duḥkha santāpa dahyamāna citta vighaṭamāna jīvita āśā dūra vijṛmbhita apūrva sarva aṅga prajvalana madana hutavaha uddāma dāha duḥsaha āyāsa durmanāyamāna parijanā pratyāśā vimokṣa mātra sulabha mṛtyu nirvāṇa pratikūla buddha rakṣitā vacana vivardhita āvega vyatikara visaṃsthulā imam jīvaloka parivartam anubhavāmi

original: makarandapratyāśānivṛttimātreṇa sulabho mṛtyureva nirvāṇaṃ nirvṛtistatpratikūlaṃ buddharakṣitāvacanaṃ saṃnihitamakarandaprāptipratipādakaṃ tena saṃvardhito ya āvega udvegastena vihvaletyarthaḥ/ saṃkalpacintāyāṃ svapnāntareṣu ca manorathonmādamohitā paśyāmi taṃ janam/
analyzed: makaranda pratyāśā nivṛtti mātreṇa sulabhaḥ mṛtyuḥ eva nirvāṇam nirvṛtiḥ tad pratikūlam buddha rakṣitā vacanam saṃnihita makaranda prāpti pratipādakam tena saṃvardhitaḥ yaḥ āvegaḥ udvegaḥ tena vihvalā iti arthaḥ saṃkalpa cintāyām svapna antareṣu ca manoratha unmāda mohitā paśyāmi tam janam

original: tathā ca priyasakhi, muhūrtamudūḍhavismayavisaṃsthulodvellavistāriprāntanālaraktanetrapuṇḍarīkatāṇḍavodbhaṭaprarūḍhamaireyamadaghūrṇanaśīlaṃ yathā syāttathā nirvarṇayati sābhilāṣaṃ māmeva paśyati/ saṃkalpādyupanato'sāviti śeṣaḥ/ nirvāpayati māṃ sukhayatīti vā/ maireyo madyaviśeṣaḥ/
analyzed: tathā ca priya sakhi muhūrtam udūḍha vismaya visaṃsthula udvella vistāri prānta nāla rakta netra puṇḍarīka tāṇḍava udbhaṭa prarūḍha maireya mada ghūrṇana śīlam yathā syāt tathā nirvarṇayati sa abhilāṣam mām eva paśyati saṃkalpa ādi upanatā asau iti śeṣaḥ nirvāpayati mām sukhayati iti vā maireyaḥ madya viśeṣaḥ

original: vistāriṇaḥ prāntasya netra vibhāgasya dīrghībhūyamānā mālākāreṇa prasaraṇānnālatvanirūpaṇaṃ svabhāvata eva netrapuṇḍarīkasya madhumadaghūrṇamānatvamiva yathā syādityuktam/ kiṃ ca kavalitāravindakesarakaṣāyakaṇṭhakalahaṃsaghoṣaghargharaskhalitagambhīrabhāratībharitakarṇavivaraṃ priye madayantike iti māṃ vyāharati/ svapnādāviti yāvat/
analyzed: vistāriṇaḥ prāntasya netra vibhāgasya dīrghībhūyamānā mālākāreṇa prasaraṇāt nāla tva nirūpaṇam svabhāvataḥ eva netra puṇḍarīkasya madhu mada ghūrṇamāna tvam iva yathā syāt iti uktam kim ca kavalita aravinda kesara kaṣāya kaṇṭha kalahaṃsa ghoṣa gharghara skhalita gambhīra bhāratī bharita karṇa vivaram priye madayantike iti mām vyāharati svapna ādau iti yāvat

analyzed: vighaṭamāna vihvala mekhalā valaya saṃdhāryamāṇa pīvara ūru pratiṣidhyamāna vipratīpa gamanām gāḍha āliṅgana saukhya atiśaya tad kṣaṇa pravṛddhāt nitambāt vighaṭamānam viśliṣyat vihvalam visrastam ca yat mekhalā valayam tena saṃdhāryamāṇābhyām pīvara ūrubhyām eva pratiṣidhyamāna pratikūla gamanām iti arthaḥ

original: śārdūlanakhaprahārā eva vikaṭapatrāvalī saiva prasādhanaṃ yasyeti pūrvopakārasmaraṇam/ sāvegaṃ sāṭopaṃ yadvidhūnanaṃ tenāpaviddhabandhā visrastabandhanā yā kabarī tasyāṃ nihitena kareṇa yaḥ parigrahastena puñjīkṛtaiḥ/ kacairiti yāvat/

original: unnamitā niścalāḥ spaṣṭaṃ vibhāvyamānā ye manmukhādyavayavāsteṣu svacchandavilasitaṃ svecchayā vilasanaṃ kurvadvidagdhaṃ vadanakamalaṃ yasya sa ityarthaḥ/

original: evaṃ nāma priyasakhi, samakṣaṃ pratyakṣaṃ sarvamanubhūya tato jhaṭiti pratibuddhā śūnyāraṇyasaṃnibhaṃ punarapi mandabhāgyā vibhāvayāmi jīvalokamiti// lavaṅgikā/ sakhi madayantike, sphuṭamākhyāhi/ api tasminnavasare snehavibhramorjitahāsavikasadbuddharakṣitālocananirūpitamāsanamayūrakaṃ parijanādgopanīyaṃ bhavati vā kiṃ na veti/
analyzed: evam nāma priya sakhi samakṣam pratyakṣam sarvam anubhūya tatas jhaṭiti pratibuddhā śūnya araṇya saṃnibham punar api mandabhāgyā vibhāvayāmi jīva lokam iti lavaṅgikā sakhi madayantike sphuṭam ākhyāhi api tasmin avasare sneha vibhrama ūrjita hāsa vikasat buddha rakṣita ālocana nirūpitam āsana mayūrakam parijanāt gopanīyam bhavati vā kim na vā iti

original: āsanārthaṃ nirmitaṃ vastu tūlapūritamiti tanmayūrākāramāsanaṃ mayūrakam/ tvadīyamāsanaṃ mayūrakaṃ svapnasamāgamanimittacaramadhātukṣaraṇārdrīkṛtaṃ sadvidagdhabuddharakṣitayā sasnehaṃ saparihāsaṃ ca svāpniko'pi te priyasaṃbhogaḥ pāramārthika eva te jāta iti dṛṣṭyaiva sūcyamānaṃ parijanātparihāsaśaṅkayā gopanīyaṃ ca bhavati vā na vetyarthaḥ/
analyzed: āsana artham nirmitam vastu tūla pūritam iti tat mayūra ākāram āsanam mayūrakam tvadīyam āsanam mayūrakam svapna samāgama nimitta carama dhātu kṣaraṇa ārdrīkṛtam sat vidagdha buddha rakṣi tayā sa sneham sa parihāsam ca svāpnikaḥ api te priya saṃbhogaḥ pāramārthikaḥ eva te jātaḥ iti dṛṣṭyā eva sūcyamānam parijanāt parihāsa śaṅkayā gopanīyam ca bhavati vā na vā iti arthaḥ

original: mālatyapekṣayā madayantikāyā nikṛṣṭatvadyotanāya ceṭījanocitajugupsitanarmavacanapravṛttiriti grāhyam/ madayantikā/ ayi asaṃbaddhaparihāsaśīle, apehi// buddharakṣitā/ sakhi madayantike, mālatyāḥ priyasakhyeveyamīdṛśāni jānāti/ īdṛśāni mantrayituṃ na khalu mādṛśī tvatsakhīti bhāvaḥ/
analyzed: mālatī apekṣayā madayantikāyāḥ nikṛṣṭa tva dyotanāya ceṭī jana ucita jugupsita narma vacana pravṛttiḥ iti grāhyam madayantikā ayi asaṃbaddha parihāsa śīle apehi buddha rakṣitā sakhi madayantike mālatyāḥ priya sakhī eva iyam īdṛśāni jānāti īdṛśāni mantrayitum na khalu mādṛśī tvad sakhī iti bhāvaḥ

original: mālatyāmevaṃ dṛṣṭavatīti kṛtvā tatsakhītvenaivameṣā vadatīti madayantikāyāṃ snehātiśayo buddharakṣitāyā darśitaḥ// madayantikā/ mā khalvevaṃ mālatīmupahasa// buddharakṣitā/ sakhi madayantike, pṛcchāmīdānīṃ kimapi/ yadi me viśvāsabhaṅgaṃ na karoṣi// madayantikā/ kiṃ punarapi praṇayabhaṅgena kṛtāparādho'yaṃ jano yenaivaṃ mantrayase/
analyzed: mālatyām evam dṛṣṭavatī iti kṛtvā tad sakhī tvena evam eṣā vadati iti madayantikāyām sneha atiśayaḥ buddharakṣitāyāḥ darśitaḥ madayantikā mā khalu evam mālatīm upahasa buddharakṣitā sakhi madayantike pṛcchāmi idānīm kim api yadi me viśvāsa bhaṅgam na karoṣi madayantikā kim punar api praṇaya bhaṅgena kṛta aparādhaḥ yam janaḥ yena evam mantrayase

original: priyasakhi, tvaṃ lavaṅgikā ca sāṃprataṃ me hṛdayam// buddharakṣitā/ yadi te kathamapi makarandaḥ punarapi darśanapathamavatarati tadā kiṃ tvayā kartavyam// madayantikā/ ekaikāvayavanisargalagnaniścale ciraṃ locane nirvāpayiṣye// buddharakṣitā/

original: atha sa manmathabalātkārito yadi kaṃdarpajananīṃ tvāṃ rukmiṇīmiva puruṣottamaḥ svayaṃgrāhasāhasena sahadharmacāriṇīṃ karoti tadā kīdṛśī pratipattiḥ kiṃ pratipattavyam/ manmathabalātkāraḥ saṃjāto yasmiṃstādṛśaḥ/ kaṃdarpajananīṃ pradyumnamātaraṃ manmathavikārahetuṃ ca/ puruṣottamo hariḥ puruṣaśreṣṭhaśca// madayantikā/ kasmādetāvadāśvasitāsmi/

original: manorathamātramidaṃ na saṃbhāvyata iti bhāvaḥ// buddharakṣitā/ sakhi, kathaya/ vyaktīkṛtyeti śeṣaḥ// lavaṅgikā/ sakhi, kathitameva hṛdayāvegasūcakairdīrghaniḥśvāsaiḥ/ iṣṭamevaitadyadi siddhyediti kathitamevetyarthaḥ/ tasmānmakarandānayanopāyaścintyatāmiti bhāvaḥ// madayantikā/

original: sakhi, kāhametasya tenaivātmānaṃ paṇīkṛtya mṛtyukavalādākṛṣṭasya tasyaiva parakīyasya kṛtyakiṃkarasyātmanaḥ śarīrasya// lavaṅgikā/ sadṛśaṃ khalu mahānubhāvatāyāḥ/ tvaduktamiti śeṣaḥ// buddharakṣitā/ smariṣyasyetadvacanam// madayantikā/ kathaṃ dvitīyayāmavicchedapaṭahastāḍyate/
analyzed: sakhi kā aham etasya tena eva ātmānam paṇīkṛtya mṛtyu kavalāt ākṛṣṭasya tasya eva parakīyasya kṛtya kiṃkarasya ātmanaḥ śarīrasya lavaṅgikā sadṛśam khalu mahā anubhāva tāyāḥ tvad uktam iti śeṣaḥ buddha rakṣitā smariṣyasi etat vacanam madayantikā katham dvitīya yāma viccheda paṭahaḥ tāḍyate

original: tadyāvannandanaṃ nirbhartsya sapādapatanaṃ vābhyarthya mālatyā uparyanukūlayiṣyāmi// madayantikā/ sakhi mālati, pratibuddhāsi/ priyatamadarśanaṃ harṣahetuḥ, kulakanyakājanānucitavyāpārāsaktiśca sādhvasahetuḥ/ aho ityāścaryam/ idamanyadeva vartate/ prastutamālatīnandanasaṃghaṭanādanyadeva makarandamadayantikāsaṃghaṭanasaṃdhānaṃ vartata ityarthaḥ/
analyzed: tat yāvat nandanam nirbhartsya sa pāda patanam vā abhyarthya mālatyāḥ upari anukūlayiṣyāmi madayantikā sakhi mālati pratibuddhā asi priyatama darśanam harṣa hetuḥ kula kanyakā jana anucita vyāpāra āsaktiḥ ca sādhvasa hetuḥ aho iti āścaryam idam anyat eva vartate prastuta mālatī nandana saṃghaṭanāt anyat eva makaranda madayantikā saṃghaṭana saṃdhānam vartate iti arthaḥ

original: atha makarando lajjāvailakṣyaśaṅkānirāsenonmukhīkartuṃ priyatamāṃ cāṭūktyā prasādayati - rambhorviti/ he rambhoru kadalīstambhavatpīvaroru, akāṇḍe bhayaṃ ko'sāvaparicita iti matsādhvasaṃ tyaja/ utkampinaḥ sādhvasajanitotkampataralasya stanayugalasya vikāraṃ vikṣobhamatikanīyānmadhyabhāgo na sahate/ yato'paricitāddhi bhītirbhavati/
analyzed: atha makarandaḥ lajjā vailakṣya śaṅkā nirāsena unmukhīkartum priyatamām cāṭu uktyā prasādayati rambhā ūru iti he rambhā ūru kadalī stambhavat pīvara ūru akāṇḍe bhayam kaḥ sau aparicitaḥ iti mad sādhvasam tyaja utkampinaḥ sādhvasa janita utkampa taralasya stana yugalasya vikāram vikṣobham ati kanīyān madhya bhāgaḥ na sahate yatas upari citāt hi bhītiḥ bhavati

original: eṣa iti svātmānaṃ nirdiśati/ ayaṃ janastu nāsaṃstutaḥ kiṃtvitthaṃ pūrvaṃ tvaduktena prakāreṇa tvayaiva kathitapraṇaya eva prasādo yasya sa tādṛśaḥ saṃkalpasamāgameṣu paricito dāsa eva/ tatra kathaṃ te sādhvasavailakṣyamityarthaḥ//2//
analyzed: eṣaḥ iti sva ātmānam nirdiśati ayam janaḥ tu na asaṃstutaḥ kiṃtu ittham pūrvam tvad uktena prakāreṇa tvayā eva kathita praṇayaḥ eva prasādaḥ yasya sa tādṛśaḥ saṃkalpa samāgameṣu paricitaḥ dāsaḥ eva tatra katham te sādhvasa vailakṣyam iti arthaḥ

original: atha buddharakṣitā kumārījanasulabhalajjāvaśāditikartavyatāmūḍhāṃ madayantikāṃ pratibodhayantī tasyā mukhamunnamayyāyameva trapāṃ śithilīkṛtya makarandavaraṇasamaya ityatra hetūnupanyasyati-preyāniti/ yaḥ pūrvaṃ tvayaiva manorathasahasrairvṛtaḥ sa eṣa preyānniratiśayapremāspadaṃ janaḥ saṃnihito vartate/ etaccāmātyagṛhaṃ suptānavahitarakṣitajanam/
analyzed: atha buddha rakṣitā kumārī jana sulabha lajjā vaśāt itikartavyatā mūḍhām madayantikām pratibodhayantī tasyāḥ mukham unnamayya ayam eva trapām śithilīkṛtya makaranda varaṇa samayaḥ iti atra hetūn upanyasyati preyān iti yaḥ pūrvam tvayā eva manoratha sahasraiḥ vṛtaḥ saḥ eṣa preyān niratiśaya prema āspadam janaḥ saṃnihitaḥ vartate etat ca amātya gṛham supta anavahita rakṣita janam

original: tenātra kaścitpaśyediti śaṅkāpi nāsti/ prauḍhaṃ tamaḥ/ tena nagarapālakebhyo'pi śaṅkā nirastā/ tasmātkṛtajñatayaiva bhadraṃ makarandapāṇigrahaṇamaṅgalaṃ kuru/ anantaramūrdhvamutkṣiptamaṇinūpuraṃ yathā syādevaṃ yāmaḥ/ ehi/

original: nūpuradhvaniranyairyathā na śrūyate, tathordhvamutkṣipya kaiścidapyalakṣitā yatra mālatīmādhavau tatraiva yāmastvaritaṃ mā lajjasvetyarthaḥ//3//
analyzed: nūpura dhvaniḥ anyaiḥ yathā na śrūyate tathā ūrdhvam utkṣipya kaiścid api alakṣitā yatra mālatī mādhavau tatra eva yāmaḥ tvaritam mā lajjasva iti arthaḥ

original: madayantikā/ sakhi buddharakṣite, kva punaridānīmasmābhirgantavyam// buddharakṣitā/ yatraiva mālatī gatā// madayantikā/ kiṃ nirvṛttasāhasā mālatī/ sāhasaṃ svayamevātmapradānam// buddharakṣitā/ atha kim/ nirvṛttasāhasaivetyarthaḥ/ anyacca tvaṃ bhaṇasi/ ``kāhametasya'' ityādi paṭhati/ tvayā yaduktaṃ tadanurūpaṃ vidhehītyarthaḥ//
analyzed: madayantikā sakhi buddha rakṣite kva punar idānīm asmābhiḥ gantavyam buddha rakṣitā yatra eva mālatī gatā madayantikā kim nirvṛtta sāhasā mālatī sāhasam svayam eva ātma pradānam buddha rakṣitā atha kim nirvṛtta sāhasā eva iti arthaḥ anyat ca tvam bhaṇasi kā aham etasya ityādi paṭhati tvayā yat uktam tad anurūpam vidhehi iti arthaḥ

original: madayantikā gurujanavidhīyamānasaṃpradāna iva svayamaśrūṇi pātayati// buddharakṣitā ānandāśruvimocanenaiva tasyāḥ svātmapradānamadhigamyāha - mahābhāga, dattaḥ khalu svayamātmā priyasakhyā/ ānandāśrupūrvakamiti bhāvaḥ// makarandaḥ - adyeti/ adya priyatamālābhānmayorjitaṃ balaṃ yathā syādevaṃ vijitameva sarvottaratvaṃ saṃpāditameva/
analyzed: madayantikā guru jana vidhīyamāna saṃpradāne iva svayam aśrūṇi pātayati buddharakṣitā ānanda aśru vimocanena eva tasyāḥ sva ātma pradānam adhigamya āha mahābhāga dattaḥ khalu svayam ātmā priya sakhyā ānanda aśru pūrvakam iti bhāvaḥ makarandaḥ adya iti adya priyatamā lābhāt mayā ūrjitam balam yathā syāt evam vijitam eva sarva uttara tvam saṃpāditam eva

original: kimanyaditaḥ paramāśvāsyamavaśiṣṭam/ na kiṃcidityarthaḥ/ tathā phalavato dayitāprāptyaiva saphalasya me navayauvanasyādyotsavo maṅgaladinam/ yanme prasādasumukhena makaradhvajena mādhavābhilaṣitaṃ saṃpādya madabhilaṣitamapi saṃpādayatā bāndhavadhurābandhukṛtyamudyatocitapadaṃ prāpitā//4//
analyzed: kim anyat itas parama āśvāsyam avaśiṣṭam na kiṃcid iti arthaḥ tathā phalavataḥ dayitā prāptyā eva saphalasya me nava yauvanasya adya utsavaḥ maṅgala dinam yat me prasāda sumukhena makaradhvajena mādhava abhilaṣitam saṃpādya mad abhilaṣitam api saṃpādayatā bāndhava dhurā bandhu kṛtyam udyata ucita padam prāpitā

original: pakṣadvāreṇa pārśvadvāreṇa sādhayāmo gacchāmaḥ// samīhitaṃ niśīthe niḥsaṃcāreṇa rājamārgasya ramaṇīyatāsmatprayāṇānuguṇyaṃ vartate// prāsādānāmiti/ saudhānāmuparibhāgeṣu valabhījālagavākṣamārgeṣu praviśya prāptāmodaḥ/ ``bhrāntyāvṛttaḥ'' iti pāṭhe gavākṣamārgeṇa harmyataleṣu paribhramya punarāvṛttaḥ/
analyzed: pakṣa dvāreṇa pārśva dvāreṇa sādhayāmaḥ gacchāmaḥ samīhitam niśīthe niḥsaṃcāreṇa rājamārgasya ramaṇīya tā asmad prayāṇa ānuguṇyam vartate prāsādānām iti saudhānām upari bhāgeṣu valabhī jāla gavākṣa mārgeṣu praviśya prāpta āmodaḥ bhrānti āvṛttaḥ iti pāṭhe gavākṣa mārgeṇa harmya taleṣu paribhramya punar āvṛttaḥ

original: ata eva pariṇatamadyagandhajanitavāsanānuviddhaḥ/ mālyāmodī punaḥ punaranuṣaktasphuradghanasāragandhī vāto yūnāmabhilaṣitaṃ yuvatīsaṃnidhānaṃ vyanaktīti madyapānamālyādibhiḥ suratādibhogo vyajyate//5//
analyzed: atas eva pariṇata madya gandha janita vāsanā anuviddhaḥ mālya āmodī punar punar anuṣakta sphurat ghanasāra gandhī vātaḥ yūnām abhilaṣitam yuvatī saṃnidhānam vyanakti iti madya pāna mālya ādibhiḥ surata ādi bhogaḥ vyajyate

original: madvyākhyāmanthamathitādbhavabhūtivacombudheḥ/
analyzed: mad vyākhyā mantha mathitāt bhavabhūti vacaḥ umbudheḥ

original: rasāmṛtamabhivyaktaṃ svādayantu budhāściram//
analyzed: rasa amṛtam abhivyaktam svādayantu budhāḥ ciram

original: iti śrīmadbhāradvājakulatilakaparvatanāthayāyajūkanandanatripurārisūriviracitāyāṃ mālatīmādhavabhāvapradīpikāyāṃ saptamāṅkavivaraṇam/
analyzed: iti śrīmat bhāradvāja kula tilaka parvata nātha yāyajūka nandana tripurāri sūri viracitāyām mālatī mādhava bhāvapradīpikāyām saptama aṅka vivaraṇam

original: aṣṭamo'ṅkaḥ/
analyzed: aṣṭamaḥ uṅkaḥ

original: vibudharatnāvalī/

atha mālatīmādhavayoḥ kāmandakyāvasathasthitayoḥ kṛtyaveśasaṃpādanānuguṇavyāpārārthamavalokitāpraveśaḥ/ avalokitā/ vanditā mayā nandanāvasathapratinivṛttā bhagavatī/ tadyāvanmālatīmādhavayoḥ sakāśaṃ gacchāmi/ parikramya/ paśyatīti śeṣaḥ/ etau tau parinirvartitagrīṣmadivasāvasānamajjanau dīrghikātīraśilātalamalaṃkurutaḥ/ tadupasarpāmi// mādhavaḥ/
analyzed: atha mālatī mādhavayoḥ kāmandakya āvasatha sthitayoḥ kṛtya veśa saṃpādana anuguṇa vyāpāra artham avalokitā praveśaḥ avalokitā vanditā mayā nandana āvasatha pratinivṛttā bhagavatī tat yāvat mālatī mādhavayoḥ sakāśam gacchāmi parikramya paśyati iti śeṣaḥ etau tau parinirvartita grīṣma divasa avasāna majjanau dīrghikā tīra śilā talam alaṃkurutaḥ tat upasarpāmi mādhavaḥ

original: niśīthasya vakṣyamāṇacandrodayatvena manmathaprauḍhasuhṛdaḥ/ manmathasuhṛttā ca manmathasādhyānukūlakaraṇāt/ tatra samaye/ ``sānandasādhvasāḥ suratavyavasāyinyo bhavanti'' iti vātsyāyanaḥ/ tathā hīti kṛtvā tasyā eva niśīthayauvanaśriya utkarṣanimittaṃ vyanakti - dalayatīti/
analyzed: niśīthasya vakṣyamāṇa candra udaya tvena manmatha prauḍha suhṛdaḥ manmatha suhṛd tā ca manmatha sādhya anukūla karaṇāt tatra samaye sa ānanda sādhvasāḥ surata vyavasāyinyaḥ bhavanti iti vātsyāyanaḥ tathā hi iti kṛtvā tasyāḥ eva niśītha yauvana śriyaḥ utkarṣa nimittam vyanakti dalayati iti

original: udgacchannaindavaḥ prakāśastadvacchuṣyattālīpattrapāṇḍuvarṇastimirastomaṃ bhinatti/ marudvegodbhedaketakīparāga iva sphārasphāramunmukhībhūya pracalita iva prakāśopamā//1//
analyzed: udgacchan aindavaḥ prakāśaḥ tadvat śuṣyat tālīpattra pāṇḍu varṇaḥ timira stomam bhinatti marut vega udbheda ketakī parāgaḥ iva sphāra sphāram unmukhībhūya pracalitaḥ iva prakāśa upamā

original: kulakumārītvena tathā pratyavasitacāritratvena ca tadabhiprāyānukūlaṃ gamyamityācarantīṃ vāmaśīlāmiva vāmaśīlāmupāvartaye svābhimatasiddhipraguṇacittāṃ karomi/ bhavatvityupāyasmaraṇe/ evaṃ tāvatkāmasūtroktena kanyāvisrambhaṇopāyenopāvartanārthaṃ yatiṣya ityabhiprāyeṇa matiṃ vyavasthāpya prakāśamāha - priya iti/
analyzed: kula kumārī tvena tathā pratyavasita cāritra tvena ca tad abhiprāya anukūlam gamyam iti ācarantīm vāma śīlām iva vāma śīlām upāvartaye sva abhimata siddhi praguṇa cittām karomi bhavatu iti upāya smaraṇe evam tāvat kāmasūtra uktena kanyā visrambhaṇa upāyena upāvartana artham yatiṣye iti abhiprāyeṇa matim vyavasthāpya prakāśam āha priyaḥ iti

original: atra nidāghasaṃtāpaśāntaya ityuktyā saṃtāpapratīkāradhiyā na rāgitayaiva tvadaṅgasaṅgaprārthanārthaṃ vijñāpayāmīti premagarbhaṃ vinayapradarśanam/ niścyotanta iti/ sutanviti saṃbodhanenāliṅganātyantopayuktasya nāyikāśarīrasyātiramaṇīyakapradarśanaṃ kimitīdṛśyāṃ daśāyāṃ darśanārhaṃ māṃ na saṃbhāvayasi/
analyzed: atra nidāgha saṃtāpa śāntaye iti uktyā saṃtāpa pratīkāra dhiyā na rāgi tayā eva tvad aṅga saṅga prārthanā artham vijñāpayāmi iti prema garbham vinaya pradarśanam niścyotantaḥ iti su tano iti saṃbodhanena āliṅgana atyanta upayuktasya nāyikā śarīrasya ati ramaṇīyaka pradarśanam kim iti īdṛśyām daśāyām darśana arham mām na saṃbhāvayasi

original: mayā tvaṃ yasminnavasare smaśānabhuvi saṃbhāvitāsi tatsadṛśa evāyaṃ samaya ityāśayaḥ/ niścyotanta ityātmanepadaṃ cintyam/ adya snānavimuktabandhakabarīsaṅgino jalabindavo yāvadeva patanti, yāvadvā stanadvandvāntarbhāgaḥ snānajalārdro vartate, yāvacca snānaśaityātsāndrapulakatvaṃ gatā tāvadevāśleṣaṃ dehi, prasannā bhava/
analyzed: mayā tvam yasmin avasare smaśāna bhuvi saṃbhāvitā asi tad sadṛśaḥ eva ayam samayaḥ iti āśayaḥ niścyotantaḥ iti ātmanepadam cintyam adya snāna vimukta bandhaka barīsaṅginaḥ jala bindavaḥ yāvat eva patanti yāvat vā stana dvandva antar bhāgaḥ snāna jala ārdraḥ vartate yāvat ca snāna śaityāt sāndra pulaka tvam gatā tāvat eva āśleṣam dehi prasannā bhava

original: etena mālatyevaṃ jānātu yatkila madaṅgavartimajjanajanitaśaityamevāsya sparśasaṃtāpaśāntaye satyabhīṣṭam, na punaḥ kāmandakīlavaṅgikādyabhiprāyānapekṣameva pariṇayavidhānamanādṛtya kiṃciccikīrṣuriti vimṛśya mālatī mahyaṃ kāpālikavadhopakārabuddhyā vitaratviti mādhavasyāśayaḥ/
analyzed: etena mālatī evam jānātu yat kila mad aṅgavarti majjana janita śaityam eva asya sparśa saṃtāpa śāntaye satī abhīṣṭam na punar kāmandakī lavaṅgikā ādi abhiprāya anapekṣam eva pariṇaya vidhānam an ādṛtya kiṃcid cikīrṣuḥ iti vimṛśya mālatī mahyam kāpālika vadha upakāra buddhyā vitaratu iti mādhavasya āśayaḥ

original: vastutastu jalamajjanajanyāṃ tātkālikīṃ kāntiṃ śobhāmiti sa tatra kāntigatālaṃkāratvena bharatamunisaṃmatāmavalokyātirāgādevāśleṣaprārthanāyāṃ pravṛttiḥ/ ``rūpayauvanalāvaṇyādupabhogopabṛṃhitaiḥ/ alaṃkaraṇamaṅgānāṃ śobheti parikīrtitā/ kāntirityucyate sāpi śobhaivāpūrṇamanmathā//'' tathā/
analyzed: vastutas tu jala majjana janyām tātkālikīm kāntim śobhām iti sa tatra kānti gata alaṃkāra tvena bharata muni saṃmatām avalokya ati rāgāt eva āśleṣa prārthanāyām pravṛttiḥ rūpa yauvana lāvaṇyāt upabhoga upabṛṃhitaiḥ alaṃkaraṇam aṅgānām śobhā iti parikīrtitā kāntiḥ iti ucyate sā api śobhā eva āpūrṇa manmathā tathā

original: ``uttiṣṭhantyā ratānte bharamuragapatau pāṇinaikena kṛtvā dhṛtvā cānyena vāso vilulitakabarībhāramaṃse vahantyāḥ/ bhūyastatkālakāntidviguṇitasurataprītinā śauriṇā vaḥ śayyāmāliṅgya nītaṃ vapurativicaladbāhu lakṣmyāḥ punātu//'' iti//2//
analyzed: uttiṣṭhantyāḥ rata ante bharam uraga patau pāṇinā ekena kṛtvā dhṛtvā ca anyena vāsaḥ vilulita kabarī bhāram aṃse vahantyāḥ bhūyas tad kāla kānti dvi guṇita surata prītinā śauriṇā vaḥ śayyām āliṅgya nītam vapuḥ ati vicalat bāhu lakṣmyāḥ punātu iti

original: atha kāmasūtravinmādhavastadvacasyapi ``anuttarāṃ copalakṣyāt''
analyzed: atha kāmasūtra vid mādhavaḥ tad vacasi api anuttarām ca upalakṣyāt

original: ṛ) ityādikāṃ dvitīyabhūmikāmadhiropayannāha - ayīti/ niranukrośe iti roṣodbhāvanena mālatyā vibhīṣikā darśitā/ yathāha vātsyāyanaḥ - ``evaṃ cittānugo bālāmupāyena prasādayet/ tathā cetsānurāgā ca visrabdhā cāpi jāyate// nātyantamānulomyena na cātiprātikūlyataḥ/ siddhiṃ gacchati kanyāsu tasmānmadhyena sādhayet//
analyzed: iti ādikām dvitīya bhūmikām adhiropayan āha ayi iti niranukrośe iti roṣa udbhāvanena mālatyā vibhīṣikā darśitā yathā āha vātsyāyanaḥ evam citta anugaḥ bālām upāyena prasādayet tathā ced sa anurāgā ca visrabdhā ca api jāyate na atyantam ānulomyena na ca ati prātikūlyataḥ siddhim gacchati kanyāsu tasmāt madhyena sādhayet

original: ātmanaḥ prītijananaṃ yoṣitāṃ mānavardhanam/ kanyāvisrambhaṇaṃ vetti yaśca tāsāṃ priyo bhavet// atilajjānvitetyevaṃ yastu kanyāmupekṣate/ so'nabhiprāyavedīti paśuvatparibhūyate//'' ityādi/ jīvayanniti/ māṃ gatajīvitaprāyaṃ jīvayanniva dhṛtasādhvasasvedarūpasāttvikabhāvo bāhuradhikaṇṭhaṃ kaṇṭhe madīye svayamevārpyatām/
analyzed: ātmanaḥ prīti jananam yoṣitām māna vardhanam kanyā visrambhaṇam vetti yaḥ ca tāsām priyaḥ bhavet ati lajjā anvitā iti evam yaḥ tu kanyām upekṣate paśu vat paribhūyate ityādi jīvayan iti mām gata jīvita prāyam jīvayan iva dhṛta sādhvasa sveda rūpa sāttvika bhāvaḥ bāhuḥ adhi kaṇṭham kaṇṭhe madīye svayam eva arpyatām

original: yathā prārthita eva bhavadupari prakoṣṭho mayā kāpālikāpasaraṇāyārjitastathetyāśayaḥ/ aindavamayūkhacumbanena yaḥ sravaṇaśīlaścandrakāntamaṇihārastadvilāsastatsadṛśaḥ/ so'pi saṃtāpaśāntyai kaṇṭhe samarpyate/ atra cāṅkapālīṃ dehi tathādhikaṇṭhaṃ bāhurarpyatāmiti ca prārthanādvayena kanyānudvegakaramupakramaṃ kāmasūtroktaṃ smārayati/
analyzed: yathā prārthitaḥ eva bhavat upari prakoṣṭhaḥ mayā kāpālikā apasaraṇāya arjitaḥ tathā iti āśayaḥ aindava mayūkha cumbanena yaḥ sravaṇa śīlaḥ candrakānta maṇi hāraḥ tad vilāsaḥ tad sadṛśaḥ saḥ api saṃtāpa śāntyai kaṇṭhe samarpyate atra ca aṅkapālīm dehi tathā adhikaṇṭham bāhuḥ arpyatām iti ca prārthanā dvayena kanyā anudvega karam upakramam kāmasūtra uktam smārayati

original: ``pūrvakāyena copakramo viṣahyatvāt''//3//
analyzed: pūrva kāyena ca upakramaḥ viṣahya tvāt

original: athavā kaṇṭhabāhvarpaṇānurūpaṃ dūre tāvadatyantadurlabhatvāt/ mandapuṇyaḥ kathaṃ kena hetunālāpasaṃvibhāgasyānurāgavyañjakavākyāmṛtasyāpyabhājanamasthānam/ dagdhamiti/ mama vapustāvacciraṃ malayānilādibhiḥ smaroddīpanavibhāvaistvatprāptyarthameva yatamānasya dagdhamiva/ dagdhaṃ yadasti tatparirabhya na nirvāpitaṃ na nirvṛttiṃ nītameva/
analyzed: athavā kaṇṭha bāhu arpaṇa anurūpam dūre tāvat atyanta durlabha tvāt mandapuṇyaḥ katham kena hetunā ālāpa saṃvibhāgasya anurāga vyañjaka vākya amṛtasya api abhājanam asthānam dagdham iti mama vapuḥ tāvat ciram malaya anila ādibhiḥ smara uddīpana vibhāvaiḥ tvad prāpti artham eva yatamānasya dagdham iva dagdham yat asti tat parirabhya na nirvāpitam na nirvṛttim nītam eva

original: tadeva tāvanmahadanaucityaṃ tadanucitaṃ mayā na gṛhītam tarhi śrutirmadīyā madāndhakokilakuhūkāreṇātyantamadanoddīpanena vyathitā saṃjātaduḥkhā/ he kiṃnarakaṇṭhi, te vācaṃ hṛdyāṃ hṛdayahāriṇīṃ pibatu/ tuśabdāvatra krameṇa punarathag/ nāmaśabda ivārthaḥ/ kiṃnaramadhurakaṇṭhatvena kokiladhvanistvadvacanādahṛdya iti cāṭukāritvam//4//
analyzed: tat eva tāvat mahat anaucityam tat anucitam mayā na gṛhītam tarhi śrutiḥ madīyā mada andha kokila kuhū kāreṇa atyanta madana uddīpanena vyathitā saṃjāta duḥkhā he kiṃnara kaṇṭhi te vācam hṛdyām hṛdaya hāriṇīm pibatu tuśabdau atra krameṇa punar athak nāma śabdaḥ iva arthaḥ kiṃnara madhura kaṇṭha tvena kokila dhvaniḥ tvad vacanāt ahṛdyaḥ iti cāṭu kāri tvam

original: avalokitā/ ayi anirvahaṇaśīle, yadidānīṃ muhūrtamātrāntaritamādhavā/ muhūrtamātrāntaritaścāsau mādhavaśceti vigrahaḥ/ durmanāyamānā mama purato bhaṇasi/ cirāyata āryaputraḥ/ api nāma kiyatā cireṇa prekṣiṣye/
analyzed: avalokitā ayi anirvahaṇa śīle yat idānīm muhūrta mātra antarita mādhavā muhūrta mātra antaritaḥ ca asau mādhavaḥ ca iti vigrahaḥ durmanāyamānā mama puratas bhaṇasi cirāyataḥ āryaputraḥ api nāma kiyatā cireṇa prekṣiṣye

original: yena punarvivardhitāśeṣasādhvasāvismṛtanimeṣavighnaṃ yathā syādevaṃ nayananimīlanameva vighnamavalokayantyevaṃ bhaṇiṣyāmi dviguṇitāveṣṭanaparirambheṇa saṃbhāvayiṣya iti/ madagrataḥ prāgevamaṅgīkṛtasya sa evāyamāśleṣāvasarasya pariṇāmo'yamadhunā saṃlāpite'pi vaidagdhyamityāśayaḥ// mālatī sāsūyamiva paśyatītyāśayaḥ/ na tu sāsūyameva/
analyzed: yena punar vivardhita aśeṣa sādhvasa a vismṛta nimeṣa vighnam yathā syāt evam nayana nimīlanam eva vighnam avalokayantī evam bhaṇiṣyāmi dvi guṇita āveṣṭana parirambheṇa saṃbhāvayiṣye iti mad agratas prāk evam aṅgīkṛtasya saḥ eva ayam āśleṣa avasarasya pariṇāmaḥ yam adhunā saṃlāpite pi vaidagdhyam iti āśayaḥ mālatī sa asūyam iva paśyati iti āśayaḥ na tu sa asūyam eva

original: atha makarando mitrasya durantādhidarśanena bhrāntacittatayā virahivipakṣatāmuddīpanabhāvanāṃ vismṛtya mādhavasyānyacittatākaraṇāya tānevopanyasyati/ ākṣipāmyanyamanaskaṃ karomi/ etasminniti/ etasminsarasi bhūpradeśā dṛśyantām/
analyzed: atha makarandaḥ mitrasya duranta adhidarśanena bhrānta citta tayā virahi vipakṣa tām uddīpana bhāvanām vismṛtya mādhavasya anya citta tā karaṇāya tān eva upanyasyati ākṣipāmi anya manaskam karomi etasmin iti etasmin sarasi bhū pradeśāḥ dṛśyantām

original: pradeśānāṃ viśeṣaṇānyāha - saharṣamandradhvānā ye mallikākṣā haṃsaviśeṣāsteṣāṃ pakṣavyādhūtāḥ pūrvaṃ paścātsphuranta uravo daṇḍā yeṣāṃ puṇḍarīkāṇāṃ tāni yeṣu bhūbhāgeṣu te tādṛśāḥ/ bāṣpāmbhaḥpūritalocanatvātkathaṃ dṛśyantāmityata āha - ekasya bāṣpāmbhasaḥ paripatanamanyasyodgamanamityanayorantarāle//14//
analyzed: pradeśānām viśeṣaṇāni āha sa harṣa mandra dhvānāḥ ye mallikākṣāḥ haṃsa viśeṣāḥ teṣām pakṣa vyādhūtāḥ pūrvam paścāt sphurantaḥ uravaḥ daṇḍāḥ yeṣām puṇḍarīkāṇām tāni yeṣu bhū bhāgeṣu te tādṛśāḥ bāṣpa ambhaḥ pūrita locana tvāt katham dṛśyantām iti atas āha ekasya bāṣpa ambhasaḥ paripatanam anyasya udgamanam iti anayoḥ antarāle

original: mādhavasya makarandoktavinodanopadeśa evodveganimittam/ makarandaḥ/ niṣpratipattyā mama tāvadvākyārthānavabodhena śūnyaṃ śūnyahṛdayatā yathā syādevamutthāya makarandopadiṣṭātmavinodanahetūnviparītānāśaṅkyāvalokayitumasamarthaḥ/ utthāyānyato'smātsthānātsthānāntaraṃ gantuṃ pravṛtta ityarthaḥ/
analyzed: mādhavasya makaranda ukta vinodana upadeśaḥ evā udvega nimittam makarandaḥ niṣpratipattyā mama tāvat vākya artha anavabodhena śūnyam śūnya hṛdaya tā yathā syāt evam utthāya makaranda upadiṣṭa ātma vinodana hetūn viparītān āśaṅkya avalokayitum asamarthaḥ utthāya anyatas smāt sthānāt sthāna antaram gantum pravṛttaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: atha makarando mitrasya duḥsahaṃ daśāntaramāpatatpratikartumasamartho niḥśvasya vadati-prasīda cittasyābhilāṣitāṃ muñca/ athavā prasanno bhava/ vānīreti/ vayasya nikuñjasahitānāṃ nadīnāṃ vetasakusumairhetubhūtaiḥ prāptasaurabhaṃ payaḥ paśya/ atra mano vinodayetyāśayaḥ/ paryanteṣu nadīnāṃ taṭeṣu/
analyzed: atha makarandaḥ mitrasya duḥsaham daśā antaram āpatat pratikartum asamarthaḥ niḥśvasya vadati prasīda cittasya abhilāṣi tām muñca athavā prasannaḥ bhava vānīra iti vayasya nikuñja sahitānām nadīnām vetasa kusumaiḥ hetu bhūtaiḥ prāpta saurabham payaḥ paśya atra manaḥ vinodaya iti āśayaḥ paryanteṣu nadīnām taṭeṣu

original: yūthikākusumānāṃ jālakairmukulairujjṛmbhitaṃ vikasitaṃ tadapi paśyetyāśayaḥ/ itaśca sānūnālambya śṛṅgāṇyādhārīkṛtya meghairmayūroddhatanṛttanimittaṃ vitānāyate paṭamayanṛttamaṇḍapatayāvāryate/ keṣu deśeṣvityata āha/ prāgbhāgeṣu giribhāgeṣu/ vikasatkuṭajakusumaiḥ prakṛṣṭo hāsastadvatsu//15//
analyzed: yūthikā kusumānām jālakaiḥ mukulaiḥ ujjṛmbhitam vikasitam tat api paśya iti āśayaḥ itas ca sānūn ālambya śṛṅgāṇi ādhārīkṛtya meghaiḥ mayūra uddhata nṛtta nimittam vitānāyate paṭa maya nṛttamaṇḍapatayā āvāryate keṣu deśeṣu iti atas āha prāgbhāgeṣu giri bhāgeṣu vikasat kuṭaja kusumaiḥ prakṛṣṭaḥ hāsaḥ tadvat su madhu prakāśa anurāga anurāga anurāga anurāga anurāga anurāga anurāga anurāga anurāga anurāga anurāga anurāga

original: jṛmbheti/ jṛmbhā vikāsastena jarjaraḥ śithilasaṃhatiryo ḍimbaḍambaraḥ kalikāsamūhastena ghanaśrīyuktakadambadrumāḥ śailaparisarabhuvo bhavanti/ etānmanovinodanārthaṃ paśyetyāśayaḥ/ atra śailabhuvo'nuvādyāḥ kadambadrumā vidheyāḥ/ evaṃ diśo meghamālāśyāmā bhavanti/ tatratyakakubho manovinodanatvenāvalokaya/ tathānuvādyavidheyabhāvau ca/
analyzed: jṛmbhā iti jṛmbhā vikāsaḥ tena jarjaraḥ śithila saṃhatiḥ yaḥ ḍimba ḍambaraḥ kalikā samūhaḥ tena ghana śrī yukta kadamba drumāḥ śaila parisara bhuvaḥ bhavanti etān manaḥ vinodana artham paśya iti āśayaḥ atra kadamba drumāḥ vidheyāḥ evam diśaḥ megha mālā śyāmāḥ bhavanti tatratya kakubhaḥ manaḥ vinodana tvena avalokaya tathā anuvādya vidheya bhāvau ca

original: tathā saritpravāhānāṃ kacchā ye'nūpaprāyadeśā udyatkandalāśca te kāntaketakabhṛtaśceti saṃpratipannāsteṣvapi mano vinodyatāmityāśayaḥ/ tathā vanānāṃ tatirāvirbhūtagandhāni yāni śilīndhralodhrayoḥ kusumāni taiḥ smereva smerā/ te manovinodananimittamityāśayaḥ/ anena prabandhena virahivargātyantāniṣṭaheturāsanno varṣartuḥ sūcyate/
analyzed: tathā sarit pravāhānām kacchāḥ yenūpa prāya deśāḥ udyat kandalāḥ ca te kānta ketaka bhṛtaḥ ca iti saṃpratipannāḥ teṣu api manaḥ vinodyatām iti āśayaḥ tathā vanānām tatiḥ āvirbhūta gandhāni yāni śilīndhra lodhrayoḥ kusumāni taiḥ smerā iva smerā te manaḥ vinodana nimittam iti āśayaḥ anena prabandhena virahi varga atyanta aniṣṭa hetuḥ āsannaḥ varṣa ṛtuḥ sūcyate

original: śilīndhrāḥ puṃnāgaviśeṣāḥ rambhetyanye/ ``śilīndhraḥ kandalīpuṣpe karatripuṭakākhyayoḥ'' iti viśvaḥ/ tripuṭaketi vicikalaviśeṣaḥ//16//
analyzed: śilīndhrāḥ puṃnāga viśeṣāḥ rambhā iti anye śilīndhraḥ kandalī puṣpe kara tripuṭaka ākhyayoḥ iti viśvaḥ tripuṭaka iti vicikala viśeṣaḥ

original: mādhavaḥ/ bhagavadvacanagauraveṇa paśyāmi/ durālokatvamasyāṃ daśāyāṃ smaroddīpakatvena ramaṇīyatvaṃ tu sukhināmavirahiṇāmaraṇyagiribhūmināmiti vivekaḥ/ tatkimetaditi sāmānyoktau napuṃsakaliṅgatā/ ko'yaṃ sarvavidaḥ suhṛdo'tyarthapratikūlānāmeva bhāvānāṃ mama duḥkhaśāntyarthamupanyāsakrama ityabhiprāyaḥ/ athavā/
analyzed: mādhavaḥ bhagavat vacana gauraveṇa paśyāmi durāloka tvam asyām daśāyām smara uddīpaka tvena ramaṇīya tvam tu sukhinām avirahiṇām araṇya giri bhūminām iti vivekaḥ tat kim etat iti sāmānya uktau napuṃsaka liṅgatā kaḥ yam sarva vidaḥ suhṛda utyartha pratikūlānām eva bhāvānām mama duḥkha śānti artham upanyāsa kramaḥ iti abhiprāyaḥ athavā

original: kimanyadbhāgyaviparyayānnimittāntaraṃ vayasyasyopanyāsakrame gaveṣaṇīyamiti svātmagatameva saṃvṛṇoti/ yadvā ramaṇīyānāṃ durālokatve nimittaṃ vimṛśan/ athavā kimanyatte divasāḥ prāptā ye durālokatve nimittānītyarthaḥ/ kīdṛśo divasā ityata āha - utphulleti/
analyzed: kim anyat bhāgya viparyayāt nimitta antaram vayasyasya upanyāsa krame gaveṣaṇīyam iti sva ātma gatam eva saṃvṛṇoti yat vā ramaṇīyānām durāloka tve nimittam vimṛśan athavā kim anyat te divasāḥ prāptāḥ ye durāloka tve nimittāni iti arthaḥ kīdṛśaḥ divasāḥ iti atas āha utphulla iti

original: vikasitāni yāni kakubhasālakusumāni tairvāsito vahangacchanyaḥ pracaṇḍaḥ purovātastatpreṅkholenāndolanena skhalitāḥ svasthānāccalitā indranīlaśakalavatsnigdhā meghapaṅktyo yeṣu divaseṣu tādṛśāḥ/ tathā nūtanāsārasiktamedinīparimalasugandhāḥ/
analyzed: vikasitāni yāni kakubha sāla kusumāni taiḥ vāsitaḥ vahan gacchan yaḥ pracaṇḍaḥ purovātaḥ tad preṅkholena āndolanena skhalitāḥ sva sthānāt calitāḥ indranīla śakala vat snigdhāḥ megha paṅktyaḥ yeṣu divaseṣu tādṛśāḥ tathā nūtana āsāra sikta medinī parimala sugandhāḥ

original: tathā prasvedajalasyāsārapavanaśaityādyo vigamo vināśastathā pracaṇḍārkatāpāccajananamāvirbhāvastayorvyatikaro vyāmiśraṇaṃ tacchobhāvahanaśīlāḥ//17//
analyzed: tathā prasveda jalasya asāra pavana śaitya ādyaḥ vigamaḥ vināśaḥ tathā pracaṇḍa arka tāpāt ca jananam āvirbhāvaḥ tayoḥ vyatikaraḥ vyāmiśraṇam tad śobhā vahana śīlāḥ

original: hā iti viṣādadyotakamavyayam/ taruṇeti/ hā priye/ tvamapi yadi madviyuktā jīvantī tiṣṭhasi tatkathamadhunedṛśo diśo draṣṭuṃ śakyāstatkathamavalokayeyam/ kīdṛśyaḥ kakubha ityata āha - prauḍhatāpiñchataruvannīlāstathā bahulā bahavastathonnamanto meghā yāsu tāḥ/ tathā śītamārutāvadhūnitapratyagraśīkarāḥ/ tathā harihetimatīrindrakārmukayuktāḥ/
analyzed: hā iti viṣāda dyotakam avyayam taruṇa iti hā priye tvam api yadi mad viyuktā jīvantī tiṣṭhasi tat katham adhunā īdṛśaḥ diśaḥ draṣṭum śakyāḥ tat katham avalokayeyam kīdṛśyaḥ kakubhaḥ iti atas āha prauḍha tāpiñcha taru vat nīlāḥ tathā bahulāḥ bahavaḥ tathā unnamantaḥ meghāḥ yāsu tāḥ tathā śīta māruta avadhūnita pratyagra śīkarāḥ tathā hari heti matīḥ indra kārmuka yuktāḥ

original: tathā madena harṣeṇa kalā ye nīlakaṇṭhakalahāstairmukharāḥ/ atrendracāpavyāptāstathā madāndhabarhikalahairduḥśabdānvitāḥ kathamavalokyāḥ saṃpratīdṛśyāṃ daśāyāmiti durālokatve hetuḥ śabdo dhvaniḥ/ arthastūddīpanavibhāvatvena//18//
analyzed: tathā madena harṣeṇa kalāḥ ye nīlakaṇṭha kalahāḥ taiḥ mukharāḥ atra indracāpa vyāptāḥ tathā mada andha barhi kalahaiḥ duḥśabda anvitāḥ katham avalokyāḥ saṃprati īdṛśyām daśāyām iti durāloka tve hetuḥ śabdaḥ dhvaniḥ arthaḥ tu uddīpana vibhāva tvena

original: virahijanātyantānabhīṣṭā unnamadambudharādibhirvyāptāḥ kathamavalokyā mādṛśairiti śokaścittavaidhuryam/ ārtiḥ pīḍā/ nāṭayati mādhavabhūto naṭo na tu mādhava eva/ yato'vasthānukṛtirnāṭyamucyate/ na ca mādhavaḥ svasyāvasthāmanukarotīti yuktam// makarandaḥ/ ko'pi vaktumapyaśakyo daśāvipāko maraṇāvasthārūpaḥ/ vajramayena//
analyzed: virahi jana atyanta anabhīṣṭāḥ unnamat ambudhara ādibhiḥ vyāptāḥ katham avalokyāḥ mādṛśaiḥ iti śokaḥ citta vaidhuryam ārtiḥ pīḍā nāṭayati mādhava bhūtaḥ naṭaḥ na tu mādhavaḥ eva yatas vasthā anukṛtiḥ nāṭyam ucyate na ca mādhavaḥ svasya avasthām anukaroti iti yuktam makarandaḥ kaḥ api vaktum api aśakyaḥ daśā vipākaḥ maraṇa avasthā rūpaḥ vajra mayena

original: suhṛdvināśadarśanadaśāyāmapi jīvatīti vajramayatvahetuḥ/ vinodo duḥkhanivāraṇopāyaḥ/ mādhavasya jīvanopāya iti niḥśvasya cintayati - evaṃ ceti/ āśvāsanopāyābhāvādavasitaprāyeva samāpteva sakhyuḥ priyātvena sakhīti saṃbodhanam/ kimaparaṃ bhavadbahudūṣaṇoktyā prayojanam/ niranukrośāsi nirdayāsītyetāvataiva tvayā saṃvṛtāni svadūṣaṇāni jñeyāni/
analyzed: suhṛd vināśa darśana daśāyām api jīvati iti vajra maya tva hetuḥ vinodaḥ duḥkha nivāraṇa upāyaḥ mādhavasya jīvana upāyaḥ iti niḥśvasya cintayati evam ca iti āśvāsana upāya abhāvāt avasita prāyā iva samāptā iva sakhyuḥ priyā tvena sakhī iti saṃbodhanam kim aparam bhavat bahu dūṣaṇa uktyā prayojanam niranukrośā asi nirdayā asi iti etāvatā eva tvayā saṃvṛtāni sva dūṣaṇāni jñeyāni

original: yathā tvayānavalokitaḥ patiryastvatprāptinimittamārabdhamahāmāṃsavikrayaprasaṅgena tvajjīvitaṃ rakṣitavāṃstathā tvamapi kuto'pyatarkitāgamanā mādhavajīvitaṃ na rakṣasīti niranukrośā/ apahastiteti/ mālatīsaṃbodhanamanapekṣitamātṛpitrādisaṃmatiriti/
analyzed: yathā tvayā anavalokitaḥ patiḥ yaḥ tvad prāpti nimittam ārabdha mahāmāṃsa vikraya prasaṅgena tvad jīvitam rakṣitavān tathā tvam api kutopi atarkita āgamanā mādhava jīvitam na rakṣasi iti niranukrośā apahastitā iti mālatī saṃbodhanam anapekṣita mātṛ pitṛ ādi saṃmatiḥ iti

original: yayā tvayā tadānīmasya mādhavasya lobhena svakarārpaṇasāhasamanuṣṭhitaṃ tadevamanaparādhe ko'yaṃ niṣkaruṇaḥ kramo vyāpāraḥ//19//
analyzed: yayā tvayā tadānīm asya mādhavasya lobhena sva kara arpaṇa sāhasam anuṣṭhitam tat evam anaparādhe kaḥ ayam niṣkaruṇaḥ kramaḥ vyāpāraḥ

original: mātariti/ dalati sphuṭati/ dhvaṃsate truṭyati/ dehabandhaḥ śarīrāvayavasaṃdhisthānam/ īdṛśapuruṣaprakāṇḍena vinā jagacchūnyaṃ jānāmi/ tathāvicchinnajvālaṃ yathā syādevamantarhṛdaye jvalāmīva jvalāmi/ tathāntarātmā sīdannavasannībhavannandhayatītyandhamasmiṃstamasi majjatīva/ viṣvaksarvato mohaḥ sthagayati sarvendriyavṛttīrāvṛṇoti/
analyzed: mātar iti dalati sphuṭati dhvaṃsate truṭyati deha bandhaḥ śarīra avayava saṃdhi sthānam īdṛśa puruṣa prakāṇḍena vinā jagat śūnyam jānāmi tathā avicchinna jvālam yathā syāt evam antar hṛdaye jvalāmi iva jvalāmi tathā antarātmā sīdan avasannībhavan andhayati iti andham asmin tamasi majjati iva viṣvak sarvatas mohaḥ sthagayati sarva indriya vṛttīḥ āvṛṇoti

original: vidhuro vyākulaḥ/ kathaṃ mandabhāgyaḥ karomi/ asya prāṇarakṣāmiti śeṣaḥ/ athavā kathamiti kimityarthe'vyayam/ kimidānīṃ karomītyarthaḥ//20//
analyzed: vidhuraḥ vyākulaḥ katham mandabhāgyaḥ karomi asya prāṇa rakṣām iti śeṣaḥ athavā katham iti kim iti arthevyayam kim idānīm karomi iti arthaḥ

original: bandhuteti/ bandhutā bandhusamūhaḥ taccittasya kṛte kaumudī maha iva kaumudīmahaḥ/ mahaśabda utsave/ mālatīnayanayoḥ kṛte pratipaccandraḥ asaṃpūrṇadarśanaviṣayatvena kadāsamyaṅnayanaviṣayatāṃ yāsyatītyasyā utkaṇṭhājanakatvena mugdhacandratvoktiḥ/ makarandanandano makarandānandanimittaṃ jīvalokasya tilaka iva/ tilako maṇḍanaviśeṣaḥ/
analyzed: bandhu tā iti bandhu tā bandhu samūhaḥ tad cittasya kṛte kaumudī mahaḥ iva kaumudī mahaḥ maha śabdaḥ utsave mālatī nayanayoḥ kṛte pratipad candraḥ asaṃpūrṇa darśana viṣaya tvena kadā asamyak nayana viṣaya tām yāsyati iti asyāḥ utkaṇṭhā janaka tvena mugdha candra tva uktiḥ makaranda nandanaḥ makaranda ānanda nimittam jīvalokasya tilakaḥ iva tilakaḥ maṇḍana viśeṣaḥ

original: pralīyate naśyati//21//
analyzed: pralīyate naśyati

original: gātreṣviti/ āliṅgyamāno gātreṣu candanarasaḥ/ dṛśyamāno dṛśi śaraccandraḥ/ vibhāvyamāno hṛdaya ānanda eva mūrtaḥ/ nikāmakamanīyaṃ svabhāvaramyaṃ tvāmuddharatā lokāntaraṃ nayatā jīvitamivoddharatā/ etacca sarvaṃ vilāpaprakāratvānna tāvadrasaviśeṣapoṣamāvahati//22//
analyzed: gātreṣu iti āliṅgyamānaḥ gātreṣu candana rasaḥ dṛśyamānaḥ dṛśi śarad candraḥ vibhāvyamānaḥ hṛdaye ānandaḥ eva mūrtaḥ nikāma kamanīyam svabhāva ramyam tvām uddharatā loka antaram nayatā jīvitam iva uddharatā etat ca sarvam vilāpa prakāra tvāt na tāvat rasa viśeṣa poṣam āvahati

original: makarandaḥ/ aciradhautaḥ sadyonirmalīkṛto rājapaṭṭaḥ śyāmaḥ pāṣāṇaviśeṣastadvadeva rucirā ramyā tathā māṃsalā puṣṭā chaviryasya tādṛgabhinavameghasamūhaḥ/ āsāro dhārāsaṃpātaḥ/
