original: tatprabhāvādayaṃ vyatikara ityabhiprāyaḥ/ kāmandakīprabhṛtibhiśca prakṛṣṭaharṣapūryamāṇamakarandanayanaceṣṭābhiḥ kuśalinī mālatī samādhaveti nirṇītamiti pratīyamāno'rthaḥ/ ata eva patanādviratāḥ sarvāḥ//8//
analyzed: tad prabhāvāt ayam vyatikaraḥ iti abhiprāyaḥ kāmandakī prabhṛtibhiḥ ca prakṛṣṭa harṣa pūryamāṇa makaranda nayana ceṣṭābhiḥ kuśalinī mālatī sa mādhavā iti nirṇītam iti pratīyamāna arthaḥ atas eva patanāt viratāḥ sarvāḥ

original: nepathya iti/ dāruṇaduḥkhajanakatvāttatpatanasya draṣṭṝṇāṃ saṃmardaḥ/ mālatīti/ punarapi tathaivāpahṛteti sāmānyato'dhigamya jñātvā sāṃsārikeṣu saṃsārabhūteṣu viṣayeṣu jīviteṣu coparatamanāḥ punaśca tamevāpāyaṃ niścitya vahnipraveśanāya suvarṇabindusaṃjñakaṃ śivāyatanamabhyetīti hatāḥ sma iti parijanavacaḥ//9//
analyzed: nepathyaḥ iti dāruṇa duḥkha janaka tvāt tad patanasya draṣṭṝṇām saṃmardaḥ mālatī iti punar api tathā eva apahṛtā iti sāmānyatas adhigamya jñātvā sāṃsārikeṣu saṃsāra bhūteṣu viṣayeṣu jīviteṣu ca uparata manāḥ punar ca tam eva apāyam niścitya vahni praveśanāya suvarṇabindu saṃjñakam śivāyatanam abhyeti iti hatāḥ smaḥ iti parijana vacaḥ

original: madayantikālavaṅgike/ jhaṭiti mālatīmādhavayordarśanābhyudayo jātaprāya iva jātaḥ/ jhaṭityatyāhitaṃ mahābhītiśca bhūrivasuvināśaśaṅkayā// kāmandakīmakarandau/ mālatīmādhavayorabhyudayena, sahaṣag bhūrivasudahanapraveśācca sakhedau/ kimayamiti/
analyzed: madayanti kālavaṅgike jhaṭiti mālatī mādhavayoḥ darśana abhyudayaḥ jāta prāyaḥ iva jātaḥ jhaṭiti atyāhitam mahā bhītiḥ ca bhūrivasu vināśa śaṅkayā kāmandakī makarandau mālatī mādhavayoḥ abhyudayena bhūrivasu dahana praveśāt ca sa khedau kim ayam iti

original: kimayaṃ bhūrivasudahanapraveśaśravaṇamālatīmādhavapratyāsannadarśanavyatikaro'sipattracandanarasacchaṭāsāratvamunneyam/ evamuttarārdhe'pi yujyate/ kimayaṃ vyatikaro meghaṃ vinā dehadahanakaraṇāmṛtavarṣaḥ//10//
analyzed: kim ayam bhūri vasu dahana praveśa śravaṇa mālatī mādhava pratyāsanna darśana vyatikara usipattra candana rasa chaṭā sāra tvam unneyam evam uttara ardhe api yujyate kim ayam vyatikaraḥ megham vinā deha dahana karaṇa amṛta varṣaḥ

original: saṃjīvaneti/ adya vidhirbhāgyamasmākaṃ kartṛ dvayoratyantaviparītakriyayorduḥkhasukhanimittayorvastunorudvegānandajanakatvena melanamanukurute/ tadyathā saṃjīvanauṣadhiviṣayorvyatikaro miśraṇaṃ tathā prakāśatimirayoḥ saṃbhedaḥ saṃgamaḥ/ tathā vajracandrakarayoḥ saṃmelanamiti//11//
analyzed: saṃjīvana iti adya vidhiḥ bhāgyam asmākam kartṛ dvayoḥ atyanta viparīta kriyayoḥ duḥkha sukha nimittayoḥ vastunoḥ udvega ānanda janaka tvena melanam anukurute tat yathā saṃjīvana oṣadhi viṣayoḥ vyatikaraḥ miśraṇam tathā prakāśa timirayoḥ saṃbhedaḥ saṃgamaḥ tathā vajra candra karayoḥ saṃmelanam iti

original: nepathye/ hā tāta, virama/ utsukāsmi te vadanakamaladarśanasya/ prasīda/ saṃbhāvaya mām/ kathaṃ mama kāraṇātsamastalokālokāntarālaviṣkambhanirmalaikamaṅgalapradīpabhūtamātmānaṃ parityajasi/ mayā punaralajjayā niranukrośayā yūyaṃ parityaktāḥ// kāmandakī/ janmeti/
analyzed: nepathye hā tāta viramaḥ utsukā asmi te vadana kamala darśanasya prasīda saṃbhāvaya mām katham mama kāraṇāt samasta loka aloka antarāla viṣkambha nirmala eka maṅgala pradīpa bhūtam ātmānam parityajasi mayā punar alajjayā niranukrośayā yūyam parityaktāḥ kāmandakī janma iti

original: aparo'nartho bhūrivasuvināśaheturanalapraveśarūpaḥ kapālakuṇḍalāmiva tvāṃ kavalayitumupasthitaḥ/ kāpālikābhibhavakleśaiḥ kṣīṇatvena śaśikalāmātrasamānāmanartha uparāga ivetyarthaḥ//12//
analyzed: aparaḥ anarthaḥ bhūri vasu vināśa hetuḥ anala praveśa rūpaḥ kapāla kuṇḍalām iva tvām kavalayitum upasthitaḥ kāpālika abhibhava kleśaiḥ kṣīṇa tvena śaśi kalā mātra samānām anarthaḥ uparāgaḥ iva iti arthaḥ

original: mādhavaḥ/ eṣeti/ jantoḥ prāṇino daivasya bhāgyasya/ purākṛtasya karmaṇa iti yāvat/ pākābhimukhasya saṃnihitasukhaduḥkhādirūpaphaladānapravaṇasya dvārāṇīva dvārāṇi duḥkhādyutpattinimittāntarāṇi purākṛtakarmāvyatiriktāni paridṛśyamānāni nirākartumīṣṭe/ prabhavatītyarthaḥ//13//
analyzed: mādhavaḥ eṣā iti jantoḥ prāṇinaḥ daivasya bhāgyasya purākṛtasya karmaṇaḥ iti yāvat pāka abhimukhasya saṃnihita sukha duḥkha ādi rūpa phala dāna pravaṇasya dvārāṇi iva dvārāṇi duḥkha ādi utpatti nimitta antarāṇi purākṛta karma avyatiriktāni paridṛśyamānāni nirākartum īṣṭe prabhavati iti arthaḥ

original: makarandaḥ/ yā tvāmādāya niṣkrāntā sā kva gatā// śrīparvatāditi/ śrīparvatāttayaiva yoginyā saha satvaraṃ yathā syādevamatrāpatamāgato'smi/ vanecarasya vacanaṃ bhūrivasurvahnipatanāya suvarṇabindumabhyetītyevaṃrūpam/ tasmādanantaramantarhitāṃ na paśyāmi//14//
analyzed: makarandaḥ yā tvām ādāya niṣkrāntā sā kva gatā śrīparvatāt iti śrīparvatāt tayā eva yoginyā saha sa tvaram yathā syāt evam atra apatam āgataḥ asmi vanecarasya vacanam bhūrivasuḥ vahni patanāya suvarṇabindum abhyeti iti evaṃrūpam tasmāt anantaram antarhitām na paśyāmi

original: kāmandakīmakarandau/ kimarthaṃ tirohitāsi/ mālatīvipannirākaraṇadvāredānīmapi bhūrivasuvināśarūpamālatīvipannirāsena punarno'smānparitrāyasvetyarthaḥ/ madayantikālavaṅgike/ sakhi mālati, nanu bhaṇāmi sakhi mālatīti/ vilāpoktiprabhedo'yam/ bhagavati, paritrāyasva/ ciraniruddhaniḥśvāsaniścalamasyā hṛdayam/
analyzed: kāmandakī makarandau kimartham tirohitā asi mālatī vipad nirākaraṇa dvārā idānīm api bhūrivasu vināśa rūpa mālatī vipad nirāsena punar na usmān paritrāyasva iti arthaḥ madayanti kāla vaṅgike sakhi mālati nanu bhaṇāmi sakhi mālati iti vilāpa ukti prabhedaḥ yam bhagavati paritrāyasva cira niruddha niḥśvāsa niścalam asyāḥ hṛdayam

original: hā amātya, hā priyasakhi, yuvāṃ dvāvapi parasparāvasānasya kāraṇaṃ jātau/ dvayorapi vināśaheturityāśayaḥ// kāmandakī/ pāṭyamānādiveti svābhāvikavarṣavilakṣaṇākāṇḍapravṛttāmbhaḥpatananimittakoktiriyam/ prīṇayati saṃtarpayati/ jīvayatītyarthaḥ// mādhavaḥ/ pratyāpannacetaneva pratyāpannajīviteva/ talliṅgānyāha - bhavatīti/ prathamaṃ niruddhaḥ/
analyzed: hā amātya hā priya sakhi yuvām dvau api paraspara avasānasya kāraṇam jātau dvayoḥ api vināśa hetuḥ iti āśayaḥ kāmandakī pāṭyamānāt iva iti svābhāvika varṣa vilakṣaṇa akāṇḍa pravṛtta ambhaḥ patana nimittaka uktiḥ iyam prīṇayati saṃtarpayati jīvayati iti arthaḥ mādhavaḥ pratyāpanna cetanā iva pratyāpanna jīvitā iva tad liṅgāni āha bhavati iti prathamam niruddhaḥ

original: paścādvitato vistārito yaḥ śvāsonnāhastena praṇunnau payodharau yatra hṛdaye tattādṛk/ unnāha ucchrāyaḥ/ cakṣurapi ca yanmohaprabhāvādasnigdhamāsīttatprakṛtau tatsvabhāve sthitaṃ mugdhamabhūdityarthaḥ/ atra nijeti padaṃ gatārthameva/
analyzed: paścāt vitataḥ vistāritaḥ yaḥ śvāsa unnāhaḥ tena praṇunnau payodharau yatra hṛdaye tat tādṛś unnāhaḥ ucchrāyaḥ cakṣuḥ api ca yat moha prabhāvāt asnigdham āsīt tat prakṛtau tad svabhāve sthitam mugdham abhūt iti arthaḥ atra nija iti padam gatārtham eva

original: tadanantaraṃ tasyā vadanaṃ mohāpagamātprasādaguṇavatprasannaṃ prātaḥkāle śriyā śobhayā parigataṃ vyāptaṃ kamalamiveti//15//

original: nepathya iti/ atha mahābhāge, punaḥ paritrāyasveti kāmandakyā atikaruṇaruditamākarṇya saudāminī bhūrivasumanalapraveśānnivārya gaganasthā prāha - avigaṇayyeti/ nandanane[nena] sahitaṃ nṛpaṃ dahanapraveśanivāraṇāya pādayornatamanādṛtya bhūrivasuḥ sapadi mama girā dhruvaṃ jīvati mālatītyevaṃrūpayā nivartito gurusaṃmadavismayo yasya tādṛk/
analyzed: nepathye iti atha mahābhāge punar paritrāyasva iti kāmandakyāḥ ati karuṇa ruditam ākarṇya saudāminī bhūrivasum anala praveśāt nivārya gagana sthā prāha a vigaṇayya iti sahitam nṛpam dahana praveśa nivāraṇāya pādayoḥ natam an ādṛtya bhūrivasuḥ sapadi mama girā dhruvam jīvati mālatī iti evaṃrūpayā nivartitaḥ guru saṃmada vismayaḥ yasya tādṛś

original: saṃmadaḥ praharṣaḥ//16//
analyzed: saṃmadaḥ praharṣaḥ

original: mādhavamakarandau/ diṣṭyānandena/ sā yoginīti/ yayā mālatī rakṣitāsvavegaprabhāvābhyāṃ vidāritameghagaganādāgacchati/ yasyā vāgamṛtadhārāsaṃpāto'tiśete jayati/ bhūrivasumālatyo rakṣaṇadvārā samastabandhujanaprāṇarakṣaketyunneyam//17//
analyzed: mādhava makarandau diṣṭi ānandena sā yoginī iti yayā mālatī rakṣitā asva vega prabhāvābhyām vidārita megha gaganāt āgacchati yasyāḥ vāc amṛta dhārā saṃpāta utiśete jayati bhūrivasu mālatyoḥ rakṣaṇa dvārā samasta bandhu jana prāṇa rakṣakā iti unneyam

original: kāmandakī/ priyaṃ na iti/ iyamabhyupaitīti saṃbhramoktiḥ// mālatī/ diṣṭyā cirasya pratyujjīvitāsmi// mālatī/ hā kathaṃ bhagavatī// kāmandakī/ jīveti/ tvaṃ jīva/ ata eva mādhavāya jīvanaṃ dehi/ madayantikādisakhījanaśca jīvatu/ himasaṅgaśītalaistavāvayavairmāṃpriyasakhīṃ ca jīvayetyarthaḥ/ āliṅganadānāditi bhāvaḥ//18//
analyzed: kāmandakī priyam naḥ iti iyam abhyupaiti iti saṃbhrama uktiḥ mālatī diṣṭyā cirasya pratyujjīvitā asmi mālatī hā katham bhagavatī kāmandakī jīva iti tvam jīva atas eva mādhavāya jīvanam dehi madayantikā ādi sakhī janaḥ ca jīvatu hima saṅga śītalaiḥ tava avayavaiḥ māṃpriya sakhīm ca jīvaya iti arthaḥ āliṅgana dānāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: itare/ priyasakhi, manorathātikrāntadarśane saṃbhāvayāsmānpariṣvaṅgeṇa// mālatī/ hā priyasakhyau// kāmandakī/ kimetaditi mādhavamakarandau prati praśnaḥ/ atha tayoridamuttaram - bhagavati, kapālakuṇḍaleti/ durjātaṃ mālatyapaharaṇavṛttāntarūpaṃ tajjanitāpado vayaṃ kṛcchrādanapāyānnirbandhādatiprayatnāduddhṛtāḥ//19//
analyzed: itare priya sakhi manoratha atikrānta darśane saṃbhāvaya asmān pariṣvaṅgeṇa mālatī hā priya sakhyau kāmandakī kim etat iti mādhava makarandau prati praśnaḥ atha tayoḥ idam uttaram bhagavati kapāla kuṇḍala iti durjātam mālatī apaharaṇa vṛttānta rūpam tad janita āpadaḥ vayam kṛcchrāt anapāyāt nirbandhāt ati prayatnāt uddhṛtāḥ

original: kāmandakī/ aghoraghaṇṭe mādhavena nihate sati yattadantevāsinyā mādhavaṃ pratyapakārarūpo mālatīharaṇadvārā vyāpārastatkilāghoraghaṇṭavadhavijṛmbhitamiti// lavaṅgikāmadayantike/ aho āścaryam/ punaruktadāruṇasya pariṇāmaramaṇīyatvaṃ vidheḥ/ punaruktamiva punaruktaṃ punaḥpunarmālatīharaṇam/ pariṇāmaramaṇīyatvaṃ cānte'kṣatamālatīlābhena// saudāminī/
analyzed: kāmandakī aghoraghaṇṭe mādhavena nihate sati yat tat antevāsinyāḥ mādhavam pratyapakāra rūpaḥ mālatī haraṇa dvārā vyāpāraḥ tat kila aghoraghaṇṭa vadha vijṛmbhitam iti lavaṅgikā madayantike aho āścaryam punar ukta dāruṇasya pariṇāma ramaṇīya tvam vidheḥ punar uktam iva punar uktam punar punar mālatī haraṇam pariṇāma ramaṇīya tvam ca anta īkṣata mālatī lābhena saudāminī

original: antevāsī jana ityātmanaḥ puṃliṅganirdeśātkapālakuṇḍalāgṛhītamālatīparitrāṇarūpamātmanaḥ puruṣārthasādhakatvaṃ sūcayati/ ciraṃtanaḥ prathamāptadīkṣaḥ siddhamantreṇācāryeṇa prathamaprakṛṣṭamantraḥ prakṛṣṭaśiṣyabhāvādityāśayaḥ// mādhavamakarandau/ kathaṃśabda āścarye/ pakṣapātasthānaṃ smārayati pūrvaśiṣyā saudāminīti/
analyzed: antevāsī janaḥ iti ātmanaḥ puṃliṅga nirdeśāt kapāla kuṇḍala āgṛhīta mālatī paritrāṇa rūpam ātmanaḥ puruṣa artha sādhaka tvam sūcayati ciraṃtanaḥ prathama āpta dīkṣaḥ siddha mantreṇa ācāryeṇa prathama prakṛṣṭa mantraḥ prakṛṣṭa śiṣya bhāvāt iti āśayaḥ mādhava makarandau katham śabdaḥ āścarye pakṣapāta sthānam smārayati pūrva śiṣyā saudāminī iti

original: svatantreṣu sthāneṣu saudāminīsmaraṇādyatsarvamidaṃ mālatīvipatpratīkāravyāpārarūpametatsarvaṃ saṃgacchate saṃgataṃ bhavati/ yujyata ityarthaḥ/ ehyehīti/ bhūrivasujīvitadānena yaḥ puṇyasaṃbhārastaddvāreṇa/ jīvitadānaṃ ca mālatībhūrivasuvipannivāraṇadvāram/ hanta harṣe/
analyzed: svatantreṣu sthāneṣu saudāminī smaraṇāt yat sarvam idam mālatī vipad pratīkāra vyāpāra rūpam etat sarvam saṃgacchate saṃgatam bhavati yujyate iti arthaḥ ehi ehi iti bhūrivasu jīvita dānena yaḥ puṇya saṃbhāraḥ tad dvāreṇa jīvita dānam ca mālatī bhūrivasu vipad nivāraṇa dvāram hanta harṣe

original: tadīdṛgatyantābhīṣṭadvayasaṃpādanena dattapramodamapi madvapurāliṅganenānandaya/ praṇāmādvirama/ tvameva jīvitadāyitvenānuguṇotkarṣeṇa ca praṇamyā mayetyāśayaḥ/ ``guṇāḥ pūjāsthānaṃ guṇiṣu na ca liṅgaṃ na ca vayaḥ'' ityādivacanāt//20//
analyzed: tat īdṛś atyanta abhīṣṭa dvaya saṃpādanena datta pramodam api mad vapuḥ āliṅganena ānandaya praṇāmāt virama tvam eva jīvita dāyi tvena anuguṇa utkarṣeṇa ca praṇamyā mayā iti āśayaḥ guṇāḥ pūjā sthānam guṇiṣu na ca liṅgam na ca vayaḥ iti ādi vacanāt

original: etadevottaraślokena vyaktīkaroti-vandyeti/ evaṃvidhaiḥ paropakāraphalairvilasitairvyāpārairatibodhisattvairatikrāntabodhisattvaiḥ/ manogatāgameṣu brahmamāyāpīha bodhasadgranthena kathitā
analyzed: etat eva uttara ślokena vyaktīkaroti vandya iti evaṃvidhaiḥ para upakāra phalaiḥ vilasitaiḥ vyāpāraiḥ ati bodhisattvaiḥ atikrānta bodhisattvaiḥ manogata āgameṣu brahma māyā api iha bodha sat granthena kathitā

original: ṛ) jīvitavyayenāpi parārthasādhanaikavyāpārasthairvilasitaistvameva vandyā jagataḥ/ tanmama vandanādvirametyarthaḥ/ spṛhaṇīyā siddhiryasyāḥ sā tādṛśī mantrasiddhirasmākamapi spṛhaṇīyā/ yasyāstava vijṛmbhitenedṛśavyāpāreṇa tadbījaṃ mālatīmādhavatarupratānanidhānamadbhutapracuraphalaśālyabhūdityarthaḥ/ kīdṛgbījam/
analyzed: jīvita vyayena api parārtha sādhana eka vyāpāra sthaiḥ vilasitaiḥ tvam eva vandyā jagataḥ tat mama vandanāt virama iti arthaḥ spṛhaṇīyā siddhiḥ yasyāḥ sā tādṛśī mantra siddhiḥ asmākam api spṛhaṇīyā yasyāḥ tava vijṛmbhitena īdṛśa vyāpāreṇa tat bījam mālatī mādhava taru pratāna nidhānam adbhuta pracura phala śāli abhūt iti arthaḥ kīdṛś bījam

original: purā kāle vidyāparigrahasamaye prītibandho'vaśyamāvābhyāmapatyasaṃbandhaḥ kārya iti pratijñārūpo mama samakṣaṃ sasaṃbandho'dyatanatattādṛgṛtena nistārarūpeṇa syādityāśayaḥ//21//
analyzed: purā kāle vidyā parigraha samaye prīti bandhaḥ vaśyam āvābhyām apatya saṃbandhaḥ kāryaḥ iti pratijñā rūpaḥ mama samakṣam nistāra rūpeṇa syāt iti āśayaḥ

original: mālatī/ bāḍham/ saudāminīyamevetyarthaḥ/ anayā khalu bhagavatīsaṃbandhapakṣapātinyā nirbhartsya kapālakuṇḍalāmātmana āvasathamupanīyāśvāsitāsmi/ kesarāvalīsābhijñānahastayehāgatya sarve yūyaṃ saṃdhāritāḥ/ rakṣitā maraṇādamībandhujanā ityarthaḥ// itarāḥ/ suprasannā na kaniṣṭhā bhagavatī// makarandamādhavau/ ahośabda āścarye/ bhoḥ saṃbuddhau/ apīti/
analyzed: mālatī bāḍham saudāminī iyam eva iti arthaḥ anayā khalu bhagavatī saṃbandha pakṣapātinyā nirbhartsya kapāla kuṇḍalām ātmanaḥ āvasatham upanīya āśvāsitā asmi kesara āvalī sa abhijñāna hastayā iha āgatya sarve yūyam saṃdhāritāḥ rakṣitāḥ maraṇāt amī bandhu janāḥ iti arthaḥ itarāḥ su prasannā na kaniṣṭhā bhagavatī makaranda mādhavau ahośabdaḥ āścarye bhoḥ saṃbuddhau api iti

original: cintāmaṇirapi prārthakasya cintārūpaṃ pariśramamapekṣate/ idaṃ tu mālatīprāṇatrāṇarūpam/ tatkathaṃ mayācintitaṃ tathāpyāryayā kṛtaṃ tadanyena kalpadrumādināpyakṛtam/ ata evāścaryam//22//
analyzed: cintāmaṇiḥ api prārthakasya cintā rūpam pariśramam apekṣate idam tu mālatī prāṇa trāṇa rūpam tat katham mayā a cintitam tathā api āryayā kṛtam tad anyena kalpadruma ādinā api a kṛtam atas eva āścaryam

original: saudāminī/ etallavaṅgikādīnāṃ saṃtoṣaṇamityāśayaḥ/ madayantikāyāstu bhartṛprāptisaṃdeśena harṣanimittam/ ślāghyeti/ jāmātarītyuktirbījam/ ``prabhavati nijasya kanyakājanasya mahārājaḥ'' iti bhūrivasuvacanasaṃpratyayena madayantyāṃ nijakanyakābuddhireva prakṛṣṭaguṇe nirastavipadi mahākule jāmātari tvayi prītirucitetyāśayaḥ/
analyzed: saudāminī etat lavaṅgikā ādīnām saṃtoṣaṇam iti āśayaḥ madayantikāyāḥ tu bhartṛ prāpti saṃdeśena harṣa nimittam ślāghyā iti jāmātari iti uktiḥ bījam prabhavati nijasya kanyakā janasya mahā rājaḥ iti bhūrivasu vacana saṃpratyayena madayantyām nija kanyakā buddhiḥ eva prakṛṣṭa guṇe nirasta vipadi mahā kule jāmātari tvayi prītiḥ ucitā iti āśayaḥ

original: tena hetunā pūrvānurāgeṇa prāṇānayanarūpeṇa yojitāpi tava prītyarthe tava mittrāya makarandāyāsmābhirdīyata ityarthaḥ//23//
analyzed: tena hetunā pūrva anurāgeṇa prāṇa ānayana rūpeṇa yojitā api tava prīti arthe tava mittrāya makarandāya asmābhiḥ dīyate iti arthaḥ

original: mādhavamuddiśya kāmandakī vadati - śrūyatāmiti// mādhavaḥ/ nikhilārtha iti śeṣaḥ/ nṛpatinandanādinā sarvathā kṛtārtho'smītyarthaḥ// mālatī/ diṣṭyā, etadapi tāvadapagataṃ hṛdayasya śaṅkāśalyam// lavaṅgikā/ sāṃprataṃ niravaśeṣaṃ pūritāḥ śrīmādhavasya manorathāḥ/ prākṛte pūrvanipātasyāniyamatayā śrīśabdasyottaranipātalakṣaṇaṃ bhavati//
analyzed: mādhavam uddiśya kāmandakī vadati śrūyatām iti mādhavaḥ nikhila arthaḥ iti śeṣaḥ nṛpati nandana ādinā sarvathā kṛtārthaḥ asmi iti arthaḥ mālatī diṣṭyā etat api tāvat apagatam hṛdayasya śaṅkā śalyam lavaṅgikā sāṃpratam niravaśeṣam pūritāḥ śrī mādhavasya manorathāḥ prākṛte pūrva nipātasya aniyama tayā śrī śabdasya uttara nipāta lakṣaṇam bhavati

original: kāryanidhānaśabdādāppratyanena nidhānasaṃbandharūpaṃ sarvaṃ kāryajātaṃ tvayaikayā niṣpāditamiti tvameva kāryāṇāṃ nidhiḥ/ jaya makarandanandana mādhava pūrṇacandra/ makarandasya madayantikālābhādapi mādhavasya mālatīlābha evātiśayānanda iti makarandanandanatve vācoyuktiḥ/ pāpavṛddhipakṣaparyantatvena pūrṇaścandraḥ/
analyzed: kārya nidhāna śabdāt āp pratyanena nidhāna saṃbandha rūpam sarvam kārya jātam tvayā ekayā niṣpāditam iti tvam eva kāryāṇām nidhiḥ jaya makaranda nandana mādhava pūrṇa candra makarandasya madayantikā lābhāt api mādhavasya mālatī lābhaḥ eva atiśaya ānandaḥ iti makaranda nandana tve vācoyuktiḥ pāpa vṛddhipakṣa paryanta tvena pūrṇaḥ candraḥ

original: saṃprāptākhaṇḍamanorathatayāsya pūrṇacandratvoktiḥ/ diṣṭyā vardhase/ sasmitaṃ paśyati/ teṣāṃ pramodanṛttamiti śeṣaḥ/ bhagavatyantevāsinyavalokitā nṛtyatīti sasmitatve hetuḥ/ ata eva lavaṅgikāha - lavaṅgikā/ tadīyakāryamapi caitasminsaṃpūrṇam/ ataḥ sarvaprakāramahotsave nṛtyati// kāmandakī/ evametadyathā lavaṅgikā vadati/
analyzed: saṃprāpta akhaṇḍa manoratha tayā asya pūrṇa candra tva uktiḥ diṣṭyā vardhase sa smitam paśyati teṣām pramoda nṛttam iti śeṣaḥ bhagavati antevāsini avalokitā nṛtyati iti sa smita tve hetuḥ atas eva lavaṅgikā āha lavaṅgikā tadīya kāryam api ca etasmin saṃpūrṇam atas sarva prakāra mahā utsave nṛtyati kāmandakī evam etat yathā lavaṅgikā vadati

original: asti vā kutrāpīdṛśaṃ prakaraṇaṃ mahotsavaprakaraṇam/ kaverāśayastvayam/ asti vā kutracitkenāpi kavinā nirmitamevaṃvidhaṃ mālatīmādhavasadṛśaṃ mahādbhutarasajanakotpādyārthaṃ vicitraramaṇīyaṃ vividhasaṃniveśamanoharamujjvalamamṛtarasavatsaguṇaṃ sālaṃkāraṃ ceti/ atredānīṃ kavinā mukhasaṃdhisūcitasarvavastujātaṃ nirvahaṇasaṃdhau pratisaṃdhatte/
analyzed: asti vā kutra api īdṛśam prakaraṇam mahotsava prakaraṇam kaveḥ āśayaḥ tu ayam asti vā kutracid kena api kavinā nirmitam evaṃvidham mālatī mādhava sadṛśam mahā adbhuta rasa janaka utpādya artham vicitra ramaṇīyam vividha saṃniveśa manoharam ujjvalam amṛta rasavat sa guṇam sa alaṃkāram ca iti atra idānīm kavinā mukha saṃdhi sūcita sarva vastu jātam nirvahaṇa saṃdhau pratisaṃdhatte

original: yathā vāsmatsaudāminīsamakṣamanayorbhūrivasudevarātayoḥ pravṛtteyaṃ pratijñāvaśyamāvābhyāmapatyasaṃbandhaḥ kartavya iti sūcitaṃ tatsaudāminīvacanasaṃniveśenaiva nirvahaṇe pratisaṃhitam// mālatī/ tatkathamivātra ramaṇīyamiti/ kathamiva hi matpitṛbhūrivasudevarātayorevaṃvidhapariṇāmaprakāra ityāśayaḥ// makarandamādhavau/
analyzed: yathā vā asmad saudāminī samakṣam anayoḥ bhūri vasudeva rātayoḥ pravṛttā iyam pratijñā vaśyam āvābhyām apatya saṃbandhaḥ kartavyaḥ iti sūcitam tat saudāminī vacana saṃniveśena eva nirvahaṇe pratisaṃhitam mālatī tat katham iva atra ramaṇīyam iti katham iva hi mad pitṛ bhūri vasudeva rātayoḥ evaṃvidha pariṇāma prakāraḥ iti āśayaḥ makaranda mādhavau

original: yadvastu yatpāṇigrahaṇarūpaṃ tadanyathā pravṛttaṃ saṃpannam/ vacanaparyāyo vacanakramaścāprakaṭa ityarthaḥ// lavaṅgikā/ bhagavati, pratipannamidānīṃ nigūḍhaṃ vākyatattvaṃ ca bhavati prakaṭavacanāt/ pravṛttikṛtaṃ tatkiṃ kartavyamityāśayaḥ// kāmandakī/ tathaiva janāntikameva vadatīti śeṣaḥ/
analyzed: yat vastu yat pāṇigrahaṇa rūpam tat anyathā pravṛttam saṃpannam vacana paryāyaḥ vacana kramaḥ ca aprakaṭaḥ iti arthaḥ lavaṅgikā bhagavati pratipannam idānīm nigūḍham vākya tattvam ca bhavati prakaṭa vacanāt pravṛtti kṛtam tat kim kartavyam iti āśayaḥ kāmandakī tathā eva jana antikam eva vadati iti śeṣaḥ

original: nandanasyānukūlyaṃ madayantikāmakarandasaṃbandha eva nimittamityāśayaḥ/ pratyastaśaṅkā niḥśaṅkāḥ/ anyathā vastu pravṛttamiti mādhavamakarandābhyāmuktaṃ tadaduttaraṃ prakāśaṃ vadati - vatsāviti/ na khalviti ca/ śrāvakadaśāyāmupadeśasamaye prītyā parigrahāya nānādigantavāstavyajanasāhacaryamāsīditi/ saudāminīsamakṣamiti/
analyzed: nandanasya ānukūlyam madayantikā makaranda saṃbandhaḥ eva nimittam iti āśayaḥ pratyasta śaṅkāḥ niḥśaṅkāḥ anyathā vastu pravṛttam iti mādhava makarandābhyām uktam prakāśam vadati vatsau iti na khalu iti ca śrāvaka daśāyām upadeśa samaye prītyā parigrahāya nānā diganta vāstavya jana sāhacaryam āsīt iti saudāminī samakṣam iti

original: tena saudāminyevātra sākṣiṇī/ yadyathā vastuvyāpārābhyāṃ tasya saṃnidhānameva tatpriyaṃkaratvena/ iyaṃ tu vipatpratīkāraṃ kṛtavatītyāśayaḥ/ avaśyamāvābhyāmapatyasaṃbandhaḥ kartavya ityātmanaḥ pravṛttisamayaniścitaṃ kuṭṭanībhāvaṃ samastalokasamakṣaparisṛtaṃ pṛcchati/ anenaiva sākṣātpratiṣedhaḥ kopāya/ śivastvayamupāya iti nirvahaṇārthaṃ smārayati//
analyzed: tena saudāminī eva atra sākṣiṇī yat yathā vastu vyāpārābhyām tasya saṃnidhānam eva tad priyaṃkara tvena iyam tu vipad pratīkāram kṛtavatī iti āśayaḥ avaśyam āvābhyām apatya saṃbandhaḥ kartavyaḥ iti ātmanaḥ pravṛtti samaya niścitam kuṭṭanī bhāvam samasta loka samakṣa parisṛtam pṛcchati anena eva sākṣāt pratiṣedhaḥ kopāya śivaḥ tu ayam upāyaḥ iti nirvahaṇa artham smārayati

original: mālatī/ aho saṃvaraṇamiti/ aho atyuktau/ saṃvaraṇaṃ hi tadviśeṣatastu bālatvādityādi pratisaṃhitam// makarandamādhavau/ visaṃvādinyo vipralambhakāḥ/ pratyāyinyaḥ pratyayayuktāḥ/ pratyayaśabdasya prabhāvaparyāyatvātprabhāvaśca durghaṭo'pi kāryasya jhaṭiti saṃghaṭanenonneyaḥ/ kalyāṇāḥ śubhāḥ/
analyzed: mālatī aho saṃvaraṇam iti aho atyuktau saṃvaraṇam hi tat viśeṣataḥ tu bāla tvāt ityādi pratisaṃhitam makaranda mādhavau visaṃvādinyaḥ vipralambhakāḥ pratyāyinyaḥ pratyaya yuktāḥ pratyaya śabdasya prabhāva paryāya tvāt prabhāvaḥ ca durghaṭaḥ api kāryasya jhaṭiti saṃghaṭanena unneyaḥ kalyāṇāḥ śubhāḥ

original: jayantīti ca stutau ca kathaṃ bhavatyāḥ sumedhaso nītirviparyasyate/ mukhasaṃdhisūcitamanusaṃdheyam/ kāmandakī/ yatprāgeveti/ kalyāṇaṃ karagrahaṇarūpaṃ puṇyaiḥ prāgācaritairārādeva kārakairmadupakramaiḥ saṃnipatya kārakairmama buddhivyāpāraiḥ karaṇabhūtaistatkalyāṇaṃ phalitam/
analyzed: jayantī iti ca stutau ca katham bhavatyāḥ sumedhasaḥ nītiḥ viparyasyate mukha saṃdhi sūcitam anusaṃdheyam kāmandakī yat prāk eva iti kalyāṇam karagrahaṇa rūpam puṇyaiḥ prāk ācaritaiḥ ārāt eva kārakaiḥ mad upakramaiḥ saṃnipatya kārakaiḥ mama buddhi vyāpāraiḥ karaṇa bhūtaiḥ tat kalyāṇam phalitam

original: tathā śiṣyayorbhūrivasudevarātayorabhimataṃ pāṇigrahaṇaṃ syādityevaṃrūpacintājanyabhedāḥ phalitāḥ/ tadvatpreyaso makarandasya kāntayā madayantikayā saha niṣṇāto nipuṇaḥ samāgamo vihitaḥ kṛtaḥ/ tathā pratyeyau rājanandanāviti yau prākcintitau tau vaḥ saṃprītau saṃjātaprītisaṃyuktau//24//
analyzed: tathā śiṣyayoḥ bhūri vasudeva rātayoḥ abhimatam pāṇigrahaṇam syāt iti evaṃrūpa cintā janya bhedāḥ phalitāḥ tadvat preyasaḥ makarandasya kāntayā madayantikayā saha niṣṇātaḥ nipuṇaḥ samāgamaḥ vihitaḥ kṛtaḥ tathā pratyeyau rāja nandanau iti yau prāk cintitau tau vaḥ saṃprītau saṃjāta prīti saṃyuktau

original: ataḥ kimaparaṃ priyataraṃ kimasti tadapyucyatām/ sādhayāmi ityādipadaiḥ krameṇa viprādiśūdraparyantāśca catvāro varṇā āśaṃsāviṣayāḥ //25//
analyzed: atas kim aparam priyataram kim asti tat api ucyatām sādhayāmi ityādi padaiḥ krameṇa vipra ādi śūdra paryantāḥ ca catvāraḥ varṇāḥ āśaṃsā viṣayāḥ

original: śabarasvāmiprītyā prakaraṇaratnākare tu bhavabhūteḥ/
analyzed: śabarasvāmi prītyā prakaraṇaratnākare tu bhavabhūteḥ

original: sāroddhāre mandaramakṛta kṛtī vyākṛtiṃ nānyaḥ//
analyzed: sāra uddhāre mandaram akṛta kṛtī vyākṛtim nā anyaḥ

original: atidustaro'lpamatinā pāvanakarmaprasādano hi mudā/
analyzed: ati dustara ulpa matinā pāvana karma prasādanaḥ hi mudā

original: hāraṃ hāraṃ vyākhyāmāśritya prakaraṇodadhistīrṇaḥ//
analyzed: hāram hāram vyākhyām āśritya prakaraṇa udadhiḥ tīrṇaḥ

original: iti śrīśilābhaṭṭīyānvayaśrīharicandrasūnostripurāripadāmbhojabhṛṅgāyamānamānasasya śrīnānyadevasya kṛtau mālatīmādhavīyaṭīkāyāṃ daśamāṅkavivaraṇam//
analyzed: iti śrī śilābhaṭṭīya anvaya śrī haricandra sūnoḥ tripurāri pada ambhoja bhṛṅgāyamāna mānasasya śrī nānyadevasya kṛtau mālatīmādhavīya ṭīkāyām daśama aṅka vivaraṇam
